Head and dorsum of the abdomen with sparse fine hairs and scattered long hairs, the hairs of the ventral surface of the abdomen denser. Head longer than wide, narrower at the anterior third, gradually widening posteriorly, widest near the posterior end; the posterior margin slightly concave in the middle; nasus slightly longer than half the length of the head, projecting forwards in profile, the base of the nasus swollen and raised; mandibles without a spine, but the anterolateral angle rather sharp; antennae with 13 segments, the relative lengths of the third and fourth segments variable. Anterior part of the pronotum erect, meeting the posterior part at a right angle; abdomen slender olive-shaped. Small soldier: head yellowish brown, the frons slightly paler, the base of the nasus pale, antennae pale yellow, meso- and metanotal plates and legs brownish yellow; head pear-shaped and rather broad, widest posteriorly; nasus tubular, slightly upturned in profile; the apical tooth of the mandible mostly inconspicuous; antennae with 13 segments, occasionally 14, in the 13-segmented condition the fourth shortest; anterior margin of the pronotum slightly concave in the middle, the posterior margin shallowly arcuately concave in the middle; abdomen olive-shaped.
/species/ahmaditermes-sinuosus/.taxonomy_note: The genus name in the original work is spelt Ahntaditermes; it is now assigned to the genus Ahmaditermes.
/species/ahmaditermes-sinuosus/.worker: Head yellow, abdomen pale yellow, the whole body densely covered with short hairs. Head between round and square, slightly expanded beside the antennal sockets; postclypeus raised, less than half as long as wide; the dorsum of the head with a pale T-shaped suture; antennae with 14 segments, the second longer than the third and fourth. Length of head to the tip of the labrum 0.92–1.33 mm, width of head 0.72–1.03 mm, width of pronotum 0.36–0.53 mm.

/species/ahmaditermes-tiantongensis/.soldier: The small soldier is paler in body colour than the large soldier and also smaller in body size. The length of the head including the nasus is about 1.7 times the width of the head; the median depression of the posterior margin of the head is deeper; the nasus is longer than half the length of the head and extends straight forwards, its tip not upturned in profile; the mandibles lack an apical spine; antennae mostly with 13 segments; the remaining morphology as in the large soldier.

/species/ahmaditermes-xiangyunensis/.soldier: Head and antennae reddish yellow, nasus reddish brown with a paler base, the anterior part of the pronotum reddish brown and the posterior part slightly paler, legs and abdomen yellow. Head with sparse long hairs, the tip of the nasus densely haired, the abdomen with many hairs. Head nearly pear-shaped, widest posteriorly, the posterior margin concave in the middle; nasus tubular, projecting forwards and slightly upturned in profile; mandibular teeth inconspicuous. Antennae with 13 segments, the second, third and fourth of moderate length, the third longest, the second next, the fourth shortest. Pronotum saddle-shaped, its anterior part upturned, the anterior margin concave in the middle. Small soldier: the colour and chaetotaxy of all parts as in the large soldier, the head shape similar but narrower and smaller, the middle of the posterior margin shallowly concave; when the antennae have 12 segments the third is slender and long, longer than the second, equal to or slightly shorter than the fourth; individuals with 13 segments also occur.

/species/ancistrotermes-crassiceps/.distribution: Manfeilong, Jinghong, Yunnan, 640 m above sea level.
/species/ancistrotermes-crassiceps/.soldier: Head yellow, mandibles reddish brown with the basal part pale yellow, labrum yellow, antennae milk-white tinged with smoky, pronotum, abdomen and legs pale yellow. The dorsum of the head with scattered long hairs, the labrum with a pair of apical hairs and the sides with four longitudinal rows of hairs; the margin of the anterior half of the pronotum with long and short hairs alternating, the posterior half and the lateral margins with sparse long hairs. Small soldier: head colour slightly paler than in the large soldier, abdomen and legs the same colour as in the large soldier; the small tooth in front of the basal tooth of the right mandible lies closer to the basal tooth than does the small tooth at the same site in the large soldier.
/species/ancistrotermes-crassiceps/.taxonomy_note: The genus field in the original work is defective, only the letters Anc surviving; the genus is in fact Ancistrotermes, and the genus name is unchanged on this site.

/species/ancistrotermes-dimorphus/.alate: The posterior part of the head deep yellowish brown, mottled with small pale spots; antennae, labrum, postclypeus and legs pale yellow; thorax and abdominal tergites pale yellowish brown, wings brownish yellow. The whole body densely covered with short hairs, the short hairs evenly distributed over the wing membrane. Head nearly round; compound eyes protruding and very large, ocelli large, elongate-oval, the distance between ocellus and compound eye less than half the width of the ocellus; the front of the labrum broadly rounded, its tip and lateral margins transparent; postclypeus raised very high, about half as long as wide. Antennae with 18 segments, the third and fourth shortest, the fifth and sixth shorter than the second. Pronotum broad in front and narrow behind, the anterior and posterior margins concave in the middle; the posterior margin of the mesonotum deeply concave. Forewing: media arising independently at the humeral suture, between the radial sector and the cubitus, the distal few branches indistinct, the cubitus with more than ten branches; hindwing: media arising from the radial sector behind the humeral suture, the rest of the venation as in the forewing.
/species/ancistrotermes-dimorphus/.distribution: Tingliang, Chongzuo and Longzhou, Guangxi; Hekou (90 m), Mengla, Jinping (380–510 m), Daweishan, Pingbian (1200 m), Qinglongchang, Yuanjiang and Jinghong (500 m), Yunnan.
/species/ancistrotermes-dimorphus/.soldier: Head yellow, mandibles reddish brown with the basal part the same colour as the head, abdomen pale yellow. The anterior margin of the labrum with a few long hairs. Head between round and square, widest in front, the lateral and posterior margins slightly arcuate, the posterolateral angles rounded, the dorsum of the head raised like a hump. Labrum narrowly triangular, nearly as long as wide, its front bluntly rounded; the front of the mandibles curved inwards, each mandible with a basal tooth at its base, and a minute tooth-granule in front of the basal tooth of the right mandible. Antennae with 15 segments, rarely 16; the second shorter than the third and fourth together, the third slightly shorter than the fourth. Anterior part of the pronotum slightly raised, the anterior and posterior margins concave in the middle. Small soldier: body and head colour as in the large soldier, abdomen greyish white and opaque, the whole body covered with scattered short hairs, the morphology of all parts resembling that of the large soldier.

/species/ancistrotermes-ganlanbaensis/.distribution: Jinghong, Yunnan, 500 m above sea level.
/species/ancistrotermes-ganlanbaensis/.soldier: Head yellow, mandibles reddish brown with the basal third deep yellow, labrum pale yellow, antennae milk-white with a pale yellow ring at the front of each segment, pronotum, abdomen and legs pale yellow. Head with several scattered long hairs; the front and the lateral margins of the labrum transparent, with a pair of apical hairs and three to four pairs of hairs in longitudinal rows on each side; the margin of the pronotum with sparse long hairs. Head nearly square-rounded, widest in the middle; in profile raised like a hump in the middle of the head towards the front. Labrum tongue-shaped, its tip bluntly rounded. The front of the mandibles slender and curved inwards, each with a minute tooth-granule at the middle of its inner margin; the left basal tooth larger than the right, with a small tooth-granule within the concave edge of the basal tooth; a slightly larger denticle in front of the basal tooth of the right mandible. The widest part of the postmentum lies at the posterior third. Antennae with 15 segments, the third shortest. The middle of the pronotum depressed, the anterior and posterior parts slightly raised, the anterior and posterior margins concave in the middle. Small soldier: body and head colour as in the large soldier, except that the denticle within the concave edge of the basal tooth of the left mandible is slightly larger than that at the same site in the large soldier.

/species/ancistrotermes-hekouensis/.distribution: Hekou, Yunnan, 110 m above sea level.
/species/ancistrotermes-hekouensis/.soldier: The large soldier is deep yellow in body colour, with a pair of apical hairs at the front of the labrum and four to five pairs of hairs in longitudinal rows on each side. Head round, widest in the middle; labrum nearly triangular, its tip bluntly rounded; each mandible with a minute tooth-granule at the middle of its inner margin; the small tooth in front of the basal tooth of the right mandible larger than the pointed process of the basal tooth of the left mandible; postmentum raised, widest in the middle. Antennae with 16 segments, the fourth shortest. The sides of the pronotum slightly broadly rounded, the anterior margin concave in the middle, the posterolateral margins contracted, the posterior margin slightly concave in the middle. Small soldier: body and head colour paler than in the large soldier, the antennal colour similar, the morphology of all parts similar to that of the large soldier, except that the inner margin of the basal tooth of the left mandible bears one small tooth and one minute pointed process, whereas the corresponding site in the large soldier bears only one minute pointed process.

/species/ancistrotermes-menglianensis/.distribution: Menglian, Yunnan, 1020 m above sea level.
/species/ancistrotermes-menglianensis/.soldier: Head oval, broad in the middle; labrum tongue-shaped, its tip bluntly rounded; each mandible with a minute marginal tooth near the middle and a denticle on the inner margin of the basal tooth; behind the denticle of the right mandible there is occasionally another minute pointed process; postmentum widest in the middle. Antennae with 16 segments, the fourth shortest. The anterior margin of the pronotum concave in the middle, the posterior margin nearly straight. In the small soldier the head and the body colour are paler than in the large soldier, and the morphology of all parts is similar to that of the large soldier.

/species/ancistrotermes-xiai/.distribution: Menglun, Mengla, Yunnan, 600 m above sea level.
/species/ancistrotermes-xiai/.soldier: Head deep yellow, mandibles reddish brown with the basal part nearly the same colour as the head, labrum darker than the head, antennae pale yellow tinged with smoky, pronotum and abdomen pale yellow, legs milk-white. Head with scattered long hairs; labrum with a pair of apical hairs and, from the tip of the labrum to the middle, three to four pairs of hairs in longitudinal rows on each side; the margin of the pronotum with long and short hairs alternating. Head nearly obovate, widest from behind the antennal carinae to before the middle of the head, the posterior margin slightly arcuate outwards; labrum tongue-shaped, its front bluntly rounded. Mandibles rather thick and straight, their front curved inwards, each with a marginal tooth-granule towards the front of the middle, and a denticle at the side of the basal tooth, the right denticle larger than the left. Postmentum raised, rounded spoon-shaped. Antennae with 15 segments, the third shortest. The anterior half of the pronotum upturned, slightly concave in the middle, the posterior margin nearly straight. Small soldier: head pale yellow, labrum yellow, mandibles reddish brown with the basal part the same colour as the head; antennae, pronotum, abdomen and legs all paler than in the large soldier; the shape of the head, the mandibles and the features of the pronotum similar to those of the large soldier.

/species/arcotermes-tubus/.soldier: Head pale yellowish brown, nasus reddish brown, antennae, mouthparts and tarsi the same colour as the head, thorax, abdomen and legs pale yellowish white, the anterior half of the pronotum slightly darker. The posterior part of the top of the head with a pair of long hairs, the tip of the nasus with four longer hairs and fine short hairs, and several hairs near the base of the nasus; the hairs of the thorax and abdomen fine and short. Head elongate, the lateral margins slightly constricted behind the antennal sockets and then widened again, the posterior margin without a median notch, pear-shaped in dorsal view; nasus rather short, almost in a straight line with the top of the head; mandibles without a spine; antennae with 13 segments, the second and third nearly equal in length and longer than the fourth. Pronotum saddle-shaped, about half as wide as the head, the anterior margin upturned and slightly concave in the middle, the posterior margin almost straight.

/species/coptotermes-chaoxianensis/.alate: Alate: head brown, paler behind, labrum, antennae and pronotum yellowish brown, abdomen black, ocelli yellowish white. Head, pronotum and forewing scales with rather dense erect bristles. Head outline nearly round, a distinct elongate yellow patch between the ocelli, a crescent-shaped yellow patch faintly visible on the inner side in front of each ocellus; compound eyes oval, ocelli elongate-oval, the distance from the compound eye to the lower margin of the head almost equal to the short diameter of the ocellus. Antennae with 19–20 segments, the third or fourth shorter. Anterior margin of the pronotum a broad shallow concavity, the posterior margin slightly concave in the middle. Wing membrane densely covered with fine hairs, the media and cubitus very weak, the veins indistinct; in the forewing the media arising independently at the humeral suture and close to the cubitus, with a faint three-branched fork at its posterior end, the cubitus with eight branches; in the hindwing the media arising from the base of the radial sector, followed by two faint branches, the cubitus with 8–9 branches.
/species/coptotermes-chaoxianensis/.soldier: Soldier: the shape of the head varies, the elongate-oval form making up about 80 per cent and the round form about 20 per cent; in round individuals the head is slightly shorter but distinctly broader and the postmentum shorter, the remaining characters being very similar in the two. Head and antennae orange-yellow, mandibles reddish brown, thoracic and abdominal tergites pale yellow. The sides of the fontanelle mostly with two bristles each, one bristle between the antenna and the fontanelle; the margin of the pronotum with sparse long bristles, the posterior half of the disc with several short hairs, the bristles of the abdominal tergites longer and denser. Whether elongate-oval or round, the head is widest at the middle, the lateral margins rounded, the posterior margin rounded out. Mandibles rather straight, their tips not distinctly curved; labrum longer than wide, reaching the middle of the mandibles; the aperture not visible in dorsal view, the aperture triangular, narrow above and broad below. Antennae with 15 segments, the 3rd and 4th almost equal or the 3rd shorter and smaller. In the elongate-oval form the waist of the postmentum lies slightly below the middle between the widest part and the posterior margin, whereas in the round form the waist clearly lies at the posterior end. Anterior margin of the pronotum with a distinct median concavity, the posterior margin slightly concave but very indistinctly so.

/species/coptotermes-cyclocoryphus/.soldier: Soldier: the head shape occurs in a round and an elongate form. Head and antennae pale yellow, mandibles deep brown, abdomen greyish white. The dorsum of the head sparsely haired, the disc of the thoracic and abdominal tergites also sparsely haired, the margins slightly denser and arranged in rows; the labrum with two apical hairs and two lateral-apical hairs, the lateral-apical hairs sometimes absent; the fontanelle hairs mostly two on each side, occasionally three or one on one side. In the round form the dorsum of the head is circular, slightly contracted at the front, the fontanelle ridge trapezoidal, the fontanelle aperture semicircular and inclined backwards, arched in profile; the labrum longer than wide, elongate-triangular, with a transparent tip, evenly rounded and contracted on both sides at the base; mandibles sickle-shaped, their tips only slightly curved, the base of the left mandible with four faint tooth processes, the foremost at three-eighths of the total length from the base; antennae with 15 segments, the third shortest; postmentum broad, its anterior part evenly rounded and swollen on both sides, narrowest at four-sevenths from the base. Anterior margin of the pronotum concave in the middle, the posterior margin slightly concave in the middle, the anterior lateral angles evenly rounded, the sides straight. In the elongate form the dorsum of the head is elongate-oval, narrower and longer than in the round form and higher in profile, the labrum longer, the postmentum narrow and long, narrowest at two-fifths from the base, the fontanelle narrower and higher.

/species/coptotermes-dimorphus/.alate: Alate: head yellowish brown, mandibles deep brown, antennae deep yellow, compound eyes black, ocelli deep yellow, with pale markings on the inner side in front of the ocelli; thorax and abdomen slightly paler than the head, wing scales darker than the thorax, wings pale yellow. Head covered with sparse long hairs and scattered short hairs, the labrum and postclypeus with symmetrical long and short hairs, the long and short hairs around the pronotum rather densely arranged, the wing scales with very few hairs, the wing membrane covered with neatly arranged rows of short hairs. Head outline approaching circular, the posterior margin broad and rounded, its dorsal margin rather straight in profile; labrum tongue-shaped and rather arched, widest behind the middle; postclypeus slightly raised, its anterior margin slightly concave, the posterior margin arcuate, less than half as long as wide; compound eyes circular, ocelli narrowly oval, their long diameter greater than half the short diameter of the compound eye and their short diameter less than one-third of the short diameter of the compound eye, closer to the compound eye, the markings on the inner side in front of the two ocelli crescent-shaped; fontanelle small; antennae with 21 segments, the second and fourth nearly equal in length, the third shortest. The first marginal tooth of the left mandible shorter than the second marginal tooth and the apical tooth; the first marginal tooth of the right mandible projecting beyond the second marginal tooth and the apical tooth, the subapical tooth at the base of its anterior margin faint. Pronotum rather broad, the middle of the anterior margin rather straight, the median notch rather narrow; the median notch of the posterior margin slightly broader; the middle of the posterior margins of the meso- and metanotum shallowly concave, with a small spherical process in the centre of the notch. Wings narrow and long; in the forewing the media arising within the wing scale near the basal suture and closer to the cubitus, branched near the middle and at the end, the cubitus with 8–9 branches; the forewing scale longer than the hindwing scale. Tibial spur formula 3:2:2.
/species/coptotermes-dimorphus/.soldier: Soldier: the head occurs in a long pear-shaped and a round pear-shaped form. Head pale yellowish brown, mandibles reddish brown, antennae dull yellow, thorax and abdomen milky yellow. The head with only a few long hairs, the fontanelle with a pair of hairs, the labrum with only a pair of apical hairs; the pronotum with rather few long hairs along its margin, the hairs of the abdomen sparse and arranged in rows, the posterior row denser. In the long pear-shaped form the head (to the base of the mandibles) is longer than wide, widest behind the middle, the posterior margin narrowly rounded, the posterior part of the dorsal margin slightly arched in profile, the postmentum projecting slightly downwards; mandibles stout, their tips curved inwards with the curved end slender and long, the basal half rather straight, the outer margin wavy near the base; labrum broadly spear-shaped, widest behind the middle, the transparent area triangular; the inner margin of the fontanelle aperture nearly semicircular, the upper end slightly inclined backwards in profile; antennae with 15–16 segments, segments 2, 3 and 4 nearly equal in length, segment 3 slightly shorter in a few individuals; postmentum narrow and long, the lateral margin before the widest part slightly concave near the base, narrowest behind the middle, the surface flat. The pronotum longer than half its width, its anterior lateral margins projecting as obtuse angles, the middle of the anterior margin slightly projecting, the median notch narrow and deep, the middle of the posterior margin slightly concave; tibial spur formula 3:2:2. The round pear-shaped head is broader, widest near the posterior end, the posterior margin broadly rounded, the dorsal margin slightly arched near the middle in profile, the postmentum distinctly short and broad, the lateral margin before the widest part slightly concave near the base, narrowest behind the middle, the rest similar to the long pear-shaped form.

/species/coptotermes-formosanus/.alate: Alate: the dorsum of the head deep yellowish brown, the dorsum of the thorax and abdomen brownish yellow and paler than the head, the venter of the abdomen yellow, the wings tinged with pale yellow. Compound eyes nearly round, ocelli elongate-round, the distance between the ocellus and the compound eye less than the width of the ocellus itself. Postclypeus extremely short, forming a transverse band, pale yellow and slightly raised, about one-quarter to one-third as long as wide; anteclypeus white and longer than the postclypeus; labrum pale yellow, rounded at the front. Antennae with 19–21 segments, mostly the third or fourth shorter. Head oval, widest behind the middle, narrower at both the anterior and posterior ends than at the middle; fontanelle aperture oval, narrow above and broad below, large and conspicuous, situated on a slightly projecting short tube at the front of the head and facing forwards. Mandibles sickle-shaped, their anterior part curved towards the midline, the base of the left mandible with a deep notch, in front of which are four small processes, successively smaller towards the front, the foremost behind the middle of the mandible, the rest of the mandibular surface smooth and toothless. Labrum nearly tongue-shaped, its front with an indistinct transparent point reaching half the length of the closed mandibles. Pronotum flat, narrower than the head, with a notch in the middle of both the anterior and posterior margins. Forewing scale larger than the hindwing scale, the wing membrane densely covered with fine short hairs; in the forewing the media arising independently at the humeral suture and closer to the cubitus than to the radial sector, the cubitus with 6–8 branches; in the hindwing the media arising from the base of the radial sector and, after arising, closer to the cubitus than to the radial sector, the cubitus with 7–8 branches.
/species/coptotermes-formosanus/.distribution: In China distributed in the eastern part of the country, the northern limit roughly along and south of the line from Hefei, Chaoxian and Wuhu, Anhui, to Jianhu, Jiangsu, south of the Huai River at about 32–39° N; abroad recorded from Japan, the Philippines, the southern states of the United States, Hawaii and Africa.
/species/coptotermes-formosanus/.soldier: Soldier: head and antennae pale yellow, mandibles blackish brown, abdomen milky white. The width of the head changes markedly with the age of the colony: in young colonies less than two and a half years old the head width is generally less than 0.99 mm, while after the colony matures the body gradually becomes larger, and in colonies that have developed for twenty years the head width may reach 1.16–1.25 mm, mature colonies being more than one-quarter broader than young ones; in addition, the pronotum and the number of antennal segments also increase with the development of the colony.

/species/coptotermes-gestroi/.distribution: Zhangfeng, Longchuan and Hongguang Farm, Yuanjiang, Yunnan; abroad recorded from Myanmar, Thailand, Malaya, Singapore and India.

/species/coptotermes-grandis/.soldier: Soldier: body large, the largest known at present in the genus Coptotermes in China. Head deep yellow, the antennal carinae and fontanelle tube brown, antennae and labrum yellowish brown, mandibles chestnut brown with the base reddish brown, thorax yellow, abdomen pale yellow. The sides of the fontanelle mostly with two bristles each, mostly one bristle between the antennal socket and the fontanelle, in a few individuals one on one side and absent on the other; the head with only a few scattered short bristles, the tip of the labrum with two, the disc occasionally with one or two; the margin of the pronotum with sparse slender bristles, the disc with several scattered short bristles, the abdominal tergites with many long bristles. Head oval, narrow in front and broad behind, widest near the base, the two posterolateral angles rounded, the posterior margin almost straight. Mandibles large and stout, their tips rather curved; labrum longer than wide, narrowing from the anterior third, smallest and not pointed at the tip, reaching the middle of the mandibles when closed. The fontanelle extends as a short tube, the aperture not visible in dorsal view, the fontanelle aperture nearly circular. Antennae with 15 segments, the third slightly smaller. Postmentum rather long, the waist narrowest between the widest part and the posterior margin, the width of the waist almost equal to that of the anterior margin. The middle of the anterior margin of the pronotum is a broad concavity, the posterior margin slightly incised.

/species/coptotermes-guangdongensis/.soldier: Soldier: head yellowish brown, thorax and abdomen pale yellow. The lateral margins of the fontanelle with two pairs of hairs, the disc of the pronotum with about ten hairs. Head pear-shaped, the fontanelle aperture roundly arched, the aperture vertical in profile, rising gradually from the top of the aperture to the dorsal margin of the head, the top of the head rather flat; antennae with 14 segments (the specimen is broken); labrum spear-shaped, the apical and subapical hairs both rather long; mandibles slender and curved, the outer margin slightly constricted near the base, the left mandible about 69–70 per cent of the length of the head capsule; postmentum rather long, its surface rather flat, the waist region at about the posterior third. The concavities of the anterior and posterior margins of the pronotum are both rather distinct. Length of the hind tibia 1.10–1.15 mm.

/species/coptotermes-gulangyuensis/.soldier: Soldier: the head shape varies markedly, two forms, elongate-oval and nearly circular, occurring in the same colony, elongate-oval individuals making up about 80 per cent. In circular individuals the head is short and broad and the postmentum distinctly shorter, the remaining characters differing little. Head, antennae and labrum pale yellow, the antennal carinae and fontanelle tube reddish brown, mandibles reddish brown, legs and abdomen pale white. The head with scattered long and short hairs, the sides of the fontanelle with two long bristles each; the labrum, besides two apical hairs, often with lateral-apical hairs and disc hairs; the pronotum with more bristles than the head, the bristles of the abdominal tergites rather dense. The elongate-oval head is mostly widest at the basal third, the circular head widest at the middle. Fontanelle aperture oval, projecting as a short tube, the aperture not visible in dorsal view, in profile slightly approaching vertical. Mandibles sickle-shaped, their tips curved inwards, the base of the left mandible with three to four serrations, increasing in size from front to back. Labrum like an equilateral triangle, slightly longer than wide or almost equal, its transparent tip projecting as a point. Antennae with 15–16 segments, mostly 15, the third short and small. In the elongate-oval form the postmentum is rather short, the waist between the widest part and the posterior margin; in the circular form the postmentum is shorter still and the waist near the posterior end. The middle of the anterior margin of the pronotum is slightly concave, the middle of the posterior margin indistinctly concave.

/species/coptotermes-hainanensis/.alate: Alate: head pale yellowish brown, mandibles reddish brown with the base paler, antennae yellow, compound eyes black, the markings on the inner side in front of the ocelli rather indistinct and distinctly paler than the head, the margin of the pronotum dull yellow and the disc pale yellow, wing scales deep yellow, meso- and metathorax and abdomen pale yellow. The long hairs of the head evenly distributed, the short hairs sparse, the dorsum of the pronotum rather densely haired and bearing long hairs, the wing membrane rather densely haired.
/species/coptotermes-hainanensis/.soldier: Soldier dimorphic. Head brownish yellow, mandibles reddish brown, pronotum paler than the head, meso- and metathorax and abdomen nearly milky white. The pilosity of the head sparse, the fontanelle with two pairs of hairs, hairs between the fontanelle and the antennal sockets, the labrum with apical and subapical hairs, the disc hairs generally visible as two pairs, the pronotum rather sparsely haired. The oval head rather narrow and long, longer than its greatest width, widest near the middle, the middle of the posterior margin slightly projecting, the middle of the dorsal margin slightly concave in profile, the postmentum projecting rather downwards; the inner margin of the fontanelle aperture nearly triangular, its height slightly less than its width, the top slightly inclined backwards in profile; the tips of the mandibles curved inwards with the curved end extending rather long, the base of the outer margin slightly projecting; labrum long spear-shaped, widest near the posterior part, the transparent area small and obtusely triangular; antennae with 16 segments, the second larger than the fourth, the third shortest; postmentum narrow and long, the oblique margin before the widest part nearly straight, the waist rather narrow with its narrowest part posterior. The pronotum rather narrow, broader at the anterior part of both sides, the median notch of the anterior margin deep and wide, the median notch of the posterior margin shallow and narrow. Tibial spur formula 3:2:2. The circular head is distinctly broader, its width only slightly less than the length of the head, the posterior margin nearly round, widest at the middle, the middle of the dorsal margin arcuate in profile, the anterior part of the postmentum rather low and flat, the middle rather raised and slightly inclined backwards, the waist rather narrow with its narrowest part posterior, the labrum slightly broad and spear-shaped, the rest similar to the oval form.

/species/coptotermes-longistriatus/.soldier: Soldier: head, labrum, antennae and pronotum all yellow, the antennal carinae and fontanelle tube brownish yellow, mandibles reddish brown with the base yellowish brown. The sides of the fontanelle with two bristles each, in a few specimens only one on one side; one bristle between the fontanelle and the antennal socket, or absent; the head with very few bristles, the margin of the pronotum with a few sparse ones and the disc with several scattered ones, the abdominal tergites with rather dense long bristles arranged in a row along the posterior margin. In dorsal view a distinct long white band runs along the midline from the posterior half of the pronotum to the end of the abdominal tergites. Head oval, narrow in front and broad behind, widest at the posterior third, the two posterolateral angles and the posterior margin slightly rounded out. Mandibles stout and rather short and straight, their tips slightly curved; labrum longer than wide, its anterior contracted part rather short, almost reaching the middle of the mandibles when closed; the aperture not visible in dorsal view, the fontanelle aperture triangular, narrow in front and broad behind. Antennae with 15 segments, the third and fourth almost equal and the third slightly smaller. The waist of the postmentum clearly lies at the posterior end. The anterior margin of the pronotum rather straight or forming an indistinct shallow concavity, the posterior margin slightly concave.

/species/coptotermes-melanoistriatus/.distribution: Kam Tsin Village, Fanling, New Territories, Hong Kong.
/species/coptotermes-melanoistriatus/.soldier: Soldier: head deep yellow, thorax and abdomen slightly paler than the head, legs pale yellow, antennae dull yellow, two black bands on either side of the dorsal midline of the abdomen. The dorsum of the head and thorax with few hairs, the sides of the fontanelle with two hairs each, one hair between the fontanelle and each antennal socket, the tip of the labrum with a pair of apical hairs and a pair of subapical hairs and the disc with one pair, the dorsal margin of the abdomen with a few scattered short hairs. Head broadly oval, the sides and the middle of the posterior margin rather straight, appearing rather broad in proportion to its length. Fontanelle aperture nearly circular. Labrum rather narrow and long, its transparent tip projecting as an obtuse angle. Mandibles slender and long, their tips curved inwards. Antennae with 15 segments, the second larger than the third and the third smaller than the fourth. The surface of the postmentum with uneven transverse wrinkles, the widest area slightly raised, the oblique margins from the widest part to the anterior margin slightly concave near the posterior part, the narrowest part slightly behind the middle, the length of the postmentum slightly more than twice its greatest width. The middle of the anterior margin of the pronotum rather projecting, the median notch rather shallow and narrow, the median notch of the posterior margin broad and shallow. Length of the hind tibia 1.152–1.20 mm, spur formula 3:2:2.

/species/coptotermes-monosetosus/.alate: Alate: head and pronotum reddish brown, antennae yellowish brown, compound eyes purple-black, labrum and ocelli yellowish white, wings pale yellowish white. Head and pronotum bearing rather many rather long bristles, the bristles of the pronotum especially more numerous than those of the head, the body colour also deeper than that of the head.
/species/coptotermes-monosetosus/.soldier: Soldier: in the same colony about 90 per cent of individuals have the head longer than wide and oval, while a few are nearly circular with the width and length almost equal, differing only in the broader head and shorter postmentum, with no other obvious differences. Head, labrum, antennae and pronotum yellow, mandibles reddish brown, abdomen yellowish white. The sides of the fontanelle mostly with one bristle each, absent on one side in a few individuals; no hairs between the antennae and the fontanelle, the head almost hairless, the labrum with two apical hairs, the margin of the pronotum with only a few bristles and the disc hairless, the abdominal tergites with rather many rather long erect bristles. The elongate-oval head is widest at the basal third, the circular head widest at the middle, the lateral margins rounded out in both forms, the posterior margin rounded. Mandibles rather short and straight, their tips slightly curved; labrum distinctly longer than wide, reaching more than half the length of the closed mandibles; fontanelle tube rather short, the aperture visible in dorsal view, the fontanelle aperture nearly oval. Antennae with 14–15 segments: with 14 segments the third and fourth are almost equal, with 15 segments the third is especially short. In the elongate-oval form the waist of the postmentum lies between the widest part and the posterior margin, in the circular form the waist clearly at the posterior end, the waist in both being wider than the anterior margin. The middle of the anterior margin of the pronotum is a broad concavity, the posterior margin very indistinctly concave.

/species/coptotermes-shanghaiensis/.alate: Alate: head pale yellowish brown, a pair of indistinct pale markings on the inner side in front of the ocelli, with another pair of distinct pale markings inside them; pronotum dull yellow, abdomen yellow, wing scales pale brown, wings pale yellow. The body covered with sparse long hairs and rather dense short hairs, the wing scales with a few long hairs, the wings covered with rather dense irregularly arranged short hairs. Head nearly circular, its dorsum flat and slightly inclined backwards; labrum broadly tongue-shaped; postclypeus nearly half as long as wide, the middle of its posterior margin slightly concave, with a median longitudinal suture; compound eyes nearly round, ocelli oval, fontanelle circular; antennae with 19 segments, the second larger than the fourth, the third shorter than the fourth. On the left mandible the anterior margin of the first marginal tooth is longer than half the posterior margin of the apical tooth, its posterior margin slightly longer than half the anterior margin of the second marginal tooth, and the posterior margin of the second marginal tooth slightly shorter than the anterior margin of the third marginal tooth; on the right mandible the anterior margin of the first marginal tooth bears a distinct subapical tooth, the posterior margin of the second marginal tooth wavy. The pronotum slightly longer than half its width, the sides arcuate, widest near the middle or slightly in front, the median notch of the anterior margin shallow and broad, the middle of the posterior margin distinctly concave, the middle of the posterior margins of the meso- and metanotum deeply concave with the sides projecting posteriorly as obtuse angles. Wings distinctly rather narrow; in the forewing the media arising independently at the humeral suture and closer to the cubitus, with one branch at the middle and one at the end, the cubitus with 8–9 branches; the hindwing broader than the forewing, its media arising from the radial sector beyond the wing scale. Tibial spur formula 3:2:2.
/species/coptotermes-shanghaiensis/.soldier: Soldier: the base of the mandibles projects as a wavy edge, the labrum broadly spear-shaped, widest towards the posterior part, contracted at the tip, the transparent area triangular. The inner margin of the fontanelle aperture triangular, its basal width and height nearly equal, the rim almost vertical in profile. Antennae with 14 segments, the second larger than the fourth, the third shortest. Postmentum rather narrow and long, its widest part arched spherically, the oblique margins slightly concave near the middle; the narrowest waist situated near the posterior end; seen from the side, the anterior dorsal margin is rather straight, while the ventral margin bulges slightly at the widest part of the postmentum. The pronotum rather flat and extended, its length slightly more than half its width; the lateral margins broader in the anterior part, the middle of the anterior margin projecting slightly forwards and concave downwards, the notch both shallow and broad; the posterior margin narrower than the anterior, broadly straight, only slightly concave at the very middle. The hind tibia rather short, the arrangement of the spurs on each leg being three, two, two.

/species/coptotermes-varicapitatus/.soldier: Soldier: the head shape varies into two forms, elongate-oval and nearly circular. The elongate-oval form again occurs in two sizes, in the same colony the former making up about 70 per cent, the small elongate-oval form about 10 per cent and the nearly circular form about 20 per cent; nearly circular individuals differ only in having the broadest and largest head and a distinctly shorter postmentum, the remaining characters being very similar. Head, antennae and labrum yellow, mandibles reddish brown, pronotum pale yellow and paler in its posterior half, meso- and metathorax and abdominal tergites pale white. The sides of the fontanelle with two distinct bristles each, mostly one bristle between the antennal socket and the fontanelle, the head almost hairless, the disc with scattered short bristles, the hairs of the abdominal tergites rather long and rather dense. Mandibles rather straight, their tips only slightly curved; labrum longer than wide, slightly narrow in front; the fontanelle extending as a short tube, the aperture not visible in dorsal view, the fontanelle aperture nearly triangular. Antennae with 15 segments, the 3rd slightly short and small, or the 3rd and 4th almost equal. In the elongate-oval form the waist of the postmentum lies near the middle but towards the posterior, in the circular form the waist clearly at the posterior end. The anterior margin of the pronotum distinctly concave, the posterior margin indistinctly concave.

/species/cryptotermes-angustinotus/.alate: Head reddish brown, anteclypeus pale brownish yellow, labrum pale reddish brown, mandibles brownish yellow with the teeth darker, pronotum deeper than the head, wings greyish brown with the anterior margin reddish brown. Head nearly rectangular, the sides parallel, the posterior margin arcuate, the median arm of the epicranial suture visible. Compound eyes moderately projecting, nearly circular; ocelli mostly elongate-oval, close to the compound eyes but not touching them, the antennal spot distinct. The frons slightly uneven, with oblique shallow grooves on both sides. The distance from the compound eye to the antennal socket less than the short diameter of the ocellus, the distance from the compound eye to the lower margin of the head about two-thirds of the long diameter of the compound eye. Anteclypeus trapezoidal, labrum broad and arched. Left mandible with two marginal teeth, the first smaller with a sharp tip, the second broader; right mandible with two marginal teeth, the first pointed, the second forming an obtuse angle, the two teeth set very close together. Antennae with 14–15 segments, the second or third slightly longer than the fourth. Pronotum slightly narrower than the head, the middle of the anterior margin shallowly concave, the middle of the posterior margin distinctly concave, the sides arcuate, the anterolateral angles narrowly rounded, the posterolateral angles broadly rounded. Fore- and hindwing scales unequal, the anterior scale often larger than the posterior; in the forewing the subcosta rather short, the radius reaching about one-quarter of the wing length, the radial sector extending to the wing tip and giving off several branches, the media arising independently at the humeral suture, for the most part close to the cubitus, turning towards the radial sector at about three-quarters of the wing length and joining it, the cubitus with about ten or more branches.
/species/cryptotermes-angustinotus/.soldier: The front of the head blackish brown, becoming paler behind the frontal ridges and turning brown at the posterior margin; labrum and antennae brownish yellow; pronotum pale brown, slightly deeper in front and deepest near the anterior margin. Head nearly square, short and thick, the median arm of the Y suture clearly visible. The frontal region shovel-shaped, its surface wrinkled, the frontal ridges raised with a median depression dividing the frontal surface into left and right halves, oblique wrinkles densely covering the slope from the frontal ridges to the top of the head. A horn-like process above and below each antennal socket; the eye beside the antennal socket, oval, rather large and projecting. Mandibles short, swollen at the base, the left mandible with two marginal teeth, the first directed obliquely forwards, the second low and stout, the right mandible also with two, the first facing inwards and obtusely angular, the second blunter. Labrum short, tongue-shaped. Antennae with 13–15 segments. The anterior margin of the pronotum concave in a broad V, the concave edge not smooth but set with fine teeth, the anterior part slightly upturned, the posterolateral margins nearly parallel, the posterior margin mostly straight, the median longitudinal line visible.

/species/cryptotermes-declivis/.alate: Head reddish brown, antennae, maxillary palps and labrum brownish yellow, thorax, abdomen and femora blackish brown, tibiae and tarsi pale yellow, wings yellowish brown. Head nearly rectangular, the sides parallel, the posterior margin arcuate. Compound eyes small, nearly circular; ocelli elongate-round, situated above the compound eyes, close to them but not touching. Postclypeus a short transverse band, its boundary with the frons indistinct, not raised, its anterior margin straight; anteclypeus trapezoidal. Antennae with 14–16 segments, the second, third and fourth of about equal length, or the second and third about equal and the fourth shorter. Pronotum as wide as the head, the anterior margin concave, the middle of the posterior margin slightly concave. Fore- and hindwing scales unequal in size, the anterior scale covering the posterior. In the forewing the subcosta extremely short, the radius reaching about one-third of the wing length, the radial sector extending to the wing tip and connected with the anterior margin by about seven short branches from base to tip; the media arising independently at the humeral suture, at first close to the cubitus, turning at one-half to three-quarters of the wing length and joining the radial sector, the cubitus with more than ten branches in all.
/species/cryptotermes-declivis/.distribution: Recorded from Zhejiang, Yunxiao in Fujian, Sichuan, Guizhou, Yunnan, Guangxi and Hainan; localities in Guangdong include Chaozhou, Dongguan, Guangzhou, Foshan, Xinhui, Longgangzui in Taishan, Ruyuan, Lianshan, Dinghu and Xiqiaoshan.
/species/cryptotermes-declivis/.soldier: Head black in front, dark red behind, antennae, thorax and abdomen pale yellow. Head short and thick, nearly square; the frons is not vertically truncate but forms an inclined slope, the angle between the slope and the mandibles distinctly greater than a right angle. Raised frontal ridges border the slope on both sides and above, the space between the ridges concave in the middle, so that the frons is divided into left and right halves; the rest of the head smooth, the wrinkles inconspicuous. A large shallow pit in the middle of the top of the head. A stout process projects forwards above and another below the inside of each antennal socket, the upper conical, the lower flattened, the two of similar size. The posterior part of the labrum transverse, its anterior part with the two margins converging into a triangle. Antennae with 11–15 segments; the eye situated on the side wall behind the antennal socket. Mandibles short and small, flat and broad, the middle of the left mandible with two low large teeth, the first slightly oblique forwards, the second facing inwards, the two teeth of the right mandible facing forwards and situated slightly further back. The pronotum about as wide as the head, the middle of the anterior margin deeply concave in a broad V, the lateral angles projecting forwards and slightly upturned, covering the back of the head, the middle of the posterior margin slightly concave forwards.

/species/cryptotermes-domesticus/.alate: Head dull yellow, thorax, abdomen, legs and antennae pale yellow, wing scales and veins dull yellow, the membranous wings transparent and colourless. Head rectangular, compound eyes small, ocelli situated above and immediately adjacent to them; anteclypeus about twice the length of the postclypeus; antennae with 16 segments, the third, fourth and fifth equal to one another and slightly shorter than the second; a pale spot above each antennal socket, larger than the ocellus. Pronotum as wide as the head or slightly wider, the middle of both the anterior and posterior margins concave inwards. Forewing scale distinctly larger than the hindwing scale and covering part of the latter. Forewing vein Ss extremely short or absent, R reaching about one-third of the wing length, Rs with 7–8 branches; M arising independently at the humeral suture, before the middle of the wing closer to Cu than to Rs, thereafter turning forwards and joining Rs at three-quarters or two-thirds of the wing length. Hindwing vein R extending beyond one-third of the wing length, to about one-half, Rs with about 5–6 branches, M arising from the base of Rs behind the humeral suture, the rest as in the forewing.
/species/cryptotermes-domesticus/.distribution: In China recorded from Nanning, Guangxi; Xuwen and Zhanjiang, Guangdong; Hekou, Yunnan; Wanning, Wenchang, Baoting, Yaxian, Danxian, Haikou, Chengmai and Fushan, Hainan; and Taiwan. Abroad distributed in India, Thailand, the Malay Peninsula, Indonesia (Sumatra, Kalimantan), Singapore, and in the Pacific region the Mariana Islands, Papua New Guinea, the Solomon Islands, the Fiji Islands, Fanning Island and the Marquesas Islands.
/species/cryptotermes-domesticus/.soldier: The anterior part of the head pitch-black, gradually turning reddish brown backwards; mandibles pure black, the first and second antennal segments brown, the remaining segments pale yellow; thorax and abdomen pale yellow, the anterior half of the pronotum tinged with brownish yellow. The head capsule thick and nearly square, the lateral margins parallel, the posterior end rounded, the front forming a vertical truncate face whose surface is uneven; the margin of the face slightly raised, its top with a notch concave backwards in the middle, the angle between the face and the mandibles less than ninety degrees in profile. The top of the head and the upper sides uneven, smoother near the back of the head and on the lower sides. A stout forward-projecting process on the lower margin of the antennal socket, and another smaller conical process facing forwards above the inside of the socket, the compound eye situated directly behind the antennal socket. Mandibles short, broad and flat, their ends pointed and upturned, the inner margin with three to four widely separated notches forming low flat teeth. Labrum short and small, semicircular. Antennae with 12–14 segments, the second about half the first, the third shorter than the second, the fourth shortest and often disc-shaped, the following segments gradually longer, moniliform. The median notch of the anterior margin of the pronotum broad and deep, upturned forwards and often covering the back of the head, with a transverse groove behind the notch, the posterior margin of the pronotum rounded.
/species/cryptotermes-domesticus/.taxonomy_note: The original work gives Cryptotermes domesticus (in which the character for termite was misprinted as that for mosquito); the scientific name agrees with the page on this site, and no synonymy has been applied.

/species/cryptotermes-dudleyi/.alate: Alate: the ocellus is rather well developed, its short diameter and the distance from the ocellus to the antennal socket broadly corresponding, the two nearly equal in length. The compound eye is situated rather low, the distance from the lower margin of the compound eye to the lower margin of the head capsule equal to the diameter of the compound eye, or slightly less than that diameter. The outline of the mandibles nearly square, each mandible with two marginal teeth.
/species/cryptotermes-dudleyi/.distribution: In China recorded from Xuwen, Guangdong and from Yaxian, Sanya, Longshui, Fushan and Chengmai, Hainan; abroad widely distributed in the Philippines, Malaysia, Indonesia, India, Sri Lanka, Papua New Guinea, Africa, Australia, the Caribbean coast, Central America and South America.

/species/cryptotermes-hainanensis/.alate: Head deep brown, labrum yellowish brown, antennae pale brown, pronotum deep brown. Head elongate-oval, the sides parallel, the posterior margin rounded out, the top of the head slightly arched. The distance from the lower margin of the compound eye to the lower margin of the head about half the long diameter of the compound eye. Ocelli elongate-round, touching the compound eye. Antennae with 16 segments. The middle of both the anterior and posterior margins of the pronotum shallowly concave, the sides nearly parallel. The forewing scale completely covers the hindwing scale.
/species/cryptotermes-hainanensis/.soldier: Head blackish brown in front, paler behind the frontal ridges, becoming yellowish brown at the posterior margin; labrum and antennae yellowish brown; pronotum yellowish brown with the anterior margin brown. Head nearly square, the lateral margins slightly bulging near the posterior end, the posterior margin broadly rounded. The margins of the frontal ridges and the frontal surface slightly rough, smooth behind the ridges; the middle of the top of the head flat or shallowly concave; the frontal ridges distinctly raised, forming a broad U in dorsal view, its midpoint flat or slightly concave, the angle between the frontal slope and the mandibles about one hundred and twenty degrees in profile. Antennae with 11–13 segments, inserted between the two tubercles, the frontal tubercles short and thick, the genal tubercles slender and long. Labrum mitre-shaped, with two hairs at its tip. Eyes distinct, slightly projecting. Mandibles short and flat, the basal prominence raised, the left mandible with three marginal teeth, the right with two. The pronotum about as wide as the head, its anterior margin V-shaped, the anterolateral angles notched, the sides nearly parallel, the posterior margin rather straight.

/species/cryptotermes-havilandi/.alate: Alate: only a few characters are recorded. The distance between the ocellus and the antennal socket is slightly greater than the diameter of the ocellus itself, the two being slightly more than equal. The compound eye is situated rather high, with a distinct gap between its lower margin and the lower margin of the head capsule, this distance being about half the diameter of the compound eye.
/species/cryptotermes-havilandi/.distribution: In China recorded from Yaxian and Lingshui, Hainan; abroad from India, Sri Lanka, Africa, the Caribbean coast, Central America and South America.

/species/cryptotermes-luodianis/.alate: Head reddish brown, anteclypeus tinged with yellow, postclypeus and labrum deep brownish yellow, antennae brownish yellow; pronotum, abdomen and femora slightly deeper than the head, fore tibia pale yellowish brown, mid and hind tibiae paler, wings brownish yellow. The tip of the labrum with seven to nine hairs. Head nearly rectangular, the sides parallel, the posterior margin broadly arcuate, the Y suture faintly visible. Compound eyes projecting; ocelli small, nearly circular, close to the compound eyes; a brownish yellow crescent-shaped antennal spot visible. The frontal surface not very flat, with longitudinal wrinkles; anteclypeus trapezoidal, labrum broad and arched. The first marginal tooth of the left mandible oblique and sharp, its posterior cutting edge shorter than the anterior cutting edge of the second marginal tooth; the right mandible with two marginal teeth, the first acute, the second obtuse. Antennae with 13–15 segments, of the second to fourth the second or third longer. The pronotum slightly broader than the head, the median longitudinal line distinct, the anterior margin concave, the posterior margin slightly concave and apparently with a small notch, the posterolateral angles more rounded than the anterolateral. The forewing scale larger than the hindwing scale and covering the greater part of its posterior portion; in the forewing the subcosta extremely short, the radius reaching one-quarter to one-third of the wing length, the radial sector reaching the wing tip and giving off 6–7 branches, the media arising independently at the humeral suture, for the most part close to the cubitus, curving and joining the radial sector at about one-half to two-thirds of the wing length, the cubitus with about ten branches.
/species/cryptotermes-luodianis/.soldier: Mandibles rather short, each with two marginal teeth. Labrum short, its tip bluntly rounded, with two rather long apical hairs. Antennae with 12–15 segments. The anterior margin of the pronotum with a broad V-shaped concavity, its edge not smooth but set with indistinct fine teeth, the anterior part slightly upturned, the median longitudinal line distinct, the posterior margin rather straight.

/species/cryptotermes-pingyangensis/.alate: Head and pronotum yellowish brown, anteclypeus pale yellow, postclypeus yellow, abdomen pale yellow. Labrum with a few long hairs. Body rather small. Head nearly rectangular, the sides nearly parallel, longer than wide; compound eyes oval, projecting from the sides of the head; ocelli nearly round, rather far from the compound eyes. Labrum slightly broad, arched spherically; the middle of the anterior margin of the anteclypeus slightly concave, its surface wrinkled. The apical tooth of the mandibles long and sharp, the inner margin with two marginal teeth, the posterior margin of the first marginal tooth of the left mandible shorter than the anterior margin of the second marginal tooth, the posterior margin of the second marginal tooth of the right mandible longer than the molar plate. Antennae generally with the second segment longer than the fourth and the third shortest. Pronotum slightly narrower than the head, the lateral margins slightly broader before the middle, the anterior notch broad and deep, the middle of the posterior margin slightly concave. The forewing scale rather long, completely covering the hindwing scale. Hind tibia short, tarsi with four segments, the spur formula 3:3:3, with an arolium between the claws.
/species/cryptotermes-pingyangensis/.soldier: The front of the head blackish brown, the posterior part reddish brown, mandibles black, labrum and antennae yellow, pronotum yellowish brown, abdomen pale brown. Labrum with a pair of apical hairs and a few short hairs. Head short and thick, longer than wide; the middle of the anterior margin of the frons concave backwards and inwards, the lateral margins distinctly concave beside the eyes in dorsal view, the posterolateral margins broadly rounded, the back of the head rather raised. A horn-like process above and below each antennal socket, the tip of the lower longer than that of the upper. Mandibles stout, broad and flat, the outer margin distinctly swollen near the base, the inner margin with two marginal teeth, the distance between the tips of the two teeth of the left mandible rather large, that of the right smaller. Labrum short and broad, its tip slightly pointed. Eyes pale, oval. Postmentum nearly square, the anterolateral angles arcuate. Antennae with 12–13 segments, the second rather long, the fourth shortest. The lateral margins of the pronotum broader in the anterior part, the posterolateral angles distinctly contracted into an arc, the posterior margin rather narrow, the median notch of the anterior margin obtusely angular, broad and deep, the concave edge smooth.

/species/cucurbitermes-sinensis/.distribution: Longsheng, Guangxi; Jiulianshan and Jingdezhen, Jiangxi; Wuyishan, Fujian.
/species/cucurbitermes-sinensis/.soldier: Head pale brown to deep brown, the nasus deeper than the head, antennae, anterior half of the pronotum and abdominal tergites brown, legs pale white. The tip of the nasus with several hairs, the head and thorax almost hairless, the abdominal tergites with only a few fine short hairs. Without the nasus the head is slightly broader than long; in front view it is constricted at the base of the nasus and at the antennal sockets, slightly convex between the two constrictions, gourd-shaped; strongly convex behind the antennal sockets, the sides circular, the posterior margin slightly flat. Nasus slender and tubular, the fontanelle at its tip appearing as a transparent point, in profile the tip of the nasus and the back of the head at about the same level, slightly concave between them. Mandibles bluntly convex, without a spine. Antennae with 14 segments, the third longer than the second, the second almost equal to the fourth. The anterior half of the pronotum upright and upturned, meeting the posterior half at a right angle, the median notch of the anterior margin distinct, that of the posterior margin indistinct. Spur formula 2:2:2, tarsi with four segments. The species is dimorphic in size, the small soldier resembling the large soldier in colour and in hairlessness, its head and nasus paler, antennae with 13 segments, the third twice as long as the second.

/species/cucurbitermes-yingdeensis/.distribution: Huashuishan, Yingde, Guangdong; Baishita, Jingdezhen, Jiangxi; Mangshan, Hunan.
/species/cucurbitermes-yingdeensis/.soldier: Head pale brown, paler behind, nasus brown, antennae, the upturned part of the pronotum and the abdominal tergites pale brown. Head and thorax almost hairless, the tip of the nasus with several long hairs, the abdominal tergites with rather many long and short soft hairs. In front view the transparent point at the tip of the nasus distinct, the head circular with length and width almost equal or width slightly greater than length. Nasus slender and tubular, slightly tapering forwards, deeply contracted where its base meets the antennal sockets, gourd-shaped, greatly raised behind the antennal sockets, the sides of the head evenly rounded, the posterior margin rather flat. In profile the tip of the nasus and the back of the head at about the same level, or the back of the head slightly higher, slightly concave between them. Mandibles blunt, without a spine. Antennae with 13 segments, the third twice as long as the second, the second short and almost equal to the fourth. Pronotum saddle-shaped, the anterior half upright and upturned, meeting the posterior half at a right angle, the anterior notch indistinct, the posterior margin without a concavity. Spur formula 2:2:2, tarsi with four segments. The small soldier has the head and antennae yellow, the nasus yellowish brown, thorax, abdomen and legs pale yellow; the head oval, narrow in front and broad behind, widest posteriorly, the posterior margin arcuate, the mandibles with a short small spine.

/species/dicuspiditermes-laetus/.alate: Head dark red, the first and second antennal segments, labrum, posterior part of the mandibles and legs brownish yellow, postclypeus and pronotum dull yellowish brown, the venter of the abdomen paler, wings yellowish brown. The whole body densely covered with fine hairs. Head oval, the top flat; fontanelle elongate-oval; compound eyes circular and projecting, ocelli elongate-oval, the ocellus-compound eye distance about equal to the width of the ocellus; postclypeus raised, more than one-third as long as wide, its posterior margin arched forwards, the anterior margin straight. Antennae with 15 segments, the third finest and shortest, the second about twice as long as the third, the fourth shorter than the second and longer than the third. Pronotum with a pale cross-shaped marking, the anterior margin straight, the median notch indistinct, the anterolateral angles projecting, the middle of the posterior margin slightly concave. Forewing M arising independently at the humeral suture, situated between Rs and Cu and slightly towards Cu, dividing into four branches beyond two-thirds of the wing length, Cu with about 9–10 branches; hindwing M arising from Rs behind the humeral suture, the rest as in the forewing. The head capsule rather densely haired, the frontal gland pore small and narrow, oval; the postclypeus less than half as long as wide, with a median suture; the distance between the apical tooth and the first marginal tooth of the right mandible slightly greater than that between the first and second marginal teeth.
/species/dicuspiditermes-laetus/.distribution: Jinping (380 m, 450 m), Mojiang (1400 m) and Jinghong (500 m), Yunnan; abroad recorded from Myanmar.
/species/dicuspiditermes-laetus/.soldier: Head straw yellow, abdomen white. Only a few hairs on the top of the frons, still sparser elsewhere, the abdomen with many hairs. Head cylindrical, raised like a mountain peak at the anterior sixth; the fontanelle situated behind the midpoint between the peak-like process and the labrum; in profile the anterior and posterior margins of the frontal process meeting almost at a right angle; the back of the head slightly broader than the front; a hard horn on the anterolateral side of each antenna. Mandibles twisted and asymmetrical, the tip of the left mandible hooked, the right rather straight. The anterior margin of the labrum forked into two sharp points. Antennae with 14 segments, the second, third and fourth of similar length, all shorter than the fifth. The notch of the anterior margin of the pronotum not very distinct. Abdomen short and small. The head capsule moderately to rather densely haired, the head rectangular and without frontal ridges; the middle of the left mandible moderately twisted, its tip hooked and swollen behind the hook, the right mandible sword-shaped with its tip also slightly hooked; labrum narrow and long, its anterior margin concave, the anterolateral angles slightly projecting; tibial spur formula 2:2:2.
/species/dicuspiditermes-laetus/.taxonomy_note: The original work records Dicuspiditermes garthwaitei, which is now placed in synonymy under D. laetus.

/species/euhamitermes-bidentatus/.soldier: Head pale yellowish brown and covered with short pubescence, mandibles brownish yellow, thorax and abdomen yellowish white. Head slightly square, the sides nearly parallel, slightly broader at the middle, the anterior margin slightly concave and the posterior margin nearly straight; labrum semicircular; mandibles hooked, each with a large blunt tooth behind the apical third, and two minute teeth above the base of each mandible; antennae with 14 segments, the third slightly longer than the second; postmentum club-shaped, the waist 0.34 mm wide; pronotum saddle-shaped, its posterior margin slightly projecting.

/species/euhamitermes-concavigulus/.soldier: Head pale yellow with rather dense short hairs, the tips of the mandibles reddish brown, thorax and abdomen yellowish white. Head subquadrate, the lateral margins nearly parallel, broader at the middle, the anterior margin slightly concave, the posterior margin broadly rounded; labrum trapezoidal with its tip concave; mandibles hooked, each with a large tooth before the middle whose tip is directed obliquely forwards, without minute teeth above the base; antennae with 14 segments, the second slightly longer than the third; the waist of the postmentum 0.25–0.28 mm wide, its anterior part with a heart-shaped depression like a spoon; pronotum saddle-shaped, the middle of the posterior margin concave and depressed.

/species/euhamitermes-daweishanensis/.soldier: Head pale yellowish brown and densely covered with short pubescence, mandibles brown tinged with red, antennae white-yellow, thorax and abdomen white-yellow. Head square but rounded, the sides slightly bulging, the anterior margin shallowly concave, the posterior margin broadly rounded; labrum trapezoidal with its tip rather straight; mandibles hooked, the left mandible slightly more than half the length of the head capsule but less than two-thirds of the greatest width of the head, each mandible with a large blunt tooth at or slightly before the apical third, and one minute sharp tooth above the base of each; antennae with 14 segments, the third slightly longer than the second; postmentum club-shaped, the waist 0.33 mm wide; pronotum saddle-shaped, the middle of the posterior margin slightly concave and depressed.

/species/euhamitermes-guizhouensis/.soldier: Head yellow with the frontal region slightly paler, mandibles slightly deeper than the head with reddish brown tips, antennae pale yellow, labrum nearly the colour of the head, pronotum pale yellow, legs pale yellow, abdomen white; the head with rather many short hairs and scattered rather long hairs, the pronotum with fewer hairs than the head, the abdomen rather densely haired. Head nearly rectangular, widest at the antennal sockets, slightly narrowing backwards; the frontal region slightly concave, the fontanelle a small but distinct point at about the apical third; labrum wider than long, its anterior margin rather flat and slightly concave in the middle; the base of the mandibles broad and the tip sharp and curved inwards, the two nearly symmetrical, each with one marginal tooth at the apical third, its posterior margin much longer than its anterior margin, the middle and posterior part of the left mandible with another distinct small tooth; the postmentum rather stout and long, narrowest at the basal third; antennae with 14 segments, the second slightly longer than the third and nearly equal to the fourth; pronotum saddle-shaped, its anterior part not longer than the posterior, the anterior margin projecting, the posterior margin broadly rounded with an indistinct median notch, the lateral lobes rather distinct.

/species/euhamitermes-melanocephalus/.soldier: Head deep brown tinged with black, glossy, densely covered with short pubescence, the anterior margin and the mandibles blackish brown, thorax and abdomen pale greyish yellow. Head rectangular but rather short, the lateral margins parallel, the anterior margin slightly concave, the posterior margin nearly straight; labrum semicircular, its tip slightly concave; mandibles hooked, each with a large blunt tooth at or slightly behind the apical third, and one minute tooth above the base of each; antennae with 14 segments, the third slightly longer than the second; postmentum club-shaped, the waist 0.25–0.28 mm wide; pronotum saddle-shaped, the middle of the posterior margin slightly concave and depressed.

/species/euhamitermes-mengdingensis/.soldier: Head yellow, labrum pale, the tips of the mandibles reddish brown and the rest yellow, antennae and pronotum pale, abdomen milky white; the dorsum of the head densely covered with short hairs and sparse long hairs, the lateral margins and dorsum of the labrum with a few long hairs interspersed with fine short hairs, the anterior margin of the pronotum and its two lateral lobes with a few long hairs, the abdomen densely covered with fine short hairs. Head rectangular, slightly broader at the middle, gradually narrowing posteriorly, the middle of the posterior margin slightly concave; labrum wider than long, its front transparent, the anterior margin with a broad V-shaped concavity, the anteclypeus short and broad; mandibles short and stout, their tips slightly curved inwards, the middle and posterior part of the outer margin wavy, the inner margin of the left mandible near the middle with one marginal tooth whose edge is slightly elongate-S-shaped and whose tip forms an obtuse angle with the inner margin, the posterior half of the molar plate broad and bearing two small sharp teeth; the marginal tooth of the right mandible in a similar position, its edge reverse-S-shaped, with a small sharp tooth close to the end of the molar plate; postmentum short and broad, widest at about the anterior third; antennae with 14 segments, the fourth shortest; pronotum saddle-shaped, its anterior margin arc-like and the posterior margin straight; the middle of the fore tibia swollen in a bow shape; tibial spur formula 3:2:2; tarsi with four segments.

/species/euhamitermes-microcephalus/.alate: Head brown, thorax and abdomen brown or slightly paler, wing scales brown; head capsule and pronotum densely covered with short pubescence and scattered long setae. Head flat and rounded; fontanelle oval and depressed, a pale small dot in front of the fontanelle; compound eyes subcircular, their long diameter about five to six times the distance between them and the lower margin of the head; ocelli flat and rounded, their long diameter more than three times the ocellus-compound eye distance; labrum semicircular; postclypeus trapezoidal, about half as long as wide; antennae with 15 segments, the third shortest; antennal spot circular and of the same colour as the head capsule, situated in front of the ocelli and smaller than them; the anterior margin of the pronotum straight, the middle of the posterior margin straight or slightly concave.
/species/euhamitermes-microcephalus/.distribution: Luodian, Guizhou; Xuwen, Taishan, Conghua and Huiyang, Guangdong; Lingao and Qiongshan, Hainan; Dongxing, Guangxi.
/species/euhamitermes-microcephalus/.soldier: Head yellowish brown and densely covered with short pubescence, the tips of the mandibles brown tinged with red, antennae, thorax and abdomen yellowish white. Head square but rounded, the middle of the lateral margins slightly expanded, the anterior margin straight, the posterior margin broadly rounded; labrum nearly square, its tip straight or slightly concave; mandibles hooked, each with a large blunt tooth at or slightly before the apical third, and one minute sharp tooth above the base of each; antennae with 14 segments, the second longer than the third; the waist of the postmentum 0.27–0.36 mm wide, the waist region indistinct; pronotum saddle-shaped, the middle of the posterior margin straight or concave forwards.

/species/euhamitermes-quadratceps/.alate: Head brown tinged with red, sparsely covered with pubescence and setae; the dorsum of the thorax and abdomen yellowish brown, the pronotum rather densely haired; wing membrane white and veins brown. Head flat and rounded; fontanelle oval, without a pale round spot in front of it; compound eyes circular, their long diameter about three times the distance between them and the lower margin of the head; the long diameter of the ocelli about four times the ocellus-compound eye distance; labrum semicircular; postclypeus trapezoidal, slightly more than half as long as wide; antennae with 15 segments, the third shortest; antennal spot circular but indistinct, smaller than the ocelli; the anterior and posterior margins of the pronotum nearly straight, the lateral margins slightly oblique backwards.
/species/euhamitermes-quadratceps/.distribution: Dabu and Huiyang, Guangdong; Dongxing and Wuming, Guangxi.
/species/euhamitermes-quadratceps/.soldier: Head pale yellowish brown to yellowish brown, sparsely covered with short pubescence, the tips of the mandibles brown, thorax and abdomen yellowish white. Head slightly square, the sides parallel, the anterior and posterior margins nearly straight; fontanelle punctiform and slightly projecting; labrum semicircular; mandibles hooked, each with a large blunt tooth at or slightly before the apical third, and only one small sharp tooth above the base of each; antennae with 14 segments, the third slightly longer than the second; postmentum club-shaped, the waist 0.28–0.35 mm wide; pronotum saddle-shaped, its posterior margin nearly straight.

/species/euhamitermes-retusus/.soldier: Head yellowish brown and covered with short pubescence, the tips of the mandibles reddish brown, thorax and abdomen yellowish white. Head nearly trapezoidal, the lateral margins slightly oblique backwards, widest beside the base of the mandibles, the anterior margin straight, the posterior margin broadly rounded; labrum semicircular with its tip distinctly concave; mandibles hooked, each with a large blunt tooth at one-third, and one small sharp tooth above the base of each, projecting above the molar plate like a small tooth; antennae with 14 segments, the second about as long as the third, the fourth shortest; the waist of the postmentum 0.28 mm wide, its anterior margin straight; pronotum saddle-shaped, its posterior margin straight and depressed in the middle.

/species/euhamitermes-yunnanensis/.alate: Head deep brown, the dorsum of the thorax and abdomen brown, wing membrane white and veins pale brown; head and pronotum densely covered with pubescence. Head flat and rounded; fontanelle oval and depressed, with a group of pale small spots in front of it; compound eyes subcircular, their long diameter about four to five times the distance between them and the lower margin of the head; the long diameter of the ocelli about twice the ocellus-compound eye distance; labrum semicircular; postclypeus trapezoidal, less than half as long as wide; antennae with 15 segments, the third shortest, the antennal spot cloud-like; the anterior margin of the pronotum nearly straight, the lateral margins steeply oblique backwards, the posterior margin projecting with a shallow median concavity.
/species/euhamitermes-yunnanensis/.distribution: Jinghong and Mengla, Yunnan; Wuming, Guangxi.
/species/euhamitermes-yunnanensis/.soldier: Head yellowish brown and densely covered with short pubescence, mandibles purplish brown, thorax and abdomen pale yellow. Head nearly trapezoidal, the lateral margins slightly oblique backwards, widest beside the base of the mandibles, the anterior and posterior margins nearly straight; labrum semicircular; mandibles hooked, each with a large blunt tooth behind the apical third; antennae with 14 segments, the third slightly longer than the second; postmentum club-shaped, the waist 0.25–0.28 mm wide; pronotum saddle-shaped, the middle of the posterior margin shallowly concave and depressed.

/species/euhamitermes-yuntaishanensis/.soldier: Head yellow, labrum pale, mandibles yellowish brown with the marginal teeth and the anterior end deep brown, antennae and pronotum pale yellow, abdomen milky white; the dorsum of the head densely covered with short hairs and sparse long hairs, the lateral margins and dorsum of the labrum with a few long hairs interspersed with fine short hairs, the clypeus with long and short hairs alternating, the periphery and dorsum of the pronotum with sparse long hairs interspersed with short hairs, the abdomen densely covered with short hairs. Head rectangular, the anterior and middle parts of the lateral margins nearly parallel, slightly narrower posteriorly, the posterior margin slightly arcuate; labrum wider than long, arc-like, its front transparent and the middle of the anterior margin slightly concave; mandibles short and stout, their tips slightly curved inwards, the outer margin wavy near the base; the marginal tooth of the left mandible situated slightly before the middle, its edge slightly elongate-S-shaped, its tip forming an obtuse angle with the inner margin, the lower half of the molar plate broad with a small sharp tooth in the middle; the postmentum widest at about the anterior quarter, narrowest at the posterior quarter; antennae with 14 segments, the fifth longer than the second; pronotum saddle-shaped, the anterior half raised vertically in an arc; the middle of the fore tibia swollen in a bow shape.
