/species/euhamitermes-zhejianensis/.alate: Head densely haired, oval, wider than long, fontanelle large and oval, compound eyes large, nearly circular and projecting, ocelli small and oval; the apical tooth of the mandibles distinctly larger than the first marginal tooth, the third and first marginal teeth of the left mandible meeting at an angle; antennae with 15 segments; pronotum as wide as the head or slightly narrower; tibial spur formula 3:2:2, tarsi with four segments.
/species/euhamitermes-zhejianensis/.soldier: Head yellow with the posterior part paler, labrum pale, mandibles reddish brown, antennae and pronotum pale yellow, abdomen milky white. Head densely covered with short hairs, with a few long hairs scattered among them; the surface of the pronotum with only a few long hairs, its periphery with sparse long hairs; the abdomen especially densely covered with short hairs, the dorsum of every abdominal segment clothed with short hairs.

/species/globitermes-brachycerastes/.soldier: Head orange-yellow, mandibles reddish brown and slightly paler at the base, thorax and abdominal tergites paler than the head. The head is very sparsely haired, with only several long hairs; the antennal segments bear rather many short hairs interspersed with sparse long hairs; the thoracic tergites sparsely covered with long hairs.

/species/globitermes-menglaensis/.soldier: Head yellowish brown, mandibles reddish brown from the marginal teeth to the tip, the posterior half deep yellow; postclypeus slightly deeper than the head, anteclypeus milky white, labrum, antennae and pronotum yellow, legs and abdomen pale yellow. The head has only several long hairs, the postclypeus four short hairs, the middle of the labrum with five pairs of hairs in longitudinal rows; the periphery of the pronotum with sparse long hairs, long hairs intermixed along the anterior margin. Head nearly circular, slightly wider than long, the middle of the posterior margin slightly concave; postclypeus raised; labrum nearly tongue-shaped, longer than wide, its tip rather straight; the front of the mandibles curved inwards like a sickle, each with one inner marginal tooth behind the middle; postmentum short and stout, its sides slightly convex outwards at the middle. Antennae with 14 segments, the fourth shortest, the second and third about equal. Pronotum saddle-shaped, the middle of the anterior margin concave, the middle of the posterior margin slightly concave. Tibial spur formula 3:2:2, tarsi with four segments.

/species/globitermes-mengpengensis/.soldier: Head yellowish brown, mandibles reddish brown from the marginal teeth to the tip, the posterior half deep yellow, labrum yellow with the anterior third transparent pale yellow, anteclypeus milky white, postclypeus deeper than the head, antennae deep yellow, pronotum yellow and deeper in its anterior half, legs and abdomen pale yellow. The head has only several long hairs, the postclypeus four short hairs, the middle of the labrum with four pairs of hairs in longitudinal rows; the pronotum with long and short hairs alternating, its posterior margin with only several left-right symmetrical long hairs. Head nearly circular, slightly wider than long, the posterior margin arcuate and projecting; labrum tongue-shaped, slightly longer than wide, the sides behind the middle arcuately convex; the front of the mandibles forming a large hook, the tip fine and sharp, each with one inner marginal tooth behind the midpoint, the marginal tooth of the left mandible slightly larger than that of the right; postmentum short and stout, its sides concave inwards near the tip. Antennae with 14 segments, the fourth shortest, the second longer than the third. Pronotum constricted at the middle, the middle of the anterior margin with a V-shaped concavity, the middle of the posterior margin slightly concave. Tibial spur formula 3:2:2, tarsi with four segments.

/species/globitermes-minor/.alate: Head brown; postclypeus pale yellowish brown, anteclypeus milky white, labrum greyish yellow, pronotum dark brown with a pale brown T-shaped mark and round spots; head and pronotum with sparse long and short hairs. Head nearly circular, the fontanelle small but visible, with a small spot in front of it; head width (including the eyes) greater than head length (to the base of the mandibles). In profile the dorsal margin of the head slightly arched; compound eyes nearly circular and projecting, ocelli oval and slightly projecting, the ocellus-compound eye distance shorter than half the short diameter of the ocellus and also shorter than the distance from the compound eye to the lower margin of the head; the postclypeus about half as long as wide. Antennae with 15 segments, the second about twice as long as the third, the third short and small, the fourth and fifth nearly equal. Pronotum narrower than the head, with a small notch in the middle of the anterior margin and a deep median concavity on the posterior margin; the posterior margins of the mesonotum and metanotum are likewise deeply concave.

/species/globitermes-sulphureus/.alate: Head and body brown, the head deeper, antennae, postclypeus and the parts below the femora brownish yellow, wings pale brown. Head oval; compound eyes circular, ocelli elliptical, the ocellus-compound eye distance less than the transverse diameter of the ocellus, or the two almost touching; postclypeus less than half as long as wide, raised very high, its anterior margin straight, the posterior margin strongly arched. In individuals with 16 antennal segments the third, fourth and fifth are all shorter than the second. Pronotum ingot-shaped, narrower than the head, with a pale T-shaped mark in the middle, the middle of the anterior margin slightly concave, the middle of the posterior margin deeply concave. Wings about twice as long as the body, the forewing scale almost reaching the base of the hindwing scale; the radius sector of the forewing runs close to the anterior margin straight to the wing tip without distinct branches, the media arises independently at the humeral suture, its distance from the cubitus nearer than that from the radius sector, and divides at the end into several branches reaching the wing tip, the cubitus with about ten branches; the media of the hindwing arises from the radius sector behind the humeral suture. The wing surface is smooth, with only sparse short hairs.
/species/globitermes-sulphureus/.distribution: Jinghong (500 m) and Menghai (1180 m), Yunnan; abroad recorded from Myanmar.
/species/globitermes-sulphureus/.soldier: Head and labrum pale yellow, mandibles reddish brown, antennae milky white, pronotum, abdomen and legs nearly milky white. Head densely covered with fine short hairs, the labrum with apical hairs and with long and short hairs intermixed. Head elongate-oval, narrow in front and broad behind, in profile the middle of the vertex raised like a mound; labrum mostly spear-shaped; the middle of the left mandible slightly arched, with a minute tooth before the basal tooth; the right mandible slightly thinner than the left; the postmentum widest at the middle. Antennae with 14 segments. The middle of both the anterior and posterior margins of the pronotum is concave inwards.

/species/glyptotermes-angustithorax/.soldier: The soldier has the head yellowish brown, the base of the mandibles brown and the tips purplish brown, labrum, antennae and pronotum pale yellowish brown, abdomen and legs pale yellow. Head elongate-cylindrical, about 1.1 times as wide as high, the lateral margins parallel, the posterior margin straight. In profile the dorsal angle of the frons slightly projecting, the frontal slope about 45 degrees, the dorsal margin of the head almost straight, the ventral margin of the postmentum sloping downwards forwards from the waist region; the frontal surface nearly flat, the anterior arm of the Y-shaped suture faintly visible, ocelli and compound eyes indistinct. Labrum flat and square, its tip slightly arched outwards. The tips of the mandibles slightly curved, the left mandible more than half as long as the head capsule, the tip of the first marginal tooth of the right mandible directed laterally. Antennae with 11–12 segments. The postmentum about six to seven times as long as the width at the waist, its widest region in the anterior third, the waist region in the posterior third. Pronotum distinctly narrower than the head, its anterior margin nearly straight or shallowly concave, with a small median notch, the lateral margins rounded, the posterior margin formed by two intersecting arcs.

/species/glyptotermes-baliochilus/.soldier: The soldier has the head reddish brown, the frontal surface slightly deeper, mandibles blackish brown; the labrum yellow in ground colour with a reddish brown triangular spot in the middle; pronotum paler than the head, abdomen and legs pale yellowish brown. Head shaped like a long cylinder, the two sides parallel, the posterior margin straight. In profile the dorsal angle of the frons hardly raised, the frontal slope about 45 degrees, both the dorsal margin of the head and the ventral margin of the postmentum nearly straight; the frontal surface bears a shallow V-shaped depression, the Y-shaped suture visible. Compound eyes large and distinct, ocelli small. Labrum flat and square, mandibles rather slender and straight, the length of the left mandible about half that of the head capsule. Antennae with 13–14 segments. The postmentum about seven times as long as the width at its waist, its widest part in the anterior third, with several transverse striae behind the anterior margin, the waist region behind the midpoint, the sides parallel and gradually diverging backwards. Pronotum slightly wider than the head, the median longitudinal line visible; the anterior margin straight or very slightly concave, the two sides nearly parallel, the posterior margin projecting outwards, a small notch in the middle of both the anterior and posterior margins.

/species/glyptotermes-bimaculifrons/.soldier: The soldier has the vertex brown tinged with red, the frontal surface brown with purple, the posterior margin of the head yellowish brown; labrum brown, antennae yellow, mandibles blackish brown; pronotum yellowish brown with the periphery darker, abdomen and legs pale brown. Head cylindrical, widest beside the compound eyes, narrowest at the base of the mandibles, the middle of the sides slightly contracted, the posterior margin broad and rounded. In profile the dorsolateral angle of the frons projects outwards, the frontal slope about 70 degrees, the dorsal margin of the head nearly straight. In front view two smooth pale round spots lie below the top of the frons, shaped like a pair of spectacles, the Y-shaped suture distinct. Compound eyes rather large, their distance to the antennal socket less than their own short diameter. The tip of the labrum flat and rounded; the tips of the mandibles curved, in profile the tip of the mandible sloping forwards and downwards, the left mandible less than half as long as the head capsule, the basal prominence of the mandible distinct. Antennae with 12–13 segments, the third shortest. The postmentum 6.7–7.9 times as long as the width at its waist, widest in the anterior third, the waist region in the posterior third. Pronotum narrower than the head, the anterior margin nearly straight with a shallow median notch, the posterior margin also rather flat, its median notch rather deep.

/species/glyptotermes-brachythorax/.alate: Alate head deep brownish yellow, compound eyes blackish brown, ocelli, antennae and labrum yellowish brown, pronotum slightly paler than the head, abdomen and legs yellowish brown. Head elongate-oval; compound eyes also elongate-oval, their short diameter less than twice the distance from the compound eye to the lower margin of the head. Ocelli spindle-shaped, their distance from the compound eye about half their short diameter. Antennae with eight segments, the specimen is broken, the second shortest. The width of the pronotum is about equal to that of the head (including the compound eyes).
/species/glyptotermes-brachythorax/.soldier: The soldier has the head yellowish brown, the tips of the mandibles blackish brown, the labrum, antennae, thorax, abdomen and legs all paler than the head. Head cylindrical, about 1.1 times as wide as high, the sides parallel, the posterior margin broadly rounded. In profile the dorsal angle of the frons hardly raised, the frontal slope about 45 degrees, the dorsal margin of the head and the ventral margin of the postmentum nearly straight, the frontal surface flat, the anterior arm of the Y-shaped suture visible, ocelli not discernible, compound eyes recognisable. Labrum nearly circular, the tips of the mandibles slightly curved, the left mandible more than half as long as the head capsule. Antennae with 11 segments. The postmentum about six times as long as the width at the waist, the widest region in the anterior third of the mentum, the waist region near the posterior margin. Pronotum slightly narrower than the head, about 2.5 times as wide as its median length, with a small notch in the middle of the anterior margin, the lateral margins rounded outwards, the middle of the posterior margin slightly concave forwards.

/species/glyptotermes-chinpingensis/.alate: The alate has the head, thoracic plates, abdominal sternites, coxae and trochanters black, antennae and labrum yellowish brown, femora and tibiae pale yellow to white, wings brown, the whole body very sparsely haired. Head nearly square, labrum square with its anterior margin straight; the anteclypeus more than twice as wide as long, the postclypeus as wide as the anteclypeus and about half as long, band-shaped. Ocelli very small, situated directly above the compound eyes, close to one another but not touching; compound eyes oval. Antennae with 13–15 segments, the second to fourth of about equal length. The anterior margin of the pronotum concave, the anterolateral angles obtuse, the posterior part narrowed, the posterior section of the lateral margins continuous with the posterior margin in an arc, the middle of the posterior margin slightly concave forwards. The forewing scale large, about twice as long as the hindwing scale, the wing surface covered with granular convexities and concavities. In the forewing Sc is very short, R reaches a quarter of the wing length, M arises independently at the humeral suture, close to Rs or fused with it and running towards the apex, Cu with many branches.
/species/glyptotermes-chinpingensis/.distribution: Mengla, Jinping, Yunnan (520 m), and also Guangxi, Fujian, Hunan and Tibet.
/species/glyptotermes-chinpingensis/.soldier: The soldier has the head pale reddish brown, paler behind and deeper in front; antennae yellow; the anterior half of the mandibles black, the posterior half the same colour as the frons; thoracic tergites and the posterior part of each sternite pale yellow, the abdomen of living individuals pale pink. Head cylindrical, rectangular in dorsal view, the sides parallel; at the anterior fifth of the dorsum of the head the middle is depressed, forming a low peak-like projection on each side, whence the surface descends at a slope of 45 degrees towards the clypeus. Mandibles short and stout, their tips curved towards the midline. Left mandible with four teeth: the first two both triangular, the second broader at the base than the first, their tips directed inwards and situated before the midpoint of the mandible; the third lower, exactly behind the midpoint; the fourth still lower. The right mandible has a large triangular tooth before the midpoint with its tip inclined slightly forwards, and a lower blunt tooth behind the midpoint. Antennae with 10–13 segments. Pronotum slightly narrower than the head, its anterior margin concave backwards, the anterolateral angles small and rounded, the anterior sections of the two sides nearly parallel, curving into a large arc where they meet the posterior margin, both the anterior and posterior margins with a median notch.

/species/glyptotermes-curticeps/.soldier: The soldier has the head brown, the front of the frons brown, anteclypeus and labrum pale brown, mandibles blackish brown, antennae yellow, eye spots pale, postmentum the same colour as the head with the lateral margins dark brown; pronotum paler than the head but distinctly darker than the yellow abdomen, the tergite of the last abdominal segment brown; body hairs fine, short and sparse. Head rectangular, the lateral margins almost parallel, slightly broader near the posterior margin, the posterior margin arcuate; at the junction of the frons and the vertex two separate mound-like projections project forwards, the frontal surface sloping at about 60 degrees. Labrum narrow and long, its length exactly reaching the posterior margin of the first marginal tooth of the left mandible, its tip narrow and rounded, the sides slightly converging towards the tip. Antennae with 11 segments, the third shortest. Mandibles short, their tips slightly curved inwards, the left mandible with four marginal teeth, the right with three, of which the third is very weak, like only a small projection. Pronotum as wide as the head or slightly narrower, flat and square, the sides oblique and nearly parallel, the anterior margin deeply concave in an arc with almost no median notch, the posterior margin arcuate with a median notch. The hind femur swollen, more than half as wide as long.

/species/glyptotermes-daiyunensis/.soldier: The soldier has the head and pronotum reddish brown, the forehead and mandibles blackish brown, antennae, legs and abdomen reddish yellow; the head very sparsely haired, the anterior margin of the labrum and the periphery of the pronotum with sparse long setae. Head rectangular, gradually expanding from front to back, widest at the back of the head, the posterior margin rather flat; the sides of the forehead slightly raised, slightly depressed between the two elevations. The inner margin of the left mandible with three teeth, that of the right with two. The anterior margin of the labrum rounded and blunt. Antennae with ten segments, the third segment on the right almost as long as the second, on the left distinctly shorter. The anterior half of the postmentum broad, the waist narrowest near the posterior end, the widest part about twice the narrowest. Pronotum like a horizontally placed rectangle, arched in the middle, the sides arcuate, the anterior margin broad and shallowly concave, the middle of the posterior margin shallowly concave. The hind femur distinctly swollen, more than half as wide as long.

/species/glyptotermes-daweishanensis/.soldier: The soldier has the back of the head and the pronotum a mixture of yellow and coffee colour, deepening from the back of the head forwards, the frons black; antennae yellow, abdomen and legs white; head and thorax with only a few scattered long hairs, the abdomen slightly more hairy. Head cylindrical, longer than wide, thicker at the posterior end than at the anterior; in dorsal view the posterior margin arcuate, the lateral margins straight but not parallel, gradually converging forwards. From two-eighths of the way from the front of the head, the dorsum and sides towards the front show irregular wrinkles; at one-eighth from the front of the head the dorsum bears two distinct, juxtaposed black tubercles, and further forwards a steep face of nearly 90 degrees descending to the clypeus. Mandibles short, broad and straight, sharp at the tip and slightly curved. The left mandible has two forward-directed teeth before the midpoint, a third marginal tooth of similar size directed inwards behind the midpoint, and further back a smaller fourth marginal tooth; the right mandible has two marginal teeth at the middle, the first larger, both directed inwards. Antennae with 9–10 segments. Pronotum about as wide as the head, not raised, the whole anterior margin concave backwards in an arc, the posterior margin rather straight. Legs short.

/species/glyptotermes-emei/.alate: Alate head deep reddish brown, the frontal region slightly paler, labrum reddish brown, clypeus deep brownish yellow, antennae brownish yellow, compound eyes nearly black; pronotum deep brownish yellow, paler than the head, with a pale median longitudinal line; the anterior parts of the mesonotum and metanotum with blackish brown longitudinal lines, wing scales reddish brown, coxae, trochanters and femora of the legs brownish yellow, abdominal tergites brownish yellow and sternites slightly paler, the head very sparsely haired. Head nearly square, slightly broader behind the compound eyes, the posterolateral angles broadly rounded, slightly longer than wide or as long as wide; the middle of the forehead slightly concave, with several longitudinal and transverse striae, forming weak frontal ridges on the two sides. Compound eyes oval, medium to rather large and slightly projecting, adjacent to the nearly circular ocelli but not touching them, the short diameter of the compound eye greater than the distance from its lower margin to the lower margin of the head. Labrum broad, its anterior margin straight; the anterior margin of the clypeus blunt and projecting forwards. Pronotum slightly wider than the head, the anterior margin concave-arcuate, the posterior margin straight with a slight median concavity, neither margin with a median notch. The forewing scale larger than the hindwing scale, the hind tibia with three apical spurs.
/species/glyptotermes-emei/.biology: Host: Sichuan cinnamon; the specimen was collected from a dead trunk.
/species/glyptotermes-emei/.soldier: The soldier has the top of the frons deepening forwards to reddish brown, the tops of the tubercles blackish brown, the back of the head slightly paler; labrum brownish yellow, mandibles nearly black and slightly paler at the base, postmentum reddish brown and slightly transparent at the tip, antennae yellowish brown, pronotum brownish yellow, mesothorax, metathorax, legs and abdomen pale yellow. Head longer than wide, narrow in front and broad behind, the posterior margin broadly arcuate or nearly straight, the two posterolateral angles broadly rounded, the Y-shaped suture faintly visible. The frontal tubercles lie above the antennal sockets. Mandibles short, the body of the mandible broad and straight with the tip strongly curved inwards, the base with a basal tubercle. Left mandible with four marginal teeth: the two triangular blunt teeth before the midpoint are almost equal in size, the first directed slightly forwards and the second inwards; the third and fourth are close together and far from the first two, the third large and the fourth small. Right mandible with two marginal teeth, the first triangular and directed inwards, the second almost right-angled. Antennae with 10–12 segments, the third shortest. Pronotum slightly narrower than the head, the anterior margin concave-arcuate with a distinct median notch, the lateral margins almost straight and contracting backwards, the posterior margin a broad arc with a distinct median notch, the surface just behind the anterior margin with two crescent-shaped depressions, the median longitudinal line distinct.

/species/glyptotermes-euryceps/.soldier: The soldier has the head brownish yellow, the anterior region slightly deeper, labrum brownish yellow, pronotum pale yellowish brown and slightly deeper than the back of the head, mesonotum, metanotum and abdomen pale yellow, femora, tibiae and tarsi pale yellow; the head with a few scattered hairs, the back of the head almost hairless. Head nearly rectangular, the lateral margins broadly arcuate, widest slightly behind the midpoint, the posterolateral angles continuous with the posterior margin in a semicircle, slightly contracted on both sides near the front. Frontal ridges indistinct, in profile the frontal surface forming a slope of about 45 degrees, the head thickest at the middle. Pale eye spots situated behind the antennal sockets on both sides of the head. Mandibles stout: left mandible with four marginal teeth, the first and second close together; right mandible with two, the first triangular, situated slightly before the midpoint, the second obtusely triangular, situated slightly behind the midpoint. Antennae with 12 segments, the third and fourth incompletely divided. The anterior part of the postmentum expanded, the posterior part narrow, club-shaped. Pronotum distinctly narrower than the head, the anterior margin concave-arcuate, the anterolateral angles narrowly rounded and slightly projecting forwards, the lateral margins nearly straight, contracting backwards and curving towards the venter, the posterior margin narrow and nearly straight, the posterolateral angles broadly rounded.

/species/glyptotermes-ficus/.soldier: The soldier has the head capsule brown tinged with red, mandibles blackish brown, labrum and antennae yellowish brown, pronotum deep yellowish brown, abdomen pale yellow, the posterior half of the tenth abdominal tergite more strongly sclerotised and darker, legs pale yellow. Head cylindrical, the sides parallel, the posterolateral angles broadly rounded. In profile the dorsal angle of the frons strongly sclerotised and raised, the frontal slope about 45 degrees, the frontal surface with a shallow V-shaped depression, several shallow transverse striae in front of the frons, the Y-shaped suture faintly visible. Compound eyes faintly discernible, their distance to the antennal socket less than the transverse diameter of the compound eye. Labrum short and square, mandibles short and stout, their tips rather curved, the left mandible less than half as long as the head capsule. Antennae with 12 segments. The broad anterior part of the postmentum nearly square, situated before the midpoint, the waist region behind the midpoint, the middle of the sides parallel and then expanding backwards, the posterior margin nearly straight. Pronotum narrower than the head, the anterior margin shallowly concave without a median notch, the lateral margins gently oblique backwards, the middle of the posterior margin with a shallow notch, the median line paler.

/species/glyptotermes-fujianensis/.biology: Host: trees of the chinquapin genus.
/species/glyptotermes-fujianensis/.soldier: The soldier has the head capsule pale yellowish brown, the frontal region yellowish brown, mandibles deep brown tinged with red, labrum, anteclypeus and antennae white, pronotum the same colour as the back of the head, abdomen pale yellow; the whole body with short sparse hairs. Head cylindrical, slightly less high than wide, the sides expanding backwards, the posterior margin broadly rounded; the frontal angle slightly projecting, with six to seven shallow longitudinal striae on it, the frontal surface slightly depressed, the Y-shaped suture not visible, the frontal slope nearly 80 degrees, the eye spots almost impossible to discern. Labrum nearly circular. Mandibles rather short, the left mandible less than half as long as the head capsule. Antennae with nine segments, the second shortest. Postmentum short and broad, the margins slightly darker, the posterior margin broadly rounded. The anterior margin of the pronotum shallowly concave, the middle of the posterior margin slightly concave.
/species/glyptotermes-fujianensis/.taxonomy_note: In the original work the genus name is spelled Glyptotermese; the name now in use is Glyptotermes, the genus to which the species belongs.

/species/glyptotermes-fuscus/.alate: Alate head reddish black, pronotum deep brown, thoracic pleura, abdominal tergites and femora brown, venter of the abdomen pale brown, tibiae and tarsi pale yellow, wings brown. Head rectangular, the sides parallel, the posterior margin arcuate; the vertex flat, the frons forming a slope. Compound eyes black and rather small; ocelli elongate-oval or nearly circular, situated directly above the compound eyes and touching them. Anteclypeus pale and trapezoidal, the labrum rather short. Antennae with 12 segments, the second to fourth about equal in size. The anterior margin of the pronotum concave-arcuate, the lateral margins arcuate, the posterior margin also arcuate with a slight median concavity. The forewing scale much larger than the hindwing scale and covering most of it, the wing surface covered with uneven punctures. In the forewing the subcosta is very short, the radius does not extend beyond a quarter of the wing length, the radius sector occasionally connects with the anterior margin by a few very short veins beyond the midpoint, the media arises independently at the humeral suture, close to the radius sector and running straight to the wing tip, the cubitus pale and with many branches; in the hindwing the subcosta disappears, the anterior sections of the radius sector and media are fused and divide into two branches at one-third of the wing length.
/species/glyptotermes-fuscus/.distribution: Taiwan; abroad recorded from the Ryukyu Islands, Ishigaki Island and the Ogasawara Islands of Japan.
/species/glyptotermes-fuscus/.soldier: The soldier has the head yellow, deeper in front, the posterior half of the mandibles reddish yellow and the anterior half black, thorax and abdomen pale yellow to white. Head elongate-tubular, rectangular in dorsal view, the sides parallel; the frons forming a slope of 45 degrees, the upper end of the slope slightly depressed in the middle, distinct frontal ridges not visible. Labrum short, nearly square, not extending beyond the midpoint of the mandibles, its anterior margin straight, the lateral angles obtuse. Mandibles stout: the left mandible has two marginal teeth of the same shape before the midpoint with their tips inclined forwards, a third exactly behind the midpoint, triangular with its tip directed inwards, and a fourth low and broad; the right mandible has two triangular marginal teeth at the middle with their tips directed inwards, the anterior slightly larger than the posterior. Antennae with 13 segments, the second about as long as the third and fourth together, the fifth as long as the second but slightly broader; in a few individuals the antennae have 11 segments, the second and third nearly equal, the fourth slightly longer. Eye spots behind the antennal sockets. Pronotum short, broad and flat, the lateral ends curved towards the venter, the anterior margin concave-arcuate, the posterior margin arcuate with a median concavity.

/species/glyptotermes-hejiangensis/.alate: Head brown, antennae and labrum yellowish brown, compound eyes darker than the head, ocelli and antennal spots paler than the head, pronotum pale brown and slightly paler than the head, abdominal tergites paler still than the pronotum. Body hairs sparse throughout. The outline of the head is broadly oval, the lateral margins behind the compound eyes continuous with the posterior margin in a semicircle, the middle of the vertex slightly depressed, the Y-shaped cephalic suture discernible, the median coronal suture especially clear. Compound eyes medium, nearly circular, moderately projecting; ocelli small, nearly elongate-oval, close to the compound eyes but not touching them; the nearly circular antennal spots distinct. The surface of the labrum arched, its anterior margin rather flat, half as long as wide; clypeus broad and flat. Each mandible with two marginal teeth. Postmentum nearly rectangular. The antennae of the specimen are incomplete, the second slightly longer than the third, the fourth slightly smaller than the third. Pronotum slightly narrower than the width of the head including the compound eyes; the median suture of the pronotum clear, the anterior margin shallowly arcuately concave, the middle broadly straight, the middle of the posterior margin also flat, neither the anterior nor the posterior margin with a distinct median notch. Hind tibia rather slender.
/species/glyptotermes-hejiangensis/.biology: The host plants include Chinese guger tree and weeping willow.
/species/glyptotermes-hejiangensis/.soldier: Head reddish yellow, the anterior region of the frons slightly deeper, clypeus pale brown, labrum brown, mandibles nearly black and slightly paler at the base, postmentum brownish yellow with the lateral margins of the anterior part darker and the tip pale, antennae pale brownish yellow and slightly deeper in the basal segments, pronotum brownish yellow, mesonotum pale brownish yellow, femora pale yellow. The head with sparse long and short hairs, the clypeus with several short hairs, the anterior margin of the labrum with eight to ten rather long hairs, the base of the mandibles with short fine hairs, the margins of the pronotum with short sparse hairs and the surface with several long hairs. Head rectangular, the lateral margins nearly parallel, widest at the eye spots behind the antennae, the eye spots pale brown, the anterolateral angles forming a small rounded reddish brown projection, the posterolateral angles broadly arcuate, the posterior margin broadly arcuate. The frontal surface sloping, slightly depressed in the middle, the frontal ridges separate and slightly raised. Labrum broadly oval, extending to two-thirds of the mandibles. Mandibles stout, swollen at the base; left mandible with four marginal teeth, the first directed forwards, the second close to the first and directed inwards, the third farther from the first two and triangular, the fourth short, small and indistinct; in the right mandible the first marginal tooth is slightly before the midpoint, rather sharp and slightly forward, the second larger, its anterior cutting edge more convex than the posterior. Postmentum narrow and long, expanded in its anterior half. Antennae with 12–13 segments, the second longer than the third and fourth, the third shortest. Pronotum kidney-shaped, slightly narrower than the head, the sides curved towards the venter, the anterior margin shallowly arcuate with a slight median concavity, the lateral margins convex-arcuate, the posterior margin broadly arcuate without a median notch; the mesonotum slightly narrower than the pronotum, the metanotum slightly wider than the mesonotum and slightly narrower than the pronotum, both the meso- and metathorax with small wing pads on each side, the forewing pads slightly larger.

/species/glyptotermes-jinyunensis/.soldier: The soldier has the head brown, the frontal surface deeper, mandibles blackish brown, labrum and antennae brown, eye spots yellow, pronotum brown and deeper than the back of the head, abdomen and legs pale brownish yellow, tibiae and tarsi darker. Head cylindrical, the sides parallel, the posterior margin broadly rounded. In profile the dorsolateral angle of the frons strongly raised, the frontal slope more than 70 degrees, the dorsal margin of the head sloping gently from the top of the frons to the back of the head; the frontal surface with a V-shaped depression, the Y-shaped suture faintly visible, the median suture slightly depressed. Compound eyes small and dot-like, their distance to the antennal socket more than about twice their own short diameter. Labrum semicircular, the tips of the mandibles rather stout and curved, the left mandible slightly longer than the right but less than half the head capsule. Antennae with 12 segments, the second and third rather short. The postmentum widest near the midpoint, the waist region at about the posterior third. The anterior margin of the pronotum with a broad V-shaped concavity, the sides parallel, the posterior margin broadly rounded with a shallow median notch.

/species/glyptotermes-latithorax/.alate: Alate head capsule brown, antennae, labrum, anteclypeus and legs greyish brown, compound eyes slightly paler than the head or deep brown, ocelli and antennal spots pale; pronotum apparently paler than the head, the abdomen paler than the thorax, femora and tibiae greyish yellow, wings pale brown, sparsely haired. Head circular, slightly long, compound eyes subcircular, their diameter greater than their distance to the lower margin of the head, projecting on the two sides of the head; ocelli small and raised as round dots, clearly separated from the compound eyes; antennal spots small and nearly semicircular, situated in front of and inside the ocelli. Antennae with 14 segments, the second and third equal, the fourth shortest. Labrum flat and square, clypeus broad and flat. Each mandible with two marginal teeth. Postmentum elongate. Pronotum as wide as the head or slightly narrower, the anterior margin concave without a median notch, the posterior margin continuous with the lateral margins in an arc. Wings narrow and long, the wing surface with distinct warts; the media of the forewing strongly sclerotised, close to and parallel with the radius sector, the distance from the radius sector to the media equal to that from the radius sector to the costal margin, the radius sector almost unbranched.
/species/glyptotermes-latithorax/.soldier: The soldier has the head chestnut brown, the front and the postclypeus deep brown, the transverse ridge adjacent to the dorsal articulation of the mandibles black; mandibles reddish black, eye spots slightly paler than the head, the lateral margins of the postmentum deep brown; pronotum pale brown with a fine dark border all round; the body very sparsely haired. Head rectangular, cylindrical, the lateral margins straight and parallel, the posterior margin rather straight. At the junction of the frons and the vertex there is a pair of inverted-V-shaped mound-like elevations with a groove between them, their two outer ends directed towards the antennal sockets and extending only halfway to them; the Y-shaped suture very indistinct. Left mandible with four marginal teeth, the first and second adjacent, followed by a blunt concavity, the third largest, the fourth broad and low; right mandible with two marginal teeth of almost equal size, their tips directed backwards. Antennae with 13–14 segments. Postmentum rather slender, its widest part 2.5 times the narrowest. Pronotum very broad and flat, about twice as wide as long, with a groove in the anterior half of the median axis, the anterior margin slightly concave with a very indistinct median notch, the lateral margins semicircular and arched downwards, the posterior margin arcuate with a shallow median concavity.

/species/glyptotermes-liangshanensis/.alate: Alate head nearly blackish brown, labrum yellowish brown, clypeus yellow, antennae pale brown, compound eyes nearly black, ocelli pale brown, thoracic tergites nearly blackish brown, abdominal tergites reddish brown, femora brown, tibiae and tarsi pale yellowish brown. Head slightly square, the anterior margin a shallow concave arc, the lateral margins rather parallel from the front to the posterior margin of the compound eyes, the posterior margin of the head nearly semicircular between the two compound eyes; in profile the frontal surface rather steep, the Y-shaped suture on the vertex very indistinct. Compound eyes nearly circular, moderately bulging; ocelli also nearly circular, rather close to the compound eyes. Labrum nearly a transverse square, its anterior margin slightly arcuately projecting. Antennae incomplete, the second slightly short, the third longer, the fourth slightly shorter than the third and slightly larger than the second. Pronotum kidney-shaped, as wide as the head including the compound eyes or slightly wider, the anterior margin a shallow concave arc, the lateral margins convex-arcuate, the posterior margin broadly arcuate with a slight median concavity, the median longitudinal line on the surface groove-like, the anterior and lateral margins with sparse short hairs, the posterior margin with slightly denser short hairs. The forewing scale very large, covering almost the whole hindwing scale.
/species/glyptotermes-liangshanensis/.soldier: The soldier has the head reddish brown, slightly deeper near the anterior margin; labrum pale yellowish brown, mandibles nearly black and slightly paler at the base; the anterior part of the postmentum pale reddish brown and the posterior part yellowish brown; antennae pale yellowish brown, pronotum yellowish brown, mesonotum and metanotum pale yellowish white. Head rectangular, the sides nearly parallel, widest at the middle or near the back of the head, the posterolateral angles broadly rounded, the posterior margin almost straight; the two frontal lobes only very slightly raised, in profile the frontal slope about 45 degrees, the eye spots behind the antennal sockets extremely indistinct. Mandibles slightly more than half the length of the head, stout in the posterior half, rather sharp and slightly curved at the front, the basal tubercle of the mandible distinct. Left mandible with four marginal teeth: the first and second triangular and of about equal size with their tips slightly forwards; the third largest and directed inwards, farther from the preceding marginal tooth; the fourth small. Right mandible with two large triangular marginal teeth, both directed inwards. Antennae with 10–11 segments. Pronotum kidney-shaped, flat, the anterior margin shallowly concave with the anterolateral angles projecting forwards, the lateral margins arcuate, the posterior margin a broad arc, both anterior and posterior margins with a small median notch, the median longitudinal line on the surface distinct.

/species/glyptotermes-limulingensis/.alate: Alate head deep brownish yellow, antennae pale yellow, compound eyes blackish brown, ocelli, antennal spots and maxillary palps yellowish brown, pronotum yellowish brown, wing veins deep brownish yellow, the wing membrane scattered with brownish yellow spots, legs pale yellowish brown. Head subcircular; compound eyes elongate-oval, their short diameter slightly greater than the distance from the compound eye to the lower margin of the head; ocelli nearly round-triangular, close to the compound eyes but not touching them; antennal spots nearly circular, larger than the ocelli. Antennae with eight segments, the third shortest, gradually increasing towards the tip, the anterior arm of the Y-shaped suture faintly visible. Pronotum narrower than the width of the head including the compound eyes, flat and square, the middle of the anterior margin slightly concave, the lateral margins slightly oblique backwards, the posterior margin nearly straight with a shallow median concavity, the posterolateral angles broadly rounded, the median longitudinal line visible, the wing surface covered with small warts.

/species/glyptotermes-longnanensis/.alate: Alate head deep reddish brown, labrum dull yellow, clypeus pale yellow, antennae deep yellow, compound eyes nearly black, ocelli yellow; pronotum reddish brown with a faint pale median suture; mesonotum and metanotum brown, their anterior halves with a black median longitudinal line; wing scales and wing veins the same colour as the pronotum, legs brown with tibiae and tarsi pale brown, the colour of the abdominal tergites close to that of the thoracic tergites. Head approximately oval, the sides slightly parallel, slightly longer than wide, the Y-shaped suture indistinct; compound eyes rather large, moderately swollen and nearly circular, ocelli nearly round and close against the compound eyes. Labrum broad, its anterior margin almost straight, the anterolateral angles rounded. Antennae incomplete, the second slightly shorter than the third, the third and fourth nearly equal. Pronotum slightly narrower than the width of the head including the compound eyes, the anterior margin a concave arc with the anterior section of the median line depressed, the lateral margins curved towards the venter, the anterolateral angles narrowly rounded, the posterolateral angles broadly rounded and continuous with the posterior margin in a semicircle. The forewing scale large, the hindwing scale short and small, about half as long as the forewing scale. Abdomen elongate-cylindrical, the sternites with a linear elevation in the middle forming a median keel line running through the abdomen.
/species/glyptotermes-longnanensis/.biology: The hosts include Chinese scholar tree, weeping willow, Chinese sweetgum and Chinese wingnut.
/species/glyptotermes-longnanensis/.soldier: The soldier has the head brownish yellow, the frontal slope turning brown towards the front, mandibles reddish brown with the anterior two-thirds nearly black, pronotum brownish yellow with a pale median line, thorax and abdomen pale yellow, legs pale yellow. Head rectangular, about 1.5 times as long as wide, the sides nearly parallel, the posterolateral angles arcuate, the posterior margin straight; the Y-shaped suture present but indistinct, the frontal slope about 45 degrees, the upper end of the slope slightly depressed in the middle, the two frontal lobes only very slightly raised. Mandibles stout, swollen at the base. Left mandible with four large marginal teeth: the first directed forwards, the second shorter, the third and fourth broad, short and directed inwards, situated behind the midpoint. Right mandible with two, the first near the midpoint, the second broad and large, situated at the basal third. Labrum short, wider than long. Antennae with 10–11 segments, mostly 11, the second larger than the third and smaller than the fourth, from the fourth onwards obconical. Pronotum slightly narrower than the head, the anterior margin a shallow arc with a slight median concavity, the sides curved towards the venter, the posterior margin narrow and straight with a slightly concave midpoint; mesonotum and metanotum with small wing pads.

/species/glyptotermes-maculifrons/.soldier: The soldier is mainly brown tinged with red, the frontal region purplish brown, the mandibles a deeper purplish brown, labrum, antennae and anteclypeus yellowish brown; the postmentum the same colour as the head capsule, deeper in the anterior section and paler in the posterior, pronotum yellowish brown and deeper along the anterior margin, abdomen pale brown, the tenth abdominal tergite again yellowish brown. The margins of the thoracic and abdominal tergites and the antennal segments with scattered short hairs, the head capsule especially sparsely haired. Head capsule cylindrical, slightly less high than wide, the sides slightly expanding backwards, the posterior margin broadly rounded; the frontal surface densely covered with fine dots, the frontal angle slightly raised and bearing about three shallow longitudinal striae, the frontal surface slightly depressed, the Y-shaped suture blurred, the frontal slope steeper than 50 degrees, the eye spots obscure. Labrum nearly square, its tip straight; mandibles rather short, each with four marginal teeth, the last on the left and the third and fourth on the right only minute projections. Antennae with 9–11 segments, the second or third shortest. Postmentum short and broad, its posterior margin slightly arched and straight in the middle, in profile its anterior half distinctly separated from the ventral margin of the head capsule. The anterior margin of the pronotum shallowly concave, the middle of the posterior margin slightly concave.

/species/glyptotermes-magnioculus/.biology: Host recorded as plane tree (Platanus acerifolia).
/species/glyptotermes-magnioculus/.soldier: The soldier has the head capsule yellowish brown tinged with red, mandibles purplish brown, labrum, antennae and pronotum yellowish brown, abdomen pale yellow, legs still paler, femora and tibiae pale yellow and tarsi rather yellow. Head capsule elongate-cylindrical, the sides roughly parallel, only slightly contracted at the middle, the posterior margin broadly rounded; in profile the dorsolateral angle of the frons hardly raised, the frontal slope about 45 degrees, the dorsal margin of the head nearly straight, the frontal surface flat, the Y-shaped suture discernible; compound eyes large and projecting, their distance to the antennal socket less than the short diameter of the eye. Labrum semicircular, the tips of the mandibles fine and curved, the left mandible about half the length of the head capsule. Antennae with 11–12 segments, the third shortest. Postmentum very long, about seven to eight times the width at the waist, widest in the anterior third, the waist region running parallel backwards from the middle. The width of the pronotum slightly greater than the widest part of the head capsule, the anterior margin with a broad shallow V-shaped concavity, the sides nearly parallel, the posterior margin projecting outwards with a shallow median notch, the median longitudinal line clear.

/species/glyptotermes-mandibulicinus/.soldier: The soldier has the head capsule brown with yellow, mandibles deep brown, labrum and antennae yellowish brown, pronotum, abdomen and legs pale yellow. Head capsule short cylindrical, the sides slightly diverging backwards, the posterior margin broadly rounded; in profile the dorsal angle of the frons slightly raised, the frontal slope about 45 degrees, the dorsal margin of the head slightly arched, the ventral margin of the postmentum straight. The frontal surface with a shallow V-shaped depression, the anterior arm of the Y-shaped suture visible, both ocelli and compound eyes discernible. Labrum trapezoidal, its tip upturned and rather curved, the basal prominence of the mandible projecting, the left mandible about half the length of the head capsule. Antennae with ten segments. The postmentum five times as long as its narrowest part, the widest region behind the anterior third, with a pale dot-like elevation in the middle of this region, the waist region in the posterior third. Pronotum slightly narrower than the head capsule, the anterior margin shallowly concave, the sides parallel, the posterior margin nearly straight, the median notches of both the anterior and posterior margins very shallow.

/species/glyptotermes-parvus/.soldier: The soldier has the head capsule yellowish brown, the colour in front of the frontal ridges nearly brown and fading backwards, mandibles deep brown, labrum and antennae brownish yellow, eye spots yellow, postmentum reddish brown with the sides of the anterior part darker; pronotum brown, slightly deeper than the back of the head capsule, the rest cream yellow. The whole body very sparsely haired. Head capsule rectangular and rather thick, the sides roughly parallel and slightly concave at the middle, the anterolateral angles slightly rounded, the posterolateral angles broadly rounded, the posterior margin nearly straight; the frontal surface steep, meeting the vertex at almost a right angle, at their junction two forward-leaning mound-like projections whose distance apart is about the width of the clypeus, slightly depressed and longitudinally wrinkled between them, the Y-shaped suture very indistinct. Mandibles short, the outer margin slightly swollen at the base, the tip of the left mandible slightly curved inwards, with three triangular marginal teeth whose tips are directed inwards, the right with two, both tips rather sharp. Labrum flat and trapezoidal, reaching only half the length of the mandibles. Antennae with 11–12 segments, if 11 then the third has a ring and is as long as the second; eye spots very small and dot-like, their diameter less than their distance to the antennal socket. The anterior part of the postmentum about one-third of the total length, the narrowest part at the posterior end. Pronotum slightly wider than the head, the sides sloping downwards in an arc, the anterior margin with a deep V-shaped concavity and a median notch, the posterior margin narrow with a shallow median concavity, hind legs stout and short.

/species/glyptotermes-satsumensis/.alate: Alate head capsule reddish brown, pronotum brownish yellow, abdomen yellow, very sparsely haired. Head broadly oval, compound eyes medium and slightly projecting, ocelli small and close against the compound eyes; postclypeus very short with indistinct limits, anteclypeus rather large and white; the segments of the labial palps short. Antennae with 15 segments, the second rather long, about the length of the third and fourth together, the third shorter than the fourth. Pronotum narrower than the head capsule, the anterior margin deeply concave, the posterior margin arched backwards. Wings transparent, the proximal veins brown, the wing membrane densely covered with distinct small warts; the radius sector and media parallel to each other and unbranched, with several weak connecting veins between them; the cubitus very indistinct, with about fifteen branches.
/species/glyptotermes-satsumensis/.biology: Host recorded as rubber tree and Cordia dichotoma.
/species/glyptotermes-satsumensis/.distribution: Taiwan; Nada, Hainan; Pingbian, Nanxi and Mengla, Jinping, Yunnan (470 m); Guangxi; Hunan; Beibeng, Medog, Tibet (910 m); also recorded from Japan.
/species/glyptotermes-satsumensis/.soldier: The soldier has the anterior part of the head deep orange-red mixed with brown, gradually paler backwards, becoming yellow at the end; antennae, thorax, abdomen and legs all yellow. The whole body with short sparse hairs. Head capsule rather like a long tube, its length varying considerably between individuals; in profile the frontal surface inclined at about 45 degrees, the junction of the top of the slope with the vertex forming two juxtaposed mountain-like elevations, the horizontal length of this slope about one-seventh of the head capsule. The two sides of the head nearly parallel, the posterior margin slightly arched backwards. The boundary between the postclypeus and the head capsule indistinct, the anteclypeus a short trapezoid; the anterior margin of the labrum arcuate, extending about to the midpoint of the mandibles. Mandibles stout, the inner margin of the left mandible with three distinct marginal teeth and a fourth broad, low and indistinct, the first three close together and the fourth farther off, in some individuals the fourth entirely absent; the inner margin of the right mandible with two prominent triangular marginal teeth. Antennae with 12–15 segments, the length of the second to fourth variable. Eye spots behind the antennae. Pronotum as wide as the head capsule or slightly narrower, the anterior margin slightly concave backwards with a shallow transverse groove behind it, the lateral margins continuous with the posterior margin in an arc, the anterior and posterior margins with slight median notches; mesothorax and metathorax with short wing pads, absent in small individuals. Femora stout and short, abdomen rather long with spine-like projections.

/species/glyptotermes-shaanxiensis/.alate: Alate head brownish, labrum dull yellow, clypeus pale yellow, compound eyes nearly black, ocelli yellow, antennae and legs brownish yellow, pronotum the same colour as the head, mesothorax, metathorax and abdomen brown, the sternites of the posterior abdominal segments rather darker. Head nearly circular, the sides almost parallel, slightly longer than wide; compound eyes large and projecting, nearly circular, ocelli small and slightly raised, situated above the compound eyes and separated from them by a space. Labrum broad and short, its anterior margin straight, the anterolateral angles rounded. Antennae with the third segment shortest, the fourth equal to or slightly longer than the third. Pronotum slightly wider than the head capsule (including the compound eyes), the anterior margin concave, the lateral margins arcuate, the posterolateral angles broadly rounded, the posterior margin rather straight; the forewing scale large, covering the metathorax, the hindwing scale only half as long.
/species/glyptotermes-shaanxiensis/.soldier: The soldier has the head brownish yellow, brown at the steep frontal slope, clypeus yellow, labrum yellow and semi-transparent, mandibles reddish brown with the terminal two-thirds nearly black, the anterior part of the postmentum brownish yellow and the posterior part pale, pronotum brownish yellow and often with a pale median longitudinal line, mesothorax, metathorax and abdomen pale yellow, femora and tibiae pale yellow, the tibial apical spurs brownish yellow, tarsi deep yellow. The whole body with sparse short hairs. Head capsule nearly rectangular and cylindrical, the sides roughly parallel, the front often slightly wider, the posterolateral angles arcuate, the posterior margin straight; the frontal slope about 45 degrees, the frontal peak slightly raised and slightly depressed at the middle, the Y-shaped suture indistinct, clypeus trapezoidal, labrum short and broad with arcuate sides and a nearly straight anterior margin. Mandibles stout, their tips slightly curved, broad and flat at the base; the inner margin of the left mandible with four marginal teeth, the third largest with its tip directed inwards, the first and second of similar size with their tips directed forwards, the fourth short and small; the right mandible with three marginal teeth, the first at the proximal third, the second large and broad at the base, the third low and small at the base. Antennae mostly with 10–11 segments, occasionally 12, the third shortest, the second slightly longer than the third and shorter than the remaining segments. Eye spots circular, behind the antennal sockets. Postmentum slender and flat, broad in front and narrow behind, the waist region narrow and long with parallel sides, expanding outwards at the base. The pronotum usually slightly narrower than the head capsule, its anterior margin a shallow arc with a median depression, the anterolateral angles projecting forwards, the lateral margins arcuate, the posterior margin nearly straight and slightly concave at the middle; the lateral angles of the mesonotum and metanotum extending backwards.

/species/glyptotermes-simaoensis/.alate: Alate head brownish, thoracic and abdominal tergites reddish brown, labrum, antennae and legs yellow. The head capsule sparsely haired, the pronotum with sparse bristles and short hairs, the abdominal tergites also with only sparse long and short hairs. Head nearly circular, the Y-shaped suture faintly visible, the antennal spots extremely indistinct; compound eyes oval and projecting, their short diameter slightly greater than the distance to the lower margin of the head capsule; ocelli small, oval, slightly raised, separate from the compound eyes but very close to them. Antennae with 12 segments, the second to fourth almost equal in length. The anterior margin of the pronotum broadly and shallowly concave, the posterior margin rather straight, neither margin with a median notch. Wings narrow and long, the wing membrane scattered with many slightly raised small brown spots; the media of the forewing strongly sclerotised, arising independently from the basal suture, close to and parallel with the radius sector, both unbranched, the cubitus not sclerotised, four branches at the base rather distinct and the rest blurred; the media of the hindwing also strongly sclerotised, fusing with the radius sector at about one-eighth from the wing base and thereafter parallel with the radius sector without branching, the cubitus not sclerotised, four to five branches at the base fairly clear and the rest indistinct.
/species/glyptotermes-simaoensis/.soldier: The soldier has the head yellowish brown, paler and slightly orange-yellow behind, the frons darker brownish, mandibles blackish brown with reddish brown bases, labrum, antennae and pronotum yellow. The head capsule sparsely haired, the anterior margin of the labrum with eight to ten hairs, the periphery of the pronotum with sparse bristles. Head capsule rectangular, the sides of the middle and posterior sections nearly parallel, the anterior part slightly contracted from the antennal sockets to the mandibular base, the posterior margin rather straight; the junction of the frons and the vertex forming a broad Y-shaped elevation with a shallow median groove, the transverse ridge slightly raised, the Y-shaped suture faintly discernible. The first marginal tooth of the left mandible close to and larger than the second, the inner margin of the right mandible with two marginal teeth, the first larger than the second. Antennae with 11 segments, the third or fourth shorter. The postmentum widest at the anterior third, where it may be more than twice the narrowest part. The pronotum almost as wide as the head capsule, the anterior margin with a broad shallow concavity, the posterior margin rather straight, neither margin with a median notch.

/species/glyptotermes-succineus/.soldier: The soldier has the head capsule amber-brown, mandibles blackish brown, labrum, antennae and eye spots brown, pronotum yellowish brown, abdomen pale yellowish brown, the posterior half of the tenth abdominal tergite more strongly sclerotised and darker, legs brown or slightly paler than the head capsule. Head capsule elongate-cylindrical, the sides parallel, the posterolateral angles broadly rounded; in profile the dorsolateral frontal angle slightly raised, the frontal slope about 45 degrees, the frontal surface a shallow V-shaped depression with several shallow longitudinal striae in the middle, the Y-shaped suture faint, the compound eyes visible, their distance to the antennal socket less than the transverse diameter of the eye. Labrum slightly short-circular with a flat tip; mandibles short and stout with rather curved tips, the left mandible shorter than half the head capsule. Antennae with 12 segments. The postmentum six to seven times as long as the waist, the broad region in the anterior third and trapezoidal, the sides of the anterior part slightly concave inwards, depressed behind the anterior margin and with several transverse striae; the waist region in the posterior third, the posterior margin arcuately convex. The pronotum narrower than the head, the anterior margin shallowly concave with a slight median notch, the lateral margins sloping gently backwards, the middle of the posterior margin slightly concave forwards, the median line pale and depressed.

/species/glyptotermes-tsaii/.alate: Alate head brownish, labrum brown, anteclypeus and antennae pale brown, compound eyes reddish brown, ocelli pale, antennal spots light brown; pronotum and sternites both paler than the head capsule, femora and tibiae pale brown, wings brown and slightly paler than the head capsule, sparsely haired. Head nearly circular and slightly long, the compound eyes not very round but semicircularly projecting, their long diameter about 1.5 times the distance to the lower margin of the head capsule; ocelli on the inner side of the compound eyes, raised in the middle; a single elongate-oval antennal spot on the inner side of each antennal socket, smaller than the ocelli and slightly raised in the middle. The Y-shaped suture runs obliquely from the middle of the dorsum of the head to the ocelli, the median suture extremely indistinct; the middle of the posterior margin of the head sometimes with a longitudinal suture reaching one-third of the way up the dorsum. Antennae with 15–16 segments, the second and third equal in length. Labrum flat and square, slightly raised on the dorsum, clypeus nearly a flat trapezoid. Pronotum wider than the head capsule (excluding the compound eyes), about twice as wide as long, the anterior margin arcuately concave with a shallow median notch, the lateral margins curved backwards in an arc, the middle of the posterior margin slightly concave. Wings narrow and long, extending beyond the end of the abdomen and about as long as the abdomen, the wing membrane densely covered with small warts; the radius reaching only a quarter of the wing length, the radius sector parallel with the media as far as the anterior corner of the wing, the radius sector unbranched.

/species/glyptotermes-xiamenensis/.soldier: The soldier has the head, labrum and pronotum reddish yellow, the frons and mandibles reddish brown, antennae, legs and abdomen yellow. The head sparsely haired, the labrum and pronotum with rather more bristles, the abdominal tergites with sparse long bristles. Head capsule rectangular, rather stout and short, the sides slightly parallel, the frons slightly raised on either side and slightly depressed in the middle. Mandibles stout and short, the left with three marginal teeth, the right with two. Labrum elongate-oval, its anterior margin rounded and blunt, almost as long as wide. Antennae with ten segments, the third short and small. The postmentum widest slightly in front of the middle, narrowest at the anterior margin and at the waist, the greatest width less than twice the least. Pronotum shaped like a butterfly with spread wings, the anterior margin a broad concavity, the posterior margin slightly concave.

/species/glyptotermes-yui/.alate: The dealate adult has the head deep brownish yellow, compound eyes blackish brown, ocelli, antennae, labrum and postmentum pale yellowish brown, pronotum slightly paler than the head capsule, legs and abdomen pale yellowish brown. Head nearly circular, compound eyes oblong, their short diameter more than twice the distance from the eye to the lower margin of the head capsule; ocelli oval, close to the compound eyes; antennal spots and epicranial suture indistinct; antennae with ten segments, the second to fourth nearly equal in length. Pronotum slightly narrower than the head capsule or as wide as the head capsule (including the compound eyes).
/species/glyptotermes-yui/.soldier: The soldier has the head capsule yellowish brown tinged with red, mandibles purplish brown, labrum, antennae and pronotum pale brown, abdomen and legs pale yellowish brown. Head capsule elongate-cylindrical, the sides parallel, the posterior margin straight; in profile the dorsolateral frontal angle raised, the frontal slope about 60 degrees, the anterolateral frontal angles also projecting, the dorsal margin of the head and the ventral margin of the postmentum both nearly straight, the frontal surface a shallow V-shaped depression between the two dorsolateral frontal angles; neither the Y-shaped suture nor the ocelli visible, the compound eyes discernible. Labrum nearly circular, mandibles short and stout with rather curved tips, the basal prominence of the mandible distinct, the left mandible shorter than half the head capsule. Antennae with 13 segments. The postmentum seven to eight times as long as the waist, the broadest region before the anterior third, several transverse striae behind the anterior margin, the lateral lobes distinct, the waist region in the posterior third. The pronotum narrower than the head capsule, the anterior margin with a broad shallow V-shaped concavity, the lateral margins oblique backwards, the middle of the posterior margin very shallowly concave.

/species/glyptotermes-zhaoi/.alate: Alate head nearly square, the sides and the middle of the posterior margin rather straight, the posterolateral angles broadly rounded; the inner margin of each mandible with two marginal teeth, the apical tooth slightly longer than the first marginal tooth, the posterior margin of the first marginal tooth of the left mandible fused with the second marginal tooth and longer than the anterior margin of the third marginal tooth; labrum short, broad and tongue-shaped. Antennae with 16–19 segments, the third not larger than the second or fourth. Compound eyes rather large, projecting beyond the lower margin of the head capsule, with a pair of ocelli adjoining them on the inner side. Postmentum a slender rectangle, broad in front and then narrowing, the sides parallel, the waist near the middle. Pronotum transversely rectangular, short and broad, slightly wider in the middle and posterior parts of the sides, wider than the head capsule, the middle of the anterior margin with a broad arcuate notch, the middle of the posterior margin slightly concave and narrower. The forewing scale large, its anterior margin projecting, covering the hindwing scale; the radius sector with five to six branches, the subcosta shorter, the radius reaching less than or nearly half the total length and about twice as long as the subcosta; the media sclerotised, arising from the radius sector within the wing scale, running close to and parallel with the radius sector to the wing tip; the cubitus with about ten branches. The media of the hindwing sclerotised, arising from the cubitus outside the wing scale, rather far from the base or absent, close to the radius sector, the cubitus with two to four forked branches. Legs slender and long, tibial spur formula 3:3:3, an arolium between the claws, cerci with two segments.
/species/glyptotermes-zhaoi/.soldier: The soldier has the head capsule yellowish brown, slightly paler behind; mandibles blackish brown, labrum and antennae white-yellow, postmentum pale yellowish brown with brown margins, pronotum, legs and abdominal tergites pale yellow, the whole body sparsely haired.

/species/hodotermopsis-sjostedti/.alate: Alate body length 12–13.5 mm, uniformly brown, the head and wing bases deeper in colour. Head nearly circular, antennae with 21–26 segments. The left mandible with an apical tooth and three marginal teeth, the molar plate short; the apical tooth of the right mandible stout, the subapical tooth small, the first marginal tooth short, the second obliquely truncate, the molar plate correspondingly longer. The pronotum slightly narrower than the width of the head, with a blackish brown depression on each side near the anterior margin; the forewing scale slightly larger than the hindwing scale. Ten abdominal tergites visible dorsally, the seventh sternite the widest, and on lifting it an eight-shaped sclerite is visible; the sclerite on the inner side of the ninth sternite of the female is perhaps a reduced ovipositor, while the male bears on the same segment a pair of unsegmented short spine-like projections; on each side of the base of the tenth segment is a cercus of five segments.
/species/hodotermopsis-sjostedti/.biology: Host plants recorded as Huangshan pine, Fujian cypress, Chinese fir, Japanese cedar, Chinese guger tree and rice-flower lyonia.
/species/hodotermopsis-sjostedti/.distribution: In China recorded from Hejiang, Sichuan; Chenzhou and Xinning, Hunan; Pingbian, Yunnan; Fanjing Shan and Leigong Shan, Guizhou; Dayao Shan and Longsheng, Guangxi; Lianshan, Guangzhou and Shixing, Guangdong; Jiangxi; Wuyi Shan, Fujian; Longquan and Qingyuan, Zhejiang (900–1300 m); and Wuzhishan, Hainan; abroad from Vietnam and Japan.
/species/hodotermopsis-sjostedti/.soldier: The front of the head nearly black, passing backwards into reddish brown, labrum and antennae brownish yellow, mandibles pure black; thorax and legs yellow mixed with brown, abdomen milky white, the brown contents of the gut faintly visible through it. Head slightly square-oval, flat, widest at the posterior end or between the posterior end and the middle, narrowing forwards from there, the posterior margin arched backwards in an arc, the vertex flat with a small pit in the middle. Labrum rounded at the sides, its anterior margin rather straight; eye spots kidney-shaped. Mandibles stout, nearly symmetrical left and right, their tips pointed and curved towards the midline; the left mandible with four irregularly shaped large teeth whose bases are connected, the right with only two large teeth, the tip of the first often bearing a triangular point. Antennae with 22–24 segments, moniliform except for the first, the second to fourth nearly equal in length, thereafter slightly thickened and the last four or five segments gradually smaller. Pronotum narrower than the head, flat like a half-moon, the anterior margin slightly concave backwards, the lateral margins continuous with the posterior margin in a semicircle, the median notch of the posterior margin distinct; mesonotum and metanotum equally wide and both narrower than the pronotum. Tarsi four-segmented in dorsal view and five-segmented in ventral view; cerci with three to five segments, the spine-like projections slender and long.

/species/hospitalitermes-damenglongensis.soldier: Body medium-sized, head pear-shaped, slightly longer than wide, the sides distinctly contracted behind the antennae, widest in the posterior section of the head, the posterior margin a broad arc and very slightly convex outwards; in profile the back of the head strongly raised and distinctly depressed near the base of the nasus. The nasus cylindrical, about half the length of the head, upturned at the tip, its lower margin meeting the clypeus at almost a right angle, the frontal gland duct visible. Mandibles with a single pointed process, this process rather long. Antennae with 14 segments, the third two to three times the second, the fourth about twice the second. Pronotum saddle-shaped, the anterior lobe distinctly shorter than the posterior lobe, the anterior margin broad and straight, the lateral margins narrowing rapidly backwards, the posterior margin narrow and arcuately convex forwards. Legs rather long, the hind femora reaching or surpassing the end of the abdomen, the tibiae slender and long, spur formula 2:2:2, tarsi with four segments.
/species/hospitalitermes-damenglongensis.worker: Head reddish brown, paler in front, labrum pale yellowish brown, antennae paler than the back of the head, pronotum the same colour as the head, femora reddish brown, tibiae yellowish brown. The head with fine short hairs, the labrum with several pairs of long and short hairs, the thoracic and abdominal tergites sparsely haired and the sternites more densely so. Body medium-sized, head nearly circular, widest behind the antennae, the posterior margin arcuate, the postclypeus raised with a straight anterior margin and an arched posterior margin, a median longitudinal groove whose length is less than half its width; the vertex with a Y-shaped suture line, the fontanelle distinct and dot-like. Antennae with 15 segments, the third longer than the fourth and about 1.5 times the second. Pronotum saddle-shaped, the anterior lobe inclined upwards and almost as long as the posterior lobe, the middle of the posterior margin with a small notch. The small worker resembles the large worker in body form and chaetotaxy, its colour paler, antennae with 15 segments, the second, third and fourth nearly equal in length.

/species/hypotermes-manyunensis/.soldier: The head yellowish brown tinged with smoky, the anterior quarter paler; mandibles reddish brown with the basal third yellowish brown; labrum yellowish brown, antennae yellowish brown slightly tinged with smoky; pronotum pale yellow, abdomen and legs milky white. The head with scattered rather long hairs; the labrum with eight pairs of hairs in longitudinal rows on either side from the tip to the base; the periphery of the pronotum with several further long hairs. Head nearly oval, widest at the middle, the dorsum highest in the middle. Labrum lanceolate, raised in the middle. The front of the mandibles curved inwards: the inner margin of the left mandible with three marginal teeth at the middle and two or three small serrate teeth above the first marginal tooth, the base with a small pointed projection; the right mandible with small serrate teeth above the base and a small pointed projection at the base. Postmentum raised, widest slightly behind the middle. Antennae with 16 segments, the fourth shortest, the second twice the fourth. The anterior part of the pronotum slightly raised, the middle of both the anterior and posterior margins concave.
/species/hypotermes-manyunensis/.taxonomy_note: The original work places this species in the genus Parahypotermes; this site now treats it under Hypotermes, the genus name having changed.

/species/hypotermes-meiziensis/.soldier: The mandibles show serrate notches downwards from the middle, slightly curved inwards at the base; the postmentum widest at the middle; antennae with 16 segments, the fourth shortest, the second about twice the length of the fourth; the anterior lobe of the pronotum constricted at the middle, the middle of both the anterior and posterior margins concave inwards.

/species/hypotermes-ruiliensis/.soldier: The head yellowish brown slightly tinged with smoky, mandibles reddish brown and paler on the basal third, labrum yellowish brown, antennae yellowish brown slightly tinged with smoky, pronotum pale yellow, abdomen and legs milky white. The dorsum of the head with scattered long hairs, the labrum with eight pairs of hairs in longitudinal rows on either side from the tip to the base, the periphery of the pronotum with several scattered long hairs. Head oval, widest slightly behind the middle, highest in the middle of the dorsum. Labrum tongue-shaped, its tip slightly pointed and rounded, slightly raised in the middle. The left mandible with three marginal teeth and two or three small serrate teeth above the first marginal tooth, the basal concavity with a small pointed projection; the right mandible with two small pointed projections at the base and serrate from the base to the concavity at the middle. Postmentum short, stout and raised. Antennae with 15 segments, the third shortest, the second twice the third. The anterior part of the pronotum raised, both the anterior and posterior margins concave.
/species/hypotermes-ruiliensis/.taxonomy_note: The original work places this species in the genus Parahypotermes; this site now treats it under Hypotermes, the genus name having changed.

/species/hypotermes-sumatrensis/.distribution: In China recorded from Guangxi and from Manyun, Yingjiang, Yunnan; abroad from Sumatra, Indonesia.
/species/hypotermes-sumatrensis/.soldier: Head and antennae brownish yellow, abdomen pale yellow. The hairs of the head very sparse, those of the abdomen denser. Head oval, widest at the middle, in profile its dorsum flatly rounded with the highest point at the middle of the vertex; postmentum markedly projecting and broader behind. Mandibles sickle-shaped: the inner margin of the left mandible with two to three triangular notches behind the midpoint, and sometimes several small projections forming a serrate surface in front of the midpoint; the posterior section of the right mandible with several small notches, but these are not very distinct. The front of the labrum narrow, the lateral margins rounded, with long hairs in longitudinal rows along the margins. Antennae with 16 segments, the third and fourth shortest, the fourth sometimes shorter than the third. The middle of both the anterior and posterior margins of the pronotum concave.
/species/hypotermes-sumatrensis/.taxonomy_note: The original work places this species in the genus Parahypotermes; this site now treats it under Hypotermes, the genus name having changed.

/species/hypotermes-wandingensis/.soldier: The head yellowish brown, mandibles reddish brown, labrum yellowish brown, antennae yellowish brown and slightly tinged with smoky, pronotum pale yellow, abdomen and legs milky white. The head with scattered rather long hairs, the labrum with eight pairs of hairs in longitudinal rows from the tip to the base. Head nearly oval, widest slightly behind the middle; labrum lanceolate. The left mandible with three marginal teeth, the right finely serrate behind the middle; the base of each mandible with a small pointed projection. Postmentum much raised, its length about 1.5 times its width. Antennae with 16 segments, the fourth shortest, the second about twice the fourth. The anterior part of the pronotum slightly raised, the sides broadly rounded, the middle of both the anterior and posterior margins concave.
