/species/hypotermes-wayaoensis/.soldier: The head yellowish brown, mandibles reddish brown, labrum yellow, antennae yellow tinged with smoky, pronotum pale yellow, abdomen and legs milky white. The head with scattered long hairs, the labrum with seven pairs of hairs in longitudinal rows on either side from the tip to the base. Head nearly oval, widest at the middle; labrum tongue-shaped, its tip bluntly rounded, the sides slightly arcuate. The left mandible with three marginal teeth and a small pointed projection at the base; the right mandible with two small pointed projections at the base. Postmentum widest at the basal quarter. Antennae with 16 segments, the fourth shortest, the second about 1.5 times the length of the fourth. The anterior part of the pronotum slightly upturned, the anterior margin rather constricted with a small V-shaped median concavity, the posterior margin slightly concave.

/species/hypotermes-yingjiangensis/.alate: Head broadly oval, the fontanelle distinct and slightly raised, the ocelli rather large; the postclypeus raised, its length about half its width, the posterior margin arched and the anterior margin straight; antennae with 19 segments, the third longer than the second. The posterior ends of the mesonotum and metanotum shallowly arcuately concave. The radius of the wings projects slightly beyond the wing scale; the media of the forewing arises separately at the shoulder suture, while that of the hindwing mostly arises from the base of the radius sector. The lateral walls of the abdomen of the queen bear no densely scattered coloured dots.
/species/hypotermes-yingjiangensis/.soldier: The head yellowish brown slightly tinged with smoky, mandibles reddish brown and paler at the base than in front, labrum yellowish brown, antennae yellowish brown tinged with smoky, pronotum pale yellow, abdomen and legs milky white. The head with several scattered long hairs, the labrum with nine pairs of hairs in longitudinal rows on either side from the tip to the base, the periphery of the pronotum with only a few hairs. Head nearly oval, widest at the middle, the highest point of the dorsum slightly in front of the middle. Labrum lanceolate, slightly raised in the middle. The inner margin of the left mandible with three marginal teeth, the notch between the second and third deep, two or three small serrate teeth above the first marginal tooth; the inner margin of the right mandible serrate behind the middle; the base of each mandible with a small pointed projection. Postmentum longer than wide. Antennae with 16 segments, the fourth shortest, the second about 1.5 times the third. The anterior half of the pronotum slightly constricted, the middle of the anterior and posterior margins concave.
/species/hypotermes-yingjiangensis/.taxonomy_note: The original work places this species in the genus Parahypotermes; this site now treats it under Hypotermes, the genus name having changed.
/species/hypotermes-yingjiangensis/.worker: Workers usually occur in two size classes, large and small, and sometimes in three, large, medium and small. The sides of the head parallel or narrowed in front, the frons flat, the fontanelle dot-like; the labrum widest at the middle, with a small transparent patch at the front. Mandibles curved like a sickle, the base of the left mandible with several notches and a distinct basal tooth, the remaining parts toothless, the right mandible also toothless apart from the basal tooth. Antennae with 17 segments, the third often longer than the second. Pronotum saddle-shaped, both the anterior and posterior margins notched.

/species/incisitermes-inamurai/.soldier: Head yellowish brown; labrum, antennae and pronotum yellow; mandibles jet black, brown at the base. Head rectangular, the dorsal margin slightly convex. Outer margin of the mandibles square, the apex curved inwards; left mandible with three teeth, the anterior two sharp, the third broad, its tip divided into two lobes, a small tooth-like process between the bases of the second and third teeth; right mandible with two teeth, stout, triangular. Labrum extremely short, anterior margin square, twice as wide as long. Antennae with 15 segments, the basal segment columnar, narrower in the middle, segment 2 equal in length to segment 4, segment 3 obconical, markedly thickened towards the apex; eye vestige distinct. Pronotum quadrilateral, wider than the head, anterior margin strongly concave backwards, posterior margin nearly straight and slightly concave in the middle, lateral margins arcuate, posterolateral corners broadly rounded, anterolateral corners square. Tibia with three apical teeth, two of them directed downwards and one outwards. The original work recorded two soldier forms, major and minor, differing very little in morphology.
/species/incisitermes-inamurai/.taxonomy_note: The original work placed this species in the genus Kalotermes under the name Kalotermes inamurae; it is now assigned to the genus Incisitermes.

/species/incisitermes-minor/.alate: Head yellowish brown, compound eyes dark brown, ocelli pale, labrum greyish white, antennal segment 3 dark brown while the remaining segments are pale; thorax yellowish brown, legs yellow, wings brown and transparent. Head nearly circular, length and width almost equal; compound eyes nearly round, prominent; ocelli slightly round, not touching the compound eyes. Antennae slender, 15 to 20 segments, segment 3 slightly longer than segments 2 and 4, the terminal five or six segments stouter, the apical segment smaller, oval. Pronotum generally slightly wider than the head, sometimes almost as wide, with a notch in the middle of the anterior margin, posterior margin slightly flat. Tibial spur formula 3:3:3, tarsi 4-segmented.
/species/incisitermes-minor/.distribution: In China recorded from Nanjing, Jiangsu; Shanghai; and Ninghai, Zhejiang; abroad it occurs in California and Arizona in the United States, and in Mexico.
/species/incisitermes-minor/.soldier: Head capsule elongate, the apex of the frons often raised above the rest, forming twin peaks; frontal surface either inclined or steep, its rugae sometimes coarse and deep, sometimes smooth, or merely punctate. Antennae short, mostly 10 to 12 segments. Mandibles short and stout, much shorter relative to the head length than in Neotermes, with several clearly discernible marginal teeth, the mandibular basal hump either distinct or flat. Labrum mostly square. Pronotum flat and broad, femora not thickened; tibial spur formula 3:3:3, tarsi 4-segmented.

/species/indotermes-hainanensis/.soldier: Medium-sized. Head relatively large, hypognathous, approaching rectangular, width slightly less than length (excluding mandibles); the anterior part slightly narrower, the middle broader, the posterior margin slightly concave in the middle; in lateral view the highest point of the head dorsum lies at the middle. Labrum ligulate, broad at the base, slightly narrowed apically, the apex broadly rounded. Mandibles stout and prominent, the basal half broader, the outer margin projecting outwards, the apical half narrower, the apex markedly incurved; left mandible with a broad marginal tooth near the middle of the inner margin, its tip directed inwards, its anterior margin straight and at the same level as the tooth tip; right mandible also with an equally broad marginal tooth on the inner margin. Postmentum long and flat, length slightly less than twice the greatest width, widest at the middle of the anterior part, its width about twice that of the narrowest part of the waist. Antennae with 14 segments, segments 2 and 4 equal in length, segment 3 longest. Pronotum with the anterior lobe erect, saddle-shaped, distinctly longer than the posterior lobe, the anterior margin of the anterior lobe projecting in the middle, the posterior margin of the posterior lobe with a distinct notch in the middle. Tibial spur formula 2:2:2, tarsi 3-segmented.
/species/indotermes-hainanensis/.taxonomy_note: The original work placed this species in the genus Sinotermes; it is now assigned to the genus Indotermes.

/species/indotermes-isodentatus/.alate: Head, thorax and abdomen brown; anteclypeus white, postclypeus brown, labrum, mandibles, antennae, legs and wings yellowish brown. Body densely covered with fine hairs, the wing surface smooth and hairless. Head oval, short and broad; compound eyes medium-sized, ocelli elliptical, the distance between ocellus and compound eye about equal to the length of the ocellus. Postclypeus very highly arched, longitudinal length less than half the width, anterior margin straight, posterior margin wedge-shaped and extending backwards; anteclypeus equal in length to the postclypeus. Fontanelle a large round pit, situated at the centre of the vertex. Antennae with 15 segments, segments 2, 3 and 4 about equal in length. The middle part of the anterior margin of the pronotum nearly straight, the lateral ends slightly projecting forwards, the centre slightly concave. Radius sector of the forewing close to the anterior margin and extending to near the wing apex, without distinct branches; media arising independently at the humeral suture, situated between the radius sector and the cubitus, dividing after the middle into several branches that reach the wing apex; cubitus with about ten branches. Media of the hindwing arising fused with the radius sector at the humeral suture, likewise between the two, the remaining venation as in the forewing.
/species/indotermes-isodentatus/.distribution: Donghai Island and Qizhou Island, Guangdong; Nada, Hainan; Mengla, Jinping, Yunnan (430 m); Puer (1350 m); Mojiang (1400 m); Jinghong (500 m); Menghan and Nujiangba.
/species/indotermes-isodentatus/.soldier: Head dark reddish brown; the anterior half of the mandibles black, the posterior half concolorous with the head; the middle of the labrum also concolorous with the head; thorax and abdomen brown, the ventral surface paler, legs pale yellow. Head densely covered with short pubescence, among which a few long hairs are scattered; thorax and abdomen with long and short hairs interspersed. Head slightly rectangular, flattened-cylindrical and stout, the sides nearly parallel, the posterior part slightly narrower, the posterior margin slightly arcuate and projecting. Labrum small, the anterior end bluntly rounded, the anterior margin and the sides colourless and transparent. Mandibles stout, flattened and broad at the base, each of the left and right mandibles with a large triangular inner-margin tooth at the middle. Antennae with 14 segments, segment 2 shorter than or equal in length to segment 3, segment 3 equal to or longer than segment 4. Postmentum elongated, slightly narrowed behind the middle. Pronotum very narrow, the anterior lobe erect and semicircular, the posterior lobe trapezoidal, the posterior margin slightly concave inwards.

/species/indotermes-luxiensis/.distribution: Mengga, Luxi, Yunnan, 1380 m above sea level.
/species/indotermes-luxiensis/.soldier: Head brown; the base of the mandibles yellowish brown, from the middle to the apical teeth reddish brown; labrum and antennae pale yellow; pronotum concolorous with the head, legs pale yellow. Head densely covered with fine hairs and sparsely with long hairs, the postmentum with short hairs and long hairs intermixed in its anterior part, thorax and abdomen with many long hairs in addition to short ones. Medium-sized; head length slightly greater than the width, the sides nearly parallel, widest about posteriorly, highest at the middle, the posterolateral corners broadly rounded, the posterior margin nearly straight; the dorsal longitudinal suture of the head extending forwards from the middle of the posterior margin to one third of the head length. Labrum ligulate. Mandibles very stout, flattened, broad and swollen at the base, the outer margin with distinct undulate prominences; left mandible with a blunt marginal tooth near the middle of the inner margin, right mandible with a triangular marginal tooth at the middle of the inner margin, its tip directed obliquely inwards. Antennae with 14 segments, segment 3 longer than segment 2. Postmentum narrow and elongate, narrowest in the posterior half. Pronotum saddle-shaped, the anterior lobe standing vertically above the posterior lobe, the anterior margin of the anterior lobe narrowly rounded, the posterior margin of the posterior lobe slightly concave in the middle. Tibial spur formula 2:2:2, tarsi 3-segmented.
/species/indotermes-luxiensis/.taxonomy_note: The original work placed this species in the genus Sinitermes; it is now assigned to the genus Indotermes.

/species/indotermes-menggarensis/.alate: Head densely covered with short pubescence and scattered long hairs. Head nearly circular, width slightly greater than length (excluding mandibles); fontanelle distinct, situated slightly towards the posterior end; Y suture indistinct. Compound eyes large and prominent, usually circular; ocelli broadly oval, relatively close to the compound eyes. Postclypeus arched, length slightly less than half the width, anterior margin rather flat, posterior margin arcuate and projecting; anteclypeus almost trapezoidal; labrum roof-shaped, anterior margin rounded. Antennae with 15 segments. Pronotum slightly narrower than the head, anterior margin thickened, posterior margin with a distinct triangular notch in the middle. Forewings and hindwings shed, the forewing scale longer than the hindwing scale. Tibial spur formula 3:2:2, tarsi 3-segmented.
/species/indotermes-menggarensis/.distribution: Mengga, Luxi, Yunnan, 1375 m above sea level.
/species/indotermes-menggarensis/.soldier: Head and base of the mandibles yellowish brown, turning reddish brown from the inner-margin tooth to the apical teeth; labrum and antennae pale yellow; pronotum slightly paler than the head. Head covered with sparse fine hairs, several pairs of long hairs between the apex of the labrum and the clypeus, the mandibular base with short hairs, the anterior part of the postmentum with a few scattered long hairs; thorax and abdomen with long and short hairs interspersed. Head length slightly greater than the width, the base of the mandibles slightly narrowed, widest behind the middle; in lateral view the highest point of the head dorsum near the posterior end, the posterior margin slightly arcuate. Labrum ligulate, slightly narrowed apically, the margins transparent. Mandibles stout, flattened and broad at the base, left mandible with two undulate prominences from the outer base to the middle, with a triangular marginal tooth near the middle, right mandible also with a triangular marginal tooth near the middle. Postmentum broad, short and flat, narrowest at the middle. Antennae with 14 segments, segment 2 slightly shorter than segment 3, segments 3 and 4 equal in length. Pronotum elongate semi-elliptical and erect, deeply concave at the junction of the anterior and posterior lobes, the posterior lobe wider than the anterior lobe. Tibial spur formula 2:2:2, tarsi 3-segmented.

/species/indotermes-yunnanensis/.alate: Smaller in size; head thick and slightly convex; compound eyes very small, fontanelle distinct; postclypeus wider than the frons, the surface rather flat, length less than half the width; labrum wider than long; antennae with 15 to 16 segments. Pronotum longer than half its width. Forewing scale slightly longer than the hindwing scale, the wing surface with fine dense punctures; media of the forewing arising independently at the humeral suture, media of the hindwing arising from the radius sector, the media situated close to the cubitus. Tibial spur formula 3:2:2.
/species/indotermes-yunnanensis/.soldier: Coloration paler, head brownish yellow, thoracic and abdominal tergites pale brown. Head densely covered with fine pubescence and scattered longer hairs; pronotum densely pubescent with a few scattered long hairs; abdominal tergites and sternites densely pubescent. Larger in size; head approaching rectangular, the sides almost parallel, width distinctly less than length (excluding mandibles); in lateral view the highest point of the head dorsum at the middle. Labrum ligulate and rather broad, the sides almost parallel, slightly wider than long. Mandibles rather stout, swollen at the base with the outer margin bulging outwards, the apex markedly incurved, the inner margin with a broad marginal tooth near the middle, its tip directed inwards. Postmentum large, length slightly more than twice the greatest width; widest near the anterior end, narrowest near the posterior end. Antennae with 15 segments, segments 2 and 4 equal in length, segment 3 shortest. Anterior lobe of the pronotum standing high, saddle-shaped, distinctly longer than the posterior lobe; anterior margin of the anterior lobe rather flat, posterior margin of the posterior lobe slightly concave in the middle. Tibial spur formula 3:2:2, tarsi 3-segmented.
/species/indotermes-yunnanensis/.taxonomy_note: The original work placed this species in the genus Sinotermes; it is now assigned to the genus Indotermes.

/species/macrotermes-acrocephalus/.soldier: Major soldier: head yellowish brown tinged with red, thoracic and abdominal tergites yellowish brown. Head elongate-oval, length about 1.3 times the width, posterior margin broadly rounded; in lateral view the dorsal margin of the head mound-like and arched, the fontanelle situated behind the highest point, the postmentum prominent; labrum lanceolate, the semi-transparent area at the tip of the labrum triangular; mandibles rather stout, about half the length of the head capsule, the middle of the inner margin of the left mandible with indistinct fine teeth, with several incisions near the mandibular base; antennae with 17 segments, segment 3 slightly longer than segment 2, compound eyes dot-like; postmentum about four times as long as wide, the waist region in the anterior third, its sides almost parallel. Anterior and posterior margins of the pronotum both distinctly incised; mesonotum and metanotum narrower than the pronotum, the lateral lobes of the thoracic tergites not markedly angular. Minor soldier slightly paler, head subrectangular, the fontanelle behind the midpoint, the labrum narrower; mandibles slender and elongate, about two thirds of the head capsule length, with fine teeth behind the middle of the inner margin of the left mandible; postmentum elongated, about three times as long as wide.

/species/macrotermes-annandalei/.alate: Head, thorax and abdomen dark reddish brown, legs brownish yellow, wings yellow, postclypeus dark reddish yellow. Head broadly oval, compound eyes elongate-oval, ocelli elliptical, the distance between the ocelli and the compound eyes less than the width of the ocellus itself; vertex flat, fontanelle a very small granular projection situated at the midpoint of the vertex, with a keel-like longitudinal ridge in front of it; postclypeus markedly arched, length less than half the width, with a median longitudinal groove; antennae with 19 segments, segment 3 slightly longer than segment 2, segments 2, 4 and 5 equal in length. Anterior margin of the pronotum slightly concave backwards, the posterior margin narrow, concave forwards in the middle, with a pale cruciform patch in the anterior middle and round or kidney-shaped pale patches on both sides in front of it. Forewing scale slightly larger than the hindwing scale; media of the forewing arising independently at the humeral suture, closer to the cubitus than to the radius sector, branching after the midpoint, the cubitus of the forewing with more than ten branches; media of the hindwing arising from the base of the radius sector or independently at the humeral suture, running close to the cubitus and branching after the middle, the cubitus of the hindwing also with more than ten branches.
/species/macrotermes-annandalei/.distribution: In China recorded from Wuming, Longzhou and Fusui, Guangxi, and from Yingjiang, Manyun, Mangshi, Nujiangba, Nanxi and Yunjinghong (500 m above sea level), Puer (1300 m above sea level) and Changpotou, Jinping (1000 m above sea level), Yunnan; abroad recorded from Myanmar and Thailand.
/species/macrotermes-annandalei/.soldier: Major soldier: head dark reddish brown on both dorsum and venter, thorax and abdomen brown, the base of the mandibles concolorous with the head and the remainder black; hairs on the head extremely sparse, those on the abdomen more numerous. Head flattened and enormous, in dorsal view elongate-trapezoidal, broad behind and narrow in front, the posterior margin slightly curved or almost straight, the lateral margins very slightly curved. Postmentum narrow and elongate, curved towards the venter, fontanelle minute. Mandibles stout, sickle-shaped: the left mandible with several shallow incisions and one deeper one behind the midpoint, without teeth anteriorly; the right mandible toothless. Labrum ligulate, the tip semi-transparent. Antennae with 17 segments, segment 3 about 1.5 to 2 times the length of segment 2 and markedly shorter than segment 4. Pronotum slightly wider than half the head width, its anterior part inclined upwards, the lateral margins extending to the sides at an obtuse angle, the anterior and posterior margins both with distinct incisions in the middle, the metanotum narrower than the pronotum, legs very long. Minor soldier markedly smaller, similar in coloration, head narrower and more elongate, the postmentum markedly curved and projecting on the venter, mandibles narrow, elongate and curved, almost toothless, antennal segment 3 longer than segments 2 and 4, legs also very long.

/species/macrotermes-barneyi/.alate: Coloration and morphology very similar to the preceding species, differing in the head and pronotum being shorter and narrower.
/species/macrotermes-barneyi/.distribution: In China widely distributed in the southern provinces and in Hong Kong; abroad it occurs in Vietnam.
/species/macrotermes-barneyi/.soldier: Major soldier: head deep yellow, abdomen paler, mandibles black; head and pronotum with a few erect hairs, the abdominal dorsum with few hairs and the venter with more. Head rectangular, widest in the posterior part or at the middle, only the anterior end slightly narrowed; fontanelle very small, situated near the midpoint of the head; head dorsum fairly flat, sloping gradually forwards and downwards from the fontanelle. Mandibles sickle-shaped, labrum ligulate, with a transparent triangular area at the tip; antennae with 17 segments, segment 3 longer than or equal to segment 2, a pale eye spot below and behind the antennal socket. Thorax and legs as in the preceding species. Minor soldier markedly smaller and slightly paler; head oval, the lateral margins more curved than in the major soldier, the posterolateral corners rounded; mandibles relatively longer, appearing slender and straight; antennae with 17 segments, segment 2 longer than or equal to segment 3; otherwise similar to the major soldier.

/species/macrotermes-chebalingensis/.soldier: Major soldier: head and thoracic dorsum yellowish brown, the abdominal dorsum slightly paler. Head capsule almost trapezoidal, widest posteriorly, the posterior margin straight; fontanelle dot-like, situated in front of the midpoint of the head, in lateral view the dorsal margin of the head highly arched at the fontanelle, the frontal region flat and slightly concave, the ventral margin of the head and the posterior part of the postmentum markedly projecting. Labrum lanceolate, the semi-transparent area at the tip triangular; mandibles stout, the anterior part rather curved, the middle of the inner margin of the left mandible with traces of fine teeth, several incisions in front of the mandibular base; antennae with 17 segments, segment 3 rather long, segments 2 and 4 nearly equal, segment 5 shorter; postmentum 3.78 times as long as the waist width. Anterior margin of the pronotum with a shallow incision in the middle, the posterior margin and the posterior margin of the mesonotum shallowly concave in the middle, the posterior margin of the metanotum straight in the middle; the lateral margins of the pro-, meso- and metanotum angular, the metanotum slightly obtuse. Minor soldier: head and thoracic dorsum bright yellow tinged with brown, the abdominal dorsum pale yellow; head capsule intermediate between oval and trapezoidal, widest behind the middle; postmentum band-like, 2.45 to 2.77 times as long as wide; anterior margin of the pronotum broadly rounded.

/species/macrotermes-choui/.soldier: Major soldier: head brown tinged with red, thoracic and abdominal tergites dark brown. Head sub-trapezoidal, length about 1.3 times the width, the posterior margin nearly straight, fontanelle at the midpoint; in lateral view both the dorsal and ventral margins of the head slightly arched, the postmentum slightly exposed; labrum lanceolate, the semi-transparent area at the tip an acute triangle; mandibles stout, about half the head capsule in length, the apex slightly curved, the middle of the inner margin of the left mandible with distinct small teeth, three to four incisions near the mandibular base; antennae with 17 segments, segment 3 less than twice the length of segment 2, compound eyes dot-like and projecting; postmentum more than four times as long as wide, the waist region in front of the midpoint, the sides gradually widening backwards from the middle, the premental region smooth. Anterior margin of the pronotum roughly straight, the posterior margin distinctly incised in the middle, the lateral margins broadly rounded; mesonotum wider than the pronotum, metanotum either slightly wider than the pronotum or the two nearly equal in size. Minor soldier: head brown tinged with yellow, thorax and abdomen brown; head subrectangular, labrum elongate-lanceolate, mandibles slender and less than two thirds of the head capsule length, the base of the right mandible with a small pointed tooth, postmentum about three times as long as wide.

/species/macrotermes-constrictus/.soldier: Head brown tinged with red, thorax and abdomen brown. Head subrectangular, length about 1.2 to 1.3 times the width, the posterolateral corners broadly rounded, fontanelle at the midpoint; in lateral view the dorsal margin of the head slightly arched at the fontanelle, the postmentum slightly projecting. Labrum lanceolate, the semi-transparent area at the tip triangular. Mandibles stout, about half the head capsule in length, the apex slightly curved; the anterior part of the inner margin of the left mandible with scattered fine teeth, three incisions behind the midpoint. Antennae with 17 segments, segment 3 slightly longer than segment 2, segments 2 and 4 nearly equal; compound eyes small, dot-like and distinctly projecting. Postmentum about 3.5 times its width, the waist region near the middle. The anterior and posterior margins of the pronotum both distinctly incised in the middle; mesonotum and metanotum both narrower than the pronotum, the angular extension of their lateral lobes very inconspicuous.

/species/macrotermes-declivatus/.distribution: Jinggu, Yunnan (850 to 900 m above sea level).
/species/macrotermes-declivatus/.soldier: Major soldier: head reddish brown, anteclypeus white, labrum pale reddish brown, antennae pale, mandibles black except for the dark reddish brown base, pronotum brown, mesonotum and metanotum slightly paler, legs pale, abdomen pale brown. Head hairless, with only five hairs along the lateral margins of the labrum and two on each side of the anterior part of the postmentum, the anterior and posterior margins and the anterolateral corners of the pronotum with a few setae. Head basket-shaped, narrow in front, widest in the posterior half, the posterior margin slightly arched in the middle; fontanelle small and round, situated in the anterior half; compound eyes minute, dot-like; anteclypeus membranous. Labrum longer than wide, the transparent apex arrow-shaped; mandibles long and stout, the apex incurved, the left mandible with fine serrations, the right mandible toothless; postmentum long, the lateral margins of the anterior part projecting, the middle and posterior parts slightly parallel; antennae with 17 segments, segment 3 longer than segment 2, segment 2 shortest. Pronotum twice as wide as long, the anterior and posterior margins both incised in the middle, the lateral lobes distinct, narrow and rounded. Medium soldier: head slightly reddish brown, labrum reddish brown, abdomen pale reddish brown; minor soldier palest, the labrum with four hairs on each side, mandibles slender.

/species/macrotermes-denticulatus/.distribution: Xiaomenglun, Yunnan; Xinglong, Hainan; Pingxiang, Guangxi.
/species/macrotermes-denticulatus/.soldier: Major soldier: head capsule reddish brown, mandibles pure black with a reddish brown base, thoracic and abdominal tergites pale brown, legs yellowish white; pilosity extremely sparse, with only a few setae on each side of the labrum, the setae at the tips of the lateral angles of the thoracic segments also absent. Head nearly rectangular, narrow in front and broad in the middle, the lateral margins slightly undulate, the posterior margin nearly straight; the middle of the inner margin of the left mandible with a row of small serrations; labrum broadly ligulate, about as long as wide apart from the transparent tip, the tip blunt; the anterior part of the postmentum contracted, broader above the waist, narrowing and then parallel below it; antennae with 17 segments, segment 3 1.5 times as long as segment 2, segment 5 shortest; fontanelle situated in the anterior part of the middle of the head. The anterior and posterior margins of the pronotum both distinctly incised, the posterior margin of the mesonotum clearly concave, the posterior margin of the metanotum nearly straight, the lateral angles of all three thoracic segments with angular lobes. Minor soldier paler, head pale yellow and thorax and abdomen even paler, mandibles reddish brown, almost hairless; head oval, widest at the middle, mandibles slender, elongate and nearly straight, labrum ligulate with a rounded blunt transparent tip, fontanelle and eyes both indistinct; antennae with 17 segments, segment 2 slightly longer than segment 3.

/species/macrotermes-guangxiensis/.alate: Head nearly reddish brown, postclypeus and ocelli pale yellowish brown, thoracic tergites reddish brown, abdomen paler; head with sparse long hairs and almost hairless on the posterior margin, the anterior and lateral margins of the pronotum also with sparse long hairs, the dorsum with both long and short hairs apart from indistinct maculae. Head distinctly wider than long, the posterior margin broadly rounded; fontanelle at the centre of the dorsum, circular and projecting; compound eyes relatively large, elliptical and prominent; ocelli oval, slightly convex, their distance to the compound eyes distinctly less than the short diameter of the ocellus; postclypeus markedly arched, with a longitudinal line at the centre of the dorsum, the anterior margin bearing a pair of long hairs; the anterior margin of the anteclypeus slightly convex in the middle; labrum ligulate, the anterior margin nearly flat; left mandible with two marginal teeth.
/species/macrotermes-guangxiensis/.soldier: Major soldier: head capsule nearly reddish brown, mandibles dark brown with a reddish brown base, antennae pale yellow, pronotum yellowish brown, mesonotum, metanotum and abdomen paler, head and pronotum almost hairless. Head almost trapezoidal, the posterior margin broadly rounded, in lateral view the middle of the dorsal margin slightly raised; fontanelle near the centre, dot-like and sunken, the eye spot small and distinct; labrum ligulate, slightly convex in the middle of each side, the apex of the transparent area rather pointed; mandibles stout with the apex incurved, the base of the inner margin of the left mandible with an incision, the fine teeth below the midpoint indistinct; postmentum nearly rectangular, the waist region almost parallel; antennae with 17 segments, segment 3 about twice segment 2. Anterior margin of the pronotum deeply concave with a median incision, the posterior margin also deeply concave, the lateral lobes narrow and rounded; posterior margin of the mesonotum deeply concave, that of the metanotum nearly straight. Minor soldier: head reddish brown, mandibles reddish brown, antennae yellowish brown; head nearly rectangular, slightly narrower in front; eyes small and oval; mandibles slender and straight with the apex incurved, the base of the inner margin of the left mandible with an incision but without fine teeth. Pronotum widest, the anterior margin broadly rounded and shallowly concave in the middle; mesonotum narrowest; hind tibia longer than the head width.

/species/macrotermes-hainanensis/.soldier: Major soldier: head reddish brown, mandibles dark brown, antennae and pronotum brownish yellow, mesonotum, metanotum and abdomen pale brownish yellow, legs yellowish white; about ten long setae on each side of the labrum, three to four on the postclypeus, the thoracic and abdominal tergites with only sparse hairs. Head nearly rectangular, widest at the middle, the posterior margin straight; mandibles stout, the apex incurved, the base of the left mandible with several incisions; labrum elliptical, the transparent apex triangular and pointed; fontanelle slightly in front of the middle, a small brown dot; antennae with 17 segments, segment 3 1.5 to 2 times segment 2; postmentum long, contracted anteriorly, widest in front of the waist, parallel below it and narrowest at the anterior margin. Pronotum widest, the anterior and posterior margins distinctly incised; mesonotum narrowest with a broadly concave posterior margin; the posterior margin of the metanotum nearly flat; the anterolateral corners of the pronotum bluntly rounded, the lateral angles of the mesonotum and metanotum sharp. Minor soldier: head, labrum and antennae orange-yellow, mandibles reddish brown; eight to ten setae on each side of the labrum; head nearly rectangular with the posterior margin nearly flat; mandibles slender, elongate and rather straight; antennae with 17 segments, segment 3 almost equal to segment 2; the anterolateral corners of the pronotum broadly lobed.

/species/macrotermes-incisus/.soldier: Major soldier: head capsule and labrum pale brownish yellow, mandibles dark brown, antennae brown, thorax, abdomen and legs dull yellow; hairs extremely sparse, with five pairs of somewhat longer hairs behind the apical hairs of the labrum, the pronotum almost bare. Head nearly rectangular, slightly swollen near the middle, the posterior margin arcuate and concave in the centre; in lateral view the dorsal margin rather flat, the middle of the postmentum arched outwards; mandibles stout and curved, the apex strongly incurved; antennae with 17 segments, segments 3 and 4 nearly equal in length and both shorter than segment 2. Anterior lobe of the pronotum shorter than the posterior lobe, the posterior margin markedly concave in the middle; mesonotum narrowest with the lateral angles projecting as points; metanotum slightly wider than the mesonotum but narrower than the pronotum. Minor soldier: head brownish yellow, mandibles dark brown, pronotum pale brownish yellow; head nearly rectangular and widest near the middle; fontanelle a small red dot, the eyes below and behind the antennal sockets; labrum elongate-lanceolate; mandibles slender with the apex slightly incurved; antennae with 17 segments, segment 2 longer than segment 3, segment 4 shortest. Anterior and posterior lobes of the pronotum almost equal in length, the anterior notch minute and the posterior notch distinct.
/species/macrotermes-incisus/.taxonomy_note: The genus name was printed in the original work as Macrote, a typographical error for Macrotermes; the species is still placed in the genus Macrotermes.

/species/macrotermes-jinghongensis/.biology: Host recorded as the rubber tree.
/species/macrotermes-jinghongensis/.soldier: Head brown tinged with red, thoracic and abdominal tergites dark brown. Head nearly rectangular, length about 1.25 to 1.36 times the width, the posterior margin nearly straight; fontanelle at the midpoint, in lateral view the dorsal margin and the postmentum both slightly arched; labrum lanceolate, the semi-transparent area at the tip triangular; mandibles short and stout, the apex slightly curved, the fine teeth at the middle of the inner margin of the left mandible indistinct, with two incisions near the mandibular base; antennae with 17 segments, segment 3 about 1.5 times segment 2; compound eyes dot-like; postmentum about more than four times as long as the narrowest part, the waist region in front of the midpoint, the sides gradually widening backwards from the middle. The anterior and posterior margins of the pronotum both incised in the middle, the lateral lobes broadly rounded; mesonotum and metanotum wider than or almost equal to the pronotum, their lateral lobes distinctly projecting at an angle.

/species/macrotermes-longiceps/.soldier: Major soldier: head reddish brown, mandibles dark brown, labrum, antennae, pronotum and abdominal tergites brownish yellow, mesonotum, metanotum and legs pale yellow; eight to ten setae on the labrum, two on the clypeus, two to four on the pronotum. Head rather long, gradually widening from front to back and widest behind, in dorsal view an isosceles trapezoid, the posterior margin slightly arched; mandibles stout, the middle of the inner margin with serrations, the mandibular body rather short; labrum elliptical, widest at the middle, the transparent area long and triangular, the apex bluntly convex; antennae with 17 segments, segment 3 longer than segment 2; fontanelle slightly in front of the middle, a small brown dot; postmentum long, broader in front of the waist and nearly parallel below it. The posterior incision of the pronotum larger than the anterior one; the lateral angles of all three thoracic segments with distinct angular lobes, the tips of the angles usually bearing one long seta. Minor soldier: head, labrum and antennae yellow, mandibles reddish brown, thorax and abdomen pale yellow; head nearly rectangular, slightly contracted anteriorly with the posterior margin arched; mandibles slender, rather straight with the apex slightly curved; labrum ligulate, the transparent area projecting as a triangle; antennae with 17 segments, segment 2 slightly longer than segment 3; fontanelle and eyes both indistinct.

/species/macrotermes-longimentis/.alate: Head and thorax deep yellowish brown, abdomen slightly paler; postclypeus deep yellow, markedly arched, with two hairs; anteclypeus white; labrum yellow, with an ill-defined pale transverse band at the middle and a slightly darker triangular patch in front of it and behind it, four hairs in all. Pilosity sparse on the head, somewhat denser on the thorax and abdomen.
/species/macrotermes-longimentis/.soldier: Head yellowish brown, the base of the antennae, the thoracic tergites and the posterior half of each abdominal segment darker, mandibles black; hairs sparse on head and thorax, those on the posterior margins of the abdominal segments arranged in rows, about more than twenty. Head nearly oval, narrow in front and broad behind, the lateral margins arcuate, the posterolateral corners rounded; labrum about 1.5 times as long as wide, the large semi-transparent pentagonal area at the tip enclosing a small triangular area; mandibles slender, sickle-shaped, the left mandible with eight incisions behind the midpoint, of which the first and third counted from the base are deeper and the second broader and shallower, the rest minute, the right mandible with a projection at the base and otherwise smooth and toothless; antennae with 17 segments, segment 3 longest and segment 2 shortest, segment 3 nearly twice segment 2 and slightly longer than segment 4.

/species/macrotermes-luokengensis/.alate: Head and thoracic dorsum dark brown, compound eyes black, postclypeus brown, mandibles dark brown, antennae dark brown. Compound eyes oval, ocelli elongate-oval, the distance between the ocelli and the compound eyes slightly less than the ocellus width; postclypeus markedly arched, length less than half the width, with a median longitudinal groove; antennae with 19 segments, segment 3 slightly longer than segment 2; fontanelle minute, situated at the centre of the vertex. Pronotum flat, about as wide as the head, broader anteriorly and narrower posteriorly, with a concavity in the middle both in front and behind, a Y-shaped pale marking slightly above the centre, and a round pale spot at each of the upper left and right corners and below the middle. Forewing scale slightly larger than the hindwing scale, the media of the forewing arising independently from the base, closer to the cubitus than to the radius sector, and beginning to branch before the midpoint, the media of the hindwing arising slightly in front of the base of the radius sector and also branching before the midpoint.
/species/macrotermes-luokengensis/.soldier: Major soldier: head brownish, abdominal tergites dark brown, mandibles black, the face with sparse small hairs. Minor soldier paler, head brownish yellow, abdomen and legs pale yellow, antennae brown, mandibles black, labrum brown with a white transparent triangular point at the anterior end. Head widest in the middle and posterior part, narrowing forwards, the two posterior corners distinctly rounded and the lateral margins rather strongly curved; mandibles slender, straight and stiff, only the tip slightly curved, the base of the left mandible with several undulate incisions, the right mandible toothless; antennae with 17 segments, segments 2 and 3 about equal in length; labrum ligulate with a transparent triangular point at the anterior end, wider than long; fontanelle minute but still distinct, situated at the centre of the vertex; the posterior part of the head with two rather short dark longitudinal stripes; postmentum projecting outwards; pronotum narrower than the head, about two thirds of the head width, the anterior margin with a few short hairs.
/species/macrotermes-luokengensis/.taxonomy_note: The genus name was printed in the original work as Macrorermes, a typographical error for Macrotermes; the species is still placed in the genus Macrotermes.

/species/macrotermes-meidoensis/.distribution: Motuo, Tibet (800 to 1100 m above sea level); Shiqiong Mountain (1000 m); Maniweng (800 m); Xirang (800 to 1200 m).
/species/macrotermes-meidoensis/.soldier: Major soldier: head reddish brown, slightly paler posteriorly, with two dark brown longitudinal stripes from the middle of the dorsum to the posterior margin, antennae brownish yellow, mandibles black with a reddish brown base, thoracic and abdominal tergites yellowish brown; head almost bare, ten setae on each side of the labrum, four on the pronotum. Head longer than wide, elongate-trapezoidal, narrow in front and broad behind, widest in the middle and posterior part, the posterior margin nearly straight; fontanelle dot-like at the centre of the dorsum; postmentum long, broad and hexagonal in front, constricted at the waist; mandibles stout with the anterior end incurved, the left mandible with several shallow incisions and one deeper one behind the midpoint, the right mandible toothless; labrum almost triangular, widest near the base, the transparent anterior part pagoda-shaped; antennae with 17 segments, segment 1 longest, segment 2 shortest and small, columnar. Minor soldier smaller and paler; head oval, fontanelle at the centre of the vertex, postmentum projecting on the venter and club-shaped; labrum narrow and elongate, the tip transparent and spear-like; mandibles straight and slender, sabre-like, the tip slightly incurved; antennae with 17 segments, segment 5 shortest.
/species/macrotermes-meidoensis/.worker: Head yellow, mandibles yellowish brown with dark brown teeth; head nearly circular; antennae with 17 segments, segments 1 and 2 cylindrical, segment 5 shortest, a small pale eye spot behind the antennal socket; fontanelle flattened and round, at the centre of the vertex; clypeus divided into anterior and posterior parts, the anteclypeus small and flat, the postclypeus large and raised and divided into left and right halves by the median suture; labrum short and ligulate; left and right mandibles each with one apical tooth and two marginal teeth; the anterior half of the pronotum tilted upwards and saddle-shaped.

/species/macrotermes-menglongensis/.soldier: Head orange-red, mandibles reddish brown and pale near the base, antennae orange-yellow, thoracic and abdominal tergites slightly paler than the head; head and pronotum with only a few long hairs. Head nearly oval, fontanelle at the centre of the head, eyes indistinct, in lateral view the dorsal margin slightly arched and the mentum projecting; labrum almost conical, the dorsum markedly arched, widest near the base, the apex of the transparent area narrowly rounded; mandibles slender and straight, the apex slightly curved, the base of the inner margin of the left mandible with an incision, with slight fine teeth below the midpoint, the inner margin of the right mandible smooth; postmentum nearly rectangular, the waist indistinct, narrowest at the anterior end, the sides somewhat parallel; antennae with 17 segments, segment 3 slightly longer than segment 2 or segment 4. Pronotum widest, the anterior and posterior margins both shallowly concave in the middle or the anterior concavity indistinct, the lateral lobes narrow and rounded; mesonotum narrowest, the posterior margin slightly concave in the middle, the lateral lobes nearly round; the posterior margin of the metanotum nearly straight, the lateral lobes nearly round.

/species/macrotermes-orthognathus/.soldier: Body yellow tinged with brown overall, legs slightly paler. Minor soldier: head oval, 1.2 to 1.4 times as long as wide, fontanelle behind the midpoint, in lateral view the dorsal margin of the head slightly arched and the postmentum markedly projecting; mandibles slender, reaching more than two thirds of the head capsule in length, the apex slender and straight, the inner margin of the left mandible with fine teeth from the midpoint onwards; antennae with 17 segments; postmentum a narrow band, the sides nearly parallel. Anterior and posterior margins of the pronotum shallowly concave, the lateral lobes of the prothorax and metathorax not markedly angular, the sides of the mesonotum nearly parallel; hind tibia longer than the head width.

/species/macrotermes-peritrimorphus/.soldier: Major soldier: head, labrum, antennae and pronotum yellowish brown, abdominal tergites and legs paler, mandibles dark brown, white where the anteclypeus meets the mandibular base; about ten long setae around the anterior half of the middle of the labrum, three to four on the postclypeus, about ten in the median area of the pronotum, one long seta at each of the angular lobes of the mesonotum and metanotum. Head nearly rectangular, broader in the middle and slightly narrower behind, the posterior margin almost straight; the left mandible smooth above the middle, with minute serrations below the middle that become coarser towards the base; labrum ligulate, longer than wide, the transparent apex almost a rounded triangle and blunt; antennae with 17 segments, segment 3 slightly longer than segment 2, segment 4 almost equal to segment 2; postmentum rectangular, broader in front and narrower and parallel below the waist. Pronotum widest, the anterior margin slightly concave in the middle and the posterior margin markedly concave in the centre; mesonotum narrowest. Medium soldier paler; head oval, widest about the posterior third; mandibles rather slender and straight; posterior margin of the pronotum concave in the middle. Minor soldier even smaller, resembling the medium soldier and paler still.

/species/macrotermes-planicapitatus/.soldier: Major soldier: head brown, thorax and abdomen mottled dark brown and slightly darker than the head, mandibles almost black, the basal segment and segment 2 of the antennae slightly paler, legs deep yellow; hairs sparse on the head and thoracic dorsum, each abdominal tergite with a row of hairs along its posterior margin. Head slightly narrowed from the antennal sockets to the mandibular base, the sides parallel behind the antennal sockets, the posterior margin rather flat; in lateral view the dorsum flat; mandibles stout with the apex incurved, the inner margin of the left mandible with several small teeth behind the midpoint and with extremely indistinct tooth traces in front of the midpoint; labrum narrow and elongate, slightly broader near the middle of each side, the transparent area distinct and projecting as a point in its anterior half; fontanelle dot-like, situated in front of the mid-dorsal point; antennae with 17 segments, segment 3 narrow and elongate and longer than segment 4. Anterior plate of the pronotum slightly shorter than the posterior plate, the median notch of the anterior margin shallow and that of the posterior margin slightly deeper; the sides of the prothorax and metathorax obtusely angular, those of the mesothorax roundly angular; hind tibia slightly shorter than the head width. Minor soldier: sides nearly parallel and only slightly broader at the middle; mandibles slender, elongate and rather straight; labrum narrow and elongate with the transparent apex projecting as a point; antennae with 17 segments, segment 2 larger than segment 3; postmentum rectangular without a waist region.
/species/macrotermes-planicapitatus/.worker: Major worker: coloration dark, thorax, abdomen and legs distinctly paler than the head and pale yellow, pilosity sparse, with short hairs scattered only on the dorsum; head widest at the sides near the antennal sockets, narrowing backwards in a circular arc, the posterior margin narrowly rounded; fontanelle slightly behind the mid-dorsal point; labrum broadly ligulate; postclypeus slightly arched and band-like, the longitudinal suture distinct; antennae with 17 segments, segment 3 smaller than or slightly larger than segment 2 and smaller than or equal to segment 4; pronotum distinctly divided into anterior and posterior lobes, the anterior lobe slightly longer than the posterior lobe and standing at right angles to it, the projecting part of the anterior margin rather broad and slightly concave in the middle, the middle of the posterior margin projecting in a broad arc with a rather deep median notch; head length from the vertex to the tip of the labrum 2.04 to 2.20 mm. Minor worker: head dark brown, antennae deep brown, distinctly smaller than the major worker and very similar to it except for the nearly circular head; head length from the vertex to the tip of the labrum 1.44 to 1.49 mm.

/species/macrotermes-trapezoides/.soldier: Major soldier: head brown tinged with red, thoracic and abdominal tergites yellowish brown. Head trapezoidal, length about 1.3 times the width, the posterior margin nearly straight; fontanelle in front of the midpoint, in lateral view the dorsal margin of the head and the postmentum both nearly flat, slightly arched at the fontanelle; labrum lanceolate, the semi-transparent area at the tip a blunt triangle; mandibles stout, longer than half the head capsule, the fine teeth at the middle of the inner margin distinct, with several incisions near the mandibular base; antennae with 17 segments, segment 3 nearly twice segment 2; compound eyes small, dot-like; postmentum about four times as long as the narrowest part, the waist region in the anterior third. The anterior and posterior margins of the pronotum both incised in the middle, the posterior more deeply; the angular projection of the pronotal lateral lobes inconspicuous, that of the mesonotal and metanotal lateral lobes distinct; hind tibia shorter than the head width. Minor soldier: head yellowish brown, thorax and abdomen paler; head trapezoidal, 1.2 to 1.3 times as long as wide, fontanelle in front of the midpoint, postmentum strongly projecting; labrum narrower and more slender than in the major soldier; mandibles slender, about two thirds of the head capsule in length, the mandibular body rather straight with the apex strongly curved; antennae with 17 segments, segments 2 to 5 nearly equal in length.

/species/macrotermes-trimorphus/.soldier: Major soldier: head and thoracic and abdominal tergites almost brownish yellow, antennae and legs pale brownish yellow, mandibles black; about ten erect setae around the margin of the labrum, two on the postclypeus, sparse on the thoracic tergites and rather dense on the abdomen. Head nearly rectangular, the posterior margin rather straight; the inner margin of the left mandible near the middle with serrations that become coarser towards the base; labrum slightly wider than long apart from the transparent tip, the transparent tip pointed and broadly blunt; the anterior part of the postmentum slightly broad, parallel below the waist; antennae with 17 segments, segment 3 1.5 to 2 times segment 2; fontanelle slightly in front of the middle, dot-like and indistinct. The anterior and posterior margins of the pronotum both concave in the middle, the posterior margin of the mesonotum slightly concave, that of the metanotum almost straight; pronotum widest and mesonotum narrowest, the lateral angles of all three thoracic segments with distinct angular lobes. Medium soldier: coloration like the major soldier but paler; head broadly oval, widest slightly behind the middle; mandibles rather slender and straight with the apex slightly incurved; anterior margin of the pronotum without an incision and the posterior margin slightly concave. Minor soldier: like the medium soldier but paler still; mandibles more slender and rather straight; labrum elongate-leaf-shaped; antennae with 17 segments, segment 2 longer than segment 3, segment 4 shortest.
/species/macrotermes-trimorphus/.worker: Major worker: head reddish brown, antennae, thoracic and abdominal tergites pale brown, legs yellowish white, a few setae scattered on the head; the lateral and posterior margins of the head forming a semicircle, widest at the middle; postclypeus strongly raised, divided into two halves by a brown median longitudinal suture; fontanelle slightly in front of the centre, a pale white triangular pit; antennae with 17 to 19 segments, segment 2 equal to or slightly longer than segment 3, segment 4 or 5 shortest; the anterior half of the pronotum standing erect and tilted upwards almost at right angles to the posterior half, the posterior incision broad and deep, the anterior margin slightly concave; posterior margin of the mesonotum slightly concave, that of the metanotum almost straight; the lateral angles of the prothorax with slight angular projections, those of the mesothorax and metathorax almost arcuate. Medium worker: head pale reddish brown, antennae with 17 segments, segment 2 longer than segment 3, segment 5 shortest, otherwise similar to the major worker. Minor worker: head pale yellow, antennae with 17 segments, segment 2 sometimes twice the length of segment 3, segment 3 shortest, the pronotum slightly narrower than the mesonotum and the metanotum widest.

/species/macrotermes-yunnanensis/.soldier: Major soldier: head reddish brown, mandibles dark brown with a slightly paler base, antennae reddish brown, thoracic and abdominal tergites yellowish brown. Head almost trapezoidal, widest in the posterior part of the head, the posterior margin rather broadly rounded; in lateral view the middle of the dorsal margin slightly raised and the ventral margin slightly projecting downwards; labrum ligulate, widest near the base, the apex of the transparent area rather pointed; mandibles stout with the apex curved, the base of the inner margin of the left mandible with an incision, the fine teeth near the midpoint indistinct; postmentum rather narrow and elongate, the sides at the waist nearly parallel and slightly broader near the base; antennae with 17 segments, segment 3 longest and about twice segment 2. Pronotum about as wide as the mesonotum and metanotum, about twice as wide as long, the anterior and posterior margins both concave in the middle, the lateral lobes narrow and rounded. Minor soldier: head pale reddish brown, mandibles deep reddish brown, antennae pale yellowish brown; head almost trapezoidal with the posterior margin almost broadly rounded; labrum ligulate with the dorsum slightly arched; mandibles rather slender and elongate, the tip slender and distinctly incurved, the base of the inner margin of the left mandible with an incision; postmentum nearly rectangular; antennae with 16 segments, segment 3 longest; pronotum widest, the posterior margin distinctly concave in the middle.

/species/macrotermes-zhejiangensis/.alate: Body dorsum dark brown, wings yellow-grey, wing veins yellowish brown, legs yellowish brown. Head capsule circular and slightly flattened; compound eyes elongate-oval and transverse; fontanelle a dot-like projection, situated at the centre of the posterior margin of the compound eyes; in lateral view the postclypeus and ocelli strongly raised, the postclypeus with a brown median line, about 2.5 times as wide as long; antennae with 19 segments, segment 3 longer than segment 2, segments 4 and 5 shortest; anterior margin of the pronotum broadly concave, the sides steeply inclined backwards, the posterior margin nearly flat, with a T-shaped pale marking in the centre and a dot-like spot at each anterolateral corner; the branching of the media of the forewing behind the midpoint indistinct or weak.
/species/macrotermes-zhejiangensis/.soldier: Major soldier: head brown tinged with yellow, antennae dark brown with the basal two segments pale, thoracic and abdominal tergites brown, legs pale brown tinged with yellow. Head almost trapezoidal, about 1.24 times as long as wide, widest about twice the width of the mandibular base, the posterior margin nearly flat; fontanelle at the midpoint, in lateral view the dorsal margin arched at the fontanelle, the postmentum slightly projecting beyond the ventral margin of the head; mandibles short and stout, less than half the head capsule in length, the fine teeth at the middle of the inner margin of the left mandible indistinct, with several incisions in front of the mandibular base; antennae with 17 segments, segment 3 slightly longer than segment 2, segments 2 and 4 equal in length; postmentum about four to five times as long as the narrowest part. The anterior and posterior margins of the pronotum and the posterior margin of the mesonotum all incised in the middle, the posterior margin of the metanotum nearly flat; the lateral margins of all three thoracic segments angular. Minor soldier: dorsum of head, thorax and abdomen pale brownish yellow, antennae darker; head seemingly almost trapezoidal, about 1.25 times as long as wide; fontanelle slightly behind the midpoint; mandibles slender and elongate, about two thirds of the head capsule in length, the mandibular body rather straight with the apex slightly curved; postmentum band-like, broader at one fifth of its length from the anterior end.

/species/microcerotermes-crassus/.distribution: Menglian, Yunnan; abroad it occurs in Myanmar, Bangladesh, Thailand and Vietnam.
/species/microcerotermes-crassus/.soldier: Head capsule chestnut brown, varying in shade, darker on the frons; thorax and abdomen greyish yellow tinged with brown. Long hairs scattered over the head capsule. Head capsule rectangular, the sides parallel, the posterior margin almost straight. Frontal peaks slightly raised, the frontal surface with shallow rugae; in lateral view the frontal peaks slightly higher than the posterior margin of the head. Antennae with 13 segments, segment 3 shortest and slightly shorter than segment 2. Labrum bell-shaped, the tip slightly projecting. Mandibular body almost rod-like, rather stout, the apex slender and distinctly curved; the inner margin with fine serrations, the re-entrant angle of the outer margin at the mandibular base rather deep; the middle of the postmentum projecting, the waist region behind the middle. Pronotum saddle-shaped, the anterior margin distinctly incised, the posterior margin straight.
/species/microcerotermes-crassus/.taxonomy_note: The genus name was printed in the original work as Mierocerotermes, a spelling error for Microcerotermes; the genus name now used is identical with the latter.

/species/microcerotermes-marilimbus/.alate: Body uniformly dark brown, head capsule darker, postclypeus dark brown or paler, the pale yellow stripe between the ocelli indistinct, pronotum with a pale T marking; legs yellowish brown. Body length with wings 8.52 to 9.63 mm, body length 5.68 to 6.60 mm. Head capsule elliptical, slightly longer than wide, length 0.85 to 0.92 mm, width 0.80 to 0.85 mm; fontanelle small, Y suture indistinct. Antennae with 14 segments, segment 3 shortest, segment 2 twice segment 3. Eye projection rate 14 per cent, the distance to the ventral margin of the head about a little more than half its long diameter. Ocelli oval, about 0.07 mm long, their distance to the compound eyes almost equal to their long diameter. Postclypeus slightly arched, the median line dark, median length 0.25 to 0.27 mm. Pronotum trapezoidal, length 0.43 to 0.48 mm, width 0.71 to 0.76 mm, the anterior margin slightly tilted up, the posterior margin distinctly concave in the middle. Hind tibia 0.95 to 1.02 mm long.
/species/microcerotermes-marilimbus/.soldier: Head capsule yellowish brown tinged with red, the frontal region slightly darker; antennae yellow; pronotum pale yellow, abdomen paler. A few long hairs borne on the head capsule. Head capsule rectangular, the sides parallel, the posterior margin rather straight; frontal angles visible, the dorsal margin of the head nearly flat. Antennae with 13 segments, segment 3 shortest, segment 2 longer than segment 3. Labrum parallel-sided, the anterior margin straight or slightly narrowed forwards, with three pairs of short setae. Mandibles sickle-shaped, stout and rather curved; the serrations of the inner margin finer in front of the mandibular base and becoming indistinct towards the apex, the re-entrant of the outer margin at the base rather shallow; the middle of the postmentum distinctly projecting in lateral view, the waist region at the posterior third; pronotum saddle-shaped, the anterior margin slightly incised, the posterior margin almost straight. Small soldier compared with the large one: mandibles slender and slightly straighter, with a coarse tooth on the inner margin near the basal third, mandible length 0.72 to 0.83 mm, against 0.62 to 0.71 mm in the large form; the middle of the postmentum flatter, head height 0.82 to 0.85 mm, against 0.89 to 1.02 mm in the large form.

/species/microcerotermes-periminutus/.soldier: Head capsule pale yellow, labrum and antennae even paler, mandibles yellowish brown tinged with red; thorax and abdomen whitish tinged with yellow. Pilosity very sparse over the whole body. Head capsule rectangular, the sides parallel, the posterior margin slightly projecting outwards; frons flat, the dorsal margin of the head also flat. Antennae with 12 segments, segment 2 shortest, segment 3 slightly longer than segment 2. Labrum square. Mandibles sabre-like, short and stout, the apex slightly curved; the length of the left mandible about equal to the head width; the serrations of the inner margin rather coarse, the re-entrant of the outer margin at the mandibular base very shallow. Postmentum distinctly projecting, the broad region near the anterior margin, the waist region near the posterior margin. The anterior and posterior margins of the pronotum both almost straight.

/species/microcerotermes-remotus/.alate: Body uniformly dark brown, head capsule darker, postclypeus yellow to yellowish brown, with a pale yellow stripe between the ocelli; pronotum with a pale T marking; legs yellow. Body length with wings 7.49 to 9.44 mm, body length 5.55 to 5.89 mm. Head capsule elliptical, slightly longer than wide, length 0.84 to 0.87 mm, width 0.74 to 0.80 mm; fontanelle a small dot, the coronal suture faintly visible. Antennae with 14 segments, segment 3 shortest. The distance between the compound eyes and the ventral margin of the head about one quarter of their long diameter. Ocelli oval, about 0.10 mm long, their distance to the compound eyes less than half their long diameter. Postclypeus slightly arched, median length 0.22 to 0.23 mm, width 0.37 to 0.40 mm. Pronotum trapezoidal, length 0.38 to 0.46 mm, width 0.62 to 0.74 mm, the anterior margin slightly tilted up and shallowly concave in the middle, the posterior margin distinctly concave. Hind tibia 0.94 to 1.02 mm long.
/species/microcerotermes-remotus/.distribution: Yaxian, Dongfang, Ledong and Lingshui, Hainan.
/species/microcerotermes-remotus/.soldier: Head capsule brown, thorax and abdomen pale yellow tinged with brown. A few scattered long hairs borne on the head capsule. Head capsule rectangular, the sides parallel, slightly narrower at the middle, the posterior margin broadly rounded; frontal peaks slightly raised, the frontal surface almost smooth. In lateral view the dorsal margin of the head slightly concave behind the frons, the top of the frons level with the posterior margin of the head. Antennae with 13 segments, segment 3 shortest and shorter than segment 2. Labrum flatly square, the anterior margin mostly inclined downwards. Both mandibles sickle-shaped, the tips slender and slightly curved; the serrations of the inner margin of unequal size, the outer margin at the base re-entering at almost a right angle; the middle of the postmentum not markedly convex, the waist region near the posterior margin; pronotum saddle-shaped, the anterior margin shallowly concave, the posterior margin straight. Small soldier paler than the large form, head capsule rectangular but shorter, the frontal angles visible, the dorsal margin of the head rather flat; antennae with 13 segments, segment 3 shortest and about half of segment 2; mandibles rather slender and straight, with a coarse tooth on the inner margin near the basal third, tapering forwards; the convexity of the middle of the postmentum also inconspicuous.

/species/microcerotermes-rhombinidus/.alate: Body uniformly dark brown, head capsule darker, postclypeus pale brown, with two elongate pale patches between the ocelli; pronotum with a pale T marking; femora of the legs pale yellowish brown, tibiae darker. Body length with wings 6.39 to 7.17 mm, body length 5.68 to 6.60 mm. Head capsule oval, slightly wider than long, length 0.73 mm, width 0.77 to 0.78 mm; fontanelle small, the coronal suture visible. Antennae with 13 segments, segment 3 shortest. The distance between the compound eyes and the ventral margin of the head less than one third of their long diameter. Ocelli oval, about 0.05 mm long, their distance to the compound eyes about equal to their long diameter. Postclypeus slightly arched, the median line dark, median length 0.19 to 0.20 mm, width 0.32 to 0.34 mm. Pronotum trapezoidal, length 0.37 to 0.39 mm, width 0.58 to 0.59 mm, the anterior margin slightly tilted up, the posterior margin concave in the middle. Hind tibia 0.71 to 0.73 mm long.
/species/microcerotermes-rhombinidus/.biology: Builds dark brown water-chestnut-shaped or variously rounded hard-shelled nests under grass roots, about 3 to 6 cm in diameter; no damage has yet been observed, and it may be beneficial for soil improvement.
/species/microcerotermes-rhombinidus/.distribution: Guangzhou, Zhuhai, Taishan, Dianbai, Zhanjiang, Haikang and Xuwen, Guangdong; also Hainan; Nanning, Pubei and Hepu, Guangxi.
/species/microcerotermes-rhombinidus/.soldier: Head capsule yellowish brown, thorax and abdomen pale yellowish white. Pilosity on the head capsule moderate. Head capsule rectangular, the sides parallel or narrowing backwards, the posterior margin nearly straight; the two frontal angles projecting as points; the dorsal margin of the head rather flat. Antennae with 13 segments, segment 3 shortest and half of segment 2. Labrum bell-shaped, with three pairs of short setae. Mandibles sabre-like, stout with the apex curved; the inner margin with both fine and coarse serrations, a coarse tooth at about the basal third, the re-entrant of the outer margin at the mandibular base very shallow; postmentum flat, the broad region at the anterior third, the waist region near the posterior margin; pronotum saddle-shaped, the anterior margin slightly concave in the middle, the posterior margin almost straight.

/species/microtermes-mangzhuangensis/.distribution: Manzhuang, Mengla, Yunnan, 600 m above sea level.
/species/microtermes-mangzhuangensis/.soldier: Head pale yellow, mandibles reddish brown with the basal third yellow, labrum pale yellow, antennae milky white, pronotum, abdomen and legs almost milky white. Head densely covered with fine short hairs, the labrum with a pair of apical hairs, its surface with seven to eight pairs of long and short hairs in longitudinal rows. Head elongate-oval, narrow in the anterior part and rounded in the posterior part, widest at the middle, the posterolateral margins broadly rounded; in lateral view the head raised like a mound in front of the middle. Labrum lanceolate, widest at the base. The inner margin of the middle of the left mandible slightly arched, with a minute tooth in front of the basal tooth; right mandible slightly more slender than the left. The middle of the anterior margin of the postmentum slightly concave, widest at the middle. Antennae with 14 segments, segment 4 shortest, segment 2 half as long again as segment 4. Anterior margin of the pronotum distinctly concave in the middle, the posterior margin slightly concave.

/species/microtermes-menglunensis/.distribution: Menglun, Mengla, Yunnan, 900 m above sea level.
/species/microtermes-menglunensis/.soldier: Head yellow, mandibles reddish brown with the basal third concolorous with the head, labrum yellow tinged with brown, antennae slightly yellow, pronotum pale yellowish brown, abdomen and legs pale yellow. Head densely covered with fine short hairs, the labrum with a pair of apical hairs and six pairs of long and short hairs in longitudinal rows from the tip to the middle; the margins and dorsum of the pronotum with sparse long and short hairs. Head elongate-oval, narrow in front and broad behind, widest slightly behind the middle; in lateral view raised in the middle of the dorsum towards the front. Labrum lanceolate, the labral rim at the tip transparent. Mandibles stout and straight, the anterior end slightly slender and incurved; the basal tooth of the left mandible broad and rounded, with a minute tooth in front of the concave edge; the basal tooth of the right mandible slightly smaller than that of the left, with two undulate prominences in front of it. Postmentum arched, widest at the anterior third. Antennae with 14 segments, segment 4 shortest. Pronotum saddle-like, the anterior half slightly tilted up, the anterior and posterior margins both concave in the middle.

/species/microtermes-mengpengensis/.distribution: Mengpeng, Mengla, Yunnan, 580 m above sea level.
/species/microtermes-mengpengensis/.soldier: Head pale yellow or deep yellow, mandibles reddish brown with the basal third yellow, labrum pale yellow, antennae milky white, pronotum, abdomen and legs pale yellow to almost milky white. Head densely covered with fine short hairs and scattered long hairs; the labrum with a pair of apical hairs and six pairs to several long hairs in longitudinal rows on each side; the margins of the pronotum with sparse long hairs. Head nearly circular or nearly oval, widest at the middle; in lateral view raised like a mound at or in front of the middle. Labrum ligulate, the apex bluntly rounded. The anterior end of the mandibles slender and incurved, the middle of the inner margin with a single minute denticle, or indistinct. Postmentum arched, projecting in a broad arc at the middle. In individuals with 15 antennal segments, segment 3 shortest; in those with 16, segment 4 shortest. Pronotum narrower than the head width, the anterior and posterior margins concave in the middle. Small soldier paler in body and head colour than the major soldier, smaller in size, similar to the major soldier in the morphology of all parts.

/species/mirocapritermes-hsuchiafui/.distribution: Yingjiang, Yunnan, 870 m above sea level.

/species/mirocapritermes-jiangchengensis.alate: Head covered with dense short hairs and scattered a few long setae; postclypeus without a median line; fontanelle small and narrow, slit-like. The distance from the apical tooth of the left mandible to the first marginal tooth equals the distance from the first to the third marginal tooth; the distance from the apical tooth of the right mandible to the first marginal tooth slightly greater than the spacing between the first marginal teeth. Tibial spur formula 3:2:2, the apical spine on the upper surface of the foreleg distinctly reduced.
/species/mirocapritermes-jiangchengensis.distribution: Kangping, Jiangcheng, Yunnan, 920 m above sea level.
/species/mirocapritermes-jiangchengensis.soldier: Body yellow, abdomen milky white; head sparsely covered with short hairs, more numerous in front of the frontal projection, the tip of the labrum with six to eight long hairs in rows of two, the anterolateral corners of the postmentum each with three short hairs; the margins of the pronotum with a few long hairs and the median area with several short ones; legs sparsely covered with short hairs, the tibiae spinose, the abdomen densely and shortly pubescent. Head rectangular, the frontal projection arcuate and distinctly projecting; labrum more than twice as long as wide, band-like, the anterior margin deeply concave, the anterolateral corners pointed and slightly projecting outwards. Mandibles asymmetrical, the anterior part of the left mandible twisted, its apex curved to the right into a hook; right mandible blade-like, shorter than the left. Postmentum nearly rectangular, widest anteriorly, the waist inconspicuous, narrowest at the anterior margin. Antennae with 14 segments, segments 2 and 3 about equal in length and longer than segment 4. Pronotum saddle-shaped, the anterior and posterior margins both arcuate and not concave in the middle; tibial spur formula 3:2:2.

/species/nasopilotermes-jiangxiensis/.soldier: Soldier large. Head brownish yellow mottled with red, the nasus dark brown, antennae paler than the head; anterior lobe of the pronotum brownish yellow, the posterior lobe slightly paler, mesonotal and metanotal and abdominal tergites deep yellow, legs yellow. The dorsum of the head and the nasus densely covered with fine short hairs, the dorsum of the pronotum hairless with short hairs sparsely arranged along the margins, the abdominal tergites with scattered small hairs. Head nearly circular, widest about the middle, wider than long (excluding the nasus), the posterior margin deeply concave in the middle, not contracted below and behind the antennal sockets, slightly swollen where the base of the nasus meets the dorsum of the head. In lateral view the dorsum of the head slightly raised only at the posterior end, extending flat from the middle to the tip of the nasus, the nasus about half as long as the head length including the nasus and shorter than the head width. Antennae with 13 segments, segment 3 longer than segment 4, segment 2 shortest. Mandibles without a pointed spine, the sides of the postmentum contracted into a waist near the middle, the posterior part broad and widest near the posterior end. Pronotum saddle-shaped, the anterior lobe vertical and rather short, the anterior margin slightly concave in the middle, the middle of the posterior margin projecting without a notch. Abdomen slender, the hind legs extending beyond the abdominal apex, tibial spur formula 2:2:2, tarsi 4-segmented. Small individual: head almost bare, with only a few short hairs at the tip of the nasus, head broadly circular, the nasus a round tube with the end slightly turned upwards, a small projection on each side at the base of the nasus, antennae with 13 to 14 segments, the apical teeth of the mandibles blunt and indistinct.
/species/nasopilotermes-jiangxiensis/.taxonomy_note: The original work placed this species in the genus Pilotermes; this site now assigns it to the genus Nasopilotermes.
/species/nasopilotermes-jiangxiensis/.worker: Workers vary slightly in size, with no distinct dimorphism observed. Larger individuals have 14 antennal segments, a yellow head and a distinct Y-shaped suture on the head; smaller individuals have 13 antennal segments, a white head mottled with pale yellow, and a faintly visible Y-shaped suture. In both forms the posterior margin of the apical tooth of the left and right mandibles is longer than the anterior margin of the first marginal tooth; in the left mandible the second marginal tooth is fused with the posterior margin of the first, and the anterior and posterior margins of the third marginal tooth are almost equal in length; in the right mandible the distance between the apical tooth and the first marginal tooth is shorter than that between the first and second marginal teeth, the posterior margins of the first and second marginal teeth are nearly equal in length, and the posterior margin of the second marginal tooth is rather straight. Tibial spur formula 2:2:2, tarsi 4-segmented.

/species/nasutitermes-bannaensis/.soldier: Head, thorax and abdomen of the soldier reddish brown, antennae yellowish brown, legs pale yellow. A few short hairs at the tip of the nasus; no distinct hairs on the dorsum of the head, thorax or abdomen, but long and short hairs more numerous on the sternites. Head nearly circular, length and width almost equal, narrow in front and broad behind, bulging like a ball behind the antennal sockets, the posterior margin broadly rounded and slightly flat at its centre. In lateral view the nasus slightly straight, the occiput slightly higher than the tip of the nasus; the mandibles bearing rather long pointed spines. Antennae with 14 segments, segment 3 short and small. The anterior margin of the pronotum standing erect and tilted up, the anterior and posterior margins without distinct incisions, the posterior margin slightly concave. Tibial spur formula 2:2:2, tarsi 4-segmented.
/species/nasutitermes-bannaensis/.worker: In the worker the apical tooth of the left mandible is almost equal in size to the first marginal tooth, and the cutting edges between the marginal teeth are rather straight; the apical tooth of the right mandible is also almost equal to the first marginal tooth, and the second marginal tooth is situated close to the first.

/species/nasutitermes-bashanensis/.biology: Host plant recorded as the Chinese chestnut.
/species/nasutitermes-bashanensis/.distribution: Langhekou, northern slope of the Daba Mountains, Zhenping, Shaanxi.
/species/nasutitermes-bashanensis/.soldier: Head and antennae brown, the nasus and the anterior margin of the pronotum also darker, the abdominal segments pale. Similar in body form to the large soldier but slightly paler; the anterior margin of the pronotum shows almost no concavity in the middle, while the posterior margin is slightly concave there; mandibles short and small, the tooth-like processes indistinct.
