/species/nasutitermes-bashanensis/.taxonomy_note: The original work placed it in the genus Mironasutitermes; it is now assigned to the genus Nasutitermes.

/species/nasutitermes-bulbus/.distribution: Xigong Lake, Motuo, Tibet, 1400 m above sea level.

/species/nasutitermes-castaneus/.distribution: Mengla, Jinping, Yunnan, 480 m above sea level; Jinghong, 500 m above sea level.
/species/nasutitermes-castaneus/.soldier: Head of the soldier nearly quadrangular, widest at the antennal insertions, the posterior margin arcuate; dorsum of the head with a pale T-shaped stripe. Postclypeus arched, about half as long as wide; labrum broadly rounded in the anterior part, narrow in the posterior part. Antennae with 15 segments, segment 2 longer than segment 3. Pronotum very highly arched, the anterior margin concave in the middle in some individuals; abdomen swollen, oval. Total body length 4.43 to 4.86 mm.
/species/nasutitermes-castaneus/.worker: Head of the worker brownish yellow, antennae, thorax and abdomen pale yellow to white. The dorsum of the head, thorax and abdomen covered with sparse fine short hairs, the ventral surface of the abdomen with more numerous and longer hairs.

/species/nasutitermes-changningensis/.soldier: Soldier trimorphic. Large form: head brown, nasus dark brown, antennae yellowish brown, anterior lobe of the pronotum dark brown and the posterior lobe slightly paler, mesonotal and metanotal and abdominal tergites yellowish brown, legs pale yellow. Hairs on the head very few, slightly more numerous at the tip of the nasus, the margins of the pronotum with a few short hairs. Head nearly broadly rounded, widest slightly behind the middle, the posterior margin concave in the middle; in lateral view the posterior part of the dorsal margin of the head markedly raised, lower at the middle; the base of the nasus slightly raised, the tip of the nasus tilted up, the mandibular teeth distinct. Antennae mostly with 13 segments, occasionally 14; in the 13-segmented form segment 2 slender and shorter than segment 4, in the 14-segmented form segment 2 shortest. Pronotum saddle-shaped, the anterior lobe shorter than the posterior lobe, the anterior margin incised in the middle, the middle of the posterior margin not distinctly incised; abdomen olive-shaped. Medium form: head brownish yellow, nasus reddish brown, anterior lobe of the pronotum pale reddish brown; head flatly rounded, widest near the middle, the tip of the nasus slightly tilted up, the mandibular teeth indistinct; antennae with 13 segments. Small form: head pale brownish yellow, nasus pale reddish brown; head broadly rounded, widest slightly behind the middle, the tip of the nasus slightly tilted up and rather slender, the mandibular teeth absent or indistinct; antennae with 12 segments.
/species/nasutitermes-changningensis/.taxonomy_note: The original work placed it in the genus Mironasutitermes; it is now assigned to the genus Nasutitermes.
/species/nasutitermes-changningensis/.worker: Head of the worker yellowish brown, the pale T-shaped suture visible, antennae pale yellow, mesonotal and metanotal and abdominal tergites pale brown, legs pale yellow. Head nearly circular, widest near the antennal sockets, postclypeus arched, antennae with 14 segments; the posterior margin of the apical tooth of the left and right mandibles equal to or slightly longer than the anterior margin of the first marginal tooth, and in the right mandible the posterior margin of the first marginal tooth shorter than that of the second marginal tooth. Pronotum saddle-shaped, the incision in the middle of the anterior margin distinct, abdomen olive-shaped. In the paler-headed form the chaetotaxy and head shape are as in the large form, the T-shaped suture indistinct, antennae with 13 segments.

/species/nasutitermes-choui/.soldier: Head of the soldier yellowish brown, nasus reddish brown, antennae brownish yellow; anterior part of the pronotum brown, mesonotal and metanotal tergites, abdomen and legs pale yellowish brown, sternites slightly darker. The surface of the head sparsely beset with fine short hairs, becoming denser towards the nasus, the hairs at the tip of the nasus long and dense; thoracic and abdominal tergites sparsely hairy, the hairs of the abdomen and of the posterior margins of the tergites near the abdominal apex of unequal length. Head circular, widest about the middle, the middle of the posterior margin nearly straight. Nasus conical, the width at the base about twice the width at mid-length, its length about two thirds of the head length; in lateral view the nasus extending straight forwards, its axis nearly parallel to the ventral margin of the head, the basal peak of the nasus faintly discernible, the occiput slightly extended backwards. The apical spine of the mandibles slender and acute; the basal mandibular tooth plate of the right mandible with about seven grooves. Antennae with 13 to 14 segments, segment 3 longer than segment 2, segment 4 shorter; postmentum hexagonal, the anterior and posterior lateral margins slightly concave. Pronotum saddle-shaped, about 2.4 times as wide as long, the anterior margin slightly concave in the middle or nearly straight, the posterior margin nearly straight. Hind femur extending beyond the middle of the abdomen, the hind tibia about 1.13 times the head length and 1.23 times the head width.

/species/nasutitermes-communis/.alate: Head of the alate reddish brown, antennae and postclypeus dull yellow; pronotum and dorsum of the abdomen brown, ventral surface of the abdomen brownish yellow; wings black. Body densely covered with fine hairs. Head oval, rather broad, the vertex flat. Compound eyes elongate-oval and projecting; ocelli large, situated on the dorsolateral side in front of the compound eyes, the distance between ocellus and compound eye less than the width of the ocellus. Postclypeus arched, the posterior margin bowing backwards, the anterior margin very straight, its length less than half its width. Fontanelle pale and slender, situated in the middle of the vertex. Antennae with 15 segments, segments 2 and 4 almost equal in length, segment 3 short, segment 5 longer than segment 3 and slightly shorter than segment 4. Pronotum broad in front and narrow behind, the anterior margin straight, the median notch distinct or absent, the posterior margin slightly concave in the middle. Media of the forewing arising independently at the humeral suture, closer to the cubitus than to the radial sector, dividing into two to three branches beyond three quarters of the wing length and running towards the posterior part of the wing apex; cubitus with about 11 to 12 branches, the seven nearest the wing scale thick and dark. Media of the hindwing arising from the radial sector, the remaining venation as in the forewing.
/species/nasutitermes-communis/.distribution: Jianou, Yongan, Hexi and Nanjing, Fujian; Jiangxi; Hunan; Nanxiong, Guangdong.
/species/nasutitermes-communis/.worker: Head of the worker yellow, abdomen almost white. Dorsum of the abdomen densely covered with short hairs, the posterior end of each ventral segment with a row of longer erect hairs. Head oval, the vertex flat, postclypeus strongly arched, its length slightly less than half its width. Antennae with 14 segments, segment 2 equal in length to segments 3 and 4 together, segment 5 shorter than segment 2. Anterior part of the pronotum erect and about the same size as the posterior part, the anterior margin not concave in the middle, or concave and divided into left and right lobes. Body length 3.88 to 5 mm.

/species/nasutitermes-curtinasus/.soldier: Head of the soldier yellowish brown, antennae slightly paler, thorax, abdomen and legs pale yellowish white, the anterior margin of the pronotum brown. Head almost bare, the tip of the nasus with four long hairs and several short hairs, two long hairs behind the vertex, four longitudinal rows of hairs between the abdominal tergites.

/species/nasutitermes-dudgeoni/.soldier: Head of the soldier yellowish brown, nasus pale yellowish brown. Small hairs sparsely distributed at the tip of the nasus. Head pear-shaped, widest posteriorly, the posterior margin rounded and nearly straight at the middle; nasus tubular, slightly turned up. Antennae with 13 segments, segment 3 either longer or shorter than segment 2 but longer than segment 4, segments 2 and 5 about equal in length. Mandibles with a pointed spine. Pronotum smallish, saddle-shaped, the anterior half erect, the posterior margin rounded, the anterior and posterior margins both concave in the middle. Femora rather long.

/species/nasutitermes-falciformis/.soldier: Head of the soldier yellowish brown, nasus brown tinged with red, antennae pale yellowish brown, thorax, abdomen and legs pale yellowish white, the anterior half of the pronotum slightly darker. Surface of the head sparsely beset with fine hairs, two long hairs behind the vertex, a few short hairs at the tip of the nasus, two short hairs at the base of the nasus, the tergites of the abdomen sparsely covered with short hairs. Head circular, slightly wider than long, widest at mid-length; the sides together with the posterior margin forming a circle. Nasus a stout cone, shorter than the head length; in lateral view the base of the nasus raised and sloping down towards the apex like a hawk's beak, shallowly concave behind the base of the nasus and then arching to the vertex; mandibles without an apical spine. Antennae with 11 to 13 segments, segments 2 and 3 almost equal, segment 4 shortest, segment 3 seemingly with indications of further subdivision. Pronotum saddle-shaped, more than twice as wide as long, the concavity in the middle of the anterior margin shallow and indistinct, the middle of the posterior margin not concave. Hind tibial spur formula 2:2:2.

/species/nasutitermes-fengkaiensis/.soldier: Head of the soldier pale yellow, nasus pale brown, antennae and legs pale yellow. Surface of the head covered with sparse fine hairs, the dorsum of the abdomen with more numerous short hairs. Head lute-shaped, narrow in front and broad behind, the sides rounded, slightly bulging near the occiput, the posterior margin arcuately rounded and slightly flat at its centre. Nasus slender, tubular, straight in lateral view. Mandibles with a pointed spine, the spine either long or short and small; in some individuals a spine on one side and a blunt projection without a distinct spine on the other. Antennae with 11 to 12 segments, in all of which segment 3 is longer than segment 2 and segment 2 longer than segment 4, segment 4 short and small. Neither the anterior nor the posterior margin of the pronotum with a distinct incision.
/species/nasutitermes-fengkaiensis/.worker: Worker: apical tooth of the left mandible almost equal in size to the first marginal tooth, the cutting edges between the marginal teeth straight; apical tooth of the right mandible slightly smaller than or almost equal to the first marginal tooth, the second marginal tooth situated rather close to the first.

/species/nasutitermes-gardneri/.soldier: Head of the soldier yellow mottled with brown, nasus reddish brown, antennae and dorsum of the abdomen yellowish brown, ventral surface of the abdomen pale brown. Head bare, with only scattered hairs, thorax with a few fine short hairs, dorsum of the abdomen densely covered with fine short hairs, the posterior end of each ventral segment with a row of long hairs. Head broadly circular, length and width about equal, widest at the middle; nasus a long tube extending straight forwards, the line between the nasus and the vertex slightly concave; the outer end of the mandibles blunt, without a pointed spine. Antennae with 13 segments, segments 2 and 4 about equal in length, segment 3 about twice as long as segment 2, sometimes appearing incompletely divided. Anterior part of the pronotum slightly shorter than the posterior part, erect or inclined backwards, the anterior margin without a distinct median incision, the posterior margin straight.
/species/nasutitermes-gardneri/.worker: Head of the worker deep yellowish brown, the cephalic sutures forming a pale T, thorax and abdomen light brown; the whole body densely covered with fine short hairs. Outline of the head between circular and square, the anterior end slightly expanded to the sides, the transverse band on the dorsum of the head inclined forwards and downwards, the fontanelle behind the intersection of the T; postclypeus arched, about three times as wide as long. Antennae with 15 or 14 segments. Anterior half of the pronotum large and erect, roughly a low transverse quadrilateral, the anterior margin notched in the middle.

/species/nasutitermes-garoensis/.distribution: Beibeng, Motuo, Tibet, 800 m above sea level; abroad, India.
/species/nasutitermes-garoensis/.soldier: Head of the soldier brownish yellow, nasus dark brown, antennae pale brown, mandibles yellowish brown with brownish black tips; thorax and dorsum of the abdomen brown, legs pale brownish yellow. Dorsum of the head with at least three pairs of hairs, thorax with several short hairs, abdomen with both long and short hairs, the tip of the nasus also with short hairs. Posterior part of the head slightly narrow, the anterior margin straight, the middle of the posterior margin slightly arched. Pronotum narrower than the head, saddle-shaped, its anterior margin only slightly concave at the middle, the posterior margin nearly straight. Tibial spur formula 2:2:2, tarsi 4-segmented.

/species/nasutitermes-grandinasus/.distribution: Jianou and Nanjing, Fujian; Nanxiong, Guangdong; Hainan; Shangqing, Jiangxi.
/species/nasutitermes-grandinasus/.soldier: Head of the soldier intermediate between circular and square, widest at the antennal sockets, the pale T-shaped marking on the dorsum of the head distinct. Postclypeus arched, its length about one third of its width. Antennae with 14 segments, segment 2 longer than segment 4, segment 3 longer than segment 2. Dorsum of the abdomen with a few short hairs, the ventral surface with scattered longer hairs. Anterior half of the pronotum erect, equal in size to the posterior half, the anterior margin concave in the middle.
/species/nasutitermes-grandinasus/.worker: Head of the worker deep yellow, sparsely hairy, abdomen pale yellowish white.

/species/nasutitermes-guizhouensis/.soldier: Head of the soldier orange-yellow, nasus reddish brown, antennae also orange-yellow; thoracic and abdominal tergites and legs pale yellow, the anterior half of the pronotum brown. Head almost bare, the tip of the nasus with several long hairs, the anterior half of the nasus with a number of short hairs; margins of the pronotum with a few fine hairs, abdominal tergites sparsely covered with short fine hairs, four longitudinal rows of hairs between the posterior margins, the posterior margins of tergites 8 and 9 each with eight hairs, the hairs of the sternites rather coarse and long. Head nearly circular, slightly longer than wide, the length including the nasus about 1.7 times the head width, widest behind the middle, the posterior margin slightly rounded. Nasus a round tube, slightly thicker at the base, its length more than three fifths of the head length; in lateral view the nasus extending straight forwards, the dorsal margin of the head rising from behind the base of the nasus to the vertex, the vertex projecting above the tip of the nasus, the apical spine of the mandibles protruding. Antennae with 13 segments, segments 2 and 4 rather short. Pronotum saddle-shaped, more than twice as wide as long, the posterior margin slightly concave in the middle. Tibial spur formula 2:2:2, tarsi 4-segmented.

/species/nasutitermes-hejiangensis/.soldier: Head of the soldier orange-yellow, nasus reddish brown, gradually becoming paler near the basal third, antennae nearly concolorous with the head, pronotum pale brown and darker anteriorly, abdomen and legs pale yellow. Hairs on the head almost absent, the tip of the nasus with a few fine hairs mixed with several longer ones, the anterior margin of the pronotum with more numerous short hairs. Head broadly pear-shaped, widest posteriorly, the two posterolateral corners broadly rounded, the middle of the posterior margin slightly concave. Nasus tubular, slender at the tip and slightly thicker at the base; in lateral view the posterior part of the dorsal margin of the head slightly raised, the nasus tilted up; mandibles with a pointed spine. Antennae with 13 to 14 segments, in the 13-segmented form segment 4 shortest and segment 2 next, in the 14-segmented form segment 3 shortest. Pronotum saddle-shaped, twice as wide as long, the anterior and posterior margins both slightly concave in the middle. Abdomen olive-shaped.
/species/nasutitermes-hejiangensis/.worker: Head of the worker yellowish brown, the T-shaped suture on the dorsum distinct, antennae, thoracic and abdominal tergites and legs pale yellowish brown. Head nearly circular, the posterior margin broadly arcuate. The posterior margin of the apical tooth of the left mandible slightly shorter than the anterior margin of the first marginal tooth, the anterior margin of the first marginal tooth of the right mandible distinctly shorter than the posterior margin of the second marginal tooth. Antennae with 15 to 16 segments, in the 15-segmented form segment 3 the most slender and short, in the 16-segmented form segment 3 shorter than segment 4 and equal in length to segment 2. Pronotum saddle-shaped, the anterior half erect, the anterior margin distinctly concave in the middle. Abdomen stoutly olive-shaped.

/species/nasutitermes-huangshanensis/.soldier: Head brown, the base of the nasus darker, nasus reddish brown, anterior lobe of the pronotum paler than the nasus, posterior lobe concolorous with the head, legs yellow; the head with several sparse long hairs, the tip of the nasus with several as well. Large form: head transversely broadly rounded, widest about the middle, the posterior margin slightly concave; in lateral view the vertex slightly raised and the base of the nasus slightly raised; antennae with 13 to 14 segments, mostly 13, segment 3 longest, the apical teeth of the mandibles rather distinct; pronotum saddle-shaped, the anterior lobe shorter than the posterior lobe, the incisions in the middle of the anterior and posterior margins distinct. Medium form: colour slightly paler in all parts, chaetotaxy as in the large form; head broadly pear-shaped, widest slightly behind the middle, the posterior margin flat and slightly concave in the middle, the nasus in lateral view slightly turned up with the base slightly raised and the apex bulging slightly outwards, nasus conical, the apical teeth of the mandibles mostly indistinct; antennae with 13 segments, segment 3 longest. Small form: paler still, chaetotaxy as in the two preceding forms; head nearly circular, widest slightly behind the middle, the nasus in lateral view turned up with the apex rather flat; antennae with 12 to 13 segments, the apical teeth of the mandibles indistinct.
/species/nasutitermes-huangshanensis/.taxonomy_note: The original work placed it in the genus Mironasutitermes; it is now assigned to the genus Nasutitermes.

/species/nasutitermes-inclinasus/.soldier: Head of the soldier yellowish brown, nasus brownish yellow tinged with red, thorax, abdomen and legs pale yellowish white, the anterior half of the pronotum yellowish brown. Surface of the head sparsely covered with fine hairs, the tip of the nasus densely covered with short hairs, the base of the nasus and the region behind the vertex each with two long hairs, the abdominal tergites with four longitudinal rows of hairs. Head flatly rounded, wider than long, widest behind the middle, the sides swelling into a circle from behind the antennal sockets, the posterolateral corners broadly rounded, the posterior margin rather flat and slightly concave in the middle. Nasus a round tube, its base triangular in width; in lateral view the nasus inclined downwards, not concave behind its base, the vertex higher than the tip of the nasus, the anterior end of the mandibles with a pointed spine. Antennae with 13 segments, segment 2 shortest, segment 3 rather long. Pronotum saddle-shaped, more than twice as wide as long, the anterior margin distinctly notched in the middle, the middle of the posterior margin nearly straight. Tibial spur formula 2:2:2.

/species/nasutitermes-kinoshitai/.alate: Head of the alate dark brown, labrum, postclypeus, anterior angles of the frons and mouthparts rusty yellow, antennae brown. Head densely covered with hairs, the pronotum also densely hairy. Head broadly oval, the postclypeus less than half as long as wide; the distance between ocellus and compound eye shorter than half the width of the ocellus; fontanelle oval, rather large. Antennae with 15 segments, segments 2 and 4 about equal in length, both longer than segment 3. Pronotum brownish yellow, with a yellow T-shaped marking and humeral markings, the posterior margin slightly concave. Media of the forewing with one to three branches.

/species/nasutitermes-longwangshanensis/.soldier: Large form: head brown, the apical third of the nasus concolorous with the head and the basal two thirds darker, antennae yellowish brown, anterior lobe of the pronotum dark brown and the posterior lobe near the head colour, thoracic and abdominal tergites yellowish brown, legs pale yellow. Pilosity on the head sparse, denser at the tip of the nasus. Head nearly flatly rounded, widest slightly behind the middle, the middle of the posterior margin slightly concave; in lateral view the posterior part of the dorsal margin of the head slightly raised, the base of the nasus slightly raised, the nasus obliquely turned up, the mandibular teeth rather distinct. Antennae with 13 to 14 segments: in the 13-segmented form segment 2 the most slender and short and segment 4 slightly longer than segment 2; in the 14-segmented form segment 4 slightly shorter than segment 2. Pronotum saddle-shaped, the median incision of the anterior margin distinct, that of the posterior margin indistinct; abdomen elongate-olive-shaped. Small form: head pale brownish yellow, nasus pale reddish brown, anterior lobe of the pronotum pale reddish brown, abdominal tergites yellowish brown, legs pale yellow, chaetotaxy similar to the large form. Head broadly rounded, widest in the middle and posterior part, the posterior margin broadly arcuate; in lateral view the posterior part of the dorsal margin of the head not markedly raised, the tip of the nasus slightly turned up, nasus conical, the mandibular teeth indistinct; antennae with 13 segments, segments 2 and 4 almost equal in length.
/species/nasutitermes-longwangshanensis/.taxonomy_note: The original work placed it in the genus Mironasutitermes; it is now assigned to the genus Nasutitermes.
/species/nasutitermes-longwangshanensis/.worker: Large worker: head yellowish brown, the T-shaped suture pale, antennae yellow, pronotum paler than the head, mesonotal and metanotal tergites similar to the pronotum, abdominal tergites pale yellowish brown, legs pale yellow. Head nearly broadly rounded, widest slightly in front of the middle; the posterior margin of the apical tooth of the left mandible almost equal to or slightly shorter than the anterior margin of the first marginal tooth, the apical tooth of the right mandible slightly longer than the anterior margin of the first marginal tooth but shorter than its posterior margin. Antennae with 14 segments, segment 4 shortest, segments 2 and 4 almost equal in length. Pronotum saddle-shaped, the median incision of the anterior margin distinct. Small form paler than the large form, chaetotaxy and head shape similar to the large form but of smaller body size, antennae with 13 segments.

/species/nasutitermes-machengensis/.soldier: Head brownish yellow, nasus tinged with red, thorax and abdomen pale brown, legs pale yellow. Head covered with sparse short hairs, the tip of the nasus with a few short hairs. Large soldier of two forms, up-turned-nasus and flat-nasus: in the up-turned form the tip of the nasus is almost level with the vertex and the base of the nasus is depressed; in the flat form the tip of the nasus lies below the vertex and the base of the nasus is slightly arched. Both forms have short apical spines on the mandibles, antennae with 13 segments, segment 3 rather long; the anterior lobe of the pronotum strongly sclerotised, the anterior and posterior margins nearly straight. Medium form similar to the flat-nasus large form, head nearly circular, antennae with 12 to 13 segments. Small form similar to the medium form, the tip of the nasus distinctly below the vertex, the apical spines of the mandibles blunt or absent, antennae with 12 segments.
/species/nasutitermes-machengensis/.taxonomy_note: The original work placed it in the genus Mironasutitermes; it is now assigned to the genus Nasutitermes.

/species/nasutitermes-mangshanensis/.soldier: Head, antennae and the upturned part of the pronotum of the soldier pale yellow, nasus brownish yellow, thoracic and abdominal tergites and legs milky white. Very few hairs on the head and thoracic tergites, the abdominal tergites with more numerous long hairs. Head nearly circular, slightly longer than wide, the sides rounded, the posterior margin projecting in an arc. Nasus almost as long as the head. Mandibles blunt, without a pointed spine. Antennae with 11 to 12 segments, mostly 11; segment 3 about twice as long as segment 2, segment 2 almost equal to or shorter than segment 4 and the shortest of all. Anterior half of the pronotum erect and upturned, neither margin with a distinct incision. Tibial spur formula 2:2:2, tarsi 4-segmented.
/species/nasutitermes-mangshanensis/.worker: Worker: apical tooth of the left mandible equal to the first marginal tooth, the cutting edges between the marginal teeth straight; apical tooth of the right mandible also equal to the first marginal tooth, the second marginal tooth situated close to the first.

/species/nasutitermes-medoensis/.distribution: Beibeng, Motuo, Tibet, 800 m above sea level; Didong, 700 m above sea level.

/species/nasutitermes-mirabilis/.soldier: Head of the soldier brown tinged with red, nasus reddish brown, thoracic and abdominal tergites pale brown, the anterior half of the pronotum dark brown, legs pale yellow. Surface of the head sparsely covered with short fine hairs, short hairs at the tip of the nasus, the anterior margin of the pronotum with a row of short hairs, the abdominal tergites with a number of short hairs interspersed with four longitudinal rows of long hairs. Pronotum saddle-shaped, more than twice as wide as long, the anterior and posterior margins both straight at the middle. Tibial spur formula 2:2:2.

/species/nasutitermes-moratus/.alate: Head of the alate and the dorsum of the thorax and abdomen brown, postclypeus yellow, antennae and ventral surface of the abdomen brownish yellow, wings brown. Body densely covered with hairs, the wing membrane hairless, with sparse short hairs only at the wing apex. Head very broad, the posterior margin circular; postclypeus slightly arched, the anterior and posterior margins both straight, its length only one quarter of its width; compound eyes large and round, ocelli large, elliptical, the ocellus-compound eye distance equal to or slightly greater than the width of the ocellus; vertex concave, fontanelle small as a dot, a further band-like spot in the middle of the concavity of the vertex. Antennae with 15 segments, segments 2, 3 and 4 almost equal in length. Pronotum broad anteriorly and narrow posteriorly, the anterior margin curved or depressed, without a median notch, the anterolateral corners blunt, the posterior margin concave in the middle. Media of the forewing arising independently at the humeral suture, closer to the cubitus than to the radial sector, ending in three to four branches, the cubitus with more than ten branches; media of the hindwing arising together with the radial sector at the humeral suture, the remaining venation as in the forewing.
/species/nasutitermes-moratus/.distribution: Changting, Fujian; Jiangxi; Nanxi, Hekou, Yunnan (90 m above sea level), Dawei Mountains, Pingbian (1500 m above sea level) and Xishuangbanna.
/species/nasutitermes-moratus/.soldier: Head of the soldier yellow, nasus reddish brown, abdomen pale yellow. Surface of the head covered with fine short hairs, the abdominal tergites also with fine short hairs, the sparse hairs arranged along the posterior margin of each tergite, the hairs of the sternites longer. Head nearly circular, length and width almost equal; nasus a slender tube more than half the head length, in lateral view the vertex and the nasus almost forming a straight line, the nasus not turned up; the anterolateral corner of the mandibles with a pointed spine. Antennae with 13 segments, segment 2 shorter than segment 3. The width of the pronotum about half the head length, its anterior part inclined backwards, meeting the posterior part at an angle of less than 90 degrees. Abdomen slender.
/species/nasutitermes-moratus/.worker: Head of the worker deep yellow, thorax and abdomen pale yellow. Head nearly circular, postclypeus slightly arched, the dorsum of the head with a T-shaped suture, antennae with 14 to 15 segments, segment 2 equal to or longer than segment 3. Anterior part of the pronotum erect. Smaller individuals paler than the large ones, the cephalic sutures indistinct, the head rather square, the length of the postclypeus about one third of its width.

/species/nasutitermes-obtusimandibulus/.worker: Worker: apical tooth of the left mandible equal to the first marginal tooth, the cutting edges between the marginal teeth straight; apical tooth of the right mandible also equal to the first marginal tooth, the second marginal tooth blunt and small, situated close to the first.

/species/nasutitermes-orthonasus/.distribution: Longyan, Hexi and Nanjing, Fujian; Hunan; Dabu, Shaoguan, Dinghu Mountain and Nanxiong, Guangdong; Guangxi; Hekou, Yunnan (90 m above sea level), Mengla, Jinping (550 m and 580 m above sea level), Menghai and Yingjiang.
/species/nasutitermes-orthonasus/.soldier: Head longer than wide, narrowing anteriorly and widening gradually backwards, widest at its posterior end, its length equal to the length of the nasus. Nasus slender as a tube, slightly turned up in lateral view, the base slightly raised, the posterior end of the vertex very high, the line where it joins the nasus undulating like a wave. The anterolateral end of the mandibles bearing a long spine, the tip of the spine often with a single inward-directed tooth. Antennae with 12 segments, segments 2 and 3 about equal in length, segment 2 stouter. Anterior part of the pronotum upright and slightly inclined backwards. Abdomen slender, olive-shaped, legs well developed.
/species/nasutitermes-orthonasus/.taxonomy_note: The original work recorded it under the genus Havilanditermes; this site now assigns it to the genus Nasutitermes, the generic name having been changed.
/species/nasutitermes-orthonasus/.worker: Head yellow, abdomen pale yellow mottled with white stripes; pilosity even over the body, the head with short hairs and a few long setae. Head oval, narrow in front and broad behind, widest at about the posterior third, the posterior margin arcuately rounded and slightly flat in the middle. The apical tooth of the left mandible distinctly larger than the first marginal tooth, the second marginal tooth reduced and merged with the posterior cutting edge of the first, the third marginal tooth minute, its anterior cutting edge meeting the posterior cutting edge of the first at an acute angle. Tibial spur formula 2:2:2, tarsi 4-segmented.

/species/nasutitermes-parvonasutus/.alate: Head of the alate brown, antennae, labrum and postclypeus yellow; pronotum paler than the head and with a yellow T-shaped marking; anterior part of the mesonotum and metanotum yellow, the posterior part brown; dorsum of the abdomen brown, the ventral surface slightly yellow; wings semi-transparent, pale blackish brown, the veins darker. Head and pronotum densely covered with hairs. Head broadly oval, with a pit in the middle of the vertex, fontanelle small and slit-like. Antennae with 15 segments, segment 3 smallest, segment 2 smaller, segments 4 and 6 nearly equal in length. Compound eyes small and round, ocelli oval, the ocellus-compound eye distance about equal to the length of the ocellus; postclypeus arched, the anterior margin nearly straight, the posterior margin bowing out. Pronotum narrower than the head, 1.5 times as wide as long, the anterior margin nearly straight and slightly raised, the middle of the posterior margin notched. Media of the forewing unbranched or with one to three branches, situated close to the cubitus, the cubitus with eight to ten oblique branches; media of the hindwing arising from the radial sector behind the humeral suture, the rest as in the forewing.
/species/nasutitermes-parvonasutus/.distribution: Hengchun, Taiwan; Changjiang, Yongan, Jianou and Nanping, Fujian.
/species/nasutitermes-parvonasutus/.soldier: In the soldier one antennal segment is incompletely divided, thus forming a longer segment. The anterior and posterior halves of the pronotum almost equal in width, the anterior part erect or slightly inclined backwards, the anterior margin without a median notch.
/species/nasutitermes-parvonasutus/.worker: Head of the worker yellow, abdomen almost white. The head with a few short hairs, the dorsum of the abdomen densely covered with short hairs, the ventral surface also with short hairs, the posterior end of each segment with a row of long hairs. Head oval, the vertex flat, the dorsum with a pale T-shaped marking; total length 4.72 to 5 mm, postclypeus slightly arched, about one third as long as wide. Antennae with 14 segments, segment 4 shortest, segments 2 and 3 about equal in length. Anterior part of the pronotum erect, the anterior margin deeply notched in the middle.

/species/nasutitermes-planiusculus/.soldier: Head of the soldier greyish yellow tinged with brown, nasus reddish brown, antennae yellowish brown, thorax, abdomen and legs pale yellowish brown, the anterior half of the pronotum darker. Surface of the head sparsely covered with minute hairs, the tip of the nasus with a few short hairs mixed with several long ones, the base of the nasus and the region behind the vertex each with a pair of long hairs; the anterior margin of the pronotum with a row of short hairs, the hairs of the abdominal tergites arranged in about four rows, with four longitudinal rows of long hairs between them. The head together with the nasus has an outline roughly resembling that of the character you: the lateral margins bulge out roundly behind the antennal sockets, the widest point lies in front of the middle, the middle section runs almost parallel towards the rear, and the posterior margin is straight; nasus a stout short cone, extending straight in lateral view, the vertex higher than the tip of the nasus, the base of the nasus not raised, the posterior vertex arching up in a dome. Mandibles without an apical spine. Antennae with 11 to 13 segments, in the 13-segmented form segment 4 shortest, segments 2 and 3 nearly equal in length. Pronotum saddle-shaped, the anterior margin shallowly concave in the middle, the posterior margin broadly rounded. Hind tibial spur formula 2:2:2, tarsi 4-segmented.

/species/nasutitermes-qimenensis/.soldier: Head brownish yellow, paler than in the large form, nasus becoming gradually darker from the base forwards and pale reddish brown, antennae slightly paler than the head, the anterior margin of the pronotum darker than the head, the remainder deep yellow, legs yellow. Head almost bare, otherwise as in the large soldier. Head nearly circular, the posterior margin rather flat, wider than long; in lateral view the nasus slightly turned up, the base of the nasus more strongly raised, the convexity of the vertex less than in the large form, nasus tubular, the apical teeth of the mandibles indistinct. Antennae with 13 segments, segment 2 shortest, segment 3 longest.
/species/nasutitermes-qimenensis/.taxonomy_note: The original work placed it in the genus Mironasutitermes; it is now assigned to the genus Nasutitermes.

/species/nasutitermes-qingjiensis/.soldier: Head of the soldier yellowish brown, most of the nasus red-brown, thorax and abdomen pale brown. Surface of the head almost bare, short hairs at the tip of the nasus, the abdominal tergites covered with fine hairs, the hairs of the sternites finer and longer. Head nearly circular; nasus a long cone, almost as long as the head, the median line of the dorsum of the nasus raised and extending into the frontal region; in lateral view slightly depressed where the nasus meets the head; mandibles without a pointed spine. Antennae with 13 segments, segments 2 and 4 shortest and about equal in length. Anterior part of the pronotum erect, slightly shorter than the posterior part, the middle of the anterior margin retaining an indistinct trace of a shallow concavity.
/species/nasutitermes-qingjiensis/.worker: Head of the worker yellowish brown, thorax and abdomen pale brown; the head with sparse short hairs, the dorsum and ventral surface of the thorax and abdomen densely covered with short hairs. Head rather roundly square, the dorsum of the head with a T-shaped marking, postclypeus arched, with a longitudinal groove in the middle. Antennae with 14 segments, segment 4 shortest. The erect anterior part of the pronotum about as wide as the posterior part, the anterior margin not concave.

/species/nasutitermes-shangchengensis/.soldier: Head reddish brown, slightly paler posteriorly, nasus deep reddish brown, pronotum and antennae yellowish brown, femora and tibiae pale yellow. Head almost bare, sparsely covered with fine short hairs, hairs more numerous at the tip of the nasus. Head nearly circular, widest slightly behind the middle, the posterior margin slightly concave, with a distinct longitudinal suture, the fontanelle tube extending from the middle of the head to the tip of the nasus. Nasus conical, in lateral view the line between the nasus and the head rather straight, the upturn indistinct, the mandibles with distinct apical teeth. Antennae with 13 segments, segments 2 and 4 shortest, the two together about equal to segment 3. Pronotum saddle-shaped, its anterior lobe slightly shorter than the posterior lobe, the median incision of the anterior margin indistinct, the middle of the posterior margin slightly concave; abdomen olive-shaped. Small form paler than the large form, the head slightly wider than long, the posterior margin more distinctly concave, the apical teeth of the mandibles indistinct; antennae with 12 segments, segment 2 shortest, segments 3 and 4 about equal in length.
/species/nasutitermes-shangchengensis/.taxonomy_note: The original work placed it in the genus Mironasutitermes; it is now assigned to the genus Nasutitermes.

/species/nasutitermes-sinensis/.soldier: Head orange-yellow, nasus pale reddish brown and still paler at the base, antennae paler than the head; the anterior half of the pronotum darker, nearly yellowish brown, abdomen and legs pale yellow. Hairs on the head very sparse, two long hairs posteriorly, the nasus with several rather long hairs and densely covered with short hairs at the tip, the anterior margin of the pronotum and the abdomen with more numerous hairs. Head pear-shaped, longer than wide, widest in the posterior half, the concavity in the middle of the posterior margin distinct. Nasus tubular, slender at the tip and thick at the base; in lateral view the dorsal margin of the head markedly raised in its posterior section, the base of the nasus slightly raised, the tip of the nasus very slightly turned up. The tip of the mandibles with a fine pointed spine. Antennae with 12 to 13 segments, segment 2 shortest in the 12-segmented form, segment 4 shortest in the 13-segmented form. Pronotum saddle-shaped, the anterior and posterior margins both concave in the middle, abdomen olive-shaped.
/species/nasutitermes-sinensis/.worker: Head yellowish brown, with a pale T-shaped suture, antennae and pronotum pale yellowish brown, mesonotal and metanotal and abdominal tergites and legs yellow. Head sparsely covered with short hairs, the abdomen more densely hairy. Head nearly circular, the posterior margin broadly arcuate, widest behind the antennal sockets, postclypeus arched. The anterior margin of the first marginal tooth of the left mandible about equal in length to the posterior margin of the apical tooth, the anterior margin of the first marginal tooth of the right mandible slightly shorter than the posterior margin of the apical tooth and also shorter than the posterior margin of the second marginal tooth. Antennae with 14 segments, segment 4 shortest. Pronotum saddle-shaped, the anterior part erect and concave, the hind tibia nearly equal to the head width.

/species/nasutitermes-takasagoensis/.alate: Head dark brown with the frons paler, antennae, labrum and postclypeus yellow; pronotum yellow or mottled with brown, mesonotum and metanotum pale, abdominal tergites and sternites yellow, legs yellow; wings yellowish brown and semi-transparent, the veins dark brown. The surface of the head densely hairy, the long and short hairs of the pronotum both dense. Compound eyes large, ocelli elongate-oval, the distance between the two shorter than the width of the ocellus. Media of the forewing close to the cubitus, with a fine branch connecting to the radial sector, dividing into two to four branches near the wing apex; cubitus situated in the middle of the wing, with eight to 14 branches; media of the hindwing arising from the base of the radial sector; femora about twice as wide as the tibiae.
/species/nasutitermes-takasagoensis/.soldier: Head brownish yellow, thorax and abdomen dull yellow. Head almost bare, or with two to three scattered long hairs; the dorsum of the abdomen with a few short hairs, each segment with two to four additional long hairs, the ventral surface with slightly more hairs. Head nearly circular, fontanelle small, slit-like, situated in the centre of the head, slightly depressed around it. Antennae with 14 to 16 segments, in the 16-segmented form segment 3 shortest and segment 4 shorter than segment 2. Labrum with length and width similar, widest at the middle; postclypeus more than twice as wide as long, the posterior margin bowing backwards, the median suture distinct. Anterior margin of the pronotum nearly straight, the median notch indistinct, the posterior margin concave in the middle.
/species/nasutitermes-takasagoensis/.worker: Head brownish yellow, the dorsum with a pale T-shaped cephalic suture, abdomen greyish white mottled with pale yellow. The head and dorsum of the abdomen with very few hairs, the abdomen with more. Head shape between square and round, the fontanelle behind the intersection of the T-shaped suture; postclypeus arched, about one third as long as wide. Antennae with 13 to 14 segments, in the large form segments 2 and 3 about equal in length and segment 3 two to three times as long as segment 4, in the medium form segments 3 and 4 equal in length. Anterior half of the pronotum high and erect, the median notch of the anterior margin distinct.

/species/nasutitermes-tiantongensis/.soldier: Head pale yellowish brown, nasus reddish brown, antennae brown, thorax, abdomen and legs white tinged with pale brown. Surface of the head covered with fine hairs mixed with several long ones, the tip of the nasus densely covered with short hairs. Head nearly pear-shaped, longer than wide, widest at the posterior third; the posterior margin convex, shallowly concave in the middle. The head together with the nasus about twice as long as the head width. Nasus a round tube extending horizontally forwards in lateral view, the base of the nasus slightly raised, the vertex higher than the tip of the nasus. Mandibles with an apical spine. Antennae with 12 to 13 segments, segment 2 or segment 4 shortest. The pronotum about 2.6 times as wide as long, the anterior and posterior margins both nearly straight at the middle. Hind tibia longer than the head width.

/species/nasutitermes-tibetanus/.distribution: Beibeng and Ani Bridge, Motuo, Tibet.
/species/nasutitermes-tibetanus/.soldier: Head yellowish brown, nasus black, pronotum yellowish brown, abdominal tergites paler. Head almost bare, or covered with minute down, the tip of the nasus sparsely covered with fine hairs, the anterior margin of the pronotum with small hairs, the abdominal tergites and sternites with sparse fine hairs. Head pear-shaped, wider than long, widest at the middle, the posterior margin rather flat and slightly concave in the middle, the anterior part straight in lateral view. The tip of the nasus slender and not turned up, the base of the nasus slightly raised, the fontanelle tube distinct, extending to the anterior middle of the head. Labrum lamellate, wider than long, the middle of the anterior margin bowing forwards. Mandibles block-like, usually without an apical spine, or with a triangular apical spine on one side, the anterior margin slightly curved, the inner surface more deeply sclerotised and small. Antennae with 12 to 13 segments, mostly 13, segment 4 shortest and almost rectangular; sometimes 12 segments on one side and 13 on the other, segment 4 occasionally divided in two; segment 3 longer than segment 2, and in the 12-segmented form segment 4 longer than segment 2. Pronotum saddle-shaped.

/species/nasutitermes-tsaii/.soldier: Head yellow slightly mottled with brown, nasus reddish brown, antennae dull yellow, abdomen milky white. Head with only one to two hairs, almost bare; the dorsum of the abdomen with a few fine short hairs, the ventral surface with numerous and longer short hairs, the posterior margin of each sternite with a row of long hairs, the tip of the nasus also hairy. Head broadly rounded, approximating a transversely oriented ellipse, widest behind the middle. Nasus conical, thick in its posterior section; in lateral view the dorsum of the nasus and the anterior part of the vertex almost forming a straight line, the base of the nasus curved backwards and rising gradually towards the middle and posterior part of the head. Antennae with 11 to 13 segments, mostly 12: in this case segment 3 shortest, segment 4 equal to or slightly longer than segment 2, segments 4 and 5 equal in length. Postmentum strongly projecting, square in frontal view, the lateral margins narrowing from back to front, the anterior margin straight and the posterior margin concave. Mandibles without an anteriorly projecting pointed spine; labrum rectangular, the anterior margin convex and slightly concave in the middle. Pronotum about half the head width, saddle-shaped, the anterior part erect, forming a low semicircle and shorter than the posterior part, the anterior margin slightly concave in the middle. Abdomen olive-shaped, the hind tibia about as long as the head width.

/species/nasutitermes-vallis/.alate: Head deep brown, compound eyes black, antennae yellowish brown, labrum and clypeus deep yellow; pronotum concolorous with the head. Head nearly circular, compound eyes oval, large and protruding, ocelli oval and also protruding; fontanelle oval with an apical fork, postclypeus arched, three to four times as wide as long. Antennae with 15 segments. The apical tooth of the left mandible larger than the first marginal tooth, the cutting edge between the marginal teeth straight, the second marginal tooth of the left mandible reduced and merged with the posterior cutting edge of the first marginal tooth; the second marginal tooth of the right mandible close to the first marginal tooth; molar plate with eight to nine ridges. The pronotum slightly arched in the middle near the anterior margin, the anterior margin straight and without a depression, the middle of the posterior margin slightly concave. Tibial spur formula 2:2:2, tarsi 4-segmented. Head and pronotum densely covered with soft hairs mixed with a few long ones, the long hairs on the margin of the pronotum more numerous than those on the head.
/species/nasutitermes-vallis/.distribution: Maliweng and Ani Bridge, Motuo, Tibet.
/species/nasutitermes-vallis/.soldier: The soldier occurs in large, medium and small forms. Large form: head yellow, nasus yellow tinged with brown; the dorsum of the head almost bare, usually with a pair of long hairs posteriorly, the tip of the nasus sparsely covered with bristles, the pronotum with few hairs, the abdominal tergites also with few hairs, the sternites with fine hairs. Head wider than long, broadly circular, the sides bulging roundly, the posterior margin broadly rounded; antennae with 13 segments, segment 3 twice as long as segment 2 or longer; the pointed spine of the mandibles very small. Pronotum saddle-shaped, the anterior half erect; tibial spur formula 2:2:2, tarsi 4-segmented. Small form paler than the large form, head slender and pointed, antennae with 11 segments, segment 3 longer than segment 4, segments 2 and 4 almost equal in length.

/species/nasutitermes-xingshanensis/.soldier: Head brown, nasus deep brown, the longitudinal stripe in the middle of the head pale; thorax and abdomen pale brown, legs paler. Hairs on the head very sparse, a few hairs at the tip of the nasus. Large form: head flatly rounded, the sides swollen, the middle of the posterior margin shallowly concave; nasus a round tube, about two thirds as long as the head, slightly turned up, the base of the nasus depressed, the mandibles with a long apical spine. Antennae with 13 segments, segment 3 twice as long as segment 2. The anterior lobe of the pronotum strongly sclerotised, the median incision shallow. Medium form similar to the large form, the nasus extending straight forwards, its tip below the vertex, the base of the nasus flat; antennae with 13 to 14 segments. Small form similar to the medium form but paler, the nasus extending straight, the apical spine of the mandibles blunt or absent.
/species/nasutitermes-xingshanensis/.taxonomy_note: The original work placed it in the genus Mironasutitermes; it is now assigned to the genus Nasutitermes.

/species/neotermes-amplilabralis/.soldier: Head capsule of the soldier nearly orange-yellow, mandibles red and paler at the base, labrum and antennae pale yellow, thorax and abdomen greyish yellow, the body covered with sparse long hairs. Head capsule nearly rectangular, rather wide and short, the lateral margins parallel, the posterior margin nearly broadly rounded; frons slightly inclined forwards, concave in a U shape. Eyes large and nearly round, their short diameter about 0.22 mm, the distance from the eye to the antennal socket slightly shorter than the short diameter of the eye. Antennae with 14 segments, segment 3 distinctly longer than segment 2. Anterior margin of the postclypeus with several long hairs; anteclypeus nearly trapezoidal, distinctly wider than long; labrum nearly broadly rounded, also distinctly wider than long, the dorsum arched and bearing several long hairs, the margin semi-transparent. Mandibles stout, the base markedly swollen; the outer margin of the left mandible rather straight, the apex curved inwards, the length about 60 per cent of the head capsule (to the mandibular base); the inner margin, apart from the apical tooth, with five marginal teeth: the first and second nearly equal in length, the first an unequal triangle with the posterior margin longer than the anterior, the third and fourth adjacent with a deep concavity between them, the fifth slightly longer than the fourth with a shallow concavity between the two. The outer margin of the right mandible curved and distinctly more curved than that of the left mandible, the inner margin with two marginal teeth forming unequal triangles, uneven and slightly wavy between the apical tooth and the first tooth. Postmentum rod-shaped, the lateral margins almost parallel below the waist, slightly enlarged near the base; in lateral view the dorsal margin of the head slightly arched, the postmentum slightly projecting. Pronotum distinctly wider than the head capsule, the anterior margin with a broad deep V-shaped notch, the lateral margins broadly rounded, the posterior margin rather straight and slightly concave in the middle.

/species/neotermes-binovatus/.alate: Head of the alate brown, compound eyes pale brown, ocelli semi-transparent, antennal segments 1 to 3 brown and the rest paler, thorax, abdomen and legs deep yellow, wings pale yellow, the veins deep yellow, the body covered with sparse hairs. Head nearly square, the posterior lateral corners broadly rounded, the posterior margin nearly straight, the head width (including the eyes) slightly greater than the head length (to the mandibular base); frons slightly inclined forwards, with a shallow pit in the middle and a small round pit on each side of it, the Y-shaped suture indistinct. Compound eyes large and round, slightly protruding; ocelli oval, situated above the compound eyes and close to them. Antennae with 16 to 19 segments, the first segment thick and long, the second shorter than the first and equal to or slightly shorter than the third, the fourth shortest, the terminal segment short and small. Postclypeus nearly rectangular, the anterior margin rather straight and with long hairs; anteclypeus trapezoidal, greyish white; labrum wide and short, nearly rectangular, the anterior margin rather straight and with long hairs. The left mandible with two marginal teeth, the apical tooth slightly longer than the marginal teeth, the second marginal tooth slightly shorter than the first; the right mandible also with two, the apical tooth slightly longer, the second slightly shorter than the first. Pronotum nearly rectangular, with sparse long and short hairs, distinctly wider than the head capsule, the anterior margin broadly concave without a median notch, the posterior margin nearly straight. Forewing scale longer than the hindwing scale; subcosta short, its apex connected with the cubitus; radius meeting the cubitus well before the middle of the wing; radial sector extending to the wing apex with six to seven branches, running close and parallel to the media, with reticulate veins between the two, media and cubitus rather widely separated. Hindwing scale smaller, cubitus and subcosta fused along the anterior margin; radius meeting the cubitus about at the middle of the wing; radial sector extending to the wing apex, media separating from the radial sector at about one quarter of the wing base and running parallel to the apex. Legs slender with sparse hairs, the apex of the tibia with three spurs, apical tibial spurs 3:3:3. Abdomen slender, cerci with two segments.
/species/neotermes-binovatus/.soldier: Head of the soldier red-brown, mandibles dark brown and paler at the base, antennal segments 1 to 3 brown and the remaining segments slightly paler; labrum and postmentum yellowish brown, the anterior margin of the pronotum brown, thorax, abdomen and legs greyish yellow. Head capsule rectangular, the lateral margins nearly parallel, the posterior margin broadly rounded; frons slightly inclined forwards, slightly concave in the middle, with a small symmetrical round pit on each side above it. Eyes oval, small, the distance from the eye to the antennal socket slightly shorter than the long diameter of the eye, ocelli absent. Antennae with 14 to 15 segments, the first segment thick and long, segment 3 distinctly longer than segment 2 or 4. Postclypeus flat, nearly rectangular; anteclypeus nearly trapezoidal; labrum nearly square, the anterior margin rather broadly rounded, with a few long hairs on the anterior margin and the surface. Mandibles stout, the base slightly swollen, the length about half the head capsule (to the mandibular base); the outer margin rather straight, the apex slightly curved inwards. Left mandible with five marginal teeth, the first and second nearly equal in length, the first large and blunt, the second nearly triangular, the third and fourth shortest and equal in length with a deep concavity between them, the fifth slightly longer and nearly triangular; right mandible with two marginal teeth, slightly uneven between the first tooth and the apical tooth, the distance between them about twice the distance from the first marginal tooth of the left mandible to the apical tooth, the two teeth almost equal in length, the first with a longer posterior margin forming an unequal triangle. The anterior end of the postmentum rather wide, the lateral margins slightly concave at the middle, divided into anterior and posterior lobes, the anterior lobe distinctly wider than the posterior lobe, the middle part slender, the posterior end rather swollen, the anterior margin slightly rounded and the posterior margin wavy. Pronotum nearly rectangular, slightly wider than the head capsule, the anterior margin broadly concave, the lateral margins broadly rounded, the posterior margin nearly straight. The apex of each tibia with three spurs, apical tibial spurs 3:3:3, tarsi 4-segmented.
/species/neotermes-binovatus/.worker: Head, pronotum and legs of the worker pale yellow, the abdomen darker. Head nearly circular, the eyes represented only by indistinct pale spots. Antennae with 13 to 14 segments, the first segment longest, segment 3 shorter than segment 2, segments 4 and 5 shortest, the following segments gradually slightly longer, the terminal segment short and small. Postclypeus flat, the anterior margin with long hairs; anteclypeus trapezoidal; labrum nearly square, wide anteriorly and narrow posteriorly, the anterior margin rather straight and with long hairs. Mandibles similar to those of the alate. Pronotum nearly rectangular, distinctly wider than the head capsule, the anterior margin broadly concave, the posterior margin nearly straight. Legs slender, the apex of the tibia with three spurs, apical tibial spurs 3:3:3, tarsi 4-segmented.

/species/neotermes-brachynotum/.soldier: Head and labrum of the soldier orange-yellow, anteclypeus greyish yellow, mandibles blackish brown and red-brown at the base, antennal segments 1 and 3 nearly brownish yellow and the rest pale yellow, thoracic and abdominal tergites and legs greyish yellow, the body covered with sparse long hairs. Head capsule nearly rectangular, the lateral margins nearly parallel, the posterior margin broadly rounded; Y-shaped suture faintly visible, frons inclined forwards, shallowly concave and rather smooth in the middle, with several long hairs. Eyes small and indistinct. Antennae with 12 to 14 segments, segment 3 longer than segment 2. Anterior margin of the postclypeus with several hairs; anteclypeus wide, flat and nearly trapezoidal; labrum nearly rectangular, the anterior margin broadly rounded, the dorsum with two rows of long hairs. Mandibles stout, the base swollen, the apex slightly curved, longer than half the head capsule. Left mandible with five marginal teeth: the first and second nearly equal in length, unequal triangles with slightly pointed apices; the third and fourth shortest and nearly equal, with a deep concavity between them; the fifth close to the fourth and slightly longer. Right mandible with two marginal teeth nearly equal in length, the first an unequal triangle with the posterior margin longer than the anterior. Postmentum rather slender, the lateral margins of the wide anterior region slightly concave at the middle forming anterior and posterior lobes, the middle section slender, slightly wider near the base, the anterior margin nearly broadly rounded, the posterior margin slightly concave; in lateral view the dorsal margin of the head slightly arched, the postmentum slightly projecting. Pronotum wide and short, about 2.5 to 2.7 times as wide as its median length, the anterior margin with a broad and rather deep V-shaped notch, the lateral margins to the posterior lateral margin nearly broadly rounded, the middle of the posterior margin slightly concave.

/species/neotermes-dolichognathus/.soldier: Head of the soldier orange-yellow, mandibles red-brown and slightly paler at the base, antennae, thorax, abdominal tergites and legs greyish yellow, the body covered with sparse hairs.

/species/neotermes-dubiocalcaratus/.soldier: Head of the soldier pale red-brown, the anterior end darker than the posterior, antennae nearly yellowish brown, eyes pale and transparent, mandibles blackish brown and red-brown at the base, pronotum pale yellow with red-brown margins, the body covered with sparse long hairs. Head capsule rather rectangular, the lateral margins more or less parallel to each other; the frontal surface slightly inclined, the median pit extending rather far backwards, the posterior lateral corners of the head capsule broad and round. Compound eyes rather large, nearly circular in outline, ocelli absent. Antennae with 13 to 16 segments, the first segment thick and long, segment 3 slightly longer than or equal to segment 2, the remaining segments gradually longer in turn, the terminal segment oval, the antennal socket process well developed and turned upwards. Postclypeus nearly rectangular, the anterior margin with long hairs; anteclypeus short and narrow; labrum nearly square, the anterior margin rather straight and sometimes slightly convex in the middle, with long and short hairs on the anterior margin and the dorsum. Mandibles stout, the base slightly swollen, the outer margin nearly straight, the apex curved inwards, about half the head capsule (to the mandibular base). Left mandible with five marginal teeth, the first and second almost equal in length and nearly triangular, the third and fourth shorter with a deep concavity between them, the fifth large and projecting; right mandible with two marginal teeth, slightly wavy between the first tooth and the apical tooth, the two teeth nearly triangular and equal in length, the first with a posterior margin slightly longer than the anterior. Postmentum with a rather wide anterior end, the lateral margins slightly concave at the middle, distinctly divided into anterior and posterior lobes, the middle part slender and narrow, the posterior end slightly wide, the anterior margin broadly rounded, the posterior margin wavy. Pronotum nearly rectangular, wider than the head capsule, with sparse long hairs, the anterior margin broadly concave, the lateral margins nearly parallel, the anterior lateral corners rather narrowly rounded, the posterior margin nearly straight. Legs slender with sparse hairs, the apex of the tibia mostly 3:3:3, in some specimens with one spur more or one fewer on the outer side of the apex of the fore or mid tibia, giving 4:3:3, 4:2:3 or 2:4:3; tarsi 4-segmented.

/species/neotermes-fovefrons/.soldier: Head of the soldier orange-red, mandibles blackish brown and slightly paler at the base, antennae, except segment 3 which is darker, together with the thorax, abdomen and legs greyish yellow; head, thorax and abdomen all with sparse long hairs. Body rather large. Head capsule more or less rectangular, the lateral margins roughly parallel, narrowing slightly towards the posterior end, the posterior margin broadly rounded; the frontal surface slightly inclined, the depression in the middle near the frontal end very distinct. Eyes rather large and nearly round, the distance to the antennal socket less than the long diameter of the eye. Antennae with 15 segments, segment 3 slightly longer than segment 2 or almost equal. Anterior margin of the postclypeus with several long hairs; anteclypeus nearly trapezoidal; labrum nearly square, the anterior margin nearly round, the dorsum with several long hairs. Mandibles stout, the base swollen, the outer margin nearly straight, the apex slightly curved; the left mandible about as long as the head height, the inner margin with five marginal teeth, the first and second triangular and nearly equal in length, the third and fourth shorter with a deep concavity between them, the fifth shorter but slightly longer than the fourth; the right mandible with two marginal teeth, slightly uneven between the first tooth and the apical tooth. The lateral margins of the wide anterior region of the postmentum slightly concave at the middle, distinctly divided into anterior and posterior lobes of equal width, the lateral margins of the waist parallel, slightly wider near the base. Pronotum rectangular, slightly wider than the head capsule, the anterior margin broadly V-shaped and incised, the posterior lateral margins rather broadly rounded, the posterior margin nearly flat and slightly concave in the middle.

/species/neotermes-fujianensis/.soldier: Head capsule of the soldier pale yellowish brown, mandibles blackish brown, thorax and abdomen yellowish white. Head capsule rectangular, the sides parallel, the posterior margin broadly rounded, the frontal region shallowly concave, the Y-shaped suture indistinct. Antennal segment 3 longer than segment 2, segment 4 slightly longer than segment 2. The apical margin of the labrum straight, the anterior lateral corners slightly rounded. Mandibles long and stout, the mandibular base prominent; the left mandible with five marginal teeth, the first broad and blunt, the second and fifth triangular and larger, the third and fourth short, blunt and small; the right mandible with two marginal teeth, very large. Eye spots small and flat, not protruding. Postmentum club-shaped, the anterior margin straight, the wide anterior region without a lobar incision, the waist distinctly contracted and narrow. Pronotum slightly narrower than the head capsule, the anterior and posterior margins both shallowly concave, the lateral margins rounding out.

/species/neotermes-humilis/.alate: Head of the worker milky yellow, labrum and antennae milky white, abdomen and legs milky yellow. Head nearly circular, the eye marks distinct, nearly circular. Antennae with 13 to 16 segments, densely covered with fine hairs. Postclypeus nearly rectangular, the anterior margin with several long hairs; anteclypeus nearly trapezoidal; labrum nearly square, with hairs on the anterior margin and the dorsum. The left mandible with an apical tooth and two marginal teeth, the apical tooth slightly longer than the marginal teeth, the two marginal teeth almost equal in length; the right mandible also with an apical tooth and two marginal teeth, the apical tooth nearly equal in length to the first marginal tooth, the second marginal tooth slightly shorter. Pronotum nearly rectangular, as wide as or slightly wider than the head capsule, the anterior margin shallowly and broadly concave, the posterior margin nearly straight. Legs rather slender and short, the apex of the tibia with three spurs, apical tibial spurs 3:3:3, tarsi 4-segmented.
/species/neotermes-humilis/.distribution: Ningming, Chonggang Nature Reserve, Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region.
/species/neotermes-humilis/.soldier: Head of the soldier yellowish brown, mandibles dark brown and red-brown at the base, labrum darker, anteclypeus pale yellow, antennae yellowish brown. Body small. Head capsule wide and short, nearly rectangular, the lateral margins nearly parallel, the posterior margin broadly rounded, the front of the frons slightly inclined, with a shallow concavity in the middle. Eyes oval, semi-transparent. Antennae damaged with only ten segments remaining, the antennal socket process well developed, not reaching the first segment; segment 3 slightly longer than segment 2 or nearly equal, segment 4 shortest. Postclypeus nearly rectangular, the anterior margin with long hairs; anteclypeus short and wide, trapezoidal; labrum nearly square, the anterior margin rather straight, with a few long hairs on the anterior margin and the surface. Mandibles rather slender, about two thirds of the head capsule (to the mandibular base), the base slightly swollen, the outer margin rather straight, the apex slightly curved inwards; the inner margin of the left mandible, apart from the apical tooth, with five marginal teeth, the first and second nearly triangular and almost equal in length, the third and fourth short and blunt with a shallow notch between them, the boundary between the fourth and fifth indistinct; the inner margin of the right mandible with two marginal teeth, slightly wavy between the first tooth and the apical tooth, the two teeth nearly triangular. Postmentum wide and short, the anterior end distinctly wider, the posterior end narrower, the anterior margin nearly straight, the posterior margin slightly convex. Pronotum nearly rectangular, with sparse long hairs, slightly wider than the head capsule, the anterior margin deeply V-shaped in the middle, the anterior lateral corners slightly pointed, the posterior lateral corners broadly rounded, the posterior margin nearly straight. Legs slender, tibial spur formula 3:3:3, tarsi 4-segmented.

/species/neotermes-miracapitalis/.soldier: Head and labrum of the soldier nearly orange-red, anteclypeus greyish yellow, mandibles blackish brown and slightly paler at the base, antennal segment 3 nearly orange-red and the remaining segments greyish yellow, thoracic and abdominal tergites and legs greyish yellow, the body covered with sparse hairs. Head capsule nearly rectangular, the lateral margins nearly parallel and slightly contracted near the middle, the posterior margin nearly flat and slightly concave in the middle; Y-shaped suture visible, the front of the frons slightly inclined, the median depression indistinct. Eyes small, the long diameter of the eye and the distance from the eye to the antennal socket nearly equal. Antennae with 13 segments, segment 3 slightly longer than segment 2, segment 4 shortest. Anterior margin of the postclypeus with several long hairs; anteclypeus wide, flat and nearly trapezoidal, the anterior margin nearly flat; labrum nearly rectangular, the anterior margin broadly rounded, the dorsum with several long hairs near the anterior lateral margin. Mandibles stout, the base swollen, the apex slightly curved, longer than half the head capsule. The inner margin of the left mandible with five marginal teeth, the first distinctly longer than the second with a deep concavity between them; the third with a rather flat tooth surface, also deeply concave between it and the fourth; the notch between the fourth and fifth rather shallow. The inner margin of the right mandible with two marginal teeth, slightly uneven between the first tooth and the apical tooth, the two teeth nearly equal in length and forming unequal triangles, the posterior margin of the first distinctly longer than the anterior. Postmentum club-shaped with a waist, the lateral margins of the waist region nearly parallel. In lateral view the dorsal margin of the head nearly flat, the postmentum slightly projecting. Pronotum wider than the head capsule, the anterior margin wider than the posterior, about twice as wide as its median length, the anterior margin deeply V-shaped, the posterior lateral corners broadly rounded, the posterior margin broadly concave.

/species/neotermes-sphenocephalus/.soldier: Head of the soldier orange-yellow, anteclypeus greyish yellow, labrum orange-red, mandibles red-brown and slightly paler at the base, antennal segments 1 and 3 nearly orange-red and the rest nearly greyish yellow, thorax, abdomen and legs greyish yellow, the head covered with rather sparse long hairs. Head capsule nearly rectangular, rather wide and short, widest near the posterior part, the posterior margin nearly flat or broadly rounded; Y-shaped suture visible, frons slightly inclined forwards, slightly concave in the middle. Eyes narrow and long, faintly visible. Antennae with 13 to 14 segments, segment 3 slightly longer than segment 2. Anterior margin of the postclypeus with several long hairs; anteclypeus wide, flat and nearly trapezoidal; labrum nearly square, the anterior margin broadly rounded, with several long hairs on the dorsum and near the anterior margin. Mandibles stout, the base swollen, the apex slightly curved inwards, longer than half the head capsule, the head height nearly equal to the left mandible. Postmentum wide and short, the lateral margins of the widest anterior end slightly concave at the middle and divided into anterior and posterior lobes, the anterior lobe slightly larger than the posterior, the middle section slender, again distinctly swollen near the base. In lateral view the dorsal margin of the head slightly raised, the postmentum slightly projecting. The anterior margin of the pronotum broadly and deeply concave, with an incision in the middle, the middle of the posterior margin slightly concave.

/species/neotermes-taishanensis/.soldier: Head of the soldier pale yellowish brown, clypeus greyish white, labrum and antennae pale yellowish brown, mandibles red-brown and slightly paler at the base, pronotum greyish yellow, mesothorax, metathorax and abdomen slightly darker, head and body covered with sparse long hairs. Head capsule nearly rectangular, the lateral margins nearly parallel, slightly narrower in front and wider behind, the posterior margin nearly flat and slightly concave in the middle; the Y-shaped suture on the vertex faintly visible, frons slightly inclined forwards, shallowly concave in the middle and with indistinct wrinkles. Antennae with 13 to 14 segments, the antennal socket process well developed, segment 3 distinctly longer than segment 2, segment 4 shortest. Anterior margin of the postclypeus with four long hairs; anteclypeus flat, wide and nearly trapezoidal; labrum nearly square, the lateral margins parallel, the anterior margin rather flat. Mandibles stout, the base slightly swollen, the apex slightly curved inwards, about two thirds of the head capsule (to the mandibular base). The inner margin of the left mandible with five marginal teeth, the first and second triangular, the first longest, the third and fourth short and blunt with a deep concavity between them, the notch between the fourth and fifth rather shallow; the inner margin of the right mandible with two marginal teeth, slightly wavy between the first tooth and the apical tooth, the two teeth nearly equal in length. Postmentum wide and short, the middle of the dorsum of the wide anterior end slightly convex and bearing several long hairs, the lateral margins slightly concave at the middle and divided into anterior and posterior lobes, the anterior lobe larger than the posterior; the waist section slightly contracted and again slightly wider near the base; the anterior margin of the postmentum nearly broadly rounded, the posterior margin very slightly concave. Pronotum rather rectangular, wider than the head capsule, the anterior margin deeply V-shaped but without a median incision, the lateral margins nearly parallel, the posterior margin nearly straight and slightly concave in the middle.

/species/neotermes-tuberogulus/.soldier: Head of the soldier red-brown, mandibles blackish brown and slightly paler at the base, antennae pale yellowish brown, thorax and abdomen greyish yellow, head and thoracic tergites with sparse long hairs. Head capsule nearly rectangular, the lateral margins parallel, the posterior margin broadly rounded; frons slightly inclined forwards and slightly concave. Eyes large, oval, the distance from the eye to the antennal socket shorter than the long diameter of the eye. Antennae with 14 segments, segment 3 slightly longer than segment 2, segment 4 shortest. Postclypeus flat and nearly rectangular, with several long hairs near the front; anteclypeus wide, short and nearly trapezoidal; labrum nearly rectangular, the anterior margin broadly rounded, with several long hairs on the surface and near the anterior margin. Mandibles stout, the base swollen, the apex slightly curved inwards; the left mandible longer than half the head, the inner margin with five marginal teeth, the first and second nearly equal in length, the first an unequal triangle, the second nearly triangular, the third and fourth shortest with a deep concavity between them, the fifth slightly longer and nearly triangular; the right mandible with two marginal teeth nearly equal in length, slightly wavy between the apical tooth and the first tooth. The anterior end of the postmentum rather wide, the middle of the surface distinctly raised like a mound, the lateral margins concave inwards at the middle, dividing the postmentum into an anterior and a posterior lobe, the former distinctly larger than the latter; the waist section slender, slightly widened near the base. Pronotum distinctly wider than the head capsule, the anterior margin a broad V-shaped notch with an incision, the posterior lateral corners nearly broadly rounded, the posterior margin rather flat and slightly concave in the middle.

/species/neotermes-undulatus/.soldier: Head and labrum of the soldier orange-red, anteclypeus greyish yellow, mandibles blackish brown and slightly paler at the base, antennae yellowish brown, thorax and abdomen greyish yellow, the body covered with sparse long hairs. Head capsule nearly rectangular, the lateral margins near the mandibular base slightly projecting, the lateral margins nearly parallel, the posterior margin broadly rounded; Y-shaped suture distinct, frons slightly inclined forwards. Eyes small and distinct, nearly oval. Antennae with 13 to 15 segments, segment 3 distinctly longer than segment 2. Anterior margin of the postclypeus with four long hairs; anteclypeus wide, short and nearly trapezoidal; the outline of the labrum approximating a rectangle, its anterior margin nearly broadly rounded. Mandibles strong, the base appearing swollen, the outer margin slightly wavy, the tip slightly curved inwards; the left mandible longer than half the head capsule, the inner margin with five marginal teeth, the first and second triangular and nearly equal in length, the third and fourth nearly equal with a deep concavity between them, the fifth slightly longer; the inner margin of the right mandible with two marginal teeth nearly equal in length, slightly wavy between the apical tooth and the first. Postmentum rather slender, the widest anterior region bearing several long hairs, the lateral margins slightly concave at the middle and divided into anterior and posterior lobes, the anterior lobe larger than the posterior, the middle section slender, slightly wider near the base. Pronotum nearly rectangular, distinctly wider than the head capsule, the anterior margin rather wide and deeply concave without an incision, the posterior lateral margins nearly broadly rounded, the posterior margin nearly flat and slightly concave in the middle.

/species/neotermes-yunnanensis/.soldier: Soldier head yellowish brown, the labrum slightly paler, the mandibles dark brown but slightly paler at the base, the antennae pale yellow, the thoracic nota and abdomen greyish yellow, with sparse long setae on the head, thorax and abdomen. Head capsule nearly rectangular, the lateral margins nearly parallel, the posterior margin broadly rounded, the frons slightly inclined forwards. Eyes rather small, oval and clearly visible, their long axis almost equal to the distance from the eye to the antenna. Antennae with 14 segments, segment 3 slightly longer than segment 2.
