Four long setae in front of the postclypeus; anteclypeus rather broad and nearly trapezoidal; labrum nearly square, its anterior margin broadly rounded, with a few long setae near the anterior margin. Mandibles robust, swollen at the base, the apices slightly incurved. Left mandible about half as long as the head capsule, its inner margin with five marginal teeth, teeth 1 and 2 equal in length, teeth 3 and 4 bluntly pointed with a deep concavity between them, and a shallow concavity between teeth 4 and 5; right mandible with two marginal teeth, the outline between the first tooth and the apical tooth slightly undulate, the two teeth almost equal in length and forming a scalene triangle. Postmentum club-shaped, slightly flattened; the lateral margins at its widest anterior point divide the postmentum slightly into an anterior and a posterior lobe, the anterior lobe larger than the posterior; the waist extends ventrally and is slender, its two edges parallel to each other, the anterior margin broadly rounded, the posterior margin slightly concave inwards. The processes of the antennal sockets are very well developed. Pronotum distinctly broader than the head capsule, its anterior margin rather deeply concave and with a median notch, the lateral margins slightly directed backwards and nearly broadly rounded, the posterior margin nearly straight.

/species/odontotermes-angustignathus/.distribution: Yunnan: Menghan, Menghai and Yunjinghong (500 m a.s.l.); Hainan.
/species/odontotermes-angustignathus/.soldier: Head dark yellow, thorax and abdomen pale yellow or slightly mixed with pink; setae on the head very few, those on the thorax, abdomen and legs more numerous. Anterior part of the head slightly narrowed, the posterior margin broadly rounded, the widest point in the posterior part of the head, the lateral margins slightly arched. Fontanelle situated at about one-fifth of the anterior part of the head, very indistinct. Posterior end of the postmentum broader than the anterior end, and in lateral view the postmentum does not bulge strongly from the ventral surface of the head. Mandibles sickle-shaped, the left marginal tooth behind the midpoint, its apex directed obliquely forwards, the portion anterior to the tooth markedly narrowed; the right mandibular tooth very indistinct and situated slightly further back. Apex of the labrum reaching the midpoint of the mandibles. Antennae with 17 segments, segment 3 shorter than segment 2, the terminal segment about equal in length to segment 2 but tapering at the tip, segment 4 equal in length to segments 2 and 3. Anterior margin of the pronotum with a distinct median concavity. Length of head to the apex of the labrum 2.18–2.38 mm, width of head 1.72–1.86 mm, width of pronotum 0.97–1.02 mm.
/species/odontotermes-angustignathus/.worker: Head deep yellow, abdomen pale yellow. Head shape intermediate between round and square, the vertex flat; the fontanelle in the middle of the vertex is a conspicuous white circular pit; the postclypeus is raised upwards, with a distinct median longitudinal suture whose length is less than half its width; antennae with 18 segments, segments 2 and 3 of similar length, segment 4 shorter, some individuals having only 17 segments.

/species/odontotermes-annulicornis/.soldier: Head orange-yellow or brownish yellow; the first and second antennal segments concolorous, while about three-quarters of the base of each segment from the third onwards is brown and the remainder pale yellow, the alternating light and dark forming rings, from which the species name is derived. Thorax, abdomen and legs yellow. Head with sparse fine setae mixed with a few long ones: one pair of long setae on the frons, one pair on the clypeus, one pair of apical setae and one pair of subapical setae on the labrum, four to five bristles on each side, and four long setae on each lateral margin of the anterior part of the postmentum. Head pear-shaped, very narrow near the mandibular bases, the posterior margin arched in a circular curve, the frons flat. Labrum elongate-lingulate, reaching the left marginal tooth, its apex rounded and blunt. Mandibles slender and straight, the apices gradually incurved; the left marginal tooth at one-third from the anterior end, its apex directed slightly forwards; the right mandible with an indistinct small tooth at a level below the left marginal tooth. Antennae usually with 16 segments, segment 4 the shortest, segments 2 and 3 almost equal, segment 3 one and a half times segment 4. Postmentum short, less than one and a half times as long as wide. Pronotum rhomboidal, the anterior margin with a rather deep median concavity, the posterior margin with a shallower median notch.

/species/odontotermes-conignathus/.distribution: Jinghong, Damenglong, Mengla and Simao, Yunnan.
/species/odontotermes-conignathus/.soldier: Body medium-sized. Head brownish yellow, the portion anterior to the antennae slightly darker, the labrum and postmentum brown, the mandibles dark brown, the thorax, abdomen and appendages yellow. Setae on the head sparse, almost without fine short setae; one pair of long setae on the frons, the setae behind the antennae shorter and one to two on each side. Head a broad oval, nearly elongate-rectangular, the lateral margins slightly arcuate, widest at two-fifths of the posterior part and narrowing gradually towards the front, the posterior margin arcuate. Labrum broadly lingulate, just covering the left marginal tooth, convex in the middle and flat at the sides to form a rim. Fontanelle indistinct. The two mandibles very straight, the inner and outer margins anterior to the marginal tooth almost linear, the outer margin contracting conically forwards from the level of the tooth, the apex slightly incurved, the base notched; the notch of the left mandible deep and containing a minute pointed tooth, the tooth situated slightly behind the midpoint with its apex lateral; the right mandibular tooth very small. Postmentum about twice as long as wide. Antennae with 16–17 segments; with 16 segments, segment 3 almost equal to segment 2 and one and a half times segment 4. Pronotum rhomboidal, with notches at the middle of both the anterior and the posterior margin.

/species/odontotermes-dimorphus/.soldier: Body medium-sized. Head yellow or reddish yellow, the postmentum darker, mostly brownish yellow or brown; thorax and abdomen pale yellow. Pilosity of the head sparse; about ten long bristles around the margin of the labrum; the pronotum bears sparse long and short setae. Head elongate-oval, narrower in front of the antennal sockets, the lateral margins of the middle and posterior portions broader and almost parallel, the posterior margin slightly flat. Mandibles robust, the apices incurved; the left marginal tooth lying more than one-third from the anterior end, its apex mostly directed inwards and in a few individuals slightly forwards, the angle of the tooth about 70 degrees; the right mandible with an indistinct small tooth at the corresponding position. Labrum lingulate, almost as long as wide. Antennae with 16 segments, segment 4 the shortest. Postmentum rectangular, the sides parallel, the anterior margin narrower. Both the anterior and the posterior margin of the pronotum with a distinct median notch.
/species/odontotermes-dimorphus/.worker: The worker is distinctly dimorphic, with a large and a small form. In the large form the head width is 1.36–1.40 mm, the antennae have 17 segments, and segment 3 or segment 5 is short and small; in the small form the head width is 0.94–0.98 mm, the antennae have 16 segments, and segment 3 or segment 4 is the shortest.

/species/odontotermes-fontanellus/.soldier: Body medium-sized. Head brownish yellow, the upper half of the mandibles dark brown and the base paler, the labrum pale brown, the antennae slightly paler than the head, the thorax, abdomen and legs yellow. Pilosity of the head sparse, with a few long setae; the anterior margin of the postmentum bears several symmetrical long or short setae; the pronotum has sparse short setae, and the setae of the abdominal tergites are long and dense. Head broadly oval, the lateral margins almost parallel, slightly broader posteriorly, the posterior margin broadly arcuate. Mandibles robust, the apex of the left mandible incurved, its tooth at one-third from the apex, the tooth apex directed antero-internally; the right mandible with a small tooth slightly behind one-third from the apex and another distinct small tooth about one-quarter from the base. Labrum lingulate, slightly narrower anteriorly, the apex bluntly rounded. Antennae with 17 segments, segment 3 the smallest, segment 4 slightly larger than segment 3, segment 5 slightly smaller than segment 4, the terminal segment elongate-oval. Postmentum nearly rectangular, about one and a half times as long as wide, widest near the posterior end. Pronotum saddle-shaped, with distinct notches at the middle of both the anterior and the posterior margin.

/species/odontotermes-formosanus/.alate: Dorsum of the head and dorsum of the thorax and abdomen dark brown, the venter brownish yellow; the anterior half of the labrum orange-red and the posterior half pale orange, with a white transverse band between them, the anterior and lateral margins of the labrum white and transparent; wings dark brown. The whole body densely hairy. Head circular, the compound eyes elliptical and the ocelli also elliptical, the distance between the ocellus and the compound eye about equal to the length of the ocellus itself. Postclypeus raised, less than half as long as wide, divided into right and left halves by a median longitudinal suture; anteclypeus equal in length to the postclypeus. Antennae with 19 segments, segment 2 longer than segment 3, 4 or 5. Pronotum broad anteriorly and narrow posteriorly, without a distinct median notch on the anterior margin, the middle of the posterior margin concave forwards; the centre of the pronotum bears a pale cross-shaped mark with a circular pale spot on each side in front of it. Wings long and large, the forewing scale slightly larger than the hindwing scale; the media of the forewing arises from the cubitus and branches profusely at its apex, the cubitus having more than ten branches; the media of the hindwing arises from the radial sector.
/species/odontotermes-formosanus/.biology: Alates appear in the nest from March; between April and June they build conical emergence turrets on the ground beside the nest, and towards seven in the evening they crawl out in swarms, usually taking flight in heavy rain, with 2,000 to 3,000 alates flying from a single nest. This species is a major pest that damages reservoir dams, living in the core of the downstream slope where weeds grow; it is very polyphagous, feeding on the trunks and bark of masson pine, Chinese arborvitae, black locust, rubber, elm, eucalyptus, chestnut and China fir, and also damages rice.
/species/odontotermes-formosanus/.distribution: Widely distributed approximately south of 35° N. In China it occurs at Luoyang and Jigongshan, Henan; Chaoxian and Wuhu, Anhui; Shaanxi; Gansu; Nanjing and Zhenjiang, Jiangsu; Hangzhou, Fenghua, Wenzhou and Longquan, Zhejiang; Wuhan, Jiangling, Yichang and Badong, Hubei; Dong'an and Hengyang, Hunan; Guizhou; Dechang, Xichang, Ya'an, Wanxian and Fuling, Sichuan; Chongqing; Jiangxi; Zhangpu, Xiamen, Nanjing, Yunxiao, Pinghe, Zhangzhou, Putian, Fuzhou, Nanping, Longyan, Changting, Jian'ou and Yong'an, Fujian; Guangzhou, Shunde, Yingde, Kaiping, Taishan and Xuwen, Guangdong; Yulin, Yishan and Liuzhou, Guangxi; Kunming (1,900 m a.s.l.), Daweishan in Pingbian (1,500 m a.s.l.), Yunjinghong and Jinping, Yunnan; as well as Taiwan, Hainan and Hong Kong; abroad it is found in Myanmar and Thailand.
/species/odontotermes-formosanus/.soldier: Head dark yellow, abdomen pale yellow to greyish white. Pilosity of the head sparse, that of the thorax and abdomen denser. Head oval, longer than wide, widest in the middle and posterior part, slightly narrowed anteriorly; the frons flat; postmentum short and stout, narrow at the anterior end and slightly projecting towards the ventral surface. Mandibles sickle-shaped, the left marginal tooth in front of the midpoint, its apex directed obliquely forwards; the right mandible with a minute tooth at the corresponding position on the inner margin, small and inconspicuous. Labrum lingulate, narrow at the anterior end and without a transparent patch, arcuate at the sides, broader posteriorly, with a row of erect long bristles along the lateral margins, its apex reaching about the middle of the mandibles and not covering the marginal teeth. Antennae with 16–17 segments, segment 2 about equal in length to segments 3 and 4 together, segment 3 longer than, or sometimes shorter than, segment 4. The anterior part of the pronotum is narrow and inclined upwards forwards, the posterior part broader, shaped like an ingot; at the corners where the anterior and posterior parts meet on each side there is an oblique groove running backwards, and both the anterior and the posterior margin have a distinct median notch.
/species/odontotermes-formosanus/.worker: Head yellow, thorax and abdomen greyish white. The lateral and posterior margins of the head form a continuous arc; the fontanelle lies in the middle of the vertex and is a small circular pit; the postclypeus is markedly raised, about half as long as wide, with a median longitudinal suture; antennae with 17 segments, segment 2 longer than segment 3. Length of head to the apex of the labrum 1.70–1.81 mm, width of head 1.36–1.41 mm, width of pronotum 0.72–0.77 mm.

/species/odontotermes-fuyangensis/.biology: The host is the camphor tree.
/species/odontotermes-fuyangensis/.soldier: Body small. Head earth-yellow, the frontal region slightly paler, the labrum and postmentum brownish yellow, the mandibles deep reddish brown and slightly paler at the base, the antennae and pronotum pale yellow. Head with sparse setae; long bristles arranged along both sides of the labrum; the anterior half of the postmentum with several setae; short setae scattered over the lateral margins and disc of the pronotum, the pilosity of the abdomen denser. Head elongate-oval, narrowed in front of the antennal sockets, the lateral margins almost parallel, widest slightly behind the middle, the posterior corners broadly rounded, the posterior margin a broad arc. Labrum slenderly lingulate, longer than wide, reaching the midpoint of the mandibles, its apex bluntly rounded. Mandibles sickle-shaped, the left marginal tooth at one-third from the apex, the mandibular body rather slender; the right mandible with a minute tooth at the corresponding position. Postmentum moderately arched, about 1.7 times as long as wide. Antennae with 15 segments; of segments 3 to 5, segment 3 is the shortest and smallest, segment 5 larger than segment 3 but smaller than the remaining segments, the terminal segment spindle-shaped. The anterior part of the pronotum is narrower than the posterior part and slightly upturned, the anterior margin with a distinct median notch, the posterior margin slightly straight and its median notch indistinct.

/species/odontotermes-giriensis/.distribution: Pangxin, Medog, Xizang (1,270 m a.s.l.); abroad it is found in Giri, India.
/species/odontotermes-giriensis/.soldier: Head deep yellow, the labrum concolorous, the antennae yellowish brown with the tip slightly darker, the anterior half of the mandibles dark brown and the base yellowish brown; thorax, abdomen and legs pale yellow. The whole body covered with soft hairs. Head oval, the frons sloping gradually forwards, longer than wide, widest at the middle of the head; fontanelle indistinct; the boundary between the frons and the postclypeus distinct, the postclypeus slightly transparent. Labrum lingulate, widest at the base, narrowing gradually towards the apex, with about seven long bristles on each side. Mandibles sabre-shaped, the apices incurved, shorter than the head; the left marginal tooth at one-quarter from the apex, with a small tooth near the base; the right mandible with a minute tooth at the corresponding position on the inner margin. Antennae with 15–16 segments, segment 1 cylindrical and the longest, segment 2 less than half of segment 1, segment 3 equal to or shorter than segment 2, segment 4 the shortest, the segments from the fifth onwards gradually clavate, the terminal segment oval. Pronotum saddle-shaped, narrower than the head, the anterior half narrow and upturned, its anterior margin with a distinct median notch, the posterior half broader, the posterior margin arcuate and slightly concave at the middle. Legs slender; tibial spur formula 3:2:2.

/species/odontotermes-gravelyi/.alate: Dorsum of the vertex and the dorsum of the thorax and abdomen yellowish brown, the ventral surface of the head and the legs yellow, the venter of the abdomen yellowish brown, the wings pale brown. Ocelli oval, their distance from the compound eye slightly less than the length of the ocellus and greater than its width; the vertex flat, the fontanelle a small conical projection. Antennae with 19 segments, segments 3 to 7 about equal in length and all shorter than segment 2, the terminal segment longer than segment 2. The anterior and the posterior margin of the pronotum each with a slight median notch; the middle of the pronotum bears a pale cross-shaped mark with a small pale spot on each side in front of it.
/species/odontotermes-gravelyi/.biology: The nest is generally built in the soil beneath the turf and is subterranean, occasionally found in earthen walls beside a stove; the nest may stand partly above ground and consists of many scattered fungus-garden chambers and fungus gardens; the species can bore into the trunks of trees and into the ground-level parts of wooden posts.
/species/odontotermes-gravelyi/.distribution: Mojiang (1,400 m a.s.l.), Pu'er (1,350 m a.s.l.), Yunjinghong (500 m a.s.l.), Mengla in Jinping (350 m a.s.l.) and Lianshan, Yunnan; abroad it is found in Myanmar.
/species/odontotermes-gravelyi/.soldier: Head deep yellow, the base of the mandibles brownish and the anterior part black, the thorax pale yellow, the abdomen nearly white; setae on the head extremely sparse, the thorax and abdomen with hairs of unequal length. Head large and flat, oval in dorsal view, narrow anteriorly and broad posteriorly, the lateral and posterior margins slightly arched; the postmentum does not bulge strongly from the ventral surface of the head and is narrow only at the anterior end, its remaining part almost equal in width. Mandibles robust; the left mandible has a sharp tooth behind the midpoint, its apex directed obliquely forwards; the right mandible has a granular tooth-like projection at the corresponding position. The lateral margins of the labrum are arcuate and the anterior end is contracted, reaching the middle of the mandibles. Antennae with 17 segments, segments 2 and 4 about equal in length, segment 3 slightly shorter. Both the anterior and the posterior margin of the pronotum have a median notch.
/species/odontotermes-gravelyi/.worker: Head deep yellow, thorax and abdomen pale yellow. Head squarish and flattened, antennae with 19 segments, segment 2 longer than segment 3; the anterior and the posterior margin of the pronotum slightly concave at the middle. Length of head to the apex of the labrum 2.22–2.72 mm, width of head 1.75–1.94 mm.

/species/odontotermes-hainanensis/.alate: The tergites of the head, thorax and abdomen are dark brown, the ventral surface of the head and of the abdomen brownish yellow, the posterior half of the labrum pale orange and the anterior half orange-red. The ocelli are far from the compound eyes, the distance between them distinctly greater than the length of the ocellus itself. The wings are rather short.
/species/odontotermes-hainanensis/.biology: It lives in the soil; the nest is entirely subterranean and consists of many fungus gardens and fungus-garden chambers. The host plants are the rubber tree, lychee and tung tree.
/species/odontotermes-hainanensis/.distribution: Fujian; Longzhou and Pingyangjiang in Pubei, Guangxi; Hekou (90 m a.s.l.), Yunjinghong (500 m a.s.l.), Menghai in Banna, Changpotou in Jinping (1,100 m a.s.l.), Mojiang (1,400 m a.s.l.), Pu'er (1,350 m a.s.l.), Simao, Kaiyuan, Yanshan, Lianghe and Yingjiang, Yunnan; Hepu, Haikang and Xuwen, Guangdong; Nada, Lehui, Qiongdong and Dongfang, Hainan.
/species/odontotermes-hainanensis/.soldier: Head deep yellow, the abdomen pale yellow or greyish white with a slight reddish tinge. Pilosity of the head sparse, that of the abdomen denser. Head oval, the lateral margins arcuate, the widest point mostly at the middle of the head. Postmentum markedly projecting towards the ventral surface, its surface curved, the posterior end broader than the anterior end. Mandibles rather slender, gently curved, only the anterior end slightly bent; the left marginal tooth at one-third of the anterior part, sharp, its apex directed obliquely forwards; the right mandible with a very small and inconspicuous granular tooth slightly behind the corresponding position. The lateral margins of the labrum are curved and bear long setae, the labral apex narrow. Antennae with 15–16 segments; segment 2 longer than segments 3 and 4; in individuals with 15 segments segment 3 is shorter than segment 4, whereas in those with 16 segments segment 3 is longer than segment 4; the segments enlarge progressively after the fifth. Both the anterior and the posterior margin of the pronotum have a median notch.
/species/odontotermes-hainanensis/.worker: Two forms, large and small. In the large form the head is deep yellow and the abdomen greyish white; the head is nearly square, the lateral margins slightly straight, the anterior end expanded and forming the widest part of the head; the fontanelle lies in the middle of the vertex and is a small circular pit; the postclypeus is raised and divided into right and left halves by a median longitudinal suture; antennae with 17 segments; the anterior part of the pronotum markedly upturned; body length 4.33–4.72 mm. In the small form the head is pale yellow and the abdomen greyish white; the lateral and posterior margins of the head form a continuous arc and are not square; antennae with 15–16 segments; body length 3.9–4 mm.

/species/odontotermes-longzhouensis/.soldier: Body rather large. Head reddish brown, the antennae and pronotum reddish yellow, the mandibles dark brown with reddish brown bases. Long bristles scattered over the head; the periphery and the posterior half of the pronotum bear numerous erect, stout, long bristles; about ten stout long setae around the margin of the labrum; the anterior half of the postmentum with several setae of unequal length. The head is slightly rectangular-trapezoidal, narrower anteriorly, widest at about the posterior third, the posterior margin slightly arcuate. Mandibles very robust, the apices slightly incurved; the tooth of the left mandible rather large, at about one-third from the anterior end; the tooth of the right mandible very small, merely a point, situated slightly below the left marginal tooth, with another small tooth near the base. Labrum lingulate, reaching the middle of the mandibles. Antennae with 16–17 segments, mostly 17, segment 3 the shortest in most individuals. The anterior margin of the pronotum has a rather broad notch, and the middle of the posterior margin is distinctly concave.
/species/odontotermes-longzhouensis/.taxonomy_note: The original work records this as Odontotermes shanglinensis; it is now merged, as a synonym, into O. longzhouensis.
/species/odontotermes-longzhouensis/.worker: The worker has a large and a small form. In the large worker the bristles of the head are longer and more numerous, head width 1.63–1.67 mm, pronotal width 0.92–0.96 mm, antennae with 18 segments, segment 4 short and small. In the small worker the bristles of the head are fewer, head width 1.08–1.13 mm, pronotal width 0.71–0.75 mm, antennae with 17 segments, segments 3, 4 and 5 short and small and approximately equal to one another.

/species/odontotermes-luoyangensis/.alate: Head reddish brown, the mandibles dark brown with orange-yellow bases, the labrum orange-yellow, the pronotum pale reddish brown, the femora yellow, the tibiae pale yellow, the wings greyish black. Body rather large, the head nearly circular and slightly flattened, the ocelli elongate-oval, the compound eyes circular and projecting. Anteclypeus raised; both the anterior and the posterior margin of the postclypeus curve backwards, with a distinct median longitudinal suture; the fontanelle lies in the middle of the dorsum of the head, its small conical projection indistinct; the antennal spot crescent-shaped; antennae with 19 segments, segment 3 slightly short, segments 4 and 5 about equal in length, the basal segment stout and long and the terminal segment rather slender and long. The pronotum is slightly narrower than the head, its anterolateral corners rounded, the anterior margin wavy because of the slightly upturned middle, the median notch distinct, the lateral margins contracting backwards, the posterior margin straight and slightly inflected at the middle. The media of the forewing lies close to the cubitus and branches at about one-half of the wing length; the cubitus arises from the media at the basal suture and has more branches than the media; the media of the hindwing lies between the radial sector and the cubitus, whose branches are fewer. The hind tibia is markedly long.
/species/odontotermes-luoyangensis/.distribution: Longmen Xishan, Luoyang, Henan (220 m a.s.l.).
/species/odontotermes-luoyangensis/.soldier: Head reddish brown, the thorax and legs yellow, the abdomen milky white, the mandibles brown with reddish yellow bases. The dorsum of the head smooth, with only a few long setae; the apical setae and the subapical setae of the labrum each one pair and about equal in length, the subapical setae and the setae behind them on both sides progressively shorter and smaller, regularly arranged and set slightly back from the labral margin. Body rather large, the head nearly elongate-oval, the lateral margins slightly arcuate, the posterior margin arcuate. Mandibles rather slender: a tooth on the inner margin of the left mandible at one-third from the anterior end, its apex slightly anterior, the mandibular apex sharp and slightly incurved, the basal notch rather broad; the right mandible has an indistinct minute tooth-like projection near the midpoint of the inner margin and another broad, low small projection near the mandibular base. Postmentum narrow and long with the sides slightly parallel, about 1.49–1.59 times as long as wide, 1.54 times on average. Antennae with 16–17 segments, the basal segment stout, segment 2 rather long, segment 3 or segment 4 the shortest, the terminal segment narrow and pointed and longer than the remaining segments. Pronotum broad, the anterior part narrower and the anterior half markedly upturned; at the junction of the anterior and posterior parts there is an oblique fissure on each side, and the median notch of the anterior margin is deeper than that of the posterior margin.
/species/odontotermes-luoyangensis/.worker: Dimorphism indistinct. Head oval, reddish yellow, thorax and legs dull yellow, abdomen yellowish white; antennae with 16–17 segments. Head width 1.26–1.42 mm, pronotal width 0.65–0.72 mm.

/species/odontotermes-obesus/.distribution: Didong (700 m a.s.l.) and Beibeng (800 m a.s.l.), Medog, Xizang; abroad it is found in Sadiya, Assam, India.
/species/odontotermes-obesus/.soldier: Head yellow to dark brown, the antennae pale yellow or tinged with brown, the mandibles dark brown, the thorax, legs and abdomen greyish yellow. Head oval and flat, the anterior part contracted and inclined, longer than wide, widest at the middle of the head, the posterior margin circular. Labrum lingulate, longer than wide, widest at the base, with about seven bristles regularly arranged on each side. Mandibles slender and sabre-like, the apices slightly curved; the left marginal tooth near one-quarter from the apex, with another small tooth often near the base; the right mandible has an undeveloped tooth about one-quarter from the apex and also a small tooth at the base. Antennae usually with 16 segments, segment 1 cylindrical and the longest, segment 4 the shortest. Postmentum longer than wide, with fine setae anteriorly. Pronotum saddle-shaped, less wide than the head, the anterior margin projecting forwards like a leaf and with a median notch, the posterior margin contracting at the sides and concave at the middle.
/species/odontotermes-obesus/.taxonomy_note: The original work records this as Odontotermes assamensis; it is now merged, as a synonym, into O. obesus.

/species/odontotermes-parallelus/.soldier: Body medium-sized; head yellow, the antennal ridges reddish yellow, the pronotum pale yellow, the mandibles reddish brown, the abdomen and legs yellowish white. The head has very few setae; the labrum has eight to ten long bristles on each side; setae on the periphery of the pronotum very few and still fewer in the middle region; the abdominal tergites with rather numerous scattered bristles. Head rectangular, the lateral margins of the middle section almost parallel, slightly contracted in front of the antennal sockets and near the posterior end, the posterior margin slightly straight. Labrum elongate-lingulate, longer than wide, the middle section gradually contracting forwards. Mandibles rather straight, the apices slightly curved. The tooth of the left mandible lies more than one-third from the anterior end. Antennae with 15–16 segments; with 15 segments segment 3 is the shortest, with 16 segments segment 4 is the shortest. Postmentum rectangular, the waist narrower anteriorly, the lateral margins parallel from the waist backwards. On each side of the anterior margin of the pronotum there is a very deep muscle-scar depression, exactly at the position where the anterior half rises vertically, and there is a distinct notch at the exact middle of both the anterior and the posterior margin.
/species/odontotermes-parallelus/.worker: Distinctly dimorphic, with a large and a small form. Apart from being larger, darker in colour and having one more antennal segment, the large form agrees with the small form in all other characters.

/species/odontotermes-pujiangensis/.soldier: Head brownish yellow, the mandibles purplish brown with bases approaching the colour of the head, the antennae paler than the head, the thorax, abdomen and appendages yellow. Long setae on the head rare, the post-antennal setae one on each side and rather long; long setae sparsely scattered over the anterior and posterior parts of the postmentum; the periphery and the posterior part of the pronotum with rather numerous long bristles. Head broadly oval, the lateral margins almost parallel, slightly broader posteriorly. Mandibles robust, the apices rather curved; the tooth of the left mandible triangular, situated on the inner margin near one-third from the anterior end, its apex directed forwards, with another fine tooth in the notch in front of the mandibular base; the right mandible has a small tooth slightly behind the corresponding position of the left marginal tooth, and a minute tooth both at the base and slightly in front of it. Labrum broadly lingulate. Antennae with 17 segments, segment 3 the smallest, segment 4 square and larger than segment 3, segment 5 slightly smaller than segment 4 and almost equal to segment 3, the following segments slightly enlarging, the terminal segment oval. Postmentum almost twice as long as wide, widest near the posterior end. Pronotum saddle-shaped, its anterior and posterior lobes almost equal in length; the middle of the anterior margin deeply incised, whereas the median depression of the posterior margin is broad and shallow.
/species/odontotermes-pujiangensis/.taxonomy_note: Owing to a line break in the original work, the scientific name was divided as Odontotermespujiangen sis; it is in fact Odontotermes pujiangensis, the genus name being unchanged.
/species/odontotermes-pujiangensis/.worker: Body yellowish white, the head slightly darker and greyish yellow; the bristles of the vertex of medium length and rather dense, the pilosity behind the head and at the sides sparser. Head nearly square and flattened, the lateral margins rather straight, the posterior corners broadly rounded and continuous with the posterior margin in a broad arc. The apical tooth of the left mandible slightly shorter than the first marginal tooth, the second marginal tooth reduced and very broad and low, the third and fourth marginal teeth shorter; the apical tooth of the right mandible almost as large as the first marginal tooth but slightly shorter, the second marginal tooth broad and short; the anterior cutting edge much shorter than the posterior cutting edge, the latter about 3.5 times the former; the molar plate surface bears seven transverse ridges. Antennae with 17–18 segments; with 17 segments segment 3 is the shortest, with 18 segments segment 4 is the shortest, segment 2 about equal in length to segments 3 and 4 together. The fontanelle lies in the middle of the vertex and is a small circular shallow depression, indistinct. In lateral view the postclypeus rises high, its length only half its width, with a median longitudinal groove. The pronotum is saddle-shaped, the anterior lobe slightly longer than the posterior lobe; the middle of the anterior margin deeply concave, the notch of the posterior margin shallow and broad. The hind tibia is shorter than the head width.

/species/odontotermes-pyriceps/.alate: Dorsum of the head and the pronotum purplish brown, the pronotum with a pale T-shaped mark at the centre and a pale spot on each side near the anterior margin; the postclypeus yellowish brown, the anteclypeus greyish white; the mandibles dark brown along the marginal teeth and the periphery and brownish yellow at the base; the anterior half of the labrum reddish brown and darker than the posterior half, with a pale transverse band between them; the wings purplish brown. Pilosity of the head, thorax and abdomen medium in density; the base of the mandibles bears more than ten mandibular-base setae. Head nearly circular, the compound eyes rather small and nearly round, the ocelli round and slightly elongate; the fontanelle small, granular and projecting, situated at the centre of the line joining the posterior margins of the compound eyes; antennae with 19 segments, segment 2 about one and a half times the length of segment 3, segment 3 equal to or slightly longer than segment 4, the segments after the fifth almost equal, the terminal segment slightly larger and elongate-oval. Postclypeus slightly raised, its length slightly less than half its width, with a median longitudinal suture. Pronotum rather broad, its width about equal to or slightly less than the head width; the anterior margin shallowly V-shaped, without a distinct median notch; the posterior margin narrower and shallowly concave at the middle.
/species/odontotermes-pyriceps/.soldier: Head yellow or deep yellow, paler where the frons meets the vertex, the labrum deep yellow, the antennae yellow, the anterior half of the mandibles purplish brown and the posterior half becoming yellowish brown, the postmentum slightly darker than the rest of the head. Pilosity of the head medium in density, denser on the clypeus and frons; the anterior part of the postmentum with two to three long setae on each side. The apex of the labrum is narrowly rounded and does not reach the left marginal tooth. Mandibles slender and sickle-shaped, the apices slightly incurved; the tooth of the left mandible situated at nearly one-third of the anterior part with its apex slightly forwards; the right mandibular tooth very small, situated below the corresponding part of the left marginal tooth, with another indistinct granular small tooth near the base. Postmentum very broad and short, the sides of the posterior part nearly parallel, the posterior margin slightly contracted inwards and concave in a circular arc, the surface of the mentum rough. Antennae mostly with 16 segments, segment 2 slightly longer than segment 3, segment 4 the smallest, the terminal segment stout and nearly conical with a rather blunt tip. Pronotum saddle-shaped, the anterior lobe narrow and small, the posterior lobe broad and large, both the anterior and the posterior margin with a distinct median notch. The fore tibia is rather swollen; the hind tibia is about equal to or slightly shorter than the head width.
/species/odontotermes-pyriceps/.worker: Two forms, large and small; the large form is slightly darker in body colour than the small form.

/species/odontotermes-quinquedentatus/.soldier: Body medium-sized; head brown tinged with yellow, the antennae and mandibular bases yellowish brown, the thorax, abdomen and legs pale yellowish brown. Pilosity of the head sparse, the labral-margin setae in four or five pairs. Head oval, the cephalic index 0.72–0.79, the lateral margins slightly straight and slightly expanding posteriorly, the posterior margin rounded, widest at the posterior quarter of the head, about 1.4–1.6 times the width at the mandibular bases. Labrum lingulate. Mandibles sickle-shaped, slender and curved at both ends; the left mandible about half the head length, with a tooth at one-third of the anterior part whose apex points forwards and forms an acute angle of 60 degrees with the inner margin, and with a fine tooth behind the midpoint and another in front of the mandibular basal projection; the right mandible with two fine teeth on the inner margin. Antennae with 16–17 segments, segment 3 or segment 4 the shortest. Postmentum about 1.7–1.9 times as long as wide, the anterior quarter slightly trapezoidal, the sides of the middle section nearly parallel, the middle of the lower margin in lateral view slightly arched. Pronotum saddle-shaped, about 1.6 times as wide as long, with shallow median concavities on the anterior and posterior margins; the posterior margin of the mesonotum is similarly shallowly concave, whereas that of the metanotum is nearly straight.

/species/odontotermes-sellathorax/.soldier: Body small; head dull yellow, the labrum and postmentum slightly darker and pale brown, the mandibles reddish brown and paler in the basal third, the thorax, abdomen and appendages pale yellow. Setae on the head few, almost without fine hairs; the clypeus with only one pair of setae; the apical setae and the subapical setae of the labrum markedly long, the subapical setae well developed. Head nearly rectangular, the sides rather parallel, the posterior corners broadly rounded, the posterior margin arcuate, widest near the middle. Labrum elongate-lingulate, the apex broadly rounded, the lateral margins nearly parallel. Mandibles sabre-shaped, the apices slightly incurved; the tooth of the left mandible at one-third from the apex, its apex forwards, with a minute tooth in the basal notch; the right mandibular tooth very small, with another small tooth near the base. Postmentum elongate, about twice as long as wide, the sides of the posterior part almost parallel or slightly arched. Antennae with 15 segments, segment 3 the smallest, segment 5 slightly larger than segment 3. The anterior margin of the pronotum is deeply incised at the two muscle scars, the width between the two scars being less than the length of the median axis, and both the anterior and the posterior margin are distinctly concave at the middle.

/species/odontotermes-shixingensis/.soldier: Five pairs of setae on the dorsum of the head near the median ridge. Mandibles sickle-shaped; the left mandible 0.48–0.51 times the head length and about 0.57–0.62 times the greatest head width; a pointed tooth at one-third of the anterior part of the left mandible, its apex directed obliquely towards a small tooth on the right side, the mandibular body behind the tooth about twice as wide as the anterior mandibular body, and a vestige of a small tooth remaining between the tooth and the mandibular basal projection; the right mandible with two fine teeth on its inner side. Antennae with 17 segments, segment 3 the shortest. The middle section of the postmentum is nearly parallel on both sides, and in lateral view its height is about one-sixth of the head height. The pronotum is about 1.46–1.58 times as wide as long, with concavities at the middle of both the anterior and the posterior margin, and with distinct lateral muscle scars.

/species/odontotermes-wuzhishanensis/.soldier: Body rather large; head and the anterior half of the pronotum orange-yellow, the antennae pale yellow, the mandibles reddish brown, the abdomen and legs yellowish white. Setae on the head very few; the labrum with ten to twelve long bristles; the periphery of the pronotum with ten to fifteen scattered long bristles and the middle region with only three to five; the abdominal tergites with more numerous soft hairs. Head oval, narrower anteriorly, widest at about the posterior third, the posterior margin slightly arcuate. Labrum lingulate, contracted at the anterior end, with a slight finger-like projection at the apex. Mandibles rather straight, the apices very slightly curved; the tooth of the left mandible situated above the middle, the portion above it distinctly more slender than the corresponding part of the right mandible; the right mandible has a distinct small tooth at the middle section and another near the base. Antennae with 17 segments, segments 3 and 5 shorter and smaller and nearly equal in length. Postmentum rectangular, the lateral margins slightly wavy, slightly narrower anteriorly, widest at the posterior third and slightly contracted near the base. Both the anterior and the posterior margin of the pronotum have a rather broad and deep median notch.
/species/odontotermes-wuzhishanensis/.worker: Distinctly dimorphic, with a large and a small form; the antennae have 17 segments in both.

/species/odontotermes-yaoi/.biology: In parts of Fujian it is a major pest of reservoirs.
/species/odontotermes-yaoi/.soldier: Soldier head yellow or deep yellow, slightly paler in the middle of the anterior part, the labrum yellow, the antennae yellowish brown with the terminal segments darker, the mandibles black at the apex and yellowish brown at the base, the thorax, legs and abdomen pale yellow, the pronotum slightly darker. Head oval and flat, the anterior end distinctly contracted and gradually forming an inclined surface, longer than wide, widest at the middle, the posterior margin arcuate, the fontanelle indistinct. Labrum lingulate, longer than wide, widest at the base, with several bristles arranged on each side. Mandibles slender and sabre-like, the apices slightly curved, slightly shorter than the head length; a large tooth on the inner margin of the left mandible at the anterior quarter and a small tooth near the base; the right mandible has an undeveloped small tooth on the inner margin near the apical quarter and another small tooth near the base. Antennae with 15 segments, segment 1 cylindrical and the longest, segment 2 slightly shorter, segment 3 square and the shortest, segments 4 to 11 gradually enlarging and clavate, the terminal segment the largest and oval. Pronotum saddle-shaped, narrower than the head width, the anterior margin projecting forwards in a leaf-like lobe with a median notch, the posterior margin contracted at the sides and slightly depressed at the middle.

/species/odontotermes-yunnanensis/.alate: The head is reddish brown; the pronotum, abdominal tergites, antennae and wings are all yellowish brown; the postclypeus, the base of the mandibles and the ventral surface of the abdomen are dull yellow; the whole body is densely covered with hairs.
/species/odontotermes-yunnanensis/.biology: This species builds earthen mounds; both the height and the diameter of the nest may exceed 2 m, and the nest contains many separate fungus-garden chambers; the royal cell lies roughly level with the ground surface, and the same royal cell may contain two or three queens.
/species/odontotermes-yunnanensis/.distribution: Yunjinghong (500 m a.s.l.), Menghai in Banna, Simao, Mojiang (1,400 m a.s.l.), Pu'er (1,350 m a.s.l.), Hekou (90 m a.s.l.), Mengla in Jinping (370 m a.s.l.), Yingjiang, Manyun, Mangshi, Lianshan, Tengchong and Nujiangba, Yunnan.
/species/odontotermes-yunnanensis/.soldier: The inner margins of the mandibles bear weak teeth; the labrum is lingulate, its lateral margins sharply incised inwards at the anterior end to form a large flexure, so that the labral apex forms a forward-projecting portion; a row of long setae is arranged along the labral margin, and the labral tip extends beyond the mandibular teeth. Antennae with 17 segments, segment 2 longer than segment 3, the tip of the terminal segment narrow. The pronotum is distinctly narrower than the head, raised in the anterior middle, and both the anterior and the posterior margin have a median notch.
/species/odontotermes-yunnanensis/.worker: Body colour pale. Head nearly circular, antennae with 18 segments, segment 2 slightly longer than segment 3, pronotum saddle-shaped.

/species/odontotermes-ziyangensis/.soldier: Head yellowish brown, the thorax, abdomen and legs pale yellow; small hairs scattered over the face, the pilosity of the thorax and abdomen dense. Head oval, longer than wide, the posterior margin arcuate. The inner margin of the left mandible bears a large marginal tooth at one-third from the anterior end and an upward tooth-like projection at the base; the inner margin of the right mandible has a minute tooth-like projection at two-thirds from the anterior end. Labrum lingulate, reaching the middle of the mandibles, arcuate at the sides and raised in the middle, the apical setae and the lateral setae distinct and equal in length, and behind the subapical setae five straight setae on each side regularly arranged along the side of the labrum. Postmentum short and stout, projecting from the ventral surface of the head, narrow anteriorly and broad posteriorly, the sides nearly parallel. Antennae with 16–17 segments, mostly 17, segments 3, 4 and 5 shorter, segments 3 and 4 together slightly shorter than segment 2, segments 4 and 5 together equal to or slightly longer than segment 2, the tip of the terminal segment pointed, straight and slightly long. Pronotum saddle-shaped, the median concavity of the anterior margin distinctly deeper than that of the posterior margin, with setae around the periphery.

/species/odontotermes-zunyiensis/.alate: Head reddish brown, the postclypeus pale yellowish brown, the anteclypeus white, the antennae brown, the pronotum slightly darker than the head and with a T-shaped mark, each anterolateral corner with an ocellus-like ring-shaped spot. Head semicircular, the fontanelle small and round, the compound eyes not very round and slightly projecting outwards, the ocelli broadly oval, the ocellus-compound eye distance about equal to the short diameter of the ocellus; the postclypeus about half as long as wide with longitudinal striae in the middle, the anteclypeus trapezoidal, the labrum arcuate, the antennae with 19 segments. As to the body pilosity, short hairs are densely distributed over the head and postclypeus, interspersed with sparse long hairs; several hairs arise in the middle of the labrum; the pronotum is densely covered with fine pubescence.
/species/odontotermes-zunyiensis/.soldier: Head orange-yellow, the mandibles dark brown with deep yellow bases; setae on the head sparse, about ten stout long erect bristles around the margin of the labrum, the pilosity of the thoracic and abdominal tergites sparse. Head oval, narrow anteriorly and broad posteriorly, longer than wide, widest in the posterior part. Labrum lingulate, its apex bluntly rounded, reaching one-third of the base of the open mandibles. Mandibles sickle-shaped and rather robust, the apices incurved; the left marginal tooth at about one-third from the anterior end, the right mandible with a dot-like small tooth slightly below the corresponding position. Antennae with 17 segments, segment 3 short and small. Postmentum rectangular, slightly narrower anteriorly and broader posteriorly, less than twice as long as wide. The anterior half of the pronotum is narrow and nearly vertically upturned, the posterior half broader, and both the anterior and the posterior margin have a distinct median notch.

/species/parrhinotermes-ruiliensis/.alate: The alate head is nearly circular, the fontanelle situated in front of the midpoint of the vertex. The left mandible has three marginal teeth, tooth 2 distinctly shorter than teeth 1 and 3; the right mandible has two marginal teeth, with an additional sub-marginal tooth in front of tooth 1, and the posterior margin of tooth 2 shorter than the molar plate. Labrum broadly rounded, the postclypeus raised with its apex projecting forwards. Antennae with 20–22 segments, segment 3 longer than segment 2. The anterior margin of the pronotum is slightly projecting at the middle, both sides broad anteriorly and narrow posteriorly and continuous with the posterior margin in a semicircle; the posterior margins of the pronotum, mesonotum and metanotum are all nearly straight. Wings rather short and broad, the forewing scale large; the media of the forewing arises independently beyond the basal suture, and the media of the hindwing arises from the radial sector close to the cubitus; transverse veinlets connect the veins into a network.
/species/parrhinotermes-ruiliensis/.soldier: The soldier is dimorphic, with a large and a small form; the body is brown, slightly paler anteriorly, the mandibles dark brown and especially dark at the tips, the thorax, abdomen and legs paler. Labrum square, slightly depressed in the middle; mandibles robust and nearly quadrangular, the apical tooth well developed, marginal tooth 1 slightly projecting, marginal tooth 2 smaller, marginal teeth 3 and 4 larger; the right mandible has a very small marginal tooth 1 and a large marginal tooth 2, followed by a rather long smooth surface and a row of masticatory teeth at the base. Pronotum saddle-shaped, sparsely covered with small hairs, the anterior margin concave at the middle, the posterior margin rather straight, the mesonotum and metanotum slightly broader than the pronotum. The major soldier has a short, broad, nearly square head, a round fontanelle opening between the two antennal sockets, a longitudinal groove in front of the opening extending to the labral apex, strong mandibles with two large teeth on the inner margin of the left mandible and two teeth on the right mandible, a short and broad labrum nearly hexagonal with a slightly concave anterior margin bearing a row of brush-like short hairs, and antennae with 16–17 segments. The minor soldier has a narrow and elongate head, slender, straight mandibles that are only slightly curved at the apex, two marginal teeth on the left mandible and one on the right, a narrow and elongate labrum whose sides are contracted into a waist, the labral apex reaching the mandibular apex, and antennae with 13–16 segments.
/species/parrhinotermes-ruiliensis/.worker: The worker is slender and small. The head is flat and oval, slightly contracted anteriorly, widest at the middle, the sides of the posterior part slightly squarish, the posterior margin arcuate and arched backwards; the dorsum of the head is flat without a raised frontal ridge and bears several scattered small bristles, and in many individuals there are two regularly arranged small hairs behind the fontanelle. The fontanelle is minute, oval with a pointed anterior end, situated at one-quarter of the anterior part of the head, with a narrow longitudinal groove in front of it running to the labrum, the sides of the groove slightly raised into ridges and the groove slightly widened in front; the fontanelle gland is stout and not spindle-shaped. The labrum is about 1.3 times as long as wide and covers the dorsal side of the mandibles; the transparent apical region is broad, milky white and semicircular, occupying about one-quarter of the labrum, its anterior margin densely set with short hairs, and a few rather long fine hairs sparsely scattered over the transparent region; the narrow groove in front of the fontanelle crosses the base of the labrum and runs longitudinally through it as far as the base of the transparent region. The mandibles are long and sabre-shaped, slightly upturned dorsally and pointed at the tips; the left mandible has two large marginal teeth at two-fifths from the anterior end, tooth 1 sharp and triangular and larger than tooth 2, and the inner margin of the basal two-fifths is densely set with a row of about ten or more small serrations; the right mandible has only one sharp, angular marginal tooth at one-quarter from the anterior end, and the inner margin of its base is likewise densely set with small serrations. The postmentum is long, its anterior margin projecting at the middle, swollen at about one-third from the front, then gradually narrowing and expanding again near the base, the posterior margin inflected, the anterior half bearing a few fine hairs. Antennae with 13 segments, segment 1 the longest, segment 2 the shortest, segments 3 and 4 slightly longer than segment 2. The pronotum is flat, its anterior margin arched forwards and the posterior margin rather flat.

/species/pericapritermes-beibengensis/.alate: Wings dark brown, head and pronotum brown, anteclypeus white, postclypeus and frons dark brown but slightly paler. Compound eyes small, distinctly projecting outwards. Ocelli small and narrow, inclined antero-internally, more than twice as long as wide, their distance from the compound eye about equal to the length of one ocellus. The head is highest at the ocelli and slopes down both forwards and backwards. Fontanelle slightly raised, white, situated behind the midpoint of the head. The postclypeus is far less than half as long as wide; the labrum is very flat and yellow. Antennae dark brown with 14 segments, segment 3 extremely short, segment 4 equal in length to segment 5, segment 2 longer than segment 4 or 6. The anterior margin of the pronotum is straight and not raised at the middle, the lateral margins projecting outwards; the pronotum bears a broad, extremely pale Y-shaped mark. Tibiae darker than femora and tarsi. Wings brown, densely set with fine punctures, with many hairs on the anterior margin and a row of hairs on the posterior margin; the costa is thick, dark at the base and pale at the apex, and the area between it and the radial sector is pale; the radial sector is thick and dark, bordered by a very narrow bright band and separated in front by an extremely fine dark line. The media lies close to the cubitus, with one branch at the apex of the forewing and two in the hindwing; the cubitus has about eight branches, of which three to four in the basal section are thick.
/species/pericapritermes-beibengensis/.soldier: Head and antennae yellow or pale brown, the head turning slightly pale yellow near the posterior margin; labrum milky white; mandibles brownish red to brownish black, the right mandible paler than the left; thorax pale yellow, abdomen milky white. Bristles scattered over the vertex and the abdomen. Head rectangular, the sides almost parallel, the posterior margin slightly rounded. Labrum spatulate, broad anteriorly and narrow posteriorly, its length varying with the mandibles, generally broader than long, with a straight anterior margin bearing four long setae. Mandibles extremely asymmetrical: the left mandible strongly twisted in the middle, its top obliquely truncate, the apex bluntly rounded; the right mandible shorter and straight, sabre-like. The median suture on the posterior part of the dorsum of the head is distinct and reaches the fontanelle; the fontanelle is minute, like a pin-prick. Antennae delicate, with 14 segments, segment 1 the longest, segment 2 about half of segment 1, segment 4 almost equal to or slightly shorter than segment 2 and cylindrical; segments 6 to 8 slender and clavate, almost equal in length; segments 9 to 13 also clavate, of similar length but shorter than segments 6 to 8; segment 14 minute. Postmentum slender, widest near the anterior one-sixth.

/species/pericapritermes-gutianensis/.alate: Head and pronotum brownish, antennae, postclypeus and wings brown, compound eyes black, ocelli, fontanelle and anteclypeus pale white, postmentum and coxae brown, femora and tibiae pale brown. The head, pronotum and abdominal tergites are densely covered with hairs, and many pale white pin-prick-like dots are scattered over the head and pronotum. Head nearly circular. Fontanelle elongate-oval with short bifurcations on both sides of its anterior end, and above it another small white dot, extremely conspicuous. Four markings are faintly visible in front of the ocelli and behind the postclypeus. Postclypeus raised, its median line slightly evident. Ocelli large, their distance from the compound eye almost equal to or slightly less than the ocellar diameter and greater than the distance from the compound eye to the lower margin of the head. Antennae with 15 segments, segment 3 the shortest. The anterior part of the pronotum is slightly upturned and bears a conspicuous T-shaped mark; no notch is visible on the anterior margin, and the posterior margin has a distinct notch. The media of the forewing arises independently at the shoulder suture and gives off three or four branches posteriorly, the cubitus having nine to ten branches; the media of the hindwing arises from the base of the radial sector and gives off two or three branches posteriorly, the cubitus having ten to eleven branches.
/species/pericapritermes-gutianensis/.soldier: Head and antennae orange-yellow, the left mandible dark brown, the right mandible reddish brown, the labrum pale white; the thoracic and abdominal tergites and the legs pale yellow. Several bristles scattered over the upper part; long bristles sparsely distributed on the periphery of the pronotum and on the posterior margins of the mesonotum and metanotum; the abdominal tergites bear, besides a few bristles, rather numerous soft hairs. Head rectangular, the sides parallel, with indistinct constrictions at the mandibular bases and near the posterior margin, the posterior margin slightly straight. The length of the labrum varies with the mandibles; it is generally broader than long or almost as long as broad, in all cases broad anteriorly and narrow posteriorly and nearly square, with an almost straight anterior margin and slightly projecting anterolateral corners. Mandibles extremely asymmetrical: the left mandible strongly twisted in the middle, its top obliquely truncate, the apex blunt; the right mandible shorter and straight, sabre-like, its apex pointed. Antennae with 14 segments, segment 4 the shortest. The median suture of the head is reddish brown and reaches behind the fontanelle; the fontanelle is dot-like. Postmentum long, widest near the anterior quarter, narrow and parallel in the middle. Pronotum saddle-shaped, the anterior half vertically upturned, its anterior margin without a notch, the posterior margin slightly arcuate and projecting.

/species/pericapritermes-latignathus/.alate: Head deep reddish brown, the postclypeus yellowish brown, the antennae, pronotum and abdominal tergites brown, the femora dull yellow, the tibiae and wings brown. The whole body densely covered with hairs, and short hairs also occur on the wing surface. Head broadly oval, almost circular, the dorsum arched. Fontanelle white, elliptical and depressed, situated at the midpoint of the dorsum of the head, similar in size to the compound eye. Ocelli elliptical, their distance from the compound eye about equal to the length or width of one ocellus. Postclypeus raised, less than half as long as wide, the anterior margin straight, the posterior margin deeply curved towards the frons, the median longitudinal suture often indistinct. Antennae with 15 segments, segments 3 and 4 both shorter than segment 2; or with 14 segments, segment 3 equal to segment 2 and segment 4 the shortest. The anterior margin of the pronotum is straight, without a median notch or with only a very slight one, the anterolateral corners slightly projecting forwards, the middle of the posterior margin concave forwards. The forewing scale is larger than the hindwing scale; the media of the forewing arises independently at the shoulder suture and lies close to the cubitus, dividing from the midpoint or from one-third towards the wing apex into three to six small branches, the cubitus having six to ten branches; the media of the hindwing arises from the base of the radial sector and branches slightly more anteriorly.
/species/pericapritermes-latignathus/.biology: It lives in the soil; the nest consists of many small earthen cavities connected by tunnels, and the royal cell is also an earthen cavity, situated approximately at the centre of the group of cavities; it feeds on decaying tree stumps and rotten grass.
/species/pericapritermes-latignathus/.distribution: Jinghong and Xiaomenglun, Yunnan; Nanxiong and Yingde, Guangdong; abroad it is found in Bangladesh.
/species/pericapritermes-latignathus/.soldier: Head reddish yellow, slightly paler at the posterior margin, the median line reddish brown; labrum white tinged with pale brown; mandibles brown; antennae pale brown; pronotum brownish yellow; legs and abdomen yellow. The head is almost hairless; the anterior margin of the labrum bears four long bristles and the middle another four short bristles; two bristles arise on the postmentum near its anterior margin; a few hairs are scattered over the pronotum, with short bristles on its periphery; the abdomen is densely covered with soft hairs, each tergite bearing both minute hairs and long bristles. Head rectangular, slightly narrower anteriorly, the posterior margin slightly convex, the fontanelle small and dot-like; the median suture extends slightly behind the fontanelle. Labrum broader than long, the anterior margin nearly straight, the anterolateral corners elongate and slightly convex. The left mandible is strongly twisted in the middle with a blunt apex; the right mandible is sabre-like with a sharp apex. Postmentum elongate, the sides of the middle almost parallel, widest at the terminal quarter. Pronotum saddle-shaped, both the anterior and the posterior margin slightly convex, the median notches indistinct. Tibial spur formula 3:2:2, tarsi four-segmented.
/species/pericapritermes-latignathus/.worker: The posterior part of the head is rounded and the anterior end expanded, the widest point at the antennal sockets. The postclypeus is markedly raised, about half as long as wide, its median longitudinal suture indistinct, its colour the same as the vertex. Antennae with 14 segments, segments 3 and 4 the shortest, segment 4 shorter than segment 3. The upturned anterior part of the pronotum is larger than the posterior part. The abdomen is swollen and olive-shaped.

/species/pericapritermes-nitobei/.alate: Alate head width including the compound eyes about 1.25 mm, pronotum width 0.90–1.04 mm.
/species/pericapritermes-nitobei/.distribution: Sichuan, Henan, Anhui, Jiangsu, Zhejiang, Hubei, Hunan, Jiangxi, Guizhou, Fujian, Taiwan, Yunnan, Guangdong and Guangxi.
/species/pericapritermes-nitobei/.soldier: Head orange-yellow or deep orange-red. Apart from several bristles on the anterior margin of the labrum, the body is almost entirely without hairs. Head rectangular, the sides slightly parallel, the two posterolateral margins and the posterior margin forming an arc; the brown median line of the head capsule is very conspicuous and extends forwards to about one-quarter of the length. The left mandible is strongly twisted, obliquely truncate on its anterior right side, the apex blunt; the right mandible slightly shorter and sabre-like. Labrum longer than wide, the anterior margin straight, the anterolateral corners shortly pointed. Antennae with 14 segments. The pronotum is narrower than the head, its anterior half vertically upturned, typically saddle-shaped.
/species/pericapritermes-nitobei/.taxonomy_note: Recorded in the original work as Pericapritermes jangtsekiangensis, now merged as a synonym into P. nitobei.

/species/pericapritermes-planiusculus/.soldier: The head capsule is yellowish tinged with brown, the left mandible dark brown, the labrum white with the anterior half yellow, the antennae yellowish brown; the pronotum pale yellowish brown, the legs slightly paler, the abdomen pale yellowish white. The head capsule bears a few scattered long bristles, four at the apex of the labrum, and two to three on each anterolateral margin of the postmentum; bristles also arise on the anterior margin and the posterolateral margins of the pronotum. The head capsule is rectangular, the head width index 0.55–0.58, the sides almost parallel and slightly widening posteriorly, the anterior half narrower, the posterolateral corners broadly rounded, the middle of the posterior margin shallowly concave, the median suture distinct and more than two-thirds of the length of the head capsule; in lateral view the dorsal margin of the head is straight and the frons forms a slope of about 30 degrees, the fontanelle being slightly projecting. The middle section of the left mandible is strongly twisted, the mandibular apex swollen and bluntly rounded; the right mandible is shorter and sabre-like, with a pointed apex. Antennae with 14 segments, segments 2 and 4 both short, the segments from the fifth onwards longer. The postmentum is slender and long, widest in front of the anterior one-fifth, the constriction index of the waist region about 0.47. The pronotum is saddle-shaped, with a distinct median incision on the anterior margin. Tibial spur formula 3:2:2.

/species/pericapritermes-semarangi/.distribution: Xinglong, Hainan; Simao, Mangshi and Santaishi, Yunnan; abroad it is found in Java and Sumatra, Indonesia.
/species/pericapritermes-semarangi/.worker: Head oval, widest slightly behind the antennal sockets. The middle of the vertex is rather high, with a small shallow depression in front of it and another behind it. The postclypeus is markedly raised, less than half as long as wide. Antennae with 14 segments, segment 2 equal to the sum of segments 3 and 4. The anterior part of the pronotum is semicircular and very highly raised. The abdomen is long and swollen, the legs short.

/species/pericapritermes-tetraphilus/.alate: The vertex, pronotum and abdominal tergites are brownish, the mesonotum, metanotum, tibiae and abdominal sternites yellowish brown, the femora pale, the wing veins distinct. The body is rather large and robust, the ocelli rather large and elliptical, their distance from the compound eye less than the width of the ocellus. Antennae with 15 segments, the segments circular or oval. The anterior margin of the pronotum is almost straight and slightly raised at the middle, the two anterolateral corners slightly projecting forwards, the posterior margin narrower than the anterior, and an indistinct pale T-shaped mark in the middle of the disc. The forewing scale is slightly larger than the hindwing scale; the media of the forewing arises independently at the shoulder suture and lies close to the cubitus, beginning to branch beyond the midpoint of the wing length, with five or six branches in all reaching the wing apex, the cubitus with about eight branches; the media of the hindwing arises from the radial sector.
/species/pericapritermes-tetraphilus/.biology: It lives in the soil or inside dead tree roots, often together with capritermes-group termites and with Odontotermes; it has been found in the tunnels bored by Odontotermes in tree roots.
/species/pericapritermes-tetraphilus/.distribution: Shantou and Shaoguan, Guangdong; Pinghe, Fujian; Yunjinghong, Hekou, Pingbian, Jinping (Mengla), Mojiang, Santaishan, Simao and Manyun, Yunnan; abroad it is found in India.
/species/pericapritermes-tetraphilus/.soldier: The posterior part of the head is orange-yellow, gradually deepening forwards into orange-red; the mandibles black; the anterior part of the thorax and the abdomen white or tinged with pale yellow. The longitudinal suture of the head extends forwards from the posterior end for more than half the length of the head. The head is a rather large rectangle; the mandibles are robust, the apex of the left mandible curved outwards and blunt, the right mandible sabre-like. The anterior margin of the labrum is rather straight, the labrum longer than wide, the anterolateral corners projecting as short needles. Antennae with 14 segments, segments 1 to 3 longer than segment 4, segments 6 to 8 equal in length and all longer than segment 5, the segments gradually shortening from the ninth or tenth onwards, the apex of the terminal segment narrow and its length about equivalent to that of segment 5. The anterior and posterior margins of the pronotum have no notch, or occasionally an extremely indistinct one.

/species/pericapritermes-wuzhishanensis/.alate: The head is brown, the postclypeus, antennae, thoracic and abdominal tergites and wings pale brown, the compound eyes black, the anteclypeus white, the fontanelle yellowish white; the head, mesonotum, wing scales and abdominal tergites bear numerous long and short hairs. The head is broadly oval, widest at the middle and narrowing towards both ends. The fontanelle is rather large, shaped like a long oval narrowed at the front end and rounded at the back, with a faintly discernible V-shaped bifurcating line on each anterolateral side, its surface slightly depressed and not raised. The postclypeus is raised and lacks a median longitudinal line. Antennae with 15 segments, the scape the thickest and longest, segment 3 the shortest and smallest. The ocelli are elliptical and not distinctly projecting, their distance from the compound eye less than the short diameter of the ocellus itself; the compound eyes are large and strongly projecting, their distance to the lower margin of the head less than the ocellus-compound eye distance. The left mandible has four teeth, the apical tooth the longest and pointed, marginal tooth 3 reduced to a mere dot. The anterior margin of the pronotum is almost straight, the posterior margin slightly concave, the T-shaped mark indistinct. The forewing scale is larger than the hindwing scale. The media of the forewing arises independently at the shoulder suture and rather nearer the cubitus, with five to six branches behind; the media of the hindwing arises from the base of the radial sector, with four branches behind.
/species/pericapritermes-wuzhishanensis/.soldier: Head rectangular, the sides slightly parallel, the frons not projecting or slightly raised. The mandibles are asymmetrical, the left mandible twisted, its apex narrow and curved inwards into a hook; the right mandible straighter and somewhat sabre-like, its apex slightly turned inwards, in a few specimens curved forwards or outwards, differing considerably from the left mandible. The labrum is usually longer than wide, the anterior notch shallow and flat. Antennae with 14 segments. The pronotum is narrower than the head and saddle-shaped. Tibial spur formula 3:2:2.

/species/procapritermes-huananensis/.distribution: Guangxi; Yingjiang (870 m), Yunnan; Limuling, Qiongzhong (350 m) and Wuzhishan (700 m), Hainan.
/species/procapritermes-huananensis/.soldier: Head yellow, the frontal gland area a translucent pale yellow triangular area, the upper margin of the frontal gland pore slightly projecting and slightly sclerotised; mandibles purplish brown tinged with black; labrum nearly white; antennae pale brown with the ends of the segments very pale; the median suture of the head brown and rather fine; thorax pale yellow, abdomen white. Total body length including the mandibles about 5–5.3 mm. The whole body is sparsely covered with hairs, the hairs of the head longer, those of the labrum especially long; the hairs of the thorax shorter, those of the pronotum denser and those of the tibiae especially dense. The head is a short rectangle with rounded corners, its outline nearly oblong; in lateral view the head is rather thick, the frons inclined forwards. The labrum is rectangular, placed somewhat obliquely to the right over the two mandibles, its lateral margins extending almost parallel forwards, the middle of the anterior margin deeply concave, the lateral corners pointed. Antennae with 14 segments, segment 1 the longest, equal to the sum of segments 2 and 3, segment 3 longer than segment 2. Mandibles slender and long, slightly sinuous but largely straight; the apex of the left mandible slightly bent to the right, that of the right mandible slightly bent downwards. Postmentum nearly rectangular, narrowest at the anterior margin. Pronotum saddle-shaped, the middle of the anterior margin slightly concave.
/species/procapritermes-huananensis/.taxonomy_note: The original work placed this species in the genus Malaysiocapritermes; it is now assigned to Procapritermes.
/species/procapritermes-huananensis/.worker: Head pale yellow, the frontal gland area dirty white, shaped like an opened folding fan; the median suture of the head translucent, thicker anteriorly and gradually finer posteriorly; mandibles pale yellow, the condyles, the mandibular apices and the tips of the maxillary lobes brown; from the metathorax to the abdomen translucent pale white, the convolutions of the digestive tract clearly visible. The whole body is covered with sparse white hairs, those of the labrum, the thoracic dorsum and the tibiae longer and thicker. Head nearly circular; in lateral view the postclypeus and anteclypeus both form distinct wart-like swellings, the depression separating them small and their lengths nearly equal, the longitudinal fissure of the postclypeus fairly distinct. Antennae with 14 segments, segment 1 the longest and nearly equal to the sum of segments 2 and 3, segment 4 equal to segment 5 and shorter than segment 2 or 3. Mandibles slightly asymmetrical, the junction between the posterior margin of the apical tooth of the left mandible and the anterior cutting edge of marginal tooth 1 forming an obtuse angle.

/species/procapritermes-zhangfengensis/.alate: Head broadly oval, slightly narrow anteriorly, densely covered with long and short hairs; the fontanelle usually long and narrow, slit-like; the compound eyes elliptical, the ocelli oval and separated from the compound eyes; the postclypeus raised; the apical tooth of the left mandible rather short, slightly larger than or almost equal to marginal tooth 1, marginal tooth 1 larger than marginal tooth 2; the posterior margin of marginal tooth 1 of the right mandible rather long. Antennae with 14–15 segments.
/species/procapritermes-zhangfengensis/.soldier: Medium-sized. Head brownish yellow, mandibles brownish, antennae, thorax and legs pale yellow, labrum white, abdomen milky white; the head sparsely covered with short hairs, the anterior part of the frons with more hairs; the apex and the middle of the labrum bear respectively four long bristles and three to four short hairs; the periphery of the pronotum bears rather numerous long hairs; the anterior end of the postmentum has four long hairs. The head capsule is rectangular, longer than wide, the sides slightly projecting at the middle, rather thick in lateral view; the median suture of the head is distinct and about one-quarter of the length of the head capsule; the frontal ridge is slightly raised, the surface from the fontanelle to the postclypeus distinctly depressed, forming a groove in lateral view. The anterior part of the labrum is contracted, the anterior margin concave, the lateral corners projecting as long points. The left mandible is slightly twisted, its apex bent to the right into a hook; the right mandible is slender and long, rod-like, bent downwards before the middle. The anterior part of the postmentum is the widest, the sides narrowing behind the midpoint. Antennae with 14 segments, segments 2 and 3 equal in length, segment 4 the shortest; the pronotum is saddle-shaped, its anterior margin upturned, the middle of the posterior margin slightly declined, and neither the anterior nor the posterior margin shows a distinct notch. Tibial spur formula 2:2:2, tarsi four-segmented.
/species/procapritermes-zhangfengensis/.taxonomy_note: The original work placed this species in the genus Malaysiocapritermes; it is now assigned to Procapritermes.

/species/prorhinotermes-flavus/.distribution: Recorded only from Lanyu Island, Taiwan.
/species/prorhinotermes-flavus/.soldier: The head capsule is brown tinged with yellow; the mandibles dark brown, almost black, the mandibular bases concolorous with the head capsule; the labrum, antennae, frontal gland pore and compound eyes yellowish brown; the thorax, abdomen and legs also yellowish brown. The whole body is sparsely covered with hairs; the periphery of the pronotum bears only scattered bristles, with two visible in the middle region. The head capsule is broadly elliptical, the sides expanding backwards from the mandibular bases and becoming almost parallel behind the compound eyes, the posterior margin broadly rounded, the widest point near the middle. The labrum is nearly square, its apex flat and slightly concave, with two apical hairs directed forwards; the anteclypeus is a transverse band, the postclypeus trapezoidal. The mandibles are sabre-like, their apices slender and slightly curved, the base with a distinct mandibular condyle, the middle of the inner margin almost smooth. Antennae with 17 segments, segments 3 and 4 both rather short. The compound eyes are distinct and slightly bulging. The frontal gland pore is circular and lies behind two-fifths of the anterior part of the head capsule, with a shallow groove in front of the pore leading to the clypeus, the groove slightly wider than the pore, the area around the pore slightly depressed and bearing several fine forward-curving arcs; in lateral view the surface in front of and behind the pore is rather flat, and the dorsal margin of the head runs straight backwards from the clypeus. The broad region of the postmentum lies at one-quarter of the anterior part, the middle of its anterolateral margin slightly concave inwards, the surface of the broad region slightly arched and bearing several arc lines; the waist lies at one-third of the posterior part of the postmentum, the length of the postmentum about six times the width of the waist. The pronotum is kidney-shaped, with a broad V-shaped shallow notch in the middle of the anterior margin, the lateral and posterior margins continuous in a broad arc, the margin of the disc slightly upturned and most evidently so at the sides; the mesonotum and metanotum are both about as broad as the pronotum.
/species/prorhinotermes-flavus/.taxonomy_note: Recorded in the original work as Prorhinotermes japonicus, now merged as a synonym into P. flavus.

/species/prorhinotermes-hainanensis/.biology: In the records from Hainan it damages various trees, including tamarind, beefwood, flamboyant and coral tree.
