/species/prorhinotermes-hainanensis/.soldier: Soldier head capsule orange-yellow, mandibles purplish brown and slightly translucent, mandibular bases yellowish brown, labrum pale yellow with the posterior half brownish, antennae pale yellowish brown with the apices of the segments slightly paler, the anteclypeus, frontal gland pore and compound eyes nearly pale yellowish white, the thorax, abdomen and legs pale yellowish brown. The body surface is sparsely covered with hairs; the hairs on the periphery of the pronotum are scattered, with two in the middle region. The outline of the head capsule is nearly trapezoidal, the sides gradually expanding posteriorly, the posterior margin broadly rounded and projecting, the widest point near the posterolateral corners of the head. Labrum lingulate, its lateral margins translucent, the apex truncate or slightly concave, the two apical hairs projecting forwards; anteclypeus membranous, postclypeus trapezoidal. Mandibles sabre-like, their apices slender and slightly curved, with a mandibular condyle, the inner margin rather straight and almost smooth. Antennae with 17–20 segments, segment 2 or 4 rather short, the compound eyes large and bulging. The frontal gland pore is circular and lies in front of two-fifths of the anterior part of the head, the longitudinal groove in front of the pore about twice as wide as the pore; in lateral view the posterior margin of the pore is distinctly raised, the median line of the vertex behind the pore is straight, and the frontal slope in front of the pore forms an angle of about 30 degrees with the postclypeus. The broad region of the postmentum lies at the anterior one-fifth, the lateral margins of the anterior half almost parallel and then expanding, the surface of the postmentum shallowly concave in an arc in the middle, the waist behind the middle. The pronotum is kidney-shaped, the middle of the anterior margin with a broad V-shaped shallow notch, the lateral margins almost parallel, the posterolateral corners broadly rounded, the posterior margin almost straight, the periphery upturned; the mesonotum is slightly broader than the metanotum.

/species/prorhinotermes-spectabilis/.biology: The host is recorded as Delonix regia.
/species/prorhinotermes-spectabilis/.soldier: Soldier head capsule pale yellow, mandibles reddish brown and semi-translucent, mandibular bases yellowish brown, labrum pale yellow tinged with white and the labral margin translucent, anteclypeus white-yellow, postclypeus yellowish brown, antennae pale yellow, the frontal gland pore and compound eyes almost concolorous with the head capsule; thorax, abdomen and legs all paler than the head capsule. The whole pilosity is sparse; the periphery of the pronotum bears only a few scattered marginal hairs, with two in the middle region.

/species/prorhinotermes-xishaensis/.alate: The alate body is orange-yellow tinged with red, the head capsule and pronotum slightly darker, the compound eyes black, the wing membrane semi-translucent with the costa and radial sector reddish brown. The head capsule and pronotum are very sparsely haired, the sternites slightly more densely so. The head capsule is circular and slightly long, the dorsal margin of the head rather flat in lateral view. The frontal gland pore is circular and lies at one-third of the anterior part of the head capsule, with a shallow groove in front of it running to the postclypeus. The postclypeus is convex and level with the frontal surface, with a median suture, about half as long as wide. The compound eyes are rather projecting and nearly circular; the ocelli are elongate-oval and transverse, almost touching the compound eyes. Antennae with 19 segments, segments 3, 4 and 5 all rather short. The pronotum is slightly wider than the head capsule, its anterior margin shallowly concave, the sides gradually narrowing posteriorly, the posterior margin almost straight. The forewing is longer than the hindwing and equally wide, the venation reticulate; the forewing lacks a media, and the media of the hindwing arises from the radial sector outside the shoulder suture. The ninth sternite of the male bears a stylus, which is absent in the female; the cerci have two segments.
/species/prorhinotermes-xishaensis/.biology: The host is recorded as the yangjiao tree.
/species/prorhinotermes-xishaensis/.soldier: Soldier head capsule pale orange-yellow, mandibles purplish brown, labrum, antennae, compound eyes, pronotum and legs all pale yellow. The pilosity of the head capsule is sparse; the periphery of the pronotum bears more than ten marginal hairs, with about two to three in the middle region. The head capsule is broadly oval, widest somewhat behind the middle, the posterior margin broadly rounded. The labrum is lingulate, about as long as wide, its apex rather rounded, with two apical hairs. The mandibles are sabre-like, the inner margin rather straight, the inner margin of the left mandibular base with a distinct tooth-like process, the outer margin with a raised mandibular condyle. Antennae with 17–19 segments, segment 3 or 4 the shortest. The compound eyes are nearly round and slightly convex. The frontal gland pore is circular and lies behind one-quarter of the anterior part of the head capsule, densely surrounded by shallow striae, with a shallow groove in front of it running to the postclypeus; in lateral view the dorsal margin of the head is raised in the frontal region and nearly straight behind the pore, the frontal slope in front of the pore about 30 degrees. The broad region of the postmentum lies at the anterior quarter, the anterior part of its surface rather flat and gradually arched posteriorly, the middle appearing dot-like, the waist at one-third of the posterior part of the postmentum. The pronotum is kidney-shaped and flat, with a broad V-shaped shallow notch on the anterior margin and a broadly rounded posterior margin; the mesonotum is broader than the pronotum, and the metanotum is also slightly broader than the pronotum.

/species/pseudocapritermes-jiangchengens.taxonomy_note: The original work wrote the name as Pseudo capritermes, which results from splitting the word across lines; it belongs to the same genus as the current name used on this site, and there is no taxonomic change.

/species/pseudocapritermes-minutus/.biology: Collected inside a decayed trunk lying on the ground.
/species/pseudocapritermes-minutus/.soldier: Very small in size; the appearance resembles that of Pseudocapritermes pseudolaetus, but the frontal ridge is not projecting. The head is reddish yellow, the mandibles brown, the antennae and the thorax and abdomen pale yellow, and the whole body is covered with short hairs. The head is long and tubular, the sides parallel; the dorsal longitudinal suture extends from the posterior margin to half the length of the head. The anterior one-fifth of the dorsum of the head slopes forwards as a facet, the crest of the slope being sinuous and blunt in lateral view, not forming a ridge-like projection. The fontanelle lies on the upper part of the slope. The labrum is narrow and strip-like, longer than wide, its anterior margin concave, both the left and the right corner needle-like. The postmentum is widest at its very front end and narrows slightly posteriorly, narrowest at the posterior third. The right mandible is shorter and slightly sinuous, its anterior end sharp; the left mandible is longer with considerable sinuation, with a swollen part near the anterior end, beyond which it gradually narrows and bends into a hook whose tip points antero-dextrally. Antennae with 14 segments, segments 3 and 4 about equal in length, segment 2 slightly longer. The anterior half of the pronotum rises vertically, shaped like a low, flat semicircle, the middle of the anterior margin slightly sinuous, the notch not distinct. The abdomen is slender and long.

/species/pseudocapritermes-planimentus/.soldier: The head capsule and antennae are yellowish brown, the labrum, thorax and abdomen yellowish white, the mandibles dark brown, the left mandible paler and reddish brown. The head capsule is rectangular, distinctly narrowed in front of the antennal sockets, the sides slightly convex, the posterolateral corners broad and rounded, the middle of the posterior margin shallowly concave; the median suture extends forwards from the posterior margin beyond the midpoint of the head capsule, the fontanelle pore-like with its posterior margin sclerotised and brownish. In lateral view the frontal ridge is not raised and the slope gentle, and behind the fontanelle a blunt ridge runs towards the lateral corners. The labrum is slightly longer than wide, the anterior margin almost straight. Antennae with 14 segments, segments 2 and 4 about equal and both shorter than segment 3. The mandibles are asymmetrical and shorter than the head; the posterior part of the left mandible is upturned and twisted inwards, its apex forming a hook, with a basal tooth and a basal process on the inner margin; the right mandible is blade-like with a pointed apex. The postmentum is long and cup-shaped, widest immediately behind the anterior margin, narrowest at one-quarter from the posterior margin; in lateral view the postmentum bulges out of the ventral surface of the head. The pronotum is saddle-shaped, the anterior, lateral and posterior margins bearing respectively one to three pairs, five pairs and one pair of long hairs, the anterior and posterior lobes nearly vertical, both the anterior and the posterior margin with a median notch. Tibial spur formula 3:2:2.

/species/pseudocapritermes-pseudolaetus/.soldier: The head is reddish yellow, slightly darker anteriorly; mandibles brownish black, antennae yellow, abdomen white; the whole body densely covered with short hairs. The head is tubular and rectangular in dorsal view, the sides parallel, the posterior margin slightly arcuate. At one-fifth of the anterior end of the head the middle rises into a pointed ridge, behind which the dorsum of the head forms an indistinct slope and gradually descends; in front of the ridge a slope of 45 degrees descends to the anterior end of the head, with a longitudinal groove in the middle of the slope. The fontanelle lies on the anterior slope near the apex of the ridge. The labrum is about as long as wide, the left anterolateral corner projecting as a needle, the right anterolateral corner sharp but not needle-like; the anterior margin oblique. The mandibles are slightly shorter than the head; the right mandible is shorter and straighter than the left, its anterior end sharp; the torsion of the left mandible is gentler, its apex directed to the right, and there is another tooth-like process at the base of the mandible pointing down and to the right. The postmentum bulges distinctly towards the ventral surface, narrow posteriorly and gradually widening in front of the midpoint, widest at the anterior end. Antennae with 14 segments, segments 3 and 4 equal and shorter than segment 2. The raised part of the pronotum is about the same size as the posterior part, the middle of the anterior margin slightly depressed.

/species/pseudocapritermes-sinensis/.soldier: The head capsule is pale yellow, the mandibles dark brown and darker on the left than on the right, the anterior half of the labrum pale yellow and the posterior half turning white, the antennae yellowish brown, the thorax, abdomen and legs pale yellow. The hairs of the head capsule are sparse, with a few long hairs on the frontal surface and a pair of crossed short hairs in front of the frontal gland pore. The head capsule is rectangular, the head width index 0.56–0.59, the sides almost parallel and slightly expanded at the middle, the posterior margin broadly rounded, the median suture distinct and about half the length of the head capsule. In lateral view the frontal slope is about 50 degrees, slightly concave at the frontal gland pore, the top of the frons slightly projecting above the pore, and the dorsal margin of the head sloping backwards from the top of the frons at 20 degrees. The labrum is strip-like, about twice as long as wide. The two mandibles are distinctly asymmetrical and nearly equal in length; the apex of the left mandible is bent into a hook, the mandibular body slightly swollen behind the hook and then band-like, twisted in an S-shape from the base upwards and to the right, its length about 1.5 times the width of the head; the right mandible is flattened, obliquely pointed at one-quarter from the anterior end. Antennae with 14 segments. The postmentum is club-shaped, the constriction index of the waist region 0.46–0.50. The pronotum is saddle-shaped. Tibial spur formula 3:2:2.

/species/pseudocapritermes-sowerbyi/.alate: The head is brownish, the thorax and abdomen brownish yellow, the wings brownish yellow with the veins brownish; the head and body densely covered with short hairs, and the wing surface also bears uniform short hairs. The head is broadly oval. The ocelli are elliptical; in the male the distance between the ocellus and the compound eye is about the width of one ocellus, in the female less than its own width. The postclypeus is slightly raised, its posterior margin slightly curved backwards, about one-third as long as wide, paler than the vertex. The fontanelle is large, its surface raised, situated at the centre of the vertex. Antennae with 15 segments, segment 3 slightly shorter than segments 2 and 4. The pronotum is ingot-shaped, the middle of the anterior margin straight, the lateral corners blunt and slightly projecting anterolaterally, the notches in the middle of the anterior and posterior margins indistinct. The forewing scale is larger than the hindwing scale. The radial sector of the forewing reaches the wing apex without branching, the media arises independently at the shoulder suture and runs nearer the cubitus than the radial sector, giving off three or four branches posteriorly to the wing apex, the cubitus with about ten branches; the media of the hindwing arises together with the radial sector at the shoulder suture and separates thereafter.
/species/pseudocapritermes-sowerbyi/.distribution: Fuzhou, Hexi, Jianou and Nanping, Fujian; Shantou, Shaoguan and Zhanjiang, Guangdong; Qiongshan, Hainan; Yingjiang, Simao, Pingbian and Mengla, Jinping (390 m, 450 m, 500 m and 580 m), Yunnan.

/species/reticulitermes-aculabialis/.biology: The host is the London plane.
/species/reticulitermes-aculabialis/.soldier: Soldier head yellowish brown, mandibles dark brown, the pilosity of the head capsule sparse. The head capsule is rectangular, the head width index 0.62–0.66, the sides almost parallel and slightly expanded at the middle, the posterior margin of the head capsule slightly projecting outwards. The frontal region is slightly raised, the middle of the frons almost flat. The labrum is sharply spear-shaped, the transparent region at its apex projecting like a pointer, about 0.046 mm long, the apical hairs long, the subapical and lateral-apical hairs short and fine. The mandibles are long and strong, their apices rather curved, the mandibular condyle visible; the mandibular length about 0.60 times the length of the head capsule and about 0.93 times the width of the head. Antennae with 16–17 segments. The broad region of the postmentum lies at the anterior one-fifth, its anterolateral margins expanding trapezoidally behind, slightly concave at the middle, the waist region slender with the sides almost parallel, the waist constriction index 0.28–0.31. The pronotum is kidney-shaped, 1.66 times as wide as long, its anterior margin with a broad V-shaped shallow notch, the sides together with the posterior margin forming a broad arc, the middle of the posterior margin slightly concave, the anterior margin more than twice as wide as the posterior, with about two long hairs in the middle region.

/species/reticulitermes-affinis/.alate: Head capsule chestnut brown, postmentum yellow, labrum and postclypeus pale brown, antennae brown, pronotum yellow, femoral segments pale brown, tibiae greyish yellow, wings greyish brown. The head capsule is nearly circular, slightly longer than wide, the fontanelle dot-like, 0.51–0.52 mm from the frontal margin. The compound eyes are roundly triangular, the projection rate 2–6 per cent, the short diameter greater than the distance from the compound eye to the lower margin of the head. The ocelli are nearly circular, their distance from the compound eye about equal to their short diameter. The postclypeus has almost no projection and lies below the vertex in lateral view, the vertex arched. Antennae with 17 segments. The pronotum is nearly flat-square, about 1.40–1.53 times as wide as long, the median notches of the anterior and posterior margins distinct, the median notch rate about 13 per cent. The wings are broad and long with a broadly rounded apex, the cubitus with about eleven branches.
/species/reticulitermes-affinis/.distribution: Chong'an and the whole of Fujian; also recorded from Zhejiang, Hunan, Guangdong and Taiwan.
/species/reticulitermes-affinis/.soldier: The head is dull yellowish brown, the mandibles deep purplish brown, the body dull yellowish white, the pilosity of the head capsule sparse. The head capsule is rectangular, the head width index about 0.59, the sides parallel, the middle of the posterior margin straight, the frontal ridge markedly raised, the depression between the ridges rather shallow. The labrum is long-spear-shaped with a narrow anterior part and a slightly blunt apex, apical, subapical and lateral-apical hairs all present. The mandibles are long and strong, their apices rather curved, the mandibular condyle indistinct, their length 0.56–0.59 of the head capsule length, equal to the head width or 0.98 times it. Antennae with 16–17 segments. The broad region of the postmentum lies at about the anterior one-fifth, the sides of the waist region parallel, the waist constriction index 0.32–0.38. The pronotum is about 1.42–1.63 times as wide as long, its anterior margin distinctly wider than the posterior, the lateral margins running straight and turning sharply backwards, the four corners narrowly rounded, both the anterior and the posterior margin straight with a median notch, the broad V-shaped notch of the anterior margin rather deep, with about sixteen hairs in the middle region.
/species/reticulitermes-affinis/.taxonomy_note: The genus name is defective in the original work, printed as Reticuliter mes; it is in fact the genus Reticulitermes, the same genus name as currently used on this site.

/species/reticulitermes-altus/.taxonomy_note: The genus name is defective in the original work, printed as Reticuliter mes; it is in fact the genus Reticulitermes, the same genus name as currently used on this site.

/species/reticulitermes-ampliceps/.alate: The alate head capsule is nearly circular, the fontanelle yellow and dot-like, 0.48 from the anterior frontal margin. The compound eyes are flatly rounded, the projection rate 2–3 per cent, their long diameter equal to or slightly greater than the distance from the compound eye to the lower margin of the head; the ocelli are elongate-oval, their long diameter greater than the distance between the two compound eyes. The dorsal margin of the head is slightly higher at the top of the frons and then slopes backwards, the postclypeus weakly projecting, almost level with the vertex and higher than the ocelli. Antennae with 17 segments. The pronotum is about 1.58 times as wide as long, the anterior margin straight with a shallow median notch, the posterior margin in two arcs with a deep median notch. The forewing is 6.88–7.04 mm long and 1.84 mm wide, the hindwing 6.58–6.73 mm long and 1.84 mm wide, the cubitus with about ten or more branches.
/species/reticulitermes-ampliceps/.soldier: Soldier head yellowish brown, mandibles reddish brown, the pilosity of the head capsule sparse. The head capsule is intermediate between rectangular and elliptical, the head width index 0.62–0.64, the sides slightly expanded in the middle and posterior parts, the posterior margin of the head broadly rounded, the head width index about 0.82–0.85. The frontal ridge is slightly raised, the interfrontal area shallowly concave and slightly concave behind the frons. The labrum is bluntly spear-shaped, its anterior part a narrow triangle, the apex bluntly rounded, the apical, subapical and lateral-apical hairs nearly equal in length, the dorsum of the labrum with several long hairs. The anterior part of the mandibles is rather slender and straight, the posterior part robust, the apex slender and slightly curved; the mandibular length about 0.53–0.54 times the head capsule length and about 0.84–0.87 times the head width. The broad region of the postmentum lies at the anterior one-fifth, its anterolateral margins expanding trapezoidally behind, the waist region rather broad with the sides in a broad arc, the waist constriction index 0.41–0.43. The pronotum is kidney-like, about 1.56–1.63 times as wide as long, the anterior and posterior margins forming two broad intersecting arcs, both concave in the middle with the anterior deeper than the posterior, with nearly twenty hairs in the middle region.

/species/reticulitermes-ancyleus/.alate: The dealate body is brown, the pronotum, postmentum and femoral segments all pale brown, the tibiae and tarsi pale yellow. The head capsule is rectangular, the vertex arched outwards, the fontanelle dot-like and slightly projecting; in lateral view the postclypeus is slightly raised and lies below the vertex. Body length without wings 5.7 mm, head width including the compound eyes 1.12 mm, head width excluding the compound eyes 1.04 mm, long diameter of the compound eye 0.27 mm, distance from the compound eye to the lower margin of the head 0.15 mm; long diameter of the ocellus 0.1 mm, ocellus-compound eye distance 0.05 mm; pronotum width 0.92 mm, length 0.61 mm, hind tibia length 1.14 mm. The distance from the compound eye to the antennal socket is about half the distance from the ocellus to the antennal socket; antennae with 15 segments, broken. The median line of the pronotum is almost invisible, with more than twenty long hairs in the middle region.
/species/reticulitermes-ancyleus/.soldier: Head pale yellow. The head capsule is rectangular, the sides parallel, the frontal ridge slightly raised. The labrum is lingulate and bears apical hairs. The apices of the mandibles curve outwards like hooks, antennae with 14–15 segments. The postmentum is slender and narrow, its width to its length about 1:9–11. The pronotum is about 1.4–1.6 times as wide as long, the middle of the anterior margin rather deeply concave, the middle of the posterior margin shallowly concave, the lateral margins sharply oblique backwards, with about twenty long bristles in the middle region.
/species/reticulitermes-ancyleus/.taxonomy_note: The genus name is printed in the original work as Rer icu, a defective spelling of Reticulitermes; it is now assigned to the genus Reticulitermes.

/species/reticulitermes-angustatus/.soldier: Soldier head yellowish brown to pale chestnut brown, mandibles purplish brown, the pilosity of the head capsule moderate. The head capsule is rectangular, the head width index 0.53–0.59, the lateral margins parallel, the posterior margin nearly broadly rounded, the frontal ridge slightly raised with the interfrontal area slightly concave. The labrum is sharply spear-shaped, the semi-transparent labral apex needle-pointed, with apical and subapical hairs but lacking lateral-apical hairs. The mandibles are strong, their apices rather curved, the curved apex short and slightly thick, the mandibular condyle indistinct; the mandibular length about 0.56 times the head capsule length and about 0.95–1.02 times the head width. Antennae with 16 segments. The broad region of the postmentum lies at about the anterior one-sixth, the anterolateral margins trapezoidal, the waist region slender with the sides parallel, the waist constriction index 0.29–0.33. The pronotum is trapezoidal, about 1.56 times as wide as long, the middle of the anterior margin with a V-shaped shallow notch, the middle of the posterior margin slightly concave, with about eight long hairs in the middle region.

/species/reticulitermes-angusticephalus/.soldier: The head is yellowish brown, the mandibles purplish brown, the thorax and abdomen yellow. The head capsule is narrow and long, the head width index 0.48–0.53, the sides almost parallel, slightly constricted behind the antennal sockets, the posterior margin broadly rounded and projecting outwards. The frontal ridge is strongly raised, the frontal corners on both sides projecting, the interfrontal area shallowly concave, the anterior slope of the ridge at an angle of about 60 degrees. The labrum is sharply spear-shaped, about 1.2 times as long as wide, the apical hairs present, the lateral-apical hairs present or absent, the subapical hairs short and small. The apices of the mandibles are rather curved, the left mandible longer but mostly less than the head width and mostly shorter than half the head capsule, the mandibular condyle slightly projecting. The postmentum is slender and long, about eleven times as long as the waist width, the ratio of waist width to head width about 1:7–8, the waist constriction index 0.29–0.37. Antennae with 16 segments. The pronotum is about 1.5–1.7 times as wide as long, its anterior margin formed by two intersecting arcs, the lateral margins sharply oblique backwards, the posterior margin short and shallowly concave in the middle, with about thirty long bristles in the middle region.
/species/reticulitermes-angusticephalus/.taxonomy_note: The genus name is defective in the original work, printed as Reticuliter mes; it is in fact the genus Reticulitermes, the same genus name as currently used on this site.

/species/reticulitermes-assamensis/.alate: The head capsule is dark brown, the pronotum yellow, the labrum, postclypeus and femoral segments brown tinged with black, the tibiae greyish yellow, the wings dull brown. The head capsule is circular and somewhat squarish, the fontanelle dot-like. The compound eyes are roundly triangular and weakly projecting, their long diameter slightly greater than or equal to the distance from the compound eye to the lower margin of the head. The ocelli are nearly circular, their distance from the compound eye about equal to their own diameter. Antennae with 18 segments. The dorsal margin of the head arches gently, the postclypeal projection weak, lower than the vertex and higher than the ocelli. The anterior margin of the pronotum is almost straight and slightly undulate, the median notch of the posterior margin distinct. The forewing and hindwing are 2.10–2.29 mm wide, the cubitus of the forewing with ten to more than ten branches.
/species/reticulitermes-assamensis/.biology: The host is recorded as Pinus yunnanensis.
/species/reticulitermes-assamensis/.distribution: Medog, Xizang; abroad it is found in Assam, India.
/species/reticulitermes-assamensis/.soldier: The head is pale yellow, the mandibles reddish brown, the pilosity of the head capsule rather dense. The head capsule is rectangular, the head width index 0.61–0.63, the sides almost parallel or slightly divergent posteriorly, the posterior margin broadly rounded. The frontal ridge is raised, the interfrontal area shallowly concave. The labrum is lingulate with a bluntly rounded apex, apical, subapical and lateral-apical hairs all present. The mandibles are rather stout and short, their apices slightly curved, the mandibular condyle visible, their length 0.56–0.58 of the head capsule length and 0.91–0.95 of the head width. Antennae with 15–16 segments. The broad region of the postmentum lies at the anterior one-fifth, the anterolateral margins trapezoidal and slightly concave at the middle, the waist region rather broad with the sides in a slight broad arc, the waist constriction index 0.35–0.38. The pronotum is trapezoidal, 1.53–1.59 times as wide as long, both the anterior and the posterior margin nearly straight and shallowly concave in the middle, with about forty hairs in the middle region.
/species/reticulitermes-assamensis/.taxonomy_note: The genus name is defective in the original work, printed as Reticuliter mes; it is in fact the genus Reticulitermes, the same genus name as currently used on this site.

/species/reticulitermes-aurantius/.taxonomy_note: The genus name is defective in the original work, printed as Reticuliter mes; it is in fact the genus Reticulitermes, the same genus name as currently used on this site.

/species/reticulitermes-bicristatus/.soldier: Soldier head deep yellow, mandibles deep reddish brown, the pilosity of the head capsule sparse. The head capsule is rectangular, the head width index 0.52–0.57, the sides almost parallel and slightly constricted at the middle, the posterior margin broadly straight. The frontal ridge is slightly raised and clearly divided into two ridges with a V-shaped depression in the middle. The labrum is sharply spear-shaped, the transparent apical region projecting as a triangle, needle-like at the tip but rather short and stout, bearing apical hairs with the subapical hairs faintly discernible. The mandibles are robust and powerful, their apices strongly curved, the ridge-like process at the mandibular base distinct; the mandibular length about 0.55 times the head capsule length and about 0.98–0.99 times the head width. Antennae with 17–18 segments. The broad region of the postmentum lies at the anterior one-fifth, its anterolateral margins nearly trapezoidally expanding behind and slightly concave at the middle, the waist region narrow and long with the sides parallel, the waist constriction index 0.33–0.34. The pronotum is nearly kidney-shaped, about 1.7 times as wide as long, the anterior margin straight with a V-shaped notch in the middle, the sides together with the posterior margin forming a broad arc, the median notch of the posterior margin rather shallow, with about six to ten hairs in the middle region.

/species/reticulitermes-bitumulus/.distribution: Liping, Rongjiang, Congjiang, Libo and Leishan, Guizhou.
/species/reticulitermes-bitumulus/.soldier: The head is pale yellow, the mandibles purplish brown, the pronotum pale yellow, the legs still paler, the pilosity of the head capsule sparse. The head capsule is rectangular, the head width index 0.52–0.58, the sides slightly narrowing posteriorly, the posterior margin almost straight. In lateral view the frontal ridge is distinctly raised; in dorsal view the two ridges project like tubercles, connected in the middle by a shallow groove that leads to the fontanelle pore. The labrum is spear-shaped with a narrowly rounded apex, apical, subapical and lateral-apical hairs all present. The mandibles are stout and strong, their apices very strongly curved, the mandibular condyle visible, that of the left mandible 0.50–0.62 of the head capsule length and 0.93–1.09 of the head width. Antennae with 17 segments. The postmentum is narrow and long, nine to twelve times as long as the waist width, the waist constriction index 0.29–0.35, the head width seven to eight times the waist width. The pronotum is 1.47–1.66 times as wide as long, both the anterior and the posterior margin broadly arcuate and concave in the middle, the lateral margins gently oblique backwards, with about thirty long hairs in the middle region.
/species/reticulitermes-bitumulus/.taxonomy_note: The genus name is defective in the original work, printed as Reticuliter mes; it is in fact the genus Reticulitermes, the same genus name as currently used on this site.

/species/reticulitermes-brachygnathus/.soldier: Soldier head pale yellowish brown, mandibles reddish brown and slightly transparent, the pilosity of the head capsule sparse. The head capsule is rectangular, the head width index 0.57–0.59, the sides parallel, the posterior margin slightly evenly rounded. The frontal ridge is slightly raised, the interfrontal area almost flat. The labrum is sharply spear-shaped, the semi-transparent apical region projecting at an acute angle, bearing apical hairs, the subapical and lateral-apical hairs rather fine and short. The mandibles are short and stout, their apices rather curved with the curved part quite short; the mandibular length about 0.48–0.50 times the head capsule length and about 0.83–0.88 times the head width. Antennae with 15–17 segments. The broad region of the postmentum lies at about the anterior one-fifth, the anterolateral margins expanding trapezoidally behind, the middle rather concave, the waist region rather broad with the sides slightly arcuate, the waist constriction index 0.36–0.42. The pronotum is nearly trapezoidal, about 1.56–1.61 times as wide as long, the median notches of the anterior and posterior margins both rather shallow, with nearly ten fine hairs in the middle region.

/species/reticulitermes-brevicurvatus/.soldier: Head yellow, mandibles dark brown, thorax and abdomen white tinged with yellow. The head capsule is rectangular, the sides parallel. The frontal ridge is very slightly raised. The labrum is spear-shaped, the semi-transparent region at its apex narrowly rounded, bearing long apical hairs and short lateral-apical hairs. The mandibles are short and hook-like, the lacinial margin of the maxilla bearing about nine hairs. Antennae with 13–14 segments. The postmentum is narrow and long. The anterior and posterior margins of the pronotum are almost straight, the middle of the anterior margin with a rather deep U-shaped notch, the middle of the posterior margin shallowly concave, the hairs of the middle region short, small and sparse.
/species/reticulitermes-brevicurvatus/.taxonomy_note: The genus name is printed in the original work as Reticuliter mes, a misspelling of Reticulitermes; it is now assigned to the genus Reticulitermes.

/species/reticulitermes-cancrifemuris/.biology: The host is recorded as Cunninghamia lanceolata.
/species/reticulitermes-cancrifemuris/.soldier: The head is orange-yellow, the mandibles yellowish brown, the pilosity of the head capsule sparse. The head capsule is rectangular, the head width index about 0.58, the sides parallel and slightly expanded in the middle and posterior parts, the posterior margin broadly rounded. The frontal ridge is raised. The labrum is long-lingulate with a bluntly rounded apex, the apical hairs present, the lateral-apical hairs absent. The mandibles are robust with strongly curved apices, about 0.56 times the head capsule length and 0.97 times the head width. Antennae with 15–16 segments. The broad region of the postmentum lies at the anterior quarter, the anterolateral margins nearly trapezoidal and slightly concave at the middle, the sides roughly parallel, the waist constriction index 0.37. The pronotum is nearly trapezoidal, 1.77 times as wide as long, the middle of the anterior margin deeply concave and that of the posterior margin shallowly concave, with about thirty hairs in the middle region. The femoral segments of the legs are slightly curved, flat and broad, their width equal to 2.5 times the width of the tibia.
/species/reticulitermes-cancrifemuris/.taxonomy_note: The genus name is defective in the original work, printed as Reticuliter mes; it is in fact the genus Reticulitermes, the same genus name as currently used on this site.

/species/reticulitermes-castanus/.alate: The body is brown, the head darker, the pronotum brown and slightly paler posteriorly, the postmentum and the femoral segments both brown, the tibiae and tarsi pale greyish yellow. The head capsule is oval, the vertex slightly arched, the fontanelle dot-like and slightly projecting. In lateral view the postclypeus is slightly raised and lies below the vertex. The long diameter of the compound eye is far greater than the distance from the compound eye to the lower margin of the head, the projection rate 5–8 per cent. The diameter of the ocellus is nearly three times the ocellus-compound eye distance. The distance from the compound eye to the antennal socket is about half the distance from the ocellus to the antennal socket. Antennae with 17–18 segments. The pronotum is about 1.5 times as wide as long, the median longitudinal line almost invisible, the hairs of the middle region abundant and dense.
/species/reticulitermes-castanus/.distribution: Damingshan, Wuming, Guangxi, 1,050 m a.s.l.; also recorded from Tianlin, Baise and Longsheng.
/species/reticulitermes-castanus/.soldier: The head is pale yellowish brown. The head capsule is rectangular, the head width index 0.51–0.57, the sides slightly constricted behind the antennal sockets and then slightly expanded outwards again. The frontal ridge is strongly raised. The labrum is roundly spear-shaped with a sharply rounded apex, the apical hairs long, the lateral-apical hairs present or absent, the subapical hairs minute. The mandibles are stout and strong with strongly curved apices, the basal ridge of the outer margin visible, their length 0.88–0.96 times the head width and 0.48–0.51 times the head capsule length. Antennae with 15–17 segments. The postmentum is club-shaped, the width of the waist region varying between 0.16 and 0.25 mm according to the colony, the waist constriction index 0.30–0.45, the ratio of the waist region to the head width about 1:7–9 and to the length of the postmentum about 1:7–12. The pronotum is about 1.6 times as wide as long, the median notch of the anterior margin deeper than that of the posterior, the lateral margins gently oblique backwards, with about fifty long bristles in the middle region.
/species/reticulitermes-castanus/.taxonomy_note: The genus name is defective in the original work, printed as Reticuliter mes; it is in fact the genus Reticulitermes, the same genus name as currently used on this site.

/species/reticulitermes-chayuensis/.soldier: The head is yellowish brown, the mandibles purplish brown, the hairs of the head capsule sparse. The head capsule is somewhat elliptical, the sides slightly expanding posteriorly, widest near the posterior end, the posterior margin broadly rounded. The frontal region is slightly projecting, slightly concave behind the frons. The labrum is nearly circular, its apex bluntly rounded and projecting outwards, the anterior quarter semi-transparent, bearing apical and subapical hairs. The mandibles are long and strong, the inner margin rather straight, the apices slightly curved, the mandibular condyle visible. Antennae with 16–17 segments. The broad region of the postmentum lies between the anterior one-fifth and the anterior one-sixth, the sides of the waist region parallel. The pronotum is nearly kidney-shaped, the anterior margin straight with a distinct median notch, the sides together with the posterior margin forming a broad arc with a shallow median notch, with four to six hairs in the middle region.
/species/reticulitermes-chayuensis/.taxonomy_note: The genus name is printed in the original work as Reticuliter mes, a misspelling of Reticulitermes; it is now assigned to the genus Reticulitermes.

/species/reticulitermes-chinensis/.alate: The alate head capsule and pronotum are deep chestnut brown, the paratype decolourised with age to a yellowish brown; the postmentum is concolorous with the head capsule, the labrum and postclypeus paler than the head capsule, the femoral segments concolorous with the head capsule and the tibiae paler. The head capsule is circular, the fontanelle dot-like, 0.50 mm from the anterior frontal margin. The compound eyes are nearly circular, the projection rate 7 per cent, the distance from the compound eye to the lower margin of the head distinctly less than the short diameter of the compound eye. The ocelli are nearly circular, the ocellus-compound eye distance about half the ocellar diameter. Antennae with 17–18 segments. The dorsal margin of the head arches gently, the postclypeus distinctly projecting and slightly lower than the vertex but higher than the ocelli. The pronotum is about 1.55 times as wide as long, the anterior margin with a broad V-shaped shallow notch, the middle of the posterior margin shallowly concave; the forewing 6.75–7.00 mm long and 1.90 mm wide.
/species/reticulitermes-chinensis/.soldier: Soldier head yellowish brown, mandibles reddish brown, the pilosity of the head capsule sparse. The head capsule is rectangular, the head width index 0.59–0.64; the two margins are parallel to each other, the posterior lateral corners slightly rounded, the posterior margin nearly straight. The frontal region is either flat or slightly raised. The labrum is spear-shaped with a pointed and rounded apex, the labral apex of the paratype being bluntly rounded and possibly incomplete; with apical and subapical hairs, the lateral-apical hairs reduced or absent. The mandibles are somewhat stout, their apices slightly curved; the mandibular length about 0.57–0.64 times the head capsule length and about 0.97–1.00 times the head width. Antennae with 16–18 segments. The broad region of the postmentum lies between the anterior quarter and the anterior one-fifth, the anterolateral margins nearly trapezoidal, the waist region rather slender with the sides nearly in a broad arc, the waist constriction index 0.27–0.32. The pronotum is trapezoidal, 1.64–1.73 times as wide as long, the anterior and posterior margins nearly straight, the middle of the anterior margin shallowly concave, with about six hairs in the middle region.

/species/reticulitermes-choui/.soldier: Soldier head pale yellowish brown with the frontal region slightly deeper, mandibles brown tinged with red and the mandibular bases yellowish brown, labrum yellowish brown, pronotum and legs pale yellowish white, the pilosity of the head capsule sparse. The head capsule is rectangular, the head width index 0.61–0.64, the sides parallel, the posterolateral corners broadly rounded, the middle of the posterior margin nearly straight. In lateral view the frontal ridge is slightly raised and the top of the frons flat; behind the fontanelle a pale yellow U-shaped cephalic suture extends to the eye spots, clearly dividing the frontal region; both the compound eyes and the ocellar spots are discernible. The labrum is spear-shaped, its apex blunt and rounded, bearing apical and subapical hairs, the lateral-apical hairs reduced or absent. The mandibles are strong, their apices rather strongly curved, the ridge-like process at the mandibular base clearly visible, the inner margin of the right mandible bearing a small tooth scar behind the midpoint; the mandibular length about 0.52–0.56 times the head capsule length and about 0.85–0.90 times the head width. Antennae with 16 segments, segment 3 the shortest. The broad region of the postmentum lies at the anterior one-fifth, the waist region broad and long with the sides almost parallel, the waist constriction index 0.39–0.43. The pronotum is 1.50–1.70 times as wide as long, the anterior margin formed by two broad intersecting arcs, the middle of the posterior margin very shallowly concave, with about ten or more hairs in the middle region.

/species/reticulitermes-chryseus/.alate: The whole body is golden yellow, the postmentum and legs pale, nearly pale yellow. The outline of the head capsule is oval, the vertex slightly arched, the fontanelle dot-like and slightly projecting; in lateral view the postclypeus appears slightly raised and lies below the vertex. Body length 7.46 mm, abdominal width 1.21 mm. Head width including the compound eyes 0.82 mm, excluding the compound eyes 0.76 mm; the projection rate of the compound eye 7 per cent, its long diameter 0.18 mm, its distance from the lower margin of the head 0.12 mm. The diameter of the ocellus 0.06 mm, the ocellus-compound eye distance 0.04 mm, the distance from the ocellus to the antennal socket greater than that from the compound eye to the antennal socket. Antennae with 13 segments, the specimen broken. Pronotum width 0.62 mm, length 0.46 mm, the median line faintly discernible, with more than forty long hairs in the middle region.

/species/reticulitermes-citrinus/.alate: The whole body is lemon yellow, the compound eyes purplish brown, the wing scales yellowish brown, the wing surface pale greyish brown. The body hairs are golden yellow. The head capsule is oval, the vertex rather flat; the postclypeus projects, its height equal to that of the vertex. The long diameter of the compound eye is greater than the distance from the compound eye to the lower margin of the head, the projection rate 3–6 per cent. The ocelli are rather large, the ocellus-compound eye distance about half the long diameter of the ocellus; the distance from the ocellus to the antennal socket is almost equal to that from the compound eye to the antennal socket. The fontanelle is a pale yellow dot, slightly projecting. Antennae with 14 segments. The pronotum is about 1.4–1.6 times as wide as long, the anterior margin slightly raised, the middle of the posterior margin slightly concave, the notches of the anterior and posterior margins almost equal, the median notch rate 8–16 per cent, the pilosity very dense. The cubitus of the forewing and of the hindwing each has about ten branches.
/species/reticulitermes-citrinus/.soldier: The head is yellow, the thorax and abdomen pale yellowish white. The head capsule is rectangular, the head width index 0.55–0.59, the sides nearly parallel or slightly expanded posteriorly; in lateral view the frontal ridge is very slightly raised. The labrum is spear-shaped, slightly longer than wide, the semi-transparent apical region narrow and rounded, a pair of short subapical hairs behind the apical hairs, the lateral-apical hairs absent, and a few bristles occasionally seen on the labral ridge. The mandibles are somewhat short and stout, the mandibular length 0.85–0.89 times the head width and not reaching half the head capsule length, the apices rather strongly curved, the basal ridge of the outer margin indistinct. The lacinial margin of the maxilla with nine to ten hairs. The waist constriction index of the postmentum 0.28–0.30. Antennae with 16 segments. The pronotum is about 1.5–1.7 times as wide as long, the notch of the anterior margin deeper than that of the posterior, the median notch rate 6–11 per cent, with about twenty hairs in the middle region.

/species/reticulitermes-coelceps/.soldier: Head yellowish brown, mandibles purplish brown, the pilosity of the head capsule sparse. The head capsule is rectangular, the head width index 0.55–0.56, the sides nearly parallel and slightly narrower in front of the middle, the posterior margin broadly rounded. The frontal ridge is slightly raised, the interfrontal area slightly concave, the middle of the dorsal margin of the head with a slight impression. The labrum is sharply spear-shaped, its posterior part retracted within the clypeus, the semi-transparent apical region needle-like, bearing apical and subapical hairs. The mandibles are strong with strongly curved apices, the mandibular condyle distinct; the mandibular length about 0.54–0.56 times the head capsule length and 0.98–1.00 in ratio to the head width. Antennae with 17 segments. The broad region of the postmentum lies at the anterior one-sixth of the head, the anterolateral margins nearly trapezoidal and expanding posteriorly, the middle slightly concave, the waist region narrow and long with the sides parallel, the waist constriction index 0.29–0.30. The pronotum is somewhat kidney-shaped, about 1.68 times as wide as long, the anterior margin broadly fork-shaped concave, the sides abruptly narrowing posteriorly and together with the posterior margin forming a broad arc, the middle slightly concave, with about six hairs in the middle region.

/species/reticulitermes-conus/.alate: Head capsule pale blackish brown; the postmentum and femoral segments concolorous with the head capsule, the pronotum blackish brown; the labrum, postclypeus, antennae and antennal spots pale chestnut brown; the tibiae greyish yellow, the wing membrane pale brown. The head capsule is circular, the fontanelle dot-like, 0.50 from the anterior frontal margin. The compound eyes are nearly circular, the projection rate 10 per cent, their distance from the lower margin of the head shorter, about 0.55 of their long diameter. The ocelli are nearly circular, their long diameter about three times the ocellus-compound eye distance. The vertex is arching like a mound, the postclypeus weakly projecting, lower than the vertex and about level with the ocelli. The antennae are incomplete. The pronotum is nearly trapezoidal, the anterior margin straight, the posterior margin formed by two intersecting arcs, the median notch rather deep. The forewing is broken, 1.84 mm wide; the hindwing 6.43 mm long and 1.84 mm wide, the cubitus with ten branches.
/species/reticulitermes-conus/.soldier: Head pale chestnut brown, mandibles purplish brown, the pilosity of the head capsule very sparse. The head capsule is rectangular, the head width index 0.63–0.66, the sides parallel, the middle of the posterior margin slightly projecting. The frons is flat. The labrum is sharply spear-shaped, the semi-transparent apical region short and needle-like, the apical hairs present, the subapical hairs almost indistinguishable, the lateral-apical hairs fine and short. The anterior part of the mandibles is rather slender, the apices rather straight, the base stout and conical; the mandibular length 0.58–0.61 times the head capsule length and 0.90–0.95 times the head width. The antennae are incomplete. The broad region of the postmentum lies at the anterior one-fifth, the anterolateral margins trapezoidal and expanding posteriorly, the waist region rather slender with the sides in a broad arc, the waist constriction index 0.30–0.31. The pronotum is nearly trapezoidal, 1.64–1.67 times as wide as long, the anterior margin straight with a shallow median notch, the middle of the posterior margin slightly concave, with four to six hairs in the middle region.

/species/reticulitermes-croceus/.alate: The whole body is deep yellow, the compound eyes purplish brown, the wings pale brown, the body hairs golden yellow.
/species/reticulitermes-croceus/.soldier: Head deep yellow, thorax and abdomen pale yellow. The head capsule is rectangular, the sides nearly parallel. In lateral view the frontal ridge is almost without elevation, and behind the fontanelle there is a shallow line. The labrum is sharply spear-shaped, the semi-transparent region at its apex short and pointed, bearing a pair of apical hairs and a pair of lateral-apical or subapical hairs, with occasionally a few bristles on the labral ridge. The mandibles are rather slender and long, their apices rather pointed and straight, the basal ridge of the outer margin indistinct. The lacinial margin of the maxilla with about ten hairs. Antennae with 14–15 segments. The pronotum is about 1.5–1.6 times as wide as long, the notches of the anterior and posterior margins distinct, the middle region almost hairless, a few individuals with one or two hairs, the marginal hairs about thirty.
/species/reticulitermes-croceus/.taxonomy_note: The genus name is printed in the original work as Reticuliter mes, a misspelling of Reticulitermes; it is now assigned to the genus Reticulitermes.

/species/reticulitermes-curticeps/.biology: The specimens were obtained from the tree Schima superba.
/species/reticulitermes-curticeps/.soldier: Head yellowish brown, mandibles reddish brown, the pilosity of the head capsule moderate. The head capsule is nearly rectangular, the head width index 0.71–0.73, the sides nearly parallel, the posterior margin broadly rounded. The frontal ridge is slightly raised, the top of the frons rounded. The labrum is lingulate, the semi-transparent apical region narrow and rounded, both the apical and subapical hairs present, the lateral-apical hairs extremely fine, the dorsal labral hairs coarse and long. The mandibles are stout, the apices rather straight, the curved part quite short; the mandibular length about 0.68 times the head capsule length and 0.96 times the head width. Antennae with 17 segments. The broad region of the postmentum lies slightly in front of the anterior one-third of the head, the anterolateral margins trapezoidal and expanding posteriorly, the waist region broad and short with the sides nearly parallel, the waist constriction index about 0.43. The pronotum is ingot-shaped, about 1.6 times as wide as long, the anterior margin formed by two intersecting arcs, the median notch rather deep, the anterior and posterior lateral corners evenly rounded, the middle of the posterior margin slightly concave, with more than thirty hairs in the middle region.

/species/reticulitermes-curvatus/.distribution: Baishanzu, Qingyuan, Zhejiang, about 1,050 m a.s.l.
/species/reticulitermes-curvatus/.soldier: Soldier head capsule pale yellowish brown, mandibles purplish brown, the head surface very sparsely haired. The head capsule is rectangular, the lateral margins parallel to each other, slightly narrowed at the middle, the posterior margin forming a straight line. The frontal region is slightly raised, the depression between the two frontal ridges shallow. The labrum is bluntly spear-shaped, the apex narrow and rounded, with apical, subapical and fine short lateral-apical hairs all present. The mandibles are short and stout, their apices very strongly curved; the antennae consist of 15 segments. The anterior broad region of the postmentum lies at the anterior one-sixth, the waist region narrow and long with the sides parallel. The anterior and posterior margins of the pronotum are both nearly straight, the notch of the anterior margin wider and deeper than that of the posterior, the lateral margins nearly straight and slowly narrowing posteriorly. About eight long hairs grow in the middle region, interspersed with several short hairs.

/species/reticulitermes-cymbidii/.alate: Head capsule blackish brown, the postmentum and femoral segments pale blackish brown, the pronotum and tibiae greyish yellow, the labrum and postclypeus paler than the head capsule, the wings greyish brown. The head capsule is nearly circular, the anterolateral corners nearly square, the fontanelle dot-like, about 0.48 mm from the anterior frontal margin. The compound eyes are roundly triangular, the projection rate 2–6 per cent, the short diameter greater than or equal to the distance from the compound eye to the lower margin of the head. The ocelli are nearly circular, the ocellus-compound eye distance almost equal to the short diameter of the ocellus. The dorsal margin of the head is slightly arched, sloping backwards from the vertex, the postclypeus almost not projecting, slightly lower than the vertex and slightly higher than the ocelli. Antennae with 17 segments. The pronotum is about 1.46–1.53 times as wide as long, the anterior margin nearly straight with the middle slightly notched, the middle of the posterior margin moderately notched. The forewing 7.19–8.45 mm long and 1.91–1.98 mm wide, the hindwing 7.04–7.50 mm long and 1.84 mm wide, the cubitus with about ten to eleven branches each.
/species/reticulitermes-cymbidii/.biology: The specimens were obtained beneath the roots of Cymbidium faberi.
/species/reticulitermes-cymbidii/.soldier: The head capsule is rectangular, the head width index 0.59–0.64, the sides parallel, the middle of the posterior margin straight. The frontal ridge is raised, the interfrontal area somewhat flat. The labrum is spear-shaped, the apex narrow and rounded, both the apical and subapical hairs present. The apices of the mandibles are rather strongly curved, their length 0.55–0.59 of the head capsule length and 0.90–0.95 of the head width. Antennae with 15–16 segments. The broad region of the postmentum lies at the anterior quarter, the anterolateral margins trapezoidal, the waist region slightly broad with the sides in a broad arc, the waist constriction index 0.38–0.43. The pronotum is nearly kidney-shaped, 1.45–1.58 times as wide as long, the anterior margin appearing to be formed by two broad intersecting arcs, the median notch distinct, the lateral margins joining the posterior margin in an arc and shallowly concave at the middle, with about thirty long hairs in the middle region.
/species/reticulitermes-cymbidii/.taxonomy_note: The genus name is defective in the original work, printed as Reticuliter mes; it is in fact the genus Reticulitermes, the same genus name as currently used on this site.

/species/reticulitermes-dabieshanensis/.alate: The head capsule, pronotum, postmentum and femoral segments are all nearly blackish brown; the tibiae greyish yellow; the labrum, postclypeus and antennae pale brown; the wing membrane brown. The head capsule is nearly circular, the fontanelle dot-like, 0.51 from the anterior frontal margin. The compound eyes are nearly circular, the projection rate 6–9 per cent, their short diameter greater than the distance from the compound eye to the lower margin of the head; the ocelli are long-oval, the short diameter greater than the ocellus-compound eye distance. The vertex is mound-like, the postclypeus almost not projecting, lower than the vertex and about level with the ocelli. Antennae with 17 segments. The pronotum is nearly trapezoidal, 1.56–1.63 times as wide as long, the anterior margin straight, the middle of the posterior margin fork-shaped notched and rather deep. The forewing 7.34–7.50 mm long and 2.07–2.14 mm wide; the hindwing 7.04–7.12 mm long and 2.05–2.12 mm wide, the cubitus of the forewing with about fourteen branches.
/species/reticulitermes-dabieshanensis/.biology: It damages the timber structures of buildings.
/species/reticulitermes-dabieshanensis/.soldier: Head yellowish brown, mandibles reddish brown, the pilosity of the head capsule sparse. The head capsule is rectangular, the head width index 0.55–0.61, the sides parallel, the posterior margin slightly projecting forwards. The frontal ridge is slightly raised, slightly concave between the two ridges. The labrum is sharply spear-shaped, the semi-transparent apical region conical, stout and pointed, the apical, subapical and lateral-apical hairs all rather distinct. The mandibles are strong, their apices very curved; the mandibular length 0.54–0.58 times the head capsule length and 0.94–0.98 times the head width. Antennae with 16–17 segments. The broad region of the postmentum lies at the anterior one-fifth, the anterolateral margins nearly parallel and then expanding again, the waist region narrow and long with the sides parallel, the waist constriction index 0.30–0.35. The pronotum is trapezoidal, about 1.61–1.68 times as wide as long, the anterior and posterior margins both rather straight, the notch at the middle of the anterior margin slightly deeper than that of the posterior, with about six hairs in the middle region.

/species/reticulitermes-dantuensis/.biology: The host is recorded as a stump of Pinus massoniana.
/species/reticulitermes-dantuensis/.distribution: Dantu, Jurong, Changzhou and Wuxi, Jiangsu.
/species/reticulitermes-dantuensis/.taxonomy_note: The genus name is defective in the original work, printed as Reticuliter mes; it is in fact the genus Reticulitermes, the same genus name as currently used on this site.

/species/reticulitermes-dayongensis/.soldier: Head pale yellowish brown, mandibles purplish brown, the pilosity of the head capsule moderate. The head capsule is rectangular, the head width index 0.60–0.62, the sides parallel, the posterior margin broad and rounded. The frontal ridge is slightly raised, a slight depression between the two ridges. The labrum is sharply spear-shaped, the transparent region at its apex needle-like and pointed, with both apical and subapical hairs. The mandibles are strong, their apices rather curved, the mandibular condyle visible; the mandibular length 0.57–0.59 times the head capsule length and 0.98–1.00 times the head width. Antennae with 16 segments. The broad region of the postmentum lies at the anterior one-sixth, the anterolateral margins nearly trapezoidal and expanding posteriorly, the waist region slender and long with the sides parallel, the waist constriction index 0.28–0.31. The pronotum is nearly trapezoidal, about 1.62–1.68 times as wide as long, the anterior and posterior margins nearly straight, the median notch of the anterior margin deeper than that of the posterior, with four to six hairs in the middle region.

/species/reticulitermes-dinghuensis/.soldier: Soldier head pale yellow, mandibles dark brown, the thorax also pale yellow and the abdomen still paler, the whole body sparsely bearing short hairs. The head capsule is rectangular, the sides parallel, the posterior margin rather straight, the frontal ridge raised upwards. The labrum is bluntly spear-shaped, the semi-transparent region at its apex narrow and roundly projecting, the two apical hairs prominent, the lateral-apical hairs absent. The mandibles are relatively short and stout, their length mostly not exceeding the head width, the inner margin of the apex strongly curved, the vertex of the outer margin higher than the apical point. The lacinia of the maxilla bears ten marginal hairs. Antennae with 15–16 segments, a few individuals with 17, segment 3 the shortest. The postmentum is slender and long, its greatest width more than three times its narrowest, the whole of it exposed beyond the lower margin of the head in lateral view. The middle region of the pronotum bears more than thirty hairs.

/species/reticulitermes-fengduensis/.biology: The specimens were collected from the paper mulberry Broussonetia papyrifera.
/species/reticulitermes-fengduensis/.soldier: Head yellowish brown, mandibles purplish brown, the pilosity of the head capsule sparse. The head capsule is rectangular, the head width index 0.55–0.58, the sides parallel, the posterior margin broadly rounded. The frontal region is flat. The labrum is spear-shaped, the apex narrow and rounded, with apical, subapical and lateral-apical hairs all present. The mandibles are long with curved apices; the mandibular length 0.54–0.58 times the head capsule length and 0.98–1.01 times the head width. Antennae with 17–19 segments. The broad region of the postmentum lies at about the anterior one-fifth, the anterolateral margins trapezoidal and slightly concave, the waist region rather broad with the sides slightly arcuate, the waist constriction index 0.40–0.43. The pronotum is ingot-shaped, about 1.6 times as wide as long, the anterior margin formed by two broad intersecting arcs, the posterior margin nearly straight, with about six long hairs in the middle region.

/species/reticulitermes-flaviceps/.distribution: Taiwan, Fujian, Zhejiang, Jiangsu, Jiangxi, Hunan, Guangdong and Hainan.
/species/reticulitermes-flaviceps/.soldier: Head yellowish brown, mandibles purplish brown, the pilosity of the head capsule rather sparse. The head capsule is rectangular, the head width index 0.60–0.71, the sides nearly parallel and slightly diverging posteriorly, the posterior margin broadly rounded. The frontal ridge is slightly raised, the interfrontal area nearly flat. The labrum is spear-shaped, its apex passing from narrowly rounded to sharply rounded, with apical, subapical and lateral-apical hairs all present. The mandibles are sabre-shaped, the mandibular body rather straight, the apex of the right mandible almost not curved, that of the left mandible slightly curved, their length 0.59 of the head capsule length and 0.93 of the head width. Antennae with 16 segments. The broad region of the postmentum lies at the anterior one-fifth, the anterolateral margins nearly trapezoidal, the waist region rather broad with the two sides in a broad arc, the waist constriction index 0.36–0.44. The pronotum is about 1.57 times as wide as long, the anterior margin formed by two broad intersecting arcs and shallowly concave at the middle, the posterior margin nearly straight with the middle slightly concave, the lateral margins like an inverted trapezium, with more than twenty hairs in the middle region.
/species/reticulitermes-flaviceps/.taxonomy_note: The genus name is defective in the original work, printed as Reticuliter mes; it is in fact the genus Reticulitermes, the same genus name as currently used on this site.

/species/reticulitermes-fukienensis/.alate: Dealate adult head capsule chestnut brown, the pronotum yellowish brown with several brown spots scattered over it, the labrum and postclypeus pale brown, the postmentum brown, the femoral segments pale brown, the tibiae pale yellowish brown. The head capsule is long-oval, the fontanelle dot-like, 0.51 mm from the anterior frontal margin. The compound eyes are nearly circular, the projection rate 3–5 per cent, the distance from the compound eye to the lower margin of the head slightly greater than the short diameter of the compound eye and comparable to the long diameter. The ocelli are nearly circular, the long diameter slightly greater than the ocellus-compound eye distance. The antennae of the specimens are broken off, the number of segments unknown. The dorsal margin of the head is rather gently sloping in front of the fontanelle, the postclypeus hardly projecting at all, lower than the vertex and higher than the ocelli. The pronotum is 1.44–1.48 times as wide as long, the anterior margin nearly straight, the middle of the posterior margin shallowly concave.
/species/reticulitermes-fukienensis/.soldier: Head yellowish brown, mandibles purplish brown, the pilosity of the head capsule moderate. The head capsule is rectangular, the head width index 0.54–0.60, the sides parallel and slightly narrowed behind the antennal sockets, the posterior margin broadly rounded. The frontal ridge is raised, broad and flat between the ridges. The labrum is spear-shaped, the apex projecting triangularly, the apical hairs present, the subapical hairs minute, the lateral-apical hairs absent. The apices of the mandibles are slender and pointed and rather strongly curved, the curved part rather long, the length 0.50–0.60 of the head capsule length and 0.93–0.97 of the head width. Antennae with 15–16 segments. The broad region of the postmentum lies at the anterior one-fifth, the anterolateral margins trapezoidal, the middle slightly concave, the waist region broad and long with the two sides in a broad arc, the length of the postmentum about six to seven times the width of the waist, the waist constriction index 0.39–0.44. The pronotum is about 1.46–1.59 times as wide as long, the anterior margin nearly straight, the middle of the posterior margin shallowly concave, with about forty hairs in the middle region.
/species/reticulitermes-fukienensis/.taxonomy_note: The genus name is defective in the original work, printed as Reticuliter mes; it is in fact the genus Reticulitermes, the same genus name as currently used on this site.

/species/reticulitermes-gaoshi/.alate: Head brown, the pronotum slightly darker than the head, with a pale T-shaped mark in the middle; the postmentum, the basal antennal segment and the femoral segments deep brown; the labrum, postclypeus and the lower half of the tibiae pale yellow, the upper half of the tibiae tinged with brown; the wings pale brown. The head capsule is nearly circular, the fontanelle large and round, about 0.15 mm in diameter, pale yellow, 0.49 mm from the anterior frontal margin, the antennal spots distinct. The compound eyes are roundly triangular, the projection rate 4 per cent, the short diameter about equal to the distance to the lower margin of the head. The ocelli are elliptical, the short diameter slightly greater than the ocellus-compound eye distance. In lateral view the vertex is raised in a gentle mound, the postclypeus weakly projecting and slightly lower than the vertex. The pronotum is inversely trapezoidal, 1.51–1.61 times as wide as long, the anterior margin nearly straight, the middle of the posterior margin notched; the forewing 7.11–7.34 mm long and 1.91–2.08 mm wide; the hindwing 6.88 mm long and 1.99–2.03 mm wide, the cubitus with about ten to twelve branches.
/species/reticulitermes-gaoshi/.soldier: Head pale yellowish brown, mandibles reddish brown, the pilosity of the head capsule moderate. The head capsule is rectangular, the head width index 0.58–0.60, the sides parallel, the posterior margin nearly straight. The frontal region is slightly projecting. The labrum is lingulate, the apex bluntly rounded or slightly narrow, the apical and subapical hairs present, the lateral-apical hairs present or absent. The mandibles are long and strong, their apices rather curved, the mandibular condyle clear; the mandibular length 0.53–0.54 times the head capsule length and 0.89–0.92 times the head width. Antennae with 16 segments. The broad region of the postmentum lies between the anterior quarter and the anterior one-fifth, the middle of the anterolateral margins slightly concave, the waist region broad and short, the waist constriction index 0.35–0.42. The pronotum is inversely trapezoidal, 1.55–1.59 times as wide as long, the middle of the anterior margin shallowly concave, the posterior margin almost without a notch, with nearly twenty long and short hairs in the middle region.

/species/reticulitermes-gaoyaoensis/.soldier: Head yellowish brown, mandibles purplish brown, the pilosity of the head capsule sparse. The head capsule is rectangular, the head width index about 0.58, the sides parallel, the posterior margin slightly rounded. The frontal ridge is slightly raised, the interfrontal area slightly concave. The labrum is sharply spear-shaped, the transparent region at its apex forming a short needle-like point, the apical and subapical hairs present, the lateral-apical hairs absent. The mandibles appear rather slender and straight, their apices slender and pointed and slightly curved; the mandibular length 0.58 times the head capsule length and about equal to the head width. Antennae with 15–16 segments. The broad region of the postmentum falls at the anterior one-sixth, the anterolateral margins trapezoidal and expanding posteriorly, the middle slightly concave; the waist region slender and long with the sides parallel to each other, the waist constriction index 0.26–0.30. The pronotum is trapezoidal, 1.56 times as wide as long, the anterior and posterior margins nearly straight with a shallow notch at the middle of each, that of the anterior margin wider and deeper, with about six hairs in the middle region.

/species/reticulitermes-grandis/.soldier: Head brownish yellow, mandibles purplish brown, the pilosity of the head capsule sparse. The head capsule is rectangular, the head width index 0.57–0.62, the sides slightly broadened in the middle and posterior parts, the posterior margin broadly rounded. The frontal ridge is strongly raised, concave between the ridges. The labrum is lingulate, the apex broadly rounded, the apical and subapical hairs present, the lateral-apical hairs present or absent. The mandibles are stout, their apices strongly curved, the mandibular condyle prominently projecting, the length 0.52–0.53 of the head capsule length and 0.88–0.90 of the head width. Antennae with 16–17 segments. The broad region of the postmentum lies at the anterior one-fifth, the two sides of the waist region parallel, the waist constriction index 0.32–0.415. The pronotum is about 1.51–1.67 times as wide as long, the anterior margin straight, the four corners broadly rounded, the middle of both the anterior and the posterior margin with a distinct notch, long hairs in the middle region reaching more than fifty.
/species/reticulitermes-grandis/.taxonomy_note: The genus name is defective in the original work, printed as Reticuliter mes; it is in fact the genus Reticulitermes, the same genus name as currently used on this site.

/species/reticulitermes-guangzhouensis/.alate: Head capsule pale blackish brown, the pronotum greyish yellow, the labrum and postclypeus slightly paler than the head capsule, the postmentum and femoral segments close to the head capsule in colour, the tibiae greyish yellow, the wings brown. The head capsule is circular and slightly long, the fontanelle dot-like, about 0.48 mm from the anterior frontal margin. The compound eyes are roundly triangular, the projection rate 1–2 per cent, the short diameter about equal to the distance from the compound eye to the lower margin of the head. The ocelli are nearly circular, the long diameter slightly greater than the ocellus-compound eye distance. Antennae with 17–18 segments. The dorsal margin of the head is slightly arched, the postclypeus slightly projecting, lower than the vertex and higher than the ocelli. The pronotum is about 1.5–1.6 times as wide as long, the anterior and posterior margins nearly straight, the median notches of both indistinct. The forewing 6.58–7.04 mm long and 1.84–1.99 mm wide, the hindwing 6.27–6.73 mm long and 1.84–1.91 mm wide, the cubitus with about nine to ten branches each.
/species/reticulitermes-guangzhouensis/.soldier: Head pale yellow, mandibles purplish brown, the pilosity of the head capsule moderate. The head capsule is rectangular, the head width index 0.54–0.65, the sides nearly parallel or slightly diverging posteriorly, the posterior margin broadly straight. The frontal ridge is raised, slightly concave between the ridges. The labrum is spear-shaped, the apex narrow and rounded, the apical and subapical hairs present, the lateral-apical hairs absent. The apices of the mandibles are slender and pointed and slightly curved, the length 0.52–0.66 of the head capsule length and 0.91–1.05 of the head width. Antennae with 14–16 segments. The broad region of the postmentum lies at the anterior quarter, the anterolateral margins trapezoidal, the waist region rather broad and slightly short, the length of the postmentum about five to six times the width of the waist, the waist constriction index 0.39–0.47. The pronotum is about 1.4–1.8 times as wide as long, the anterior margin formed by two intersecting arcs, the lateral margins slightly oblique posteriorly, the middle of the posterior margin slightly concave, with thirty to forty hairs in the middle region.
/species/reticulitermes-guangzhouensis/.taxonomy_note: The genus name is defective in the original work, printed as Reticuliter mes; it is in fact the genus Reticulitermes, the same genus name as currently used on this site.

/species/reticulitermes-guilinensis/.biology: The host is recorded as Pinus elliottii.
/species/reticulitermes-guilinensis/.soldier: Head orange-yellow, mandibles reddish brown and slightly transparent, the pilosity of the head capsule sparse. The head capsule is rectangular, the head width index 0.55–0.56, the sides nearly parallel and gradually narrowing posteriorly, the posterior margin evenly rounded. The frontal ridge is distinctly raised, shallowly concave between the ridges. The labrum is lingulate, the apex roundly blunt, the apical hairs fine, the remaining hairs almost imperceptible. The mandibles are firm and slender, their apices rather strongly curved, the length 0.52–0.53 of the head capsule length and 0.94–0.95 of the head width. Antennae with 14–15 segments. The middle of the anterolateral margins of the broad region of the postmentum is concave, the broad region lies at the anterior one-fifth, the waist region slender and long with the two sides parallel, the waist constriction index 0.33–0.34. The pronotum is 1.44–1.50 times as wide as long, the median notch of the anterior margin both broad and deep, the middle of the posterior margin slightly incised, with about sixteen hairs in the middle region.
/species/reticulitermes-guilinensis/.taxonomy_note: The genus name is defective in the original work, printed as Reticuliter mes; it is in fact the genus Reticulitermes, the same genus name as currently used on this site.

/species/reticulitermes-guizhouensis/.biology: The host is recorded as Pterocarya stenoptera.
/species/reticulitermes-guizhouensis/.soldier: The whole body has a pale yellowish brown ground colour, the mandibles brown tinged with red and slightly translucent, the pronotum and legs pale yellow. The pilosity of the head capsule is sparse; the outline is rectangular, the lateral margins parallel, the posterior margin broadly rounded, the head width index 0.52–0.58. In lateral view the frontal ridge is raised, the anterolateral corners of the ridge slightly more heavily sclerotised; in dorsal view it is divided into two peaks, the ridge lines of the two peaks forming a shallow V-shaped arch. The labrum is spear-shaped, the apex narrow and rounded, the apical, subapical and lateral-apical hairs and the labral ridge hairs all present. The apices of the mandibles are curved, the middle of the mandibular body stout, with a mandibular condyle, the left mandible longer than half the head capsule and about equal to or slightly exceeding the head width. Antennae with 15–16 segments. The postmentum is narrow and long, eight to eleven times as long as the waist width, the anterior broad region about 0.3–0.4 of the waist width, the head width 5.7–7.8 times the waist width, several shallow transverse striae behind the anterior margin and behind these a dot-like arch. The two sides of the anterior margin of the pronotum form broad arcs, the middle is concave, the lateral margins oblique posteriorly, the posterior margin shallowly concave, with about thirty long hairs in the middle region.
/species/reticulitermes-guizhouensis/.taxonomy_note: The genus name is printed in the original work as Reticuliter mes, a misspelling of Reticulitermes; it is now assigned to the genus Reticulitermes.

/species/reticulitermes-gulinensis/.alate: The head capsule is brown tinged with black, the labrum, postclypeus and antennae chestnut brown, the pronotum, postmentum and tibiae dull yellow, the femoral segments pale brown. The outline of the head capsule is nearly circular, the fontanelle a small dot, 0.59 mm from the anterior frontal margin. In lateral view the dorsal margin of the head is arched, the postclypeus projecting, its height exceeding the ocelli but below the vertex. The compound eyes are nearly circular, the projection rate 5–7 per cent, the short diameter slightly greater than the distance from the compound eye to the lower margin of the head. The ocelli are nearly circular, the radius almost equal to the ocellus-compound eye distance. Antennae with 18–19 segments. The pronotum is 1.43–1.47 times as wide as long, the anterior and posterior margins nearly straight, each with a distinct median notch. The forewing 9.66–9.95 mm long and 2.45–2.58 mm wide; the hindwing 9.18 mm long and 2.53 mm wide; the Cu vein with more than ten branches.
/species/reticulitermes-gulinensis/.soldier: Head yellowish brown, mandibles purplish brown, the pilosity of the head capsule moderate. The head capsule is rectangular, the head width index 0.55–0.57, the lateral margins parallel, the posterior margin almost a straight line. The frontal ridge is markedly elevated, concave between the two ridges. The labrum is lingulate, the apex slightly rounded, the apical, subapical and lateral-apical hairs all well developed. The mandibles are stout and powerful, their apices sharply curved into a hook, the mandibular condyle clear, their length 0.9–0.94 times the head width. Antennae with 17–18 segments.
