The broadest region of the postmentum falls in front of the anterior one-fifth, the anterolateral margin of the broad region first parallel and then expanding outwards, the waist region rather long with the sides parallel, the waist constriction index 0.3–0.33. The pronotum is about 1.56 times as wide as long, the V-shaped notch at the middle of the anterior margin rather deep, the notch at the middle of the posterior margin distinct, with about fifty hairs in the middle region.
/species/reticulitermes-gulinensis/.taxonomy_note: The genus name is printed in the original work as Reticuliter mes, a misspelling of Reticulitermes; it is now assigned to the genus Reticulitermes.

/species/reticulitermes-hainanensis/.alate: The head capsule, pronotum, postmentum and femoral segments are all nearly blackish brown; the labrum and postclypeus brown, the latter paler; the tibiae pale yellow, the wing membrane brown. The head capsule is nearly circular, the fontanelle dot-like, 0.53–0.58 mm from the anterior frontal margin. The compound eyes are nearly circular, the projection rate 6–9 per cent, the long diameter greater than the distance from the compound eye to the lower margin of the head. The ocelli are long-oval, the long diameter greater than the ocellus-compound eye distance. The dorsal margin of the head is mound-like, the postclypeus almost not projecting, lower than the vertex and slightly higher than the ocelli. Antennae with 19 segments. The pronotum is trapezoidal, the middle of the anterior margin with a small notch, the middle of the posterior margin distinctly notched. The forewing 8.26–8.57 mm long and 2.21–2.37 mm wide; the hindwing 7.96–8.26 mm long and the same width as the forewing, the cubitus with about fourteen branches.

/species/reticulitermes-huapingensis/.alate: Head capsule chestnut brown, the postmentum, pronotum and tibiae greyish yellow, the labrum, postclypeus, antennae and femoral segments pale chestnut brown. The head capsule is long-oval, the fontanelle dot-like, 0.56 mm from the anterior frontal margin. The compound eyes are elliptical, the circumocular groove distinct, the projection rate about 5 per cent, the short diameter greater than the distance from the compound eye to the lower margin of the head. The short diameter of the ocellus is greater than the ocellus-compound eye distance. In lateral view the postclypeus is almost not raised, situated below the vertex, the vertex arched. Antennae with 17–18 segments. The pronotum is 1.47–1.51 times as wide as long, the anterior margin broadly and shallowly concave, the notch at the middle of the posterior margin slightly shallower.
/species/reticulitermes-huapingensis/.distribution: Longsheng, Guangxi; Liping and Congjiang, Guizhou.
/species/reticulitermes-huapingensis/.soldier: Head capsule pale yellowish brown, mandibles purplish brown, the pilosity moderate. The head capsule is rectangular, the head width index 0.55–0.6, the sides parallel, the posterior margin nearly straight. The frontal ridge is distinct, concave between the ridges. The labrum is nearly lingulate, the apex bluntly rounded, bearing rather long apical hairs, the subapical hairs very weak, the lateral-apical hairs absent. The mandibles are stout, their apices rather curved, the mandibular condyle present, the mandibular length 0.94–0.97 times the head width. Antennae with 16–17 segments. The anterior broad region of the postmentum lies at the anterior one-sixth, the lateral margins of the waist region parallel, the waist constriction index 0.35–0.38. The pronotum is about 1.6 times as wide as long, the notches of the anterior and posterior margins both rather distinct, the lateral margins abruptly narrowing posteriorly, with forty to fifty long hairs in the middle region.
/species/reticulitermes-huapingensis/.taxonomy_note: The genus name is printed in the original work as Reticuliter mes, a misspelling of Reticulitermes; it is now assigned to the genus Reticulitermes.

/species/reticulitermes-hubeiensis/.biology: The specimens were collected from the tree Sapium sebiferum.
/species/reticulitermes-hubeiensis/.soldier: Head pale yellowish brown, mandibles purplish brown, the pilosity of the head capsule sparse. The head capsule is rectangular, the head width index 0.58–0.64, the sides parallel, the posterior margin broadly rounded. The frons is flat or slightly raised, the interfrontal area flat. The labrum is spear-shaped, the apex narrow and rounded, the apical and subapical hairs present, the lateral-apical hairs minute. The mandibles are rather strong, their apices rather curved; the mandibular length 0.49–0.55 times the head capsule length and 0.85–0.88 times the head width. Antennae with 15–16 segments. The broad region of the postmentum lies at the anterior one-fifth, the anterolateral margins trapezoidal, the waist region rather broad with the sides parallel, the waist constriction index 0.41–0.44. The pronotum is ingot-shaped, about 1.5–1.6 times as wide as long, the anterior margin formed by two broad intersecting arcs, the posterior margin almost straight, with more than ten hairs in the middle region.

/species/reticulitermes-hunanensis/.alate: Head capsule pale blackish brown, the pronotum blackish brown at the periphery and concolorous with the head in the middle; the postmentum and femoral segments concolorous with the head capsule; the labrum, postclypeus, antennae and antennal spots brown; the tibiae greyish yellow, the wings brown. The head capsule is nearly circular, the fontanelle dot-like, 0.48 mm from the anterior frontal margin. The compound eyes are nearly circular, the projection rate 8 per cent, their short diameter greater than the distance from the compound eye to the lower margin of the head. The ocelli are nearly circular, their distance from the compound eye about equal to their short diameter. The vertex arches like a mound, the postclypeus almost not projecting, lower than the vertex and about level with the ocelli. Antennae with 17 segments. The pronotum is trapezoidal, about 1.43 times as wide as long, the middle of the anterior margin shallowly concave, the middle of the posterior margin rather deeply incised. The forewing 6.90 mm long and 1.95 mm wide; the hindwing 6.75 mm long and 1.92 mm wide, the cubitus with about eight branches.
/species/reticulitermes-hunanensis/.soldier: Head pale yellowish brown, mandibles reddish brown, the pilosity of the head capsule sparse. The head capsule is rectangular, the head width index 0.57–0.59, the sides nearly parallel and slightly narrowing posteriorly, the posterior margin slightly projecting. The frontal region is slightly raised, the interfrontal area slightly concave. The labrum is sharply spear-shaped, the semi-transparent apical region projecting narrowly at an acute angle, the apical hairs present, the subapical hairs minute, the lateral-apical hairs absent. The mandibles are long and strong, the apices stout and short and slightly curved; the mandibular length 0.59 times the head capsule length and 0.93 times the head width. Antennae with 16 segments. The broad region of the postmentum lies at about the anterior one-sixth, the anterolateral margins trapezoidal and expanding posteriorly, the waist region slender and long with the sides parallel, the waist constriction index 0.28. The pronotum is nearly kidney-shaped, about 1.77 times as wide as long, the median notches of the anterior and posterior margins rather shallow, the lateral margins abruptly narrowing posteriorly, with about six hairs in the middle region.
/species/reticulitermes-hunanensis/.taxonomy_note: The original work also includes a separate entry for Tsaitermes hunanensis; this entry records only the morphological content of the genus Reticulitermes, and the two must not be confused.

/species/reticulitermes-hypsofrons/.alate: The whole body is chestnut brown, the pronotum yellow with brown clouding on the anterior half, the postmentum chestnut brown with a yellow spot in the middle, the tibiae and tarsi pale yellow, the whole body covered with golden soft hairs. The head capsule is approximately oval, the vertex slightly concave, the fontanelle slightly projecting, the postclypeus slightly raised but lower than the vertex. The lacinial margin of the maxilla bears twelve hairs. The short diameter of the compound eye is slightly greater than the distance from the compound eye to the lower margin of the head, the projection rate 3–6 per cent. The long diameter of the ocellus is slightly greater than the ocellus-compound eye distance. The distance from the compound eye to the antennal socket is about half the distance from the ocellus to the antennal socket. Antennae with 17–18 segments. The pronotum is about 1.45–1.59 times as wide as long, the median notch of the posterior margin deeper than that of the anterior, the hairs of the middle region long and dense, more than sixty. The Cu vein of the forewing has about thirteen branches, that of the hindwing about twelve.
/species/reticulitermes-hypsofrons/.soldier: The head is yellow, the thorax and abdomen pale yellow, the hairs of the thorax and abdomen rather dense. The head capsule is rectangular, the head width index 0.51–0.55, the lateral margins parallel and slightly concave at the middle. The frontal ridge is strongly raised. The labrum is roundly spear-shaped, about 1–1.22 times as long as wide, the semi-transparent apical region broad and rounded; the apical hairs fine and long, the lateral-apical hairs either well developed or reduced, and behind the apical hairs there is also a pair of very short subapical hairs. The mandibles are rather short and stout, 0.89–0.97 times the head width and 0.46–0.52 times the head capsule length. The lacinial margin of the maxilla bears about eleven hairs. The narrow region of the postmentum differs considerably between colonies, its width 0.14–0.19 mm, the waist constriction index 0.27–0.36. Antennae with 16–17 segments. The pronotum is about 1.54–1.67 times as wide as long, the notches of the anterior and posterior margins both rather deep, the median notch rate 11–20 per cent, with more than thirty hairs in the middle region.
/species/reticulitermes-hypsofrons/.taxonomy_note: The genus name is printed in the original work as Reticuliter mes, a misspelling of Reticulitermes; it is now assigned to the genus Reticulitermes.

/species/reticulitermes-jiangchengensis/.alate: Head capsule blackish brown, the pronotum dull yellow, the postmentum concolorous with the head capsule but slightly paler, with a yellow spot in the middle; the labrum and postclypeus dull brown, the femoral segments blackish brown, the tibiae greyish yellow, the wings dull brown. The head capsule is long-oval, the fontanelle dot-like, 0.53 mm from the anterior frontal margin. The compound eyes are roundly triangular, the projection rate 4 per cent, the short diameter greater than the distance from the compound eye to the lower margin of the head. The ocelli are circular, the diameter equal to the ocellus-compound eye distance. The dorsal margin of the head arches gently, the vertex rather flat, the postclypeus slightly raised, lower than the vertex and level with the ocelli. Antennae with 18–19 segments. The pronotum is step-like, 1.42–1.47 times as wide as long, the anterior margin nearly straight with a shallow median incision, the median notch of the posterior margin rather deep. The forewing 7.8–8.3 mm long and about 2.14 mm wide; the hindwing 7.19–7.65 mm long and about 1.99 mm wide; the Cu vein with about eight branches.
/species/reticulitermes-jiangchengensis/.soldier: Head yellowish brown, mandibles purplish brown, the pilosity of the head capsule moderate. The head capsule is rectangular, the head width index 0.52–0.53, the sides nearly parallel and somewhat narrowed behind the antennal sockets, the posterior margin slightly rounded. The frontal ridge is strongly raised, shallowly concave between the two ridges. The labrum is lingulate, the apex broad and rounded, the semi-transparent region with a bluntly angular appearance; the apical and subapical hairs present, the lateral-apical hairs fine or indistinct. The mandibles are short and stout, their apices strongly curved like a hook, the mandibular condyle distinct, the mandibular length 0.9–0.93 times the head width. Antennae with 17 segments. The broad region of the postmentum lies at the anterior one-fifth, the anterolateral margins first parallel and then expanding outwards; the waist region narrow and long with the sides parallel, the waist constriction index 0.31–0.34. The pronotum is approximately trapezoidal, about 1.52–1.58 times as wide as long, the anterior margin broadly V-shaped concave, the posterior margin nearly straight with the middle slightly concave, with more than thirty hairs in the middle region.
/species/reticulitermes-jiangchengensis/.taxonomy_note: The genus name is printed in the original work as Reticuliter mes, a misspelling of Reticulitermes; it is now assigned to the genus Reticulitermes.

/species/reticulitermes-labralis/.alate: The head capsule, postmentum, pronotum and femoral segments are all blackish brown; the labrum, postclypeus and tibiae greyish brown, the tibiae paler. The head capsule is circular, the fontanelle dot-like, about 0.48 mm from the frontal margin. The compound eyes are roundly triangular, the projection rate 1–5 per cent, the long diameter greater than the distance from the compound eye to the lower margin of the head; the ocelli are nearly circular, the long diameter greater than their distance from the compound eye. The vertex arches like a mound, the frontal slope slightly concave, the postclypeus projecting and slightly lower than the vertex, slightly higher than the ocelli. Antennae with 17–18 segments. The anterior margin of the pronotum is broad and flat with a broad shallow median notch, the lateral margins slightly arcuate, the middle of the posterior margin distinctly notched.
/species/reticulitermes-labralis/.soldier: Head pale yellow, mandibles reddish brown, the pilosity of the head capsule sparse. The head capsule is rectangular, the head width index 0.62–0.65, the sides nearly parallel, the posterior margin broad and rounded. The frontal region is very slightly raised, the interfrontal depression rather shallow. The labrum is spear-shaped, the apex narrow and rounded, the apical, subapical and lateral-apical hairs all present. The mandibles are rather weak, slender and straight, their apices slender and almost straight; the mandibular length 0.54–0.56 times the head capsule length and 0.83–0.88 times the head width. Antennae with 15–16 segments. Small white ocellus-like spots are occasionally visible. The broad region of the postmentum lies between the anterior one-fifth and one-quarter, the waist region broad and short with the sides slightly in a broad arc, the waist constriction index 0.40–0.50, about one-sixth of the head width. The pronotum is 1.50–1.59 times as wide as long, the anterior and posterior margins rather straight, the notches both shallow, the lateral margins in a broad arc, with ten to sixteen hairs in the middle region.

/species/reticulitermes-largus/.soldier: The frontal ridge is slightly raised, the interfrontal area slightly concave, the area behind the frons low and concave. The labrum is sharply rounded and spear-shaped, the semi-transparent apical region nipple-like, the anterior part of the labrum triangular, the sides of the middle evenly rounded, with apical, subapical and lateral-apical hairs all present, the lateral-apical hairs fine and short. The mandibles are strong, their apices strongly curved, the mandibular condyle distinct; the mandibular length 0.53–0.55 times the head capsule length and 0.89–0.91 times the head width. Antennae with 18 segments. The broad region of the postmentum lies at about the anterior one-sixth, its anterolateral margin expanding posteriorly like a trapezium, the middle slightly concave; the waist region narrow and long with the sides parallel, the waist constriction index 0.30–0.35. The pronotum is kidney-shaped, 1.53–1.61 times as wide as long, the anterior and posterior margins slightly formed by two intersecting arcs, the median notch of the anterior margin more distinct than that of the posterior, with about four hairs in the middle region.

/species/reticulitermes-latilabris/.alate: The head and postmentum are pale brown tinged with red, the thorax and the dorsal and ventral plates of the abdomen pale brown, the legs pale yellow, the femoral segments slightly deeper. The head capsule is oval, the vertex projecting, the fontanelle flat. In lateral view the postclypeus is slightly raised, lower than the vertex. Total length 14.65 mm, abdominal width 3.41 mm. Head width including the compound eyes 1.07 mm, excluding the compound eyes 1.04 mm; the projection rate of the compound eye 3 per cent, its long diameter 0.20 mm, its distance from the lower margin of the head 0.21 mm. The long diameter of the ocellus 0.07 mm, the ocellus-compound eye distance 0.05 mm, the distance from the ocellus to the antennal socket slightly greater than that from the compound eye to the antennal socket. Antennae with 13 segments, broken. Pronotum width 0.85 mm, length 0.56 mm, the median line faintly discernible, with nearly forty long hairs in the middle region. Hind tibia 1.04 mm long.
/species/reticulitermes-latilabris/.soldier: The head is yellow. The head capsule is rectangular, the head width index 0.62–0.72, the sides nearly parallel. The frons is flat. The labrum is lingulate, slightly wider than long, the apical region semicircular, with apical and lateral-apical hairs present. The apices of the mandibles are pointed and rather straight, the mandibular length 0.92–1.06 times the head width and 0.60–0.66 times the head capsule length. Antennae with 14–15 segments. The postmentum is short and broad, the waist constriction index 0.31–0.33, the ratio of the waist width to the head width about 1:7–8, and to the length of the postmentum also about 1:7–8. The pronotum is about 1.4–1.6 times as wide as long, the middle of the anterior and posterior margins both shallowly concave, the lateral margins slowly oblique posteriorly, with more than ten bristles in the middle region.

/species/reticulitermes-leiboensis/.biology: The specimens were collected from the lacquer tree Rhus verniciflus.
/species/reticulitermes-leiboensis/.soldier: Head yellowish brown and rather deep, mandibles purplish brown, the pilosity of the head capsule moderate. The head capsule is rectangular, the head width index 0.60–0.64, the sides nearly parallel and slightly broadened in the middle and posterior parts, the posterior margin broadly rounded. The frontal region is slightly raised, the interfrontal area shallowly concave. The labrum is broadly lingulate, the apex broadly rounded, the apical, subapical and lateral-apical hairs all rather long. The mandibles are rather straight, their apices slender and slightly curved; the mandibular length 0.57–0.61 times the head capsule length and 0.91–0.97 times the head width. Antennae with 15–16 segments. The broad region of the postmentum falls roughly at the anterior one-fifth, its anterolateral margin nearly trapezoidal and expanding posteriorly, the middle slightly concave; the waist region slender and narrow with the sides nearly in a broad arc, the waist constriction index 0.26–0.27. The pronotum is kidney-shaped, about 1.5–1.6 times as wide as long, the anterior and posterior margins both appearing as two broad intersecting arcs, the median notch of the anterior deeper than that of the posterior, with about thirty hairs in the middle region.

/species/reticulitermes-leigongshanensis.soldier: Head pale yellow, mandibles purplish brown, the pilosity of the head capsule moderate. The head capsule is rectangular, the head width index 0.58–0.61, the sides nearly parallel, the posterior margin slightly arcuately convex outwards. The frontal ridge is very slightly raised, with a shallow interfrontal depression. The labrum is sharply spear-shaped, the semi-transparent apical region projecting like a nipple, both the apical and subapical hairs rather long. The mandibles are rather stout and straight, their apices short and slightly curved; the mandibular length 0.57–0.59 times the head capsule length and 0.97–0.98 times the head width. Antennae with 16 segments. The broad region of the postmentum lies at the anterior one-sixth, the anterolateral margins parallel and then expanding, the waist region slender and long with the sides parallel, the waist constriction index 0.28–0.33. The pronotum is trapezoidal, about 1.63–1.73 times as wide as long, the anterior and posterior margins nearly straight, the median notch of the anterior margin deeper than that of the posterior, with about six hairs in the middle region.

/species/reticulitermes-leptomandibulari.alate: Head capsule chestnut brown, the pronotum concolorous but deeper; the postmentum and femoral segments nearly brown but paler; the tibiae pale yellow; the labrum and postclypeus pale brown; the wings pale brown. The head capsule is nearly circular, the fontanelle dot-like, about 0.48 mm from the anterior frontal margin. The compound eyes are nearly circular, the projection rate 8–10 per cent, their short diameter distinctly greater than the distance from the compound eye to the lower margin of the head. The ocelli are long-oval, the long diameter twice the ocellus-compound eye distance. The dorsal margin of the head is mound-like, the postclypeus weakly projecting, lower than the vertex and about level with the ocelli. Antennae with 17 segments. The pronotum is trapezoidal, 1.47–1.58 times as wide as long, the anterior margin straight with a shallow median notch, the middle of the posterior margin fork-shaped notched. The forewing 6.81–6.88 mm long and 1.90 mm wide; the hindwing 6.51–6.58 mm long and 1.84 mm wide, the cubitus with about nine to eleven branches.
/species/reticulitermes-leptomandibulari.biology: It damages the timber structures of buildings.
/species/reticulitermes-leptomandibulari.distribution: Yongan and elsewhere in Fujian; also recorded from Zhejiang, Guangdong, Hunan and Hainan.
/species/reticulitermes-leptomandibulari.soldier: Head yellowish brown, mandibles reddish brown, the pilosity of the head capsule sparse. The head capsule is rectangular, the head width index 0.53–0.62, the sides nearly parallel, the middle of the posterior margin straight, the posterolateral corners slightly rounded. The frontal ridge is slightly raised, a slight depression between the two ridges. The labrum is sharply spear-shaped, its apical transparent region needle-like, the apical and subapical hairs both present, the lateral-apical hairs absent. The mandibles appear rather slender and straight, their apices slender and pointed and slightly curved; the mandibular length 0.60–0.61 times the head capsule length and 1.00–1.02 times the head width. Antennae with 15–16 segments. The broad region at the anterior end of the postmentum lies at the anterior one-sixth, the anterolateral margins expanding posteriorly in a trapezium, the middle slightly concave; the waist region slender and long with the sides parallel, the waist constriction index 0.25–0.33. The pronotum is trapezoidal, about 1.56–1.61 times as wide as long, the anterior and posterior margins nearly straight with a shallow median notch in each, with about six hairs in the middle region.

/species/reticulitermes-levatoriceps/.soldier: Head orange-yellow, mandibles reddish brown, the pilosity of the head capsule moderate. The head capsule is rectangular, the head width index 0.61–0.66, the sides nearly parallel, widest at the middle, the posterior margin together with the posterolateral corners broadly rounded. The middle of the dorsal margin of the head is arched to varying degrees, the frontal region flat and lower than the dorsal summit, the frontal slope about sixty degrees, the interfrontal area slightly forked and concave. The labrum is sharply spear-shaped, the transparent region at the apex a small triangle, the apex a short needle-like point, the apical hairs present, the subapical hairs well developed, the dorsal labral hairs all rather long, the lateral-apical hairs absent. The mandibles are rather straight, their apices rather pointed and nearly straight; the mandibles 0.55–0.62 times the head capsule length and 0.84–0.99 times the head width. Antennae with 16 segments. The broad region of the postmentum lies at about the anterior quarter, the anterolateral margins nearly trapezoidal and expanding posteriorly, the waist region narrow and long with the sides slightly arcuate, the waist constriction index 0.33–0.37. The pronotum is about 1.7 times as wide as long, the middle of the anterior margin fork-shaped concave, the middle of the posterior margin slightly concave, with more than ten hairs in the middle region.

/species/reticulitermes-lii/.alate: The head is brown tinged with black, the labrum and postclypeus greyish brown, the anteclypeus white; the antennae pale blackish brown with white between the segments, the compound eyes blackish brown, the ocelli pale yellow, the antennal spots brown; the pronotum and the femoral and tibial segments of the legs all greyish yellow, the wings pale blackish brown. The head capsule is round with squarish tendencies, the fontanelle dot-like, about 0.48 mm from the anterior frontal margin. The compound eyes are roundly triangular, the projection rate 2–5 per cent, the short diameter greater than the distance from the compound eye to the lower margin of the head. The ocelli are oval, the ocellus-compound eye distance roughly comparable to the short diameter of the ocellus. Antennae with 16 segments. The postclypeus projects, almost level with the vertex and higher than the ocelli. The anterior margin of the pronotum is slightly upturned, composed of two broad arcs, with a shallow U-shaped median notch, the middle of the posterior margin with a shallow incision, its width about 1.46–1.52 times its length. The forewing 6.73–6.88 mm long and 1.6–1.72 mm wide; the hindwing 6.27–6.58 mm long and 1.6–1.72 mm wide; the branches of the Cu vein about ten each.
/species/reticulitermes-lii/.soldier: Head pale yellowish brown, mandibles reddish brown, the pilosity of the head capsule moderate. The head capsule is rectangular, the head width index 0.56–0.63, the sides nearly parallel and slightly constricted behind the antennal sockets; the frontal ridge is raised, nearly flat between the ridges. The labrum is lingulate, the apex bluntly rounded, the apical and subapical hairs both present, the lateral-apical hairs reduced. The apices of the mandibles are rather curved, the mandibular condyle visible, its length 0.5–0.57 times the head capsule length and 0.87–0.95 times the head width. Antennae with 14–15 segments. The broadest region of the postmentum lies at the anterior one-fifth, the anterolateral margins trapezoidal, the middle slightly concave; the waist region narrow and long with the sides parallel, the waist constriction index 0.31–0.39. The pronotum is about 1.45–1.58 times as wide as long, the anterior margin with a broad V-shaped shallow notch, the middle of the posterior margin slightly concave, with about thirty hairs in the middle region.
/species/reticulitermes-lii/.taxonomy_note: The genus name is printed in the original work as Reticuliter mes, a misspelling of Reticulitermes; it is now assigned to the genus Reticulitermes.

/species/reticulitermes-longicephalus/.soldier: Soldier head pale yellowish brown, the thorax and abdomen pale yellowish white, the hairs on the head capsule sparse and those of the abdomen rather dense. The head capsule is rectangular, the lateral margins nearly parallel and slightly narrowed at the middle, the posterolateral corners broad and rounded. The frontal ridge is distinctly raised, the labrum spear-shaped. The mandibles are short and hook-like, the antennae with 14 segments. The anterior broad region of the postmentum is pentagonal, the waist narrow. The median notch of the anterior margin of the pronotum is very deep, the posterior margin only shallowly concave, the hairs of the middle region fine and small, about eight in number.

/species/reticulitermes-longigulus/.alate: Head capsule light blackish brown; postmentum and femoral segments concolorous with the head; pronotum and tibiae greyish yellow; labrum and postclypeus light greyish brown; wings light brown with a blackish tinge. Head capsule roundish-square; fontanelle dot-like, about 0.48 mm from the anterior margin of the frons. Compound eyes rounded-triangular, protrusion 5–7%, short diameter greater than the distance from the compound eye to the lower margin of the head. Ocelli nearly circular; ocellus–compound eye distance equal to or slightly less than the short diameter of the ocellus. Dorsal margin of the head gently arched; postclypeus projecting, lower than the vertex, about level with the ocelli. Antennae 16–17 segments. Pronotum about 1.48–1.53 times as wide as long, anterior margin shallowly concave in the middle, posterior margin distinctly incised in the middle. Forewing 7.5–8.16 mm long, 1.91–1.99 mm wide; hindwing 7.04–7.48 mm long, 1.91–1.99 mm wide; Cu vein with about 14 branches in the forewing and about 11 in the hindwing.
/species/reticulitermes-longigulus/.biology: Host record: Dabie Mountains pine (Pinus dabeshanensis).
/species/reticulitermes-longigulus/.soldier: Head pale yellow, mandibles purplish brown, pilosity of the head capsule moderate. Head capsule rectangular, head-width index 0.56–0.59, lateral margins parallel, posterior margin broadly rounded. Frontal peaks distinctly raised, with a depression between the two peaks. Labrum lanceolate, narrow and pointed at the apex, but without a sharp tip; one apical seta and one subapical seta on each side. Mandibles rather curved at the apex, mandibular basal ridge visible; mandible length 0.48–0.53 times head capsule length and 0.83–0.88 times head width. Antennae 16–17 segments. Broad region of the postmentum about at the anterior quarter; anterior lateral margins trapezoidal, the middle section slightly concave; waist region slightly broad, margins parallel, waist constriction index 0.38–0.42. Pronotum trapezoidal, 1.46–1.55 times as wide as long, anterior and posterior margins both nearly straight, the anterior margin shallowly incised in the middle; about 20 setae in the middle region.

/species/reticulitermes-longipennis/.alate: Head capsule light chestnut brown; labrum, postclypeus, postmentum and femora nearly yellowish brown; pronotum and tibiae light yellowish brown; antennae brownish. Head capsule circular and slightly elongate; fontanelle dot-like, 0.48 mm from the anterior margin of the frons. In profile the vertex is slightly arched, the anterior margin of the postclypeus distinctly projecting, almost level with the vertex and higher than the ocelli. Compound eyes nearly circular, protrusion 4%, short diameter about equal to the distance from the compound eye to the lower margin of the head. Ocelli oval; short diameter greater than the ocellus–compound eye distance. Antennae 16–17 segments. Pronotum about 1.43 times as wide as long, anterior margin with a distinct broad V-shaped incision in the middle, posterior margin nearly straight with an indistinct incision. Forewing 7.34–7.8 mm long, 1.83–2.17 mm wide; hindwing 6.73–7.34 mm long, 1.75–1.99 mm wide; forewing Cu vein with about 14 branches.
/species/reticulitermes-longipennis/.taxonomy_note: The genus name is printed as Reticuliter mes in the original work, a misspelling of Reticulitermes; the species is here placed in Reticulitermes.

/species/reticulitermes-luofunicus/.soldier: Head pale yellow, mandibles blackish brown, pilosity of the head capsule sparse. Head capsule rectangular, head-width index about 0.62, lateral margins slightly arcuate and slightly widened posteriorly, posterior margin broadly rounded. Frontal peaks slightly raised. Labrum sharply lanceolate, apex shortly needle-like, apical setae present, lateral apical setae present or absent. Mandibles stout, apex strongly curved; mandible length about 0.59 times head capsule length and 0.95 times head width. Antennae 16–17 segments. Broad region of the postmentum before the anterior fifth; waist region narrow and elongate, margins nearly parallel, waist constriction index about 0.30. Pronotum kidney-shaped, about 1.75 times as wide as long, anterior margin shallowly concave in the middle, posterior margin distinctly incised in the middle; about 4 setae in the middle region.

/species/reticulitermes-majiangensis/.soldier: Head pale yellow, mandibles reddish brown, pilosity of the head capsule sparse. Head capsule rectangular, head-width index 0.60–0.63, lateral margins nearly parallel, the posterior part slightly widened, posterior margin slightly projecting. Frontal peaks slightly raised, with a slight depression between them. Labrum sharply lanceolate, the semi-transparent area at its tip shortly needle-like; apical setae present, subapical setae distinct, lateral apical setae absent. Mandibles slightly straight, apex slightly curved; mandible length 0.55–0.57 times head capsule length and 0.90–0.93 times head width. Antennae 15–16 segments. Broad region of the postmentum at the anterior sixth; anterior lateral margins nearly trapezoidal and widening posteriorly, the middle section slightly concave; waist region narrow and long, margins parallel, waist constriction index 0.29–0.33. Pronotum trapezoidal, about 1.63–1.68 times as wide as long, anterior and posterior margins nearly straight, the incisions at the middle of both margins nearly equal; 4–6 setae in the middle region.

/species/reticulitermes-mangshanensis/.distribution: Mount Mang, Yizhang, Hunan (altitude about 500 m).
/species/reticulitermes-mangshanensis/.soldier: Head, labrum, antennae and pronotum of the soldier yellow; posterior part of the head and posterior half of the pronotum paler; mandibles brown with a reddish tinge; thorax and abdomen pale yellowish white. Head sparsely beset with setae; apical setae and lateral apical setae of the labrum prominent; setae on the tergites of the thorax and abdomen rather numerous. Head shaped like an elongated trapezoid combined with an oval, widest posteriorly near the turn of the two posterior lateral margins; frons flat or slightly raised, not elevated above the dorsal surface of the occiput; fontanelle situated in the depression behind the frontal peaks, appearing as a small brown dot. Labrum ligulate, transparent area absent or very short, apex rounded and blunt. Mandibles rather slender and straight; left mandible 0.85–0.93 times the greatest head width, apex slightly curved. Antennae 15–17 segments, the fourth the shortest. Anterior margin of the pronotum with a rather broad and deep incision in the middle, posterior margin with a shallower incision.
/species/reticulitermes-mangshanensis/.taxonomy_note: The species was placed in Tsaitermes in the original work; it is here placed in Reticulitermes.

/species/reticulitermes-microcephalus/.taxonomy_note: The genus name is printed as Reticuliter mes in the original work, a misspelling of Reticulitermes; the species is here placed in Reticulitermes.

/species/reticulitermes-minutus/.soldier: Head capsule rectangular, head-width index 0.63–0.65, lateral margins nearly parallel, posterior margin broadly rounded. Frontal peaks slightly raised, their tops broad and rounded, the space between them rather flat with several shallow longitudinal striae. Labrum lanceolate, narrow and rounded at the apex, with two apical setae; subapical setae short, lateral apical setae absent. Mandibles slender and slightly curved at the apex, 0.59–0.62 times head capsule length but shorter than the head width. Antennae 14–15 segments. Postmentum 7–9 times as long as the waist constriction, waist constriction index 0.34–0.36, ratio of waist width to head width about 1:6 to 1:7. Pronotum about 1.4–1.6 times as wide as long, anterior margin formed by the intersection of two arcs, lateral margins narrowly rounded and extending posteriorly, posterior margin shallowly incised in the middle; more than 30 setae in the middle region.
/species/reticulitermes-minutus/.taxonomy_note: The genus name is printed as Reticuliter mes in the original work, a misspelling of Reticulitermes; the species is here placed in Reticulitermes.

/species/reticulitermes-mirogulus/.alate: Head capsule brownish yellow, pronotum yellow, tibiae pale yellow. Head capsule nearly circular, frontal region slightly concave, dorsal margin of the head slightly raised. Fontanelle dot-like; compound eyes nearly circular, their short diameter greater than the distance from the compound eye to the lower margin of the head; ocelli oval, long diameter about twice the ocellus–compound eye distance. Antennae 17 segments in total. Anterior margin of the pronotum slightly incised in the middle, posterior margin with a distinct incision in the middle. Forewing narrow and long, about 3.5 times as long as wide, cubital vein with 10–11 branches.

/species/reticulitermes-mirus/.soldier: Head brownish yellow, mandibles reddish brown, pilosity of the head capsule sparse. Head capsule rectangular, head-width index about 0.57, lateral margins nearly parallel, the posterior half slightly narrowed, posterior margin broad and rounded. Frontal peaks distinctly raised. Antennae broken off; the scale covering the antennal socket upturned, forming a short lid. Labrum broadly ligulate, broad and rounded at the apex, with apical and subapical setae, the lateral apical setae reduced and minute. Mandibles stout, apex rather curved, with the mandibular basal ridge; length about 0.52 times head capsule length and about 0.92 times head width. Waist region of the postmentum narrow and elongate, waist constriction index 0.35, postmentum 9.5 times as long as the waist constriction. Pronotum about 1.55 times as wide as long, anterior margin nearly straight with a distinct incision in the middle, the posterior lateral corners together with the posterior margin forming a broad arc, the posterior margin also incised in the middle; setae in the middle region abundant and dense.
/species/reticulitermes-mirus/.taxonomy_note: The genus name is printed as Reticuliter mes in the original work, a misspelling of Reticulitermes; the species is here placed in Reticulitermes.

/species/reticulitermes-nanjiangensis/.soldier: Head greyish yellow, frontal region grey with a blackish tinge, pilosity of the head capsule moderate and slightly dense. Head capsule rectangular, head-width index 0.60–0.66, lateral margins parallel, posterior margin broadly rounded. Frons flat. Labrum lanceolate, apex bluntly rounded, labral setae well developed, the apical, subapical and lateral apical setae all rather long. Mandibles slender and straight, apex pointed and slightly curved; mandible length 0.63–0.66 times head capsule length and 1.01–1.05 times head width. Antennae 15–16 segments. Broad region of the postmentum about at the anterior quarter, anterior lateral margins nearly parallel and then widening; waist region narrow, its sides broadly arcuate, waist constriction index 0.23–0.28. Pronotum nearly kidney-shaped, about 1.4–1.6 times as wide as long, anterior and posterior margins both shallowly concave in the middle, the anterior deeper than the posterior; more than 20 long setae in the middle region.

/species/reticulitermes-neochinensis/.soldier: Head light yellowish brown, mandibles brown with a reddish tinge and slightly transparent, head setae sparse. Head capsule rectangular, head-width index 0.59–0.62, lateral margins parallel, posterior margin straight, frons flat. Labrum lanceolate, apex triangular, the apical, subapical and lateral apical setae all distinct. Mandibles rather stout, the curved apex short; mandible length 0.55–0.58 times head capsule length and 0.89–0.95 times head width. Antennae 15–16 segments. Broad region of the postmentum before the anterior fifth; waist region long and nearly parallel, waist constriction index 0.33–0.39. Pronotum trapezoidal and rather high, 1.43–1.55 times as wide as long, anterior incision broad and deep, posterior incision very shallow; more than 10 setae in the middle region.

/species/reticulitermes-oocephalus/.soldier: Head of the soldier orange-yellow, thorax and abdomen pale yellow, pilosity sparse throughout. Head oval, 1.33–1.49 times as long as wide, very slightly raised in profile. Labrum lanceolate, about 1.14–1.49 times as long as wide, the semi-transparent area narrow and rounded-projecting. Mandibles 0.64–0.72 times head capsule length, apex slender and straight. Margin of the lacinia with about 10 setae. Postmentum slightly broad. Antennae 14–15 segments. Pronotum 1.59–1.69 times as wide as long, the anterior incision deeper than the posterior one.
/species/reticulitermes-oocephalus/.taxonomy_note: The species was placed in Tsaitermes in the original work; it is here placed in Reticulitermes.

/species/reticulitermes-oreophilus/.distribution: Huaping Forest Region, Longsheng, Guangxi (altitude about 1300 m).
/species/reticulitermes-oreophilus/.soldier: Head of the soldier pale yellow, labrum and antennae even paler, mandibles brownish red, thorax and abdomen yellow. Apical setae and lateral apical setae of the labrum distinct, subapical setae short. Setae in the middle region of the pronotum weak and sparse, only about 10. Head oval, narrow anteriorly and broad posteriorly, the transparent area at the labral tip bluntly rounded and projecting. Mandibles rather slender and elongate; left mandible 0.91 times the greatest head width and 0.66 times head capsule length, apex slender and straight. Antennae 15 segments, the third the shortest. Anterior margin of the pronotum with a broad incision, posterior margin more deeply incised in the middle; width about 1.63 times the length, median emargination index 22%.
/species/reticulitermes-oreophilus/.taxonomy_note: The species was placed in Tsaitermes in the original work; it is here placed in Reticulitermes.

/species/reticulitermes-ovatilabrum/.soldier: Head pale brown, mandibles purplish brown, pronotum yellowish brown, setae on the head capsule rather sparse. Head capsule rectangular, head-width index 0.51–0.54, lateral margins parallel, posterior margin straight. Frontal peaks strongly raised, concave between the peaks. Labrum ligulate, shaped like an upright egg, broad and rounded at the apex; apical, subapical and lateral apical setae of similar length. Mandibles short and stout, apex strongly curved, mandibular basal ridge projecting; mandible length 0.48–0.49 times head capsule length and 0.86–0.95 times head width. Antennae 17 segments. Broad region of the postmentum behind about the anterior sixth, the anterior lateral margins parallel and then abruptly widening posteriorly; waist region narrow and elongate, margins parallel, waist constriction index 0.29–0.38. Pronotum trapezoidal, about 1.5–1.6 times as wide as long, anterior margin with a broad V-shaped shallow concavity, posterior margin slightly concave in the middle; nearly 30 setae in the middle region.
/species/reticulitermes-ovatilabrum/.taxonomy_note: The genus name is printed as Reticuliter mes in the original work, a misspelling of Reticulitermes; the species is here placed in Reticulitermes.

/species/reticulitermes-paralucifugus/.soldier: Head light yellowish brown, mandibles purplish brown, pronotum paler than the head, pilosity of the head capsule sparse. Head capsule rectangular, head-width index 0.61–0.64, lateral margins slightly widening posteriorly, posterior margin broad and rounded. Frontal surface flat, only slightly depressed between the two peaks. Labrum broadly lanceolate, its apex extending forward to before the mid-point of the mandibles, narrow, rounded and semi-transparent at the tip; apical, subapical and lateral apical setae short and slender. Mandibular apex slightly curved, mandibular basal ridge visible; left mandible about 0.83–0.87 times head width. Antennae 16 segments, the fourth the shortest. Postmentum widest at the anterior fifth, 6.75–7.35 times as long as the waist constriction; head width 5.9–6.4 times the waist constriction. Anterior margin of the pronotum with a broad forked incision, posterior margin almost straight in the middle, median emargination index about 12%; more than 20 setae in the middle region.

/species/reticulitermes-parvus/.alate: Head capsule dark brown with a reddish tinge, postmentum concolorous with the head capsule; antennae, labrum and postclypeus brown; compound eyes greyish black, eye ring and ocelli pale brownish yellow; pronotum dark brown; wings pale yellowish brown; femora brown, tibiae and tarsi pale yellowish brown. Head capsule elongate-oval, fontanelle dot-like, 0.39–0.41 mm from the frontal margin; in profile the vertex arched, the postclypeus slightly projecting and lower than the vertex. Compound eyes rounded-triangular, larger than the distance from the compound eye to the lower margin of the head, protrusion 7–8%. Short diameter of the ocellus more than twice the ocellus–compound eye distance. Postclypeus about 5 times as wide as long, the median suture visible. Pronotum 1.36–1.40 times as wide as long, anterior margin broadly incised, lateral margins gently sloping posteriorly, posterior margin shallowly notched in the middle.
/species/reticulitermes-parvus/.biology: Specimens collected from the roots of Pinus massoniana.
/species/reticulitermes-parvus/.distribution: Longquan, Zhejiang (altitude 1050 m); also recorded elsewhere in the province.
/species/reticulitermes-parvus/.soldier: Head capsule rectangular, head-width index 0.60, lateral margins nearly parallel and slightly widening posteriorly, posterior margin broadly rounded. Frontal peaks slightly raised, slightly concave between them. Labrum ligulate, apex narrow and rounded, apical setae present, subapical setae minute. Mandibles slender, apex slightly curved; mandible length 0.60 times head capsule length and 1.02 times head width. Antennae 14–15 segments. Broad region of the postmentum before the anterior quarter, waist constriction index 0.34. Pronotum 1.44 times as wide as long, the incisions at the middle of the anterior and posterior margins both rather distinct, lateral margins gently sloping posteriorly; about 20 setae in the middle region.

/species/reticulitermes-perangustus/.soldier: Head yellowish brown, mandibles purplish brown, pilosity of the head capsule moderate. Head capsule rectangular, head-width index 0.54–0.58, lateral margins nearly parallel, slightly narrowed behind the antennal sockets, posterior margin nearly straight. Frontal peaks slightly raised. Labrum lanceolate, apex narrow and rounded, apical setae present, subapical setae very small, lateral apical setae absent. Mandibles short and stout, apex short, pointed and strongly curved, mandibular basal ridge distinct; mandible length 0.47–0.52 times head capsule length and 0.87–0.91 times head width. Antennae 17–18 segments. Broad region of the postmentum before the anterior fifth, anterior lateral margins nearly trapezoidal; waist region slender and long, margins parallel, waist index 0.30–0.35. Pronotum trapezoidal, 1.6–1.7 times as wide as long, anterior margin with a broad forked shallow concavity, posterior margin very shallowly incised; about 30 setae in the middle region.

/species/reticulitermes-periflaviceps/.soldier: Head pale yellow, mandibles purplish brown, thorax, abdomen and legs white with a yellowish tinge, short setae scattered over the head capsule. Head capsule rectangular, head-width index 0.61–0.64, lateral margins nearly parallel and slightly widening posteriorly, posterior margin broadly rounded. Frontal pore dot-like, situated behind the anterior third. Frons of the single-peak type; in profile the frontal peak is moderately raised with an anterior slope of about 40 degrees and a posterior slope of about 160 degrees. Labrum lanceolate, about 1.2 times as long as wide, apical setae rather long and subapical setae minute. Mandibles sabre-shaped, apex slightly curved, left mandible 0.6–0.62 times head capsule length. Antennae 15 segments, the third or fourth the shortest. Anterior lateral margins of the postmentum trapezoidal, widest at the anterior fifth; waist region in the middle, margins parallel, postmentum 7.35–7.62 times as long as the waist width, waist constriction index 0.4–0.41. Pronotum 1.49–1.66 times as wide as long, anterior margin broadly incised, posterior margin shallowly concave in the middle; about 20 long setae in the middle region.
/species/reticulitermes-periflaviceps/.taxonomy_note: The genus name is printed as Reticuliter mes in the original work, a misspelling of Reticulitermes; the species is here placed in Reticulitermes.

/species/reticulitermes-perilabralis/.soldier: Head pale yellowish brown, mandibles dark brown, pilosity of the head capsule sparse. Head capsule rectangular, head-width index 0.61–0.65, lateral margins roughly parallel and slightly widening posteriorly, posterior margin an even arc. Frontal peaks slightly raised, slightly concave between the peaks. Labrum ligulate, apex broad and rounded, apical, subapical and lateral apical setae all present. Mandibles slightly stout at the apex, curved and slightly upturned; length about 0.51–0.56 times head capsule length and 0.81–0.87 times head width. Antennae 16–17 segments. Widest part of the postmentum at the anterior fifth, anterior lateral margins trapezoidal; waist region rather broad with parallel margins, waist constriction index 0.38–0.48. Pronotum kidney-shaped, 1.6–1.7 times as wide as long, anterior and posterior margins both shallowly concave in the middle; more than 10 setae in the middle region.
/species/reticulitermes-perilabralis/.taxonomy_note: The letters of the genus name are defective in the original work, printed as Reticuliter mes; this is in fact Reticulitermes, the same genus name as used on this site.

/species/reticulitermes-perilucifugus/.soldier: Head yellowish brown, pronotum yellow, abdomen pale yellow. Head capsule rectangular, head-width index 0.66, lateral margins almost parallel and slightly extending posteriorly, posterior margin broadly rounded. Frontal peaks very weakly raised, shallowly concave between them. Labrum lanceolate, length and width nearly equal, apical and subapical setae present, lateral apical setae absent. Mandibles stout and short, left mandible about 0.83–0.86 times head width and about 0.55–0.57 times head capsule length, apex slightly curved, the basal ridge on the outer margin discernible. Antennae 16 segments. Waist constriction index of the postmentum 0.38–0.43; head width about 7 times the waist constriction, postmentum about 6–7 times the waist constriction. Pronotum about 1.6–1.7 times as wide as long, the incision at the anterior margin deeper than at the posterior margin, lateral margins steeply sloping posteriorly; 20 long setae or thereabouts in the middle region.
/species/reticulitermes-perilucifugus/.taxonomy_note: The letters of the genus name are defective in the original work, printed as Reticuliter mes; this is in fact Reticulitermes, the same genus name as used on this site.

/species/reticulitermes-pingjiangensis/.alate: Head capsule of the dealate adult blackish brown; postmentum, labrum and postclypeus brown; anteclypeus white; antennae brown with the basal segment darker; compound eyes black, eye ring and ocelli pale brown; pronotum yellowish grey; femora brown, tibiae yellowish grey, pale brown near the femora. Head capsule nearly circular, slightly longer than wide, frontal region rather flat, fontanelle dot-like, 0.35 mm from the frontal margin, median suture indistinct; in profile the vertex is gently raised above the ocelli, the postclypeus weakly projecting, higher than the ocelli and lower than the vertex. Compound eyes rounded-triangular, protrusion 6%, short diameter slightly greater than the distance from the compound eye to the lower margin of the head. Ocelli circular and slightly flattened, short diameter equal to the ocellus–compound eye distance. Antennae 17 segments. Pronotum 1.47 times as wide as long, anterior margin rather flat, lateral margins gradually narrowing posteriorly, posterior margin distinctly notched in the middle, median emargination index 15%.
/species/reticulitermes-pingjiangensis/.soldier: Head orange-yellow, mandibles brownish, antennae and pronotum cream-yellow, head setae moderate. Head capsule rectangular, head-width index 0.57–0.62, lateral margins nearly parallel, slightly narrowed posteriorly, posterior margin slightly rounded. Frontal peaks distinctly raised, shallowly concave between them. Labrum elongate-lanceolate, the anterior part narrowed into a triangle, lateral apical setae absent. Mandibles solid and long, apex slightly curved, mandibular basal ridge visible; length 0.55–0.57 times head capsule length and 0.92–0.98 times head width. Antennae 15–17 segments. Broad region of the postmentum before the anterior sixth; waist region slender and long or broadly arcuate, waist constriction index 0.31–0.35. Pronotum ob-trapezoidal, anterior and posterior margins both shallowly incised in the middle; about 30 setae in the middle region.
/species/reticulitermes-pingjiangensis/.taxonomy_note: The genus name is printed as Reticuliter mes in the original work, a misspelling of Reticulitermes; the species is here placed in Reticulitermes.

/species/reticulitermes-planifrons/.soldier: Head orange-yellow, thorax and abdomen pale yellow, pilosity of the body sparse. Head capsule rectangular, head-width index 0.60–0.64, lateral margins parallel, frontal region flat. Labrum lanceolate, about 1.02–1.23 times as long as wide, the semi-transparent area at the apex narrow and rounded, apical and lateral apical setae well developed, subapical setae and labral ridge setae present or reduced. Mandibles about 0.52–0.56 times head capsule length and 0.84–0.89 times head width, apex slightly curved, the middle section rather stout; a minute tooth lies below the basal notch of each mandible, and the basal ridge on the outer margin is indistinct. About 8 setae along the margin of the lacinia. Narrow region of the postmentum slightly broad, waist constriction index 0.30–0.34. Pronotum about 1.45 times as wide as long, the incisions of the anterior and posterior margins both rather deep, median emargination index 15–21%; about 30 setae in the middle region.

/species/reticulitermes-planimentus/.soldier: Head pale yellow, mandibles reddish brown, pilosity of the head capsule sparse. Head capsule rectangular, head-width index 0.58–0.61, lateral margins nearly parallel, the posterior part slightly widened, posterior margin slightly arcuate and convex. Frontal peaks slightly raised, slightly concave between them. Labrum sharply lanceolate, the semi-transparent area at its tip shortly needle-shaped, apical and subapical setae both present. Mandibles rather straight, the apex strongly curved but the curved part very short, mandibular basal ridge present, thickened below the middle; length 0.54–0.57 of head capsule length and 0.91–0.97 of head width. Antennae 17 segments. Widest part of the postmentum between the anterior seventh and the anterior sixth, anterior lateral margins nearly parallel and then slightly spreading; waist region slender and long, margins parallel, waist constriction index 0.27–0.31. Pronotum somewhat trapezoidal, about 1.56–1.66 times as wide as long, anterior and posterior margins nearly straight, the V-shaped incision at the middle of the anterior margin very shallow; 4–6 long setae in the middle region.
/species/reticulitermes-planimentus/.taxonomy_note: The letters of the genus name are defective in the original work, printed as Reticuliter mes; this is in fact Reticulitermes, the same genus name as used on this site.

/species/reticulitermes-pseudaculabialis.alate: Head capsule blackish brown, pronotum also blackish brown, labrum, postclypeus and antennae light blackish brown, tibiae and tarsi brownish yellow. Head capsule elongate-oval, compound eyes rather small, their greatest diameter slightly greater than the distance from the compound eye to the lower margin of the head. Ocelli nearly circular, diameter slightly greater than the distance between ocellus and compound eye. Antennae 17–18 segments. Vertex gently arched, postclypeus projecting, situated lower than the vertex and higher than the ocelli. Anterior margin of the pronotum straight; the incision at the middle of the anterior margin narrower and shallower than that at the middle of the posterior margin. Wings narrow and long, cubital vein with 9–11 branches.
/species/reticulitermes-pseudaculabialis.soldier: Head pale yellowish brown, mandibles purplish brown, pilosity of the head capsule rather sparse. Head capsule rectangular, head-width index 0.60, lateral margins nearly parallel, the middle of the posterior margin straight, posterior lateral corners broadly rounded. Frontal region slightly raised, flat between the peaks. Labrum lanceolate, apex triangular, apical and subapical setae present, lateral apical setae slender and short. Mandibles short and stout, apex strongly curved, mandibular basal ridge visible; length 0.50 of head capsule length and 0.80–0.84 of head width. Antennae 17–18 segments. Widest part of the postmentum at the anterior fifth, anterior lateral margins trapezoidal and widening posteriorly, the middle section slightly concave; waist region narrow and long, margins nearly parallel, waist constriction index 0.39–0.41. Pronotum somewhat trapezoidal, about 1.56 times as wide as long, anterior margin with a broad V-shaped shallow concavity, posterior margin slightly concave in the middle; more than 20 setae in the middle region.
/species/reticulitermes-pseudaculabialis.taxonomy_note: The letters of the genus name are defective in the original work, printed as Reticuliter mes; this is in fact Reticulitermes, the same genus name as used on this site.

/species/reticulitermes-rectis/.soldier: Head dark yellowish brown, mandibles dark reddish brown, pilosity of the head capsule moderate. Head capsule rectangular, head-width index 0.54–0.59, lateral margins parallel, the middle of the posterior margin straight; frontal peaks slightly raised, the two peaks distinguishable. Labrum ligulate, broadly rounded at the apex, but the transparent tip slightly pointed and nearly triangular; apical and subapical setae present, lateral apical setae slender and short. Mandibles rather stout, apex slightly more curved; length 0.55–0.57 of head capsule length and 0.94–0.98 of head width. Antennae incomplete. Widest part of the postmentum at the anterior fifth, anterior lateral margins trapezoidal and widening posteriorly; waist region slender and long, waist constriction index 0.26–0.30. Pronotum trapezoidal, 1.5–1.6 times as wide as long, anterior and posterior margins both nearly straight, the anterior margin shallowly notched in the middle, the posterior margin with almost no visible incision; about 16 setae in the middle region.
/species/reticulitermes-rectis/.taxonomy_note: The letters of the genus name are defective in the original work, printed as Reticuliter mes; this is in fact Reticulitermes, the same genus name as used on this site.

/species/reticulitermes-setosus/.biology: Host: Schima (Schima superba); specimens collected from its roots.
/species/reticulitermes-setosus/.soldier: Head pale yellowish brown, mandibles brown and slightly transparent, pilosity of the head capsule rather dense. Head capsule rectangular, head-width index 0.58–0.61, lateral margins parallel, posterior margin nearly straight. Frontal region slightly raised, slightly concave between the peaks. Labrum ligulate, broadly rounded at the apex, apical, subapical and lateral apical setae of nearly equal length, the setae in the middle of the labral surface also rather long. Mandibles long and strong, apex slightly elongate and curved, mandibular basal ridge distinct; length 0.57–0.61 of head capsule length and 0.96–1.03 of head width. Antennae 15–16 segments. Broad region of the postmentum at the anterior fifth, its anterior lateral margins trapezoidal; waist region slender and long with parallel margins, waist constriction index 0.26–0.30. Pronotum trapezoidal, 1.43–1.54 times as wide as long, anterior margin shallowly notched in the middle, posterior margin nearly straight; nearly 30 long setae in the middle region.
/species/reticulitermes-setosus/.taxonomy_note: The letters of the genus name are defective in the original work, printed as Reticuliter mes; this is in fact Reticulitermes, the same genus name as used on this site.

/species/reticulitermes-solidimandibulas.soldier: Head capsule yellowish brown, mandibles reddish brown, pilosity moderate. Head capsule rectangular, head-width index 0.54–0.59, lateral margins nearly parallel, the middle or posterior part slightly narrowed, posterior margin largely straight. Frontal peaks raised but not high, slightly concave between them. Labrum sharply lanceolate, the apex shortly pointed, or shortly needle-shaped or nipple-shaped; apical setae long, subapical setae minute or slightly longer, lateral apical setae present or absent. Mandibles stout and long with the apex strongly curved; left mandible 0.52–0.62 times head capsule length and 0.95–1.06 times head width. Antennae 15–16 segments. Widest part of the postmentum at the anterior sixth, anterior lateral margins nearly trapezoidal; waist region slender and long with parallel margins, waist constriction index 0.29–0.33. Pronotum kidney-shaped, anterior and posterior margins both shallowly concave in the middle; 8–10 setae or slightly more in the middle region.
/species/reticulitermes-solidimandibulas.taxonomy_note: The letters of the genus name are defective in the original work, printed as Reticuliter mes; this is in fact Reticulitermes, the same genus name as used on this site.

/species/reticulitermes-speratus/.alate: Head capsule dark chestnut brown, pronotum greyish yellow, postmentum, labrum, postclypeus and femora chestnut brown, tibiae greyish yellow, wings pale brown and semi-transparent. Head capsule circular and rather short, fontanelle a small dot, 0.51–0.53 mm from the anterior margin of the frons. Compound eyes nearly circular, protrusion 2–4%; distance from the compound eye to the lower margin of the head less than the long diameter of the compound eye. Ocelli nearly circular, ocellus–compound eye distance about equal to the short diameter of the ocellus. Antennae 16–17 segments. Dorsal margin of the head mound-shaped, postclypeus almost not projecting, lower than the vertex and higher than the ocelli. Pronotum about 1.6–1.65 times as wide as long, anterior margin nearly straight and shallowly notched in the middle, posterior margin formed by two intersecting arcs with a deeper notch. Forewing 7.04–7.26 mm long, 1.84–1.99 mm wide; hindwing 6.88–7.04 mm long, 1.84–1.91 mm wide; Cu vein with about 8–10 branches in each.
/species/reticulitermes-speratus/.distribution: Dandong and Dalian, Liaoning; coastal areas of Hebei; and Beijing and Tianjin.
/species/reticulitermes-speratus/.soldier: Head capsule rectangular, head-width index 0.63–0.72, lateral margins nearly parallel and slightly widening posteriorly, posterior margin broadly rounded. Frontal peaks slightly raised, nearly flat between the two peaks. Labrum ligulate, apex bluntly rounded, narrowly rounded in a few individuals; one pair of apical setae, subapical setae almost invisible, lateral apical setae absent. Mandibles slightly stout, apex slightly curved; mandible length 0.58–0.61 times head capsule length and 0.88–0.92 times head width. Antennae 15–16 segments. Broad region of the postmentum at the anterior fifth, anterior lateral margins nearly trapezoidal, the middle section slightly concave; waist region with nearly parallel margins, waist constriction index 0.33–0.38. Pronotum nearly trapezoidal, 1.5–1.66 times as wide as long, anterior and posterior margins nearly straight, anterior margin shallowly concave in the middle, posterior margin slightly concave in the middle; setae in the middle region sparse, about 4–8.
/species/reticulitermes-speratus/.taxonomy_note: The genus name is printed as Reticuliter mes in the original work, a misspelling of Reticulitermes; the species is here placed in Reticulitermes.

/species/reticulitermes-subligulosus/.soldier: Head pale yellow, mandibles brown, pilosity moderate. Head capsule rectangular, head-width index 0.62–0.65, lateral margins parallel, posterior margin broadly rounded, frontal region flat. Labrum ligulate, apex bluntly rounded, apical and subapical setae together with the longer lateral apical setae present. Mandibles nearly straight at the apex and slightly curved; length 0.57–0.63 of head capsule length and 0.92–0.99 of head width. Antennae 14–15 segments. Broad region of the postmentum at the anterior fifth; waist region slender and short, its sides broadly arcuate towards front and rear, waist constriction index 0.26–0.29. Pronotum kidney-shaped, about 1.46–1.56 times as wide as long, anterior and posterior margins both shallowly concave in the middle, the anterior slightly deeper, lateral margins converging steeply posteriorly; about 20 setae in the middle region.
/species/reticulitermes-subligulosus/.taxonomy_note: The letters of the genus name are defective in the original work, printed as Reticuliter mes; this is in fact Reticulitermes, the same genus name as used on this site.

/species/reticulitermes-sublongicapitatu.soldier: Head of the soldier yellowish brown, head capsule exceptionally long, lateral margins nearly parallel. Frontal peaks almost not raised. Labrum lanceolate, apex bluntly rounded, bearing two apical setae. Mandibles strong, apex strongly curved; antennae 14–15 segments. Postmentum very long. Anterior margin of the pronotum rather deeply incised in the middle, posterior margin nearly straight; about 8 long setae in the middle region.

/species/reticulitermes-sylvestris/.alate: Head blackish brown, postmentum pale greyish yellow, pronotum greyish yellow with the anterior margin pale brown, tergites and sternites of the abdomen blackish brown; wings and femora pale blackish brown, the fore legs paler, tibiae and tarsi pale greyish yellow, body setae yellow. Head capsule circular, slightly longer than wide; labrum hemispherical, postclypeus fan-shaped, median suture indistinct. Frontal region shallowly concave, antennal patch smooth and slightly paler. Compound eyes flattened-oval, protrusion 4–5%. In profile the postclypeus weakly projecting, slightly lower than the vertex; fontanelle dot-like, at the same level as the postclypeus. Distance from the compound eye to the lower margin of the head shorter than the long diameter of the compound eye; distance from the compound eye to the antennal socket about two-fifths of the distance from the ocellus to the antennal socket. Antennae 16 segments, the third and fourth the shortest. Pronotum 1.57–1.6 times as wide as long, anterior margin slightly upturned and shallowly concave in the middle, the median line visible, posterior margin notched in the middle, median emargination index 8–10%; long and short setae abundant in the middle region.
/species/reticulitermes-sylvestris/.soldier: Head pale yellowish brown, mandibles purplish brown and slightly transparent, thorax and abdomen greyish white, short setae scattered over the head capsule. Head capsule rectangular, head-width index 0.52–0.57, lateral margins parallel, posterior margin broadly rounded. Frontal pore dot-like, situated at the anterior quarter of the head, with three pairs of setae in front of it. Frons of the single-peak type, distinctly raised in profile, anterior slope about 45 degrees and posterior slope about 160 degrees. Labrum lanceolate, about 1.26 times as long as wide, the semi-transparent area at the apex pointed in a triangle, apical, subapical and lateral apical setae all distinct. Mandibles sabre-shaped, apex slightly curved, left mandible 0.51–0.55 times head capsule length. Antennae 13–16 segments. Anterior lateral margins of the postmentum widening posteriorly, widest at the anterior fifth; the narrowest part of the waist region lies in the middle-posterior section, margins parallel, waist constriction index 0.35–0.39. Pronotum 1.43–1.54 times as wide as long, anterior and posterior margins both shallowly concave in the middle; about 30 long setae in the middle region.
/species/reticulitermes-sylvestris/.taxonomy_note: The genus name is printed as Reticuliter mes in the original work, a misspelling of Reticulitermes; the species is here placed in Reticulitermes.

/species/reticulitermes-testudineus/.soldier: Head of the soldier yellow, thorax and abdomen pale yellow, short setae sparsely covering the body. Head capsule rectangular, lateral margins nearly parallel, frontal peaks raised. Labrum shaped like a hexagonal turtle shell, the semi-transparent area at the labral tip a broad triangle; apical, lateral apical and subapical setae totalling six and of roughly equal length, the four labral ridge setae rather long. Mandibular apex slightly curved, the peak at the base of the outer margin very small. About 9 setae along the margin of the lacinia. Antennae 14–16 segments. Narrow region of the postmentum rather broad. Anterior and posterior margins of the pronotum both rather deeply incised; more than 20 setae in the middle region.

/species/reticulitermes-tianpingshanensi.soldier: Head pale yellowish brown, mandibles reddish brown, pilosity of the head capsule moderate. Head capsule rectangular, head-width index 0.64–0.67, lateral margins nearly parallel, posterior margin largely straight, frontal region flat. Labrum ligulate, apex bluntly rounded, apical, subapical and lateral apical setae all present. Mandibles rather straight, only the apex slightly curved; length 0.60 of head capsule length and 0.93–0.94 of head width. Antennae 15 segments. Widest part of the postmentum at the anterior fifth, anterior lateral margins nearly trapezoidal and widening posteriorly; waist region slender and long, margins parallel, waist constriction index 0.31–0.33. Pronotum trapezoidal, anterior and posterior margins nearly straight, anterior margin with a shallow incision in the middle, the incision at the middle of the posterior margin indistinct; about 30 setae in the middle region.
/species/reticulitermes-tianpingshanensi.taxonomy_note: The letters of the genus name are defective in the original work, printed as Reticuliter mes; this is in fact Reticulitermes, the same genus name as used on this site.

/species/reticulitermes-tibetanus/.soldier: Apex of the labrum pointed and bluntly rounded, apical setae present, subapical setae distinct, lateral apical setae slender and short, almost indiscernible. Mandibles long and strong, apex rather strongly curved, mandibular basal ridge discernible; length 0.58–0.62 of head capsule length and 0.92–0.98 of head width. Antennae 16–18 segments. Broad region of the postmentum at the anterior sixth, anterior lateral margins trapezoidal and widening posteriorly, the middle section shallowly concave; waist region slender and long, margins parallel, waist constriction index 0.28–0.32. Pronotum kidney-shaped, 1.63–1.74 times as wide as long, anterior margin formed by two intersecting arcs with a prominent incision in the middle, lateral margins and posterior margin forming an arc, posterior margin slightly concave in the middle; about 4 long setae in the middle region.
/species/reticulitermes-tibetanus/.taxonomy_note: The letters of the genus name are defective in the original work, printed as Reticuliter mes; this is in fact Reticulitermes, the same genus name as used on this site.

/species/reticulitermes-translucens/.alate: Alate brownish throughout, pronotum yellow, wings pale brown. Fontanelle dot-like and slightly raised, antennae 19–20 segments. Forewing scale larger than the hindwing scale, the two widely separated, the wing scales densely setose, the media with rather many branches. Tarsi 4-segmented, tibial spur formula 3:2:2. Head narrow anteriorly and broad posteriorly, somewhat oval, head-width index about 0.80, head index about 0.70; frontal peaks flat or slightly raised, not elevated above the dorsal surface of the occiput, slightly depressed between them; mandibles rather straight, labrum ligulate.
/species/reticulitermes-translucens/.soldier: Head of the soldier yellow, antennae pale yellow, mandibles brownish, thorax and abdomen pale yellowish white. Head capsule rectangular, lateral margins nearly parallel, frontal region flat. Labrum somewhat oval, the transparent area at the labral tip rather long and triangular, apical, lateral apical and subapical setae all present. Mandibles rather slender and elongate, the apex rather straight. Ten setae along the margin of the lacinia. Antennae 15–16 segments. Postmentum rather slender, the ratio of its narrowest part to the head width about 1:9. Anterior margin of the pronotum arcuate on both sides and incised in the middle, lateral margins gently sloping posteriorly, posterior margin shallowly concave in the middle; setae in the middle region of the thoracic tergites: more than 20 on the pronotum, about 10 on the mesonotum and fewer than 10 on the metanotum.

/species/reticulitermes-trichocephalus/.soldier: Head yellow, thorax and abdomen pale yellow, setae on the head capsule rather abundant. Head capsule rectangular, head-width index 0.64–0.68, lateral margins nearly parallel, posterior margin broadly rounded. Frontal peaks distinctly raised. Labrum lanceolate, about 1.2 times as long as wide, bearing apical and subapical setae. Mandibles slender and short, apex rather straight, the mandibular basal ridge on the outer margin indistinct; length 0.6–0.63 times head capsule length and 0.91–0.97 times head width. Antennae 14 segments. Waist constriction index of the postmentum 0.37–0.39; head width about 6 times the waist constriction, postmentum about 6–7 times the waist constriction. Pronotum about 1.4–1.6 times as wide as long, anterior margin formed by two intersecting arcs, posterior margin nearly straight, lateral margins steeply sloping posteriorly; about 30 setae in the middle region.
/species/reticulitermes-trichocephalus/.taxonomy_note: The genus name is printed as Reticuliter mes in the original work, a misspelling of Reticulitermes; the species is here placed in Reticulitermes.

/species/reticulitermes-tricholabralis/.biology: Host records include Dabie Mountains pine (Pinus dabeshanensis) and bald cypress (Taxodium distichum).
/species/reticulitermes-tricholabralis/.soldier: Head capsule rectangular, head-width index 0.60–0.66, lateral margins parallel, posterior margin broadly rounded. Frons flat, slightly concave between the peaks. Labrum lanceolate, the semi-transparent area at the apex narrowly angular but not sharply pointed; labral setae well developed, apical, subapical and lateral apical setae all present. Mandibles slender and pointed at the apex, slightly curved and slightly upturned; length 0.54–0.58 of head capsule length and 0.85–0.91 of head width. Antennae 15–16 segments. Broad region of the postmentum at the anterior quarter, anterior lateral margins trapezoidal; waist region slightly broad, its sides nearly broadly arcuate, waist constriction index 0.37–0.46. Pronotum somewhat kidney-shaped, 1.53–1.77 times as wide as long, anterior margin formed by two broad intersecting arcs, posterior margin shallowly concave to incised in the middle; more than 10 setae in the middle region.
/species/reticulitermes-tricholabralis/.taxonomy_note: The letters of the genus name are defective in the original work, printed as Reticuliter mes; this is in fact Reticulitermes, the same genus name as used on this site.

/species/reticulitermes-trichothorax/.soldier: Labrum rather short, the apex narrowly rounded, apical, lateral apical and subapical setae all present. Mandibles rather stout and short, the mandible length less than the head width and about half the head capsule length, apex rather curved, mandibular basal ridge distinct. About 11 setae along the margin of the lacinia. Antennae 16–17 segments. Waist constriction index of the postmentum 0.29–0.34, the ratio of the narrowest part to the head width about 1:8 and to the postmental length about 1:10 to 1:12. Pronotum kidney-shaped, anterior margin with a broad V-shaped incision, lateral margins steeply sloping posteriorly, the middle of the posterior margin also with a shallow V-shaped incision, median emargination index about 18%. Setae in the middle region of the thoracic tergites: about 60 on each of the pronotum, mesonotum and metanotum.
/species/reticulitermes-trichothorax/.taxonomy_note: The genus name is printed as Reticuliter mes in the original work, a misspelling of Reticulitermes; the species is here placed in Reticulitermes.

/species/reticulitermes-tricolorus/.alate: Head brown with a blackish tinge, pronotum pale brownish black, brownish yellow or greyish yellow in different individuals; postmentum brown or pale brown, not always matching the pronotum. Femora pale blackish brown, tibiae and tarsi pale greyish yellow, abdomen pale blackish brown, with a white longitudinal stripe in the middle of sternites 2–5. Head capsule oval, median suture of the head yellow, vertex slightly raised; postclypeus projecting, slightly lower than the vertex. Compound eyes almost not projecting, their long diameter greater than the distance to the lower margin of the head in males and nearly equal to it in females. Long diameter of the ocellus greater than the ocellus–compound eye distance; distance from the ocellus to the antennal socket three times the distance from the compound eye to the antennal socket. Fontanelle small and raised. Nine setae along the margin of the lacinia. Antennae 17 segments, the third or fourth the shortest. Pronotum about 1.5–1.7 times as wide as long, anterior and posterior margins both bluntly incised, median line pale yellow, setae in the middle region rather dense. Cu vein with 11 branches in each of the forewing and hindwing.
/species/reticulitermes-tricolorus/.soldier: Head yellow, thorax and abdomen pale yellowish white. Head capsule rectangular, head-width index 0.52–0.63, lateral margins parallel, frontal peaks strongly raised. Labrum elongate-lanceolate, about 1.1–1.5 times as long as wide, the semi-transparent area at the apex narrowly rounded, bearing two long apical setae; two short subapical setae present or absent, lateral apical setae absent, the labral ridge usually bearing two long setae. Mandibles rather slender and elongate, apex slightly curved; length 0.51–0.63 times head capsule length and 0.89–1.06 times head width; eight setae along the margin of the lacinia. Waist constriction index of the postmentum 0.28–0.4. Antennae 14–16 segments, mostly 14–15, the third or fourth the shortest. Pronotum about 1.4–1.6 times as wide as long, the incision at the middle of the anterior margin rather deep, that at the middle of the posterior margin shallower, setae in the middle region abundant.
/species/reticulitermes-tricolorus/.taxonomy_note: The genus name is printed as Reticuliter mes in the original work, a misspelling of Reticulitermes; the species is here placed in Reticulitermes.
