/species/reticulitermes-wugangensis/.alate: Head capsule of the dealate adult blackish brown, compound eyes purplish brown, pronotum yellow, postmentum nearly yellow, femora brown, tibiae and tarsi pale yellow. Head capsule circular, vertex slightly flat, fontanelle in the middle of the head. Compound eyes nearly circular, protrusion 5%, long diameter slightly greater than the distance from the compound eye to the lower margin of the head; ocelli small, long diameter equal to the ocellus–compound eye distance. Postclypeus projecting, about level with the ocelli and lower than the vertex. Antennae 18–19 segments. Anterior margin of the pronotum wavy and incised in the middle, posterior margin double-waved and also incised in the middle.
/species/reticulitermes-wugangensis/.soldier: Head orange-yellow, mandibles dark brown, antennae and pronotum cream-yellow. Head capsule rectangular, head-width index 0.62–0.65, lateral margins slightly wavy, the posterior half slightly enlarged, posterior margin broadly rounded. Frontal peaks distinctly raised. Labrum broadly ligulate, apical, subapical and lateral apical setae all present. Mandibles stout, apex rather curved, mandibular basal ridge distinct; length 0.53–0.55 times head capsule length and 0.83–0.85 times head width. Antennae 17–18 segments. A dot-like projection in the middle of the broad anterior region of the postmentum, waist constriction index 0.37. Anterior margin of the pronotum straight with a V-shaped notch in the middle, lateral margins gradually narrowing posteriorly, posterior margin formed by two intersecting arcs; setae in the middle region abundant and dense.
/species/reticulitermes-wugangensis/.taxonomy_note: The genus name is printed as Reticuliter mes in the original work, a misspelling of Reticulitermes; the species is here placed in Reticulitermes.

/species/reticulitermes-wugongensis/.soldier: Head pale yellow, mandibles purplish brown, pilosity of the head capsule moderate.
/species/reticulitermes-wugongensis/.taxonomy_note: The genus name is printed as Reticuliter mes in the original work, a misspelling of Reticulitermes; the species is here placed in Reticulitermes.

/species/reticulitermes-wuyishanensis/.soldier: Head orange-yellow, mandibles reddish brown, pilosity of the head capsule sparse. Head capsule rectangular, head-width index 0.53–0.55, lateral margins parallel, posterior margin straight. Frontal peaks strongly raised, with a groove between the two peaks. Labrum ligulate, apex bluntly rounded, bearing long apical setae, slender subapical setae and short lateral apical setae. Mandibles short and stout, apex strongly curved, mandibular basal ridge strongly projecting; length 0.49–0.52 times head capsule length and 0.93–0.94 times head width. Antennae 16–17 segments. Broad region of the postmentum at the anterior fifth, anterior lateral margins trapezoidal; waist region narrow and long, margins parallel, waist constriction index 0.29–0.33. Pronotum about 1.52–1.67 times as wide as long, anterior margin composed of two broad arcs with a rather deep incision in the middle, lateral margins and posterior margin forming an arc, the incision at the middle of the posterior margin shallower; about 40 setae in the middle region.
/species/reticulitermes-wuyishanensis/.taxonomy_note: The genus name is printed as Reticuliter mes in the original work, a misspelling of Reticulitermes; the species is here placed in Reticulitermes.

/species/reticulitermes-xingshanensis/.soldier: Head yellow, mandibles purplish brown, pilosity of the head capsule sparse. Head capsule rectangular, head-width index 0.55–0.62, lateral margins parallel, posterior margin nearly straight. Frontal region flat, only slightly depressed behind the frons. Labrum lanceolate, the apex passing from narrowly rounded to pointedly rounded; labral setae well developed, apical, subapical and lateral apical setae all rather long. Mandibular apex rather strongly curved; length 0.49–0.52 of head capsule length and 0.85–0.90 of head width. Antennae 16–17 segments. Broad region of the postmentum at the anterior fifth, anterior lateral margins trapezoidal, the middle section shallowly concave; waist region slightly broad with parallel margins, waist constriction index 0.36–0.49. Pronotum kidney-shaped, about 1.63–1.72 times as wide as long, the incisions at the middle of the anterior and posterior margins both rather distinct; about 20 setae in the middle region.
/species/reticulitermes-xingshanensis/.taxonomy_note: The letters of the genus name are defective in the original work, printed as Reticuliter mes; this is in fact Reticulitermes, the same genus name as used on this site.

/species/reticulitermes-xingyiensis/.soldier: Head pale yellow, antennae paler, labrum darker, mandibles bright brown; thorax and abdomen white with a yellowish tinge. Head capsule rectangular and slightly elongate, head-width index 0.54–0.6, lateral margins parallel, posterior margin nearly straight. Frontal peaks raised. Labrum ligulate, the semi-transparent apex broadly and roundly projecting, apical, lateral apical and subapical setae all rather distinct. Mandibles rather slender and straight, shorter than the head width but more than half the head capsule length. About 9 setae along the margin of the lacinia. Postmentum slightly broad, waist constriction index 0.31–0.37, the ratio of the narrowest part to the head width about 1:7 and to the postmental length about 1:7.9 to 1:9.8. Antennae 15–16 segments. Anterior and posterior margins of the pronotum almost straight, lateral margins sloping posteriorly, anterior margin with a shallow U-shaped concavity in the middle, posterior margin slightly concave forwards, median emargination index about 13%. Setae in the middle region of the thoracic tergites: about 30 or more on each of the pronotum and mesonotum, about 20 on the metanotum.
/species/reticulitermes-xingyiensis/.taxonomy_note: The genus name is printed as Reticuliter mes in the original work, a misspelling of Reticulitermes; the species is here placed in Reticulitermes.

/species/reticulitermes-yinae/.soldier: Head yellowish brown, mandibles reddish brown, head capsule setose. Head capsule rectangular, head-width index 0.58–0.60, lateral margins nearly parallel, the posterior part slightly widened, the middle of the posterior margin straight, posterior lateral corners broadly rounded. Frontal peaks slightly raised, low and concave between them. Labrum sharply lanceolate, the semi-transparent area at the apex a small nipple-like point, apical setae present, subapical setae almost imperceptible. Mandibles stout, apex strongly curved, mandibular basal ridge distinct; length 0.55–0.57 of head capsule length and 0.92–0.98 of head width. Antennae 17 segments. Widest part of the postmentum between the anterior seventh and the anterior sixth, anterior lateral margins nearly trapezoidal and spreading posteriorly; waist region narrow and long, margins parallel, waist constriction index 0.32–0.37. Pronotum nearly trapezoidal, 1.66–1.69 times as wide as long, anterior and posterior margins nearly straight, anterior margin with a V-shaped incision in the middle, the incision at the middle of the posterior margin indistinct; about 6 long setae in the middle region.
/species/reticulitermes-yinae/.taxonomy_note: The letters of the genus name are defective in the original work, printed as Reticuliter mes; this is in fact Reticulitermes, the same genus name as used on this site.

/species/reticulitermes-yingdeensis/.biology: Specimens collected from Chinese sweetgum (Liquidambar formosana).
/species/reticulitermes-yingdeensis/.distribution: Mount Huashui, Yingde, Guangdong, and Hunan.
/species/reticulitermes-yingdeensis/.soldier: Head of the soldier orange-yellow, the frons darker and the posterior half paler, the antennal ridges yellowish brown, a large dark brown spot on each side of the clypeus; mandibles brownish, their bases yellowish brown; labrum, antennae and pronotum pale yellow; abdomen and legs paler. Pilosity of the head extremely sparse; the labral apex bears one pair each of apical and lateral apical setae. Head broad, lateral margins parallel, widest at about the posterior third, contracting evenly and roundly posteriorly; frontal peaks slightly raised, not higher than the dorsal surface of the occiput, slightly concave behind the peaks towards the fontanelle, the fontanelle small and circular. Labrum ligulate, widest at the base, the transparent part of the labral tip bluntly rounded. Mandibles sabre-shaped, the apex slightly incurved, the inner margin toothless; the base of the left mandible with three saw-like structures, the third the largest, with another large tooth-like swelling at the base. Postmentum narrow and long, broad anteriorly, narrowest in the middle, the widest part more than twice the narrowest. Antennae 16–17 segments, the first segment stout and long, the third or fourth the shortest and smallest. Anterior margin of the pronotum with a broad and deep central concavity, the anterior lateral corners rounded and projecting outwards, posterior margin only slightly concave in the middle.
/species/reticulitermes-yingdeensis/.taxonomy_note: The species was placed in Tsaitermes in the original work; it is here placed in Reticulitermes.

/species/reticulitermes-yizhangensis/.alate: Head chestnut brown, pronotum, postmentum and tibiae yellow with a brownish tinge, labrum, postclypeus, antennae, femora and wings from yellowish brown to brownish yellow. Head capsule circular and slightly elongate, fontanelle dot-like, 0.47 and 0.54 from the frontal margin, the median suture of the head indiscernible. In profile the vertex is mound-shaped, the postclypeus projecting but distinctly lower than the vertex. Compound eyes nearly circular, protrusion 6%, short diameter slightly greater than or equal to the distance from the compound eye to the lower margin of the head; ocelli nearly circular, short diameter nearly equal to the ocellus–compound eye distance. Antennae 16–17 segments. Pronotum about 1.52 times as wide as long, anterior margin straight, posterior margin with a shallow notch in the middle.
/species/reticulitermes-yizhangensis/.soldier: Head pale yellow, mandibles dark brown, thorax dark yellow, pilosity of the head capsule sparse. Head capsule rectangular, head-width index 0.53–0.54, lateral margins nearly parallel, slightly contracted near the middle, posterior margin broadly rounded. Frontal peaks distinct, shallowly concave between them. Labrum ligulate, apical, subapical and lateral apical setae present. Mandibles short and stout, apex rather curved; length 0.46–0.47 times head capsule length and 0.88 times head width. Antennae 15–16 segments. Broad region of the postmentum at the anterior sixth, waist region narrow and long, waist constriction index 0.33–0.35. Pronotum ob-trapezoidal, 1.52–1.57 times as wide as long, anterior margin shallowly concave, posterior margin nearly straight; about 30 setae in the middle region.
/species/reticulitermes-yizhangensis/.taxonomy_note: The genus name is printed as Reticuliter mes in the original work, a misspelling of Reticulitermes; the species is here placed in Reticulitermes.

/species/reticulitermes-yongdingensis/.soldier: Head yellowish brown, mandibles dark brown, thorax, abdomen and legs yellowish brown. Head capsule rectangular, nearly twice as long as wide, head-width index 0.51–0.54, lateral margins nearly parallel, slightly constricted from the antennal sockets backwards, posterior margin straight and the two posterior lateral corners rounded. Frontal peaks distinctly raised, slightly concave between the two peaks, with several shallow longitudinal striae. Labrum elongate-lanceolate, the apex narrowly rounded, apical, lateral apical and subapical setae present. Mandibles rather stout, apex rather curved, mandibular basal ridge slightly projecting; left mandible about 0.94–0.95 times head width and about 0.49–0.5 times head capsule length, with a small pointed tooth on the left dorsal side of the basal projection. Postmentum about 10.59–11.25 times as long as the waist constriction, waist constriction index 0.29–0.32. Antennae 16–17 segments. Anterior margin of the pronotum formed by two intersecting arcs, posterior margin nearly straight and shallowly incised in the middle, median emargination index about 15%; more than 50 long setae in the middle region.
/species/reticulitermes-yongdingensis/.taxonomy_note: The genus name is printed as Reticuliter mes in the original work, a misspelling of Reticulitermes; the species is here placed in Reticulitermes.

/species/reticulitermes-yunsiensis/.distribution: Mount Daiyun, Mount Wuyi and elsewhere in Fujian.
/species/reticulitermes-yunsiensis/.soldier: Head pale yellowish brown, mandibles purplish brown, pilosity of the head capsule sparse. Head capsule rectangular, head-width index 0.55–0.59, lateral margins parallel, the middle of the posterior margin straight, posterior lateral corners slightly rounded. Frontal peaks slightly raised, slightly concave between them. Labrum sharply lanceolate, the semi-transparent area at the apex thickly needle-shaped with a rather blunt tip, apical and subapical setae present, lateral apical setae very small. Mandibles long and strong, apex rather strongly curved, the outer margin somewhat wavy, mandibular basal ridge visible; length 0.55–0.56 of head capsule length and 0.96 of head width. Antennae 16–17 segments. Broad region of the postmentum at the anterior sixth, anterior lateral margins trapezoidal and extending posteriorly, the middle section slightly concave; waist region slender and long, margins parallel, waist constriction index 0.27–0.32. Pronotum trapezoidal, about 1.51–1.64 times as wide as long, anterior and posterior margins nearly straight, both with a shallow incision in the middle; 4–6 setae in the middle region.
/species/reticulitermes-yunsiensis/.taxonomy_note: The letters of the genus name are defective in the original work, printed as Reticuliter mes; this is in fact Reticulitermes, the same genus name as used on this site.

/species/reticulitermes-zhaoi/.distribution: Mount Wuyi, Jianyang, Fujian (altitude 900 m), and Guangxi.
/species/reticulitermes-zhaoi/.soldier: Head yellowish brown, mandibles brown with a reddish tinge, thorax and abdomen pale yellow. Head capsule rectangular, head-width index 0.53–0.59, lateral margins parallel. Frontal peaks gently raised, their tops broad and flat, slightly concave between them. Labrum sharply lanceolate, about 1.24 times as long as wide, apex pointedly rounded, bearing two long apical setae, subapical setae very small, lateral apical setae mostly absent. Mandibular apex rather long and curved; the left mandible shorter than the head width but longer than half the head capsule, mandibular basal ridge absent. Postmentum rather long, about 8–10 times as long as the waist constriction, the ratio of the waist constriction to the head width about 1:6 to 1:7, waist constriction index 0.31–0.37. Antennae 15–16 segments. Pronotum about 1.5 times as wide as long, anterior and posterior margins almost straight, anterior margin with a shallow V-shaped concavity in the middle, posterior margin slightly concave in the middle, lateral margins slightly sloping posteriorly; nearly 40 long setae in the middle region.
/species/reticulitermes-zhaoi/.taxonomy_note: The genus name is printed as Reticuliter mes in the original work, a misspelling of Reticulitermes; the species is here placed in Reticulitermes.

/species/schedorhinotermes-ganlanbaensis.soldier: Head of the soldier widest behind the antennal sockets, distinctly narrowing posteriorly, the posterior margin a narrow arc; in profile the dorsal surface slightly arcuate, the postmentum rather projecting on the ventral surface. Mandibles slender and long, not swollen at the outer base, the left mandible with two marginal teeth and the right with one. Labrum narrow and long, contracted at the middle of its sides to form a waist; the apex and the anterior margin of the transparent area rather deeply incised in the middle, the notch flanked by two projecting semicircular lobes, the dorsal surface with a longitudinal groove, the labral tip reaching the mandibular apices. Anteclypeus rather long, projecting forward in the middle and not concave at the centre, distinctly longer than the sides of the postclypeus; postclypeus raised. Fontanelle distinct and circular, situated in front of the mid-point between the two antennal sockets, the posterior part of the aperture smooth and unwrinkled, in front hollowed into a longitudinal groove that reaches the clypeus and extends to the labral tip. Antennae 15–16 segments. Postmentum rather short, the waist near the middle, the narrowest part fairly broad relative to the widest part or to the length. Pronotum rather narrow; the anterior margin projecting distinctly forward in the middle without a central concavity, the posterior part of the lateral margins slightly contracted, a shallow notch in the centre of the posterior margin; the pronotum slightly wider than the mesonotum and narrower than the metanotum.

/species/schedorhinotermes-insolitus/.soldier: Head of the major soldier ginger-yellow, the antennae, pronotum and abdominal tergites all pale yellow. Pilosity of the head sparse; the pronotum and meso- and metanotum bear sparse hairs along their margins, and the hairs along the posterior margin of each abdominal segment are rather dense. Body large; head oval, its length (to the mandibular base) slightly greater than the greatest width, widest at about the posterior third of the sides, slightly contracted anteriorly, the middle of the posterior margin slightly projecting, the depression where the projecting margin meets the posterior lateral margins indistinct; in profile the dorsal margin of the head is slightly concave before the mid-point and slightly convex behind. Mandibles rather stout, the apex incurved, the outer margin slightly swollen near the base; the inner margin of the left mandible with two marginal teeth and that of the right with one, marginal tooth 1 narrow and pointed, marginal tooth 2 almost obsolete and merely a slight wave-like projection. Labrum rather short and broad, widest near the posterior part of the sides and hexagonal, the apex with a transverse transparent band whose anterior margin is rather deeply incised in the middle, the median longitudinal groove on the dorsal surface distinct; anteclypeus short and broad, band-like; postclypeus larger and slightly raised. Fontanelle distinct, situated at the centre between the two antennal sockets on the anterior part of the frons, the aperture circular, its anterior part deeply hollowed into a longitudinal groove that reaches the postclypeus and extends to the labral tip. Antennae 17 segments, the second and fourth subequal and both shorter than the third. Postmentum rather narrow and long, its widest part spherically swollen on the dorsal surface, the waist near the middle. Anterior margin of the pronotum projecting in a broad arc in the middle without a central incision, the notch at the middle of the posterior margin distinct; the pronotum about as wide as the mesonotum and slightly narrower than the metanotum; tibiae rather slender and long, tibial spur formula 3:2:2, tarsi 4-segmented.

/species/schedorhinotermes-magnus/.distribution: Guangxi (Dongxing); Yunnan (Mengla, Jinping, altitude 580–680 m; Hekou, 90 m; Nanxi; Jinghong, 500 m; Menghan).
/species/schedorhinotermes-magnus/.soldier: Soldiers of two forms. Major soldier: the corresponding part of the left mandible bears another large tooth, and from the middle to the posterior part another small blunt tooth; labrum hexagonal, slightly wider than long, widest at the posterior third, the anterior margin incised backwards in the middle into two lobes. Fontanelle distinct, situated slightly behind the mid-point between the two antennal sockets, the longitudinal groove in front of it running straight to the labral tip, its anterior margin with a row of fine hairs. Antennae 17 segments, the second and third short and cylindrical and equal in length, the fourth and fifth bead-like and nearly as long as these, the terminal segment slightly narrower. Narrowest part of the postmentum near the posterior end. Pronotum much narrower than the head, its anterior margin rather broad and projecting forwards in the middle with a central incision, the posterior margin slightly narrower, the posterior lateral corners large and rounded, the middle of the posterior margin concave; its width equal to that of the meso- and metanotum, or the mesonotum slightly narrower and the metanotum slightly wider; legs long. Minor soldier: body deep yellow throughout, the head darkest. Head rather narrow and long, widest behind the antennal sockets, the lateral margins straight and gradually converging anteriorly, the posterior margin convexly rounded; in profile the head is flattened with the top slightly arched. Mandibles slender and long, the posterior section straight and the anterior section incurved; before the mid-point of the left mandible two teeth with their points directed forwards, and a single tooth at the corresponding position on the right mandible. Labrum elongate, broader at the posterior end, contracted into a waist before the middle and widening again anteriorly; the apex and the anterior margin of the transparent area rather deeply incised and divided into two semicircular lobes, with a longitudinal groove on the dorsal surface in the middle. Postclypeus rather long and trapezoidal. Antennae 15 segments, the second and third equal in length and cylindrical, the following segments gradually becoming bead-like.
/species/schedorhinotermes-magnus/.worker: Head of the worker pale yellow, thorax, abdomen and legs white, the abdomen sometimes faintly showing the colour of the gut contents through the cuticle; body densely covered with short hairs. Head squarish, wider than long, the sides parallel. Postclypeus raised, twice as wide as long. Antennae 16–17 segments: with 16 segments the third is equal in length to the second and twice as long as the fourth; with 17 segments the third, fourth and fifth are equal and shortest, and the following segments gradually enlarge into rounded beads. Anterior half of the pronotum erect like a fan, the middle of its posterior margin slightly concave forwards; mesonotum rather broad; metanotum widest.

/species/schedorhinotermes-pyricephalus/.alate: Head of the alate broadly oval, the postclypeus very short and flat, antennae 18–25 segments. Pronotum flattened, narrower than the head. Forewing scale larger than the hindwing scale and covering its posterior margin; the wing veins with a very faint reticulate pattern, the wing surface hairy; the media of the forewing arising independently at the humeral suture, that of the hindwing arising from the base of the radial sector, the media very close to the cubitus. Fontanelle situated at the middle of the head.
/species/schedorhinotermes-pyricephalus/.soldier: Head of the soldier oval, distinctly narrowed anteriorly, the fontanelle a large aperture situated at the front of the head and extended forwards on a short tube. Mandibles slender and curved, the inner margin smooth and toothless apart from the saw-like incision at the base. Antennae 13–17 segments; labrum a pointed tongue. Pronotum flat, narrower than the head. Surface of the postmentum spherically swollen, the narrowest part near the posterior end. With 17 antennal segments the second and fourth are subequal and both shorter than the third. Pronotum rather broad, wider than the mesonotum; the middle of the anterior margin slightly projecting forwards with a small shallow depression at the centre, the middle of the posterior margin likewise concave, the notch both shallow and broad. Legs rather slender and long, tibial spur formula 3:2:2, tarsi 4-segmented.

/species/sinocapritermes-albipennis/.alate: Vertex brownish; abdominal tergites, sternites and pronotum brownish yellow, the centre of the pronotum slightly paler than the surrounding parts but without a T-shaped mark. Antennae, postclypeus and legs paler, light brownish yellow; wings white in life. Postclypeus raised, less than half as long as wide. Ocelli nearly circular, the distance to the compound eye smaller than the ocellus diameter. Between the two eyes the vertex bears a distinctly shallow basin, in the centre of which lies the elongate-oval fontanelle. Antennae 15 segments, the second stout and long, the third the shortest, the fourth and fifth equal in length and slightly longer than the third, the sixth about as long as the second but slightly thinner. Pronotum broad anteriorly and narrow posteriorly, the anterior margin nearly straight without a central incision, the anterior lateral corners small and rounded, the middle of the posterior margin slightly concave forwards. Forewing scale slightly larger than the hindwing scale; the media of the forewing arising independently at the humeral suture and running between the radial sector and the cubitus, dividing into two branches beyond the mid-point; the media of the hindwing arising from the radial sector, somewhat nearer the cubitus.
/species/sinocapritermes-albipennis/.biology: Inhabits soil beneath turf; the nest consists of numerous small soil chambers and galleries and is simple in structure.
/species/sinocapritermes-albipennis/.soldier: Head yellow, labrum white, pronotum and legs pale yellow, abdomen white. Body covered with a rather dense pilosity. Head somewhat flattened-cylindrical, rectangular in dorsal view but rather broad, the sides parallel or slightly narrowed anteriorly, the posterior margin somewhat arched backwards. The head suture does not extend beyond the mid-point of the head. From about the anterior middle the vertex slopes gradually forwards, so that the frons is rather flat. Fontanelle at one-sixth of the head from the front, set in a small shallow pit. Labrum elongate, its two anterior corners projecting forwards as cones. Mandibles curved and rod-like, about as long as the head, asymmetrical, the left more strongly curved; the anterior ends of both curve towards the midline as small blunt hooks, and behind the mid-point of the left mandible there is a prominent blunt tooth hidden by the labrum. Antennae 14 segments, the second and fourth equal in length, the third longer than the second and about equal to the fifth. Pronotum narrower than the head, its anterior part distinctly raised; mesonotum narrower; metanotum as wide as the pronotum.
/species/sinocapritermes-albipennis/.taxonomy_note: The genus name is printed as Sinicapritermes in the original work; the name now in use is Sinocapritermes.

/species/sinocapritermes-guangxiensis/.soldier: Head capsule yellowish brown, mandibles blackish brown, labrum yellow-white with the dorsal surface darker, antennae pale yellowish brown with the articulations slightly paler, thorax, abdomen and legs pale yellowish white. Pilosity of the head capsule moderate, the frons rather full, with a pair of short crossed setae in front of the frontal gland aperture; the anterior and posterior margins of the pronotum each with 20 to more than 30 setae. Head capsule rectangular, head-width index 0.63–0.65, the sides nearly parallel, the posterior margin broadly rounded; coronal suture distinct, about half the length of the head capsule. In profile the dorsal margin of the head slopes gradually backwards from the top of the frons, the frontal slope about 30°. Labrum slightly longer than wide, inclined somewhat to the right, the apex deeply U-shaped incised, the anterior lateral corners pointed and projecting forwards. Apex of the left mandible hooked, the mandibular body behind the hook bar-like, slightly twisted into an S from the anterior third backwards; right mandible sabre-shaped, the apex slightly curved, the inner margin of the mandibular base with two small blunt tooth-like projections. Antennae 14 segments, the second the shortest, the third the longest. Pronotum saddle-shaped, the middle of the anterior margin cut in as a triangle. Apical tibial spur formula 2:2:2.

/species/sinocapritermes-magnus/.soldier: Head capsule brownish yellow, mandibles purplish brown, labrum yellow-white with the centre of the dorsal surface pale brown, antennae pale yellow; thorax, abdomen and legs pale yellowish white. Pilosity of the head capsule moderate, the frons rather full, with two pairs of crossed short setae in front of the frontal gland aperture; the anterior and posterior margins of the pronotum each with more than 20 setae. Head capsule rectangular and rather short, head-width index 0.67–0.75, the sides nearly parallel, the posterior margin broadly rounded, the coronal suture distinct and about half the length of the head capsule. In profile the region of the frontal gland aperture is slightly concave and the frontal slope above the aperture rather raised; the frontal gland aperture is a small chitinised tube set in a triangular shallow pit at the centre of the frontal slope. Labrum slightly longer than wide, inclined somewhat to the right, the apex semicircularly incised, the two anterior lateral corners pointed and projecting forwards. Apex of the left mandible hooked with a slight twist behind it, the middle section rather straight; right mandible sabre-shaped, the apex slightly curved and its point directed downwards. Antennae 14 segments, the second and fourth nearly equal in length, the third longer. Pronotum saddle-shaped, the middle of the anterior margin slightly concave, the posterior margin nearly straight. Apical tibial spur formula 2:2:2, tarsi 4-segmented.

/species/sinocapritermes-mushae/.alate: Head black; postclypeus, antennae, labrum, labial palps, maxillary palps, pronotum, abdominal tergites and sternites, legs and wings all dark brown, slightly paler than the head. Body densely covered with hairs.
/species/sinocapritermes-mushae/.distribution: Wushe, Taiwan; Zhejiang; Jian'ou, Pinghe and Changting, Fujian; Chongqing; Guangxi; Shaoguan and Zhanjiang, Guangdong; Hainan; Mount Dawei, Pingbian, Yunnan (altitude 1500 m).
/species/sinocapritermes-mushae/.soldier: Head brownish yellow or reddish brown, antennae, labrum and the remaining mouthparts yellow-white, mandibles reddish brown to blackish brown, thorax pale yellow, abdomen white and opaque. Head, thorax and abdomen all bearing numerous hairs, the head held downwards and not parallel with the thorax and abdomen. Head flattened-cylindrical, about two-thirds as wide as long (to the mandibular base), the posterior part roundly arched, the sides nearly parallel, the anterior part slightly narrowed, the median longitudinal suture of the posterior dorsum distinct and not reaching the mid-point of the head. Antennae 14 segments, the first long and large, the second small and cylindrical, about half as long as the first and equal in length to the fourth. Labrum more than one and a half times as long as wide, with sabre-like projections on either side of the apex. Fontanelle a small shallow pit at one-fifth of the head from the front, with a groove in front of it extending to the postclypeus. Postmentum projecting distinctly on the ventral surface. Mandibles long and sabre-like, twisted in a sloping manner, the left more strongly curved and hooked at the tip, the right rather straight and also hooked at the apex. Pronotum distinctly narrower than the head, saddle-shaped, its anterior part raised, the centres of the anterior and posterior margins almost without incisions.

/species/sinocapritermes-parvulus/.distribution: Yaxian and Tongshi, Mount Jianfeng, and Mount Mihou in Dongfang, Hainan.
/species/sinocapritermes-parvulus/.soldier: Sclerotisation of the whole body very weak. Head pale yellow, the two condylar spots nearly blackish brown, the frontal gland area dirty white and spread out like a folding fan; thorax and abdomen almost semi-transparent, the coiled gut visible through the cuticle. Body surface covered with hairs throughout, those on the postclypeus and pronotum stouter, those on the vertex, antennae and legs denser. Head nearly circular; in profile both the postclypeus and the anteclypeus are raised, with a clear concave margin between them. Antennae 14 segments. On the left mandible the angle between the posterior margin of the apical tooth and the anterior cutting edge of marginal tooth 1 is less than a right angle, marginal tooth 2 minute; on the right mandible the corresponding structures meet at an acute angle, the anterior cutting edge of marginal tooth 1 inclined inwards with the tooth point directed upwards. Left mandible changing from flattened to round, becoming flattened and slightly widened again in the anterior middle section, the end concave and forming a small inward hook; right mandible slightly shorter, the body gradually rounded towards the apex, the tip curved downwards and pointed. Postmentum rather long, the hammer-shaped part large, its widest part about twice the narrowest. Pronotum typically saddle-shaped, the middle of the anterior margin slightly concave, the posterior margin nearly straight. Abdomen slender and long, its widest part wider than the thorax and narrower than the head.
/species/sinocapritermes-parvulus/.taxonomy_note: The scientific name is set as Sinocapritermesparvulus in the original work, an artefact of line-breaking; it refers to the same species as the name used on this site, and the genus name is unchanged.

/species/sinocapritermes-sinensis/.alate: Head capsule dark brown, labrum brown, antennae brown with the articulations slightly paler, frontal gland aperture pale yellowish brown; pronotum dark brown, abdominal tergites and legs pale brown, head capsule and pronotum densely covered with short hairs. Head capsule oval, the frontal gland aperture narrow and small, elliptical. Compound eyes circular, protrusion about 16%; ocelli oval, the ocellus–compound eye distance slightly greater than the short diameter of the ocellus and smaller than its long diameter. Postclypeus slightly raised, the median suture distinct, less than half as long as wide. Antennae 13 segments, broken; the second to fourth subequal and all rather short, the segments from the fifth onwards progressively longer. Pronotum flat, the anterior margin slightly raised from a shallow arcuate depression, neither the anterior nor the posterior margin with a central incision. Tibial spur formula 2:2:2, tarsi 4-segmented.

/species/sinocapritermes-sinicus/.distribution: Ningming, Guangxi; Mount Meihua and Mount Daiyun, Fujian.
/species/sinocapritermes-sinicus/.soldier: Body medium-sized. Head and antennae yellow, mandibles reddish brown, labrum white; thoracic tergites and legs pale yellow, abdomen pale white. Head with sparse long hairs, those around the frontal gland aperture on the frons more numerous; labrum usually with 6–8 long setae; the anterior and posterior margins of the pronotum also with many long hairs; postmentum sparsely hairy, with only a few long and short hairs at the anterior end. Head rectangular, longer than wide, the sides parallel; head suture distinct, not reaching the mid-point of the head, in profile slightly depressed from the suture to the middle of the posterior margin. Fontanelle at the centre of the frons, distinctly depressed from the fontanelle to the postclypeus, appearing in profile as a longitudinal groove. Labrum rectangular, inclined to the right, the anterior margin concave, the two lateral corners projecting as points. Mandibles asymmetrical, the left slightly twisted and hooked at the tip, the right rather straight with a slight hook at the tip. Anterior part of the postmentum rather broad, the narrowest part of the waist near the middle and slightly behind it. Antennae 14 segments, the fourth rather short. Middle of the anterior margin of the pronotum slightly concave, the posterior margin without a distinct incision. Apical spur arrangement 2:2:2, tarsi 4-segmented.

/species/sinocapritermes-songtaoensis/.soldier: Head, postmentum and antennae pale yellowish brown; labrum pale yellow, the transparent projections at the anterior lateral corners nearly white; mandibles deep reddish brown; thorax, abdomen and legs pale yellow. Hairs on the anterior part of the head rather dense, becoming sparser posteriorly, the posterior part with only a few short hairs; thoracic hairs sparse, those of the abdomen rather dense. Head somewhat rectangular, the sides nearly parallel, the posterior lateral corners joined to the posterior margin by a broad arc; the frontal region sloping from the anterior part of the frons towards the clypeus, the slope slightly concave; fontanelle above the concave slope, dot-like, the median suture distinct and situated posteriorly, about one-third of the head length. Middle of the anterior margin of the labrum incised in a U. Mandibles slightly asymmetrical left and right: the middle section of the left mandible slender and slightly twisted, curved and rod-like, the apex slightly incurved, the curved end short and hook-like, the posterior margin of the hook swollen and trapezoidal; right mandible flattened and broad like a sabre, the anterior part of the inner margin narrowed to the pointed tip. Antennae 14 segments, the third and fifth equal in length and longer than the fourth. Pronotum saddle-shaped, less than half as long as wide, the anterior margin projecting forwards in a broad arc with a slight central concavity, the posterior margin projecting backwards in a broad arc with a rather distinct central notch. Tibial spur formula 2:2:2.
/species/sinocapritermes-songtaoensis/.worker: Head pale yellow, thorax and abdomen slightly paler than the head, legs pale yellow and nearly white. Hairs scattered on the head, those of the pronotum sparse, those of the abdomen loose. Body rather small, head nearly circular, postclypeus slightly raised; the apical tooth of the left mandible rather long and projecting, the posterior cutting edge longer than the anterior edge of marginal tooth 1, marginal teeth 2 and 1 joined by a long posterior cutting edge whose end shows only a minute tooth mark. Antennae 14 segments, the fifth longer than the second, the second longer than the third, the third and fourth similar in length. Pronotum broadly saddle-shaped. In another worker form the head is somewhat circular, widest at the middle and narrowing behind it, the posterior margin a broad arc; the head suture T-shaped, the vertex flat in profile; postclypeus raised, the second segment slightly longer than the third or nearly equal to it; pronotum saddle-shaped; abdomen olive-shaped, the gut contents visible through the cuticle.

/species/sinocapritermes-vicinus/.alate: Head brownish, postclypeus and antennae slightly paler, pale yellowish brown; pronotum yellowish brown, wings greyish brown. Head broadly oval. Compound eyes circular, distinctly projecting; ocelli elliptical, the ocellus–compound eye distance greater than the width of the ocellus itself. Postclypeus slightly raised, about one-third as long as wide. Fontanelle elongate-oval, medium-sized, situated at the centre of the shallow concavity of the vertex between the two compound eyes. Antennae 15 segments, the third the shortest and smallest, the fourth and fifth roughly equal. Pronotum kidney-shaped, the anterior margin straight, the anterior part slightly raised, the central incisions of the anterior and posterior margins indistinct. Forewing scale larger than the hindwing scale; the media of the forewing arising independently at the humeral suture, nearer the radial sector, the whole vein rather close to the cubitus, giving off one to three branches to the wing apex from about half the wing length or from the apical third; the cubitus with about 7–10 branches.

/species/sinocapritermes-xiushanensis/.soldier: Body medium-sized. Head narrowly rectangular, the sides nearly parallel, the posterior lateral corners rounded, the posterior margin a broad arc; the dorsal margin of the head slightly raised at the frons, sloping from the anterior part of the frons to the clypeus, the slope slightly concave; the fontanelle tube-shaped, situated above the concave slope, the median suture short and less than half the head length. Labrum rectangular, the middle of the anterior margin incised in a U, the two lateral corners long and transparent. Middle section of the left mandible slightly slender, the outer margin arcuate, the apex bent inwards, short and hook-like, the inner margin behind the hook swollen and trapezoidal; right mandible slightly broad and straight, the sides parallel, long and sabre-like, only the anterior part of the inner margin narrowed to the tip. Postmentum narrow and long, the anterior part broad and spherically raised, the waist near the posterior end, the narrowest part less than half the widest. Pronotum broadly saddle-shaped, less than half as long as wide, both the anterior and posterior margins projecting in broad arcs, the central notch of the posterior margin rather distinct. Tibial spur formula 2:2:2, tarsi 4-segmented. Head pale yellow, thorax and abdomen paler than the head, legs nearly the colour of the abdomen; hairs scattered on the head, those of the pronotum few, those of the abdomen rather dense.

/species/sinocapritermes-yunnanensis/.alate: Head rectangular, the lateral margins nearly parallel, the dorsal margin rather flat; the frontal region forms a slope, sometimes rather steep, the fontanelle dot-like; the longitudinal suture of the head distinct, extending forwards beyond the middle. Mandibles extremely asymmetrical left and right: the tip of the left mandible blunt or turned inwards, the apex slightly flattened and not hooked, the middle of the inner cutting edge slightly concave; the right mandible rather straight, its anterior section sometimes slightly curved outwards. Labrum similar in length and width, in some specimens slightly longer or slightly shorter, the anterior margin straight, the two anterior lateral corners short and pointed; postclypeus very narrow. Antennae 13–16 segments. Pronotum saddle-shaped, narrower than the head. Apical spurs 3:2:2, tarsi 4-segmented.
/species/sinocapritermes-yunnanensis/.biology: The nest is usually underground and consists of several chambers and passages; the species feeds on plant rootlets and decaying parts, and can also bore into the surface layers of living trees and into sugarcane.
/species/sinocapritermes-yunnanensis/.soldier: Head capsule yellowish brown, mandibles blackish brown, labrum yellow-white, antennae pale yellowish brown with the articulations slightly paler; thorax, abdomen and legs pale yellowish white. Head capsule short and rectangular, head-width index 0.68–0.70, the sides nearly parallel, the posterior lateral corners broadly rounded, the posterior margin straight or shallowly concave forwards, the median suture about one-third of the head capsule; in profile the dorsal margin of the head slopes gently backwards from the top of the frons, the frons raised, the frontal slope about 40°, the centre of the frons slightly depressed. Frontal gland aperture behind a small shallow pit at the centre of the frontal slope, the aperture tube-like. The two mandibles nearly equal in length but asymmetrical: the apex of the left is a rounded hook, behind which it swells into a bar, the inner margin straight in profile and shallowly concave at the middle, weakly twisted from the middle forwards and backwards into a slight S; right mandible sabre-shaped, the apex slightly hook-like. Antennae 14 segments, the second to fourth nearly equal in length, the segments from the fifth onwards gradually longer. Postmentum club-shaped, the waist region behind the mid-point, 2.4–3.0 times as long as wide. Pronotum saddle-shaped, the centres of the anterior and posterior margins without distinct incisions. Tibial spur formula 2:2:2.

/species/sinonasutitermes-admirabilis/.soldier: Soldiers of three forms. Large form: head brownish yellow, nasus reddish brown, antennae yellowish brown, thorax, abdomen and legs pale greyish yellow; head nearly bare, the tip of the nasus with a few short hairs. Head flattened-round, the sides strongly bulging behind the mid-point, the posterior margin flattened-round. Nasus a stout cone about three-fifths as long as the head, upturned in profile with the tip slightly higher than the top of the head, the base of the nasus deeply concave, the angle between nasus and head about 120°; mandibles with a short apical spine. Antennae 13 segments, the second the shortest, about half the third, the fourth slightly shorter than the third. The anterior raised part of the pronotum strongly sclerotised and with a median incision. Medium form: colour slightly paler, head flattened-round and wider than long, nasus shorter than the head, directed forwards in profile with the tip lower than the top of the head, the base of the nasus seemingly arched; antennae 13 segments, the fourth slightly longer than the second; incision of the anterior margin of the pronotum very shallow. Small form: head elongate-oval, longer than wide, nasus extending straight forwards with the tip slightly lower than the top of the head, the base of the nasus flat; antennae 12 segments, the third 1.5 times the second; anterior and posterior margins of the pronotum nearly straight.

/species/sinonasutitermes-dimorphus/.alate: Head, antennae and postclypeus yellowish brown, thorax, wings and legs yellow. Head and pronotum densely covered with soft hairs mixed with a few long hairs, the long hairs of the pronotum more numerous than those of the head. Head nearly circular; fontanelle large, elongate-oval, with a fork on each anterolateral side; four or more elliptical markings between the two ocelli. Compound eyes elliptical, distinctly projecting; ocelli oval and raised, the ocellus–compound eye distance smaller than their short diameter and also smaller than the distance from the compound eye to the lower margin of the head. Postclypeus raised, 3–4 times as wide as long, with a median longitudinal line. Antennae 15 segments, the third rather short, or the second and third both short and nearly equal. Apical tooth of the left mandible slightly larger than marginal tooth 1, the cutting edge between the marginal teeth rather straight; apical tooth of the right mandible slightly larger than or nearly equal to marginal tooth 1, marginal tooth 2 close to marginal tooth 1, the molar plate with nine grooves. Middle of the anterior margin of the pronotum slightly arched, deeply depressed on both sides near the anterior margin, the incision of the anterior margin indistinct, the posterior margin distinctly concave.
/species/sinonasutitermes-dimorphus/.distribution: Mount Meihua, Longyan, Fujian; Mount Maozifeng, Nanxiong, Guangdong.
/species/sinonasutitermes-dimorphus/.soldier: Soldiers of two forms. Head, antennae, thorax and abdominal tergites all yellow, the nasus and the anterior part of the pronotum brownish yellow. Head and thorax without hairs, abdominal tergites with only a few soft hairs. Large form: head broadly oval, wider than long, strongly projecting behind the antennae, the sides narrowly rounded, the posterior margin broadly rounded; in profile the nasus is straight and not upturned, concave in the middle, its tip slightly lower than the posterior margin of the head; the apical spine of the mandibles extremely short, sometimes only a small point remains. Antennae 13 segments, the third about twice the second, the second and fourth nearly equal in length. Pronotum saddle-shaped, the anterior half erect and raised, the anterior margin rather flat without a distinct incision, the posterior margin arcuate. Tibial spurs 2:2:2, tarsi 4-segmented. Small form: body colour similar to the large form, the tip of the nasus with a few hairs, the rest of the body almost hairless; head broadly circular, the posterior margin broadly rounded with the middle slightly flat; antennae 12 segments, the third about twice the second; mandibles mostly with extremely short small spines, in some specimens a small point on the left and blunt without a spine on the right; the incisions of the anterior and posterior margins of the pronotum both indistinct.

/species/sinonasutitermes-erectinasus/.alate: Head dark reddish brown, pronotum yellowish brown, the middle of the sternites pale yellow, legs yellow, wings pale yellowish brown. Compound eyes elongate-oval and projecting outwards, ocelli elliptical, the distance to the compound eye smaller than the ocellus width. Postclypeus not raised, about four times as wide as long, the anterior and posterior margins straight and slightly arched; the front of the labrum rounded, without a pale transverse band in the middle; fontanelle between the two compound eyes, with a pale Y-shaped mark. Antennae 15 segments, the second to fifth nearly equal in length. Anterior margin of the pronotum nearly straight, slightly raised in the middle, the posterior margin rather narrow and with a central incision. Forewing scale larger than the hindwing scale; the media of the forewing arising independently at the humeral suture, with or without branches, the distance between the media and the cubitus smaller than that between the media and the radial sector, the cubitus with ten branches; the media of the hindwing arising from the radial sector, the remaining venation as in the forewing. Wing hairs short and small.
/species/sinonasutitermes-erectinasus/.soldier: Head and antennae dark reddish brown, the anterior part of the nasus darker, thorax and abdomen pale yellow. Head almost bare; the dorsum of the abdomen covered with minute hairs, the ventral hairs longer, the posterior margins of the tergites and sternites of each segment bearing a row of erect long hairs. Large form: head like a transversely placed ellipse, widest behind the mid-point, the posterior part broadly rounded; nasus conical with a stout base, the line between nasus and top of head distinctly curved, the angle with the clypeus greater than 90° and upturned; the anterior lateral end of the mandible bears a spine. Antennae 13 segments, the second and fourth equal in length, the third longer, the fifth slightly longer than the fourth. Anterior and posterior parts of the pronotum meeting at a right angle, the middle of the anterior margin slightly concave. Small form: colour and pilosity as in the large form, but the head hairs fewer; head nearly circular, the nasus not markedly upturned, the angle with the clypeus still greater than 90°, the anterior outer end of the mandible with a sharp spine; antennae 12 segments, the third equal to the second or 1.5 times it; the middle of the anterior margin of the pronotum not concave.
/species/sinonasutitermes-erectinasus/.worker: Head yellow with a pale T-shaped head suture, thorax and abdomen white. Head between circular and square, the sides parallel, slightly contracted behind, the posterior margin arched, the vertex flat. Postclypeus raised, less than half as long as wide. Fontanelle exactly behind the junction of the T-shaped suture, a small circular pit. Antennae 14 segments, the second and third equal in length, the fourth rather short. Anterior part of the pronotum erect, the anterior and posterior parts equal in size, the middle of the anterior margin with an incision. Small form paler, head shape as in the large form, the T-shaped suture indistinct, the anterior margin of the pronotum without an incision.

/species/sinonasutitermes-guangxiensis/.soldier: Head and antennae brownish yellow, nasus reddish brown, thorax and abdomen pale brown, legs yellowish white. Head nearly bare, the tip of the nasus with a few hairs. Large form: head flattened-round, wider than long, the sides broadly bulging behind the mid-point, the middle of the posterior margin nearly straight; nasus a stout cone, shorter than the head, upturned in profile with the tip slightly higher than the top of the head, the base of the nasus shallowly concave, the angle between nasus and head slightly greater than 120°; mandibles with a short apical spine. Antennae 13 segments, the second to fourth nearly equal in length, the third about 1.5 times the second. The anterior raised part of the pronotum strongly sclerotised and with a median incision. Small form: colour rather brighter and paler, head capsule nearly circular and wider than long, nasus shorter than the head, upturned in profile with the tip higher than the top of the head, the base of the nasus shallowly concave, the angle about 115°, the apical spine of the mandibles short and small; antennae 12 segments, the second the shortest, the third slightly longer than the second; anterior and posterior margins of the pronotum both nearly straight.

/species/sinonasutitermes-hainanensis/.soldier: Large form: head and thorax pale yellow, antennae yellow, the nasus and the raised part of the pronotum brown; head with 3–4 long hairs, the dorsum of the thorax and abdomen almost hairless. Head like a transversely placed ellipse, wider than long, widest in the middle, the sides narrowly rounded, the posterior margin broadly rounded. Nasus stout, slightly upturned in profile, the tip somewhat inclined downwards yet higher than the dorsum of the occiput, concave in the middle; the apical spine of the mandibles short and small. Antennae 13 segments, the third twice the second or more, the second the shortest. Tibial spurs 2:2:2, tarsi 4-segmented. Small form: colour as in the large form, the tip of the nasus with a few hairs, the body almost hairless; head nearly circular, slightly longer than wide, the nasus straight in profile with the tip slightly lower than the occiput, the spine at the lateral end of the mandible point-like; antennae 12 segments, the third about twice the second; the incisions of the anterior and posterior margins of the pronotum both indistinct.
/species/sinonasutitermes-hainanensis/.worker: Antennae of the worker: the third segment twice the second or longer, the second the shortest. The anterior half of the pronotum erect and raised, meeting the posterior half at a right angle, the incision of the anterior margin distinct, the posterior margin slightly concave. Tibial spurs 2:2:2, tarsi 4-segmented. The apical tooth of the left mandible distinctly longer than marginal tooth 1, and the apical tooth of the right mandible also slightly larger than marginal tooth 1; marginal tooth 2 rather close to marginal tooth 1, the molar plate with eight grooves.

/species/sinonasutitermes-mediocris/.soldier: Head yellowish brown, the tip of the nasus reddish brown, the base of the nasus and the antennae brownish yellow, thorax and abdomen pale brownish yellow, legs pale yellow; head nearly bare, the tip of the nasus with a few short hairs. Large form: head flattened-round, wider than long, the middle of the sides bulging, the posterior margin broadly rounded; nasus a stout cone, shorter than the head, slightly upturned in profile with the tip about level with the top of the head, the base of the nasus shallowly concave, the angle between nasus and head slightly greater than 110°; apical spine of the mandibles short and small. Antennae 13 segments, the second the shortest, the third about twice the second, the fourth slightly longer than the second. The anterior raised part of the pronotum strongly sclerotised and with a median incision. Small form: pilosity as in the large form but paler; head circular and slightly long, longer than wide, nasus shorter than the head, slightly upturned in profile with the tip about level with the top of the head, the base of the nasus rather deeply concave, the angle about 110°; antennae 12 segments, the second the shortest, the third about 1.5 times the second, the fourth shorter and stouter than the third; anterior and posterior margins of the pronotum nearly straight.

/species/sinonasutitermes-planinasus/.soldier: Small soldier with body colour as in the large form. Head circular and slightly long, longer than wide; nasus a stout cone, shorter than the head, directed straight forwards in profile with the tip distinctly lower than the top of the head, the base of the nasus slightly arched, the angle between nasus and head about 105°. Antennae 12 segments, the second the shortest, the third longer than the second, the third and fourth nearly equal. Anterior and posterior margins of the pronotum both nearly straight.

/species/sinonasutitermes-platycephalus/.soldier: Large form: head brownish yellow, nasus deep brown with a reddish tinge, antennae brownish yellow, thoracic and abdominal tergites paler than the head, the anterior half of the pronotum deep brown, legs pale yellowish brown. Head nearly bare; the tip of the nasus with four long hairs and two or three rings of fine hairs, two long hairs behind the vertex, a few short hairs around the margin of the pronotum. Head circular and somewhat flattened, 1.2 times as wide as long, the sides roundly bulging, the posterior margin broadly rounded; nasus a stout cone, its base rather concave in profile, the nasus slightly upturned, the top of the head higher than the tip of the nasus; mandibles with an apical spine. Antennae 12 segments. The incisions at the centres of the anterior and posterior margins of the pronotum indistinct. Small form: head and antennae yellowish brown, nasus reddish brown, the anterior half of the pronotum brown, thoracic and abdominal tergites pale brownish yellow, pilosity as in the large form but sparser and shorter; head flattened-round, 1.2 times as wide as long, the middle of the posterior margin nearly straight; nasus a stout cone, nearly straight in profile with the tip slightly upturned, the top of the head higher than the tip of the nasus; mandibles with an apical spine; antennae 13 segments, the third and fourth rather long; pronotum saddle-shaped, the centres of the anterior and posterior margins slightly concave; tibial spurs 2:2:2, tarsi 4-segmented.

/species/sinonasutitermes-trimorphus/.soldier: Soldiers of three forms. Head, antennae and pronotum reddish yellow, the nasus and the raised part of the pronotum brown, thoracic and abdominal tergites yellow, legs pale yellow; head and thoracic tergites hairless, abdominal tergites with a few minute hairs. Large form: head broadly circular, wider than long, the middle of the sides strongly bulging, the posterior margin broadly rounded; nasus stout and short, upturned in profile with the tip slightly higher than the posterior part of the head, concave in the middle; the apical spine of the mandibles short and small or merely a point-like projection. Antennae 13 segments, the third twice the second or longer, the second the shortest. The anterior half of the pronotum erect, the middle of the anterior margin slightly concave, the posterior margin without or with an indistinct notch; apical spurs 2:2:2, tarsi 4-segmented. Medium form: colour as in the large form, nasus longer, not upturned in profile, slightly concave in the middle, mandibles blunt or with a point-like projection; antennae 12–13 segments; the anterior margin of the pronotum with a slight incision. Small form: colour and pilosity as in the two preceding forms, head nearly circular, the posterior margin slightly flat, about as long as wide, the apex of the mandibles mostly with small sharp spines; antennae 11–12 segments; the anterior and posterior margins of the pronotum without distinct incisions.
/species/sinonasutitermes-trimorphus/.worker: The mandibles of the worker differ from those of the soldier: the apical tooth of the left mandible distinctly larger than marginal tooth 1, the cutting edge between the two marginal teeth straight; the apical tooth of the right mandible slightly larger than or nearly equal to marginal tooth 1, marginal tooth 2 blunt and rather close to marginal tooth 1, the molar plate with eight grooves.

/species/sinonasutitermes-xiai/.alate: Head dark reddish brown, labrum, postclypeus and antennae yellowish brown, postmentum brown, pronotum deep yellow, wings deep yellow with a brownish tinge. Pilosity of the pronotum very dense. Head nearly circular, compound eyes elongate-oval and projecting outwards, ocelli flattened-round, the distance to the compound eye less than one-third of their short diameter; postclypeus more than four times as wide as long, with a median suture; fontanelle elongate-oval, divided into two forks at the anterolateral sides. Antennae 15 segments, the second the shortest. Anterior margin of the pronotum rather straight, raised in the middle, the anterior lateral corners drooping downwards, the middle of the posterior margin concave.
/species/sinonasutitermes-xiai/.soldier: Head and antennae brownish yellow, nasus with a reddish tinge, thorax, abdomen and legs pale greyish yellow; head nearly bare, the tip of the nasus with a few hairs. Large form: head flattened-round, wider than long, the sides roundly projecting; nasus a stout cone, shorter than the head, directed straight forwards in profile with the tip lower than the top of the head, the base of the nasus flat, the angle between nasus and head about 105°; apical spine of the mandibles short and small. Antennae 13 segments, the second the shortest, the third about twice the second, the fourth slightly longer than the second. The anterior part of the pronotum strongly sclerotised, the anterior and posterior margins nearly straight. Small form: colour and pilosity close to the large form, head nearly circular and wider than long, nasus conical, slightly upturned in profile with the tip slightly lower than the top of the head, the base shallowly concave and rising gently towards the top of the head, mandibles with a short apical spine; antennae 12 segments, the second the shortest, the third about 1.5 times the second, the fourth stouter and shorter than the third.

/species/sinonasutitermes-yui/.alate: Head and postmentum brown, labrum, postclypeus, antennae, fontanelle and thorax and abdomen yellowish brown, legs nearly yellow with the tibiae darker, wings pale yellow; head and pronotum densely covered with hairs. Head nearly circular, compound eyes elongate-oval and projecting outwards, ocelli flattened-round, the ocellus–compound eye distance less than one-third of the short diameter of the compound eye. Postclypeus raised, about four times as wide as long, the median line distinct; fontanelle elongate-oval, the two forks at the anterolateral sides distinct, with an indistinct small circular spot in front of it. Antennae 15 segments, the second the shortest. Anterior margin of the pronotum nearly straight, raised in the middle, the anterior lateral corners drooping downwards, the lateral margins converging rapidly posteriorly, the middle of the posterior margin shallowly concave.
/species/sinonasutitermes-yui/.distribution: Dongfang, Ledong, Yaxian, Lingshui and Qionghai, Hainan.
/species/sinonasutitermes-yui/.soldier: Head and antennae yellowish brown, nasus reddish brown, thorax, abdomen and legs pale greyish brown; head nearly bare, the tip of the nasus with a few hairs and spines. Large form: head circular and somewhat flattened, 1–1.06 times as wide as long, widest behind the middle, the posterior margin flattened-round; nasus a stout cone, strongly upturned in profile, the angle with the clypeus about 130°, the part of the nasus rising above the top of the head exceeding one-third of the head height, the base of the nasus concave, mandibles with a short apical spine. Antennae 13 segments, the second the shortest, about half the third. The anterior raised part of the pronotum strongly sclerotised and with a median incision. Medium form: head flattened-round, wider than long, nasus shorter than the head, slightly upturned in profile with the tip about level with the top of the head, the base of the nasus shallowly concave, the angle slightly greater than 110°; antennae 13 segments, the second to fourth nearly equal in length. Small form: head circular and slightly long, longer than wide, nasus shorter than the head, upturned in profile with the tip higher than the top of the head, the base of the nasus shallowly concave, the angle about 120°; antennae 12 segments, the second the shortest. Anterior and posterior margins of the pronotum nearly straight.
/species/sinonasutitermes-yui/.worker: Large form: head deep yellowish brown, the T-shaped suture pale on the dorsal surface, the region below the antennal sockets nearly yellow, the anterior lobe of the pronotum close to the head in colour, legs yellow. Head broadly circular, widest near the anterior part at the mandibular base, the fontanelle behind the junction of the T-shaped suture; on the left and right mandibles the posterior margin of the apical tooth is nearly as long as the anterior margin of marginal tooth 1, and the posterior margin of marginal tooth 2 of the right mandible is longer than the posterior margins of the apical tooth and of marginal tooth 1 respectively. Antennae 14 segments, rarely 15. Pronotum saddle-shaped; tibial spurs 2:2:2, tarsi 4-segmented. Medium form slightly paler, head shape and position of the fontanelle as in the large form, antennae 14 segments. Small form still paler, head shape and position of the fontanelle similar to the medium form, antennae 14 segments.

/species/speculitermes-angustigulus/.alate: Outline of the head nearly circular, ocelli and compound eyes both small; postclypeus distinctly raised, its length equal to or less than half its width, the posterior margin arched; fontanelle distinct, situated rather far back; antennae 15 segments. Middle of the anterior margin of the pronotum slightly concave; the posterior margins of the mesonotum and metanotum each with a narrow pointed triangular incision. Wing surface brown; the media of the forewing arising from the radial sector and running close to the cubitus. Tibial spurs 3:2:2, tarsi 3-segmented.
/species/speculitermes-angustigulus/.soldier: Body colour mainly yellowish brown: head yellowish brown, mandibles deep blackish brown, postmentum yellowish brown with darker margins, postclypeus, labrum and antennae pale yellow, pronotum dull yellow, the tergites and sternites of the mesothorax and metathorax and the legs still paler. The fine hairs of the anterior part of the head are dense, becoming sparser posteriorly, the posterior end nearly bare; the base of the mandibles bears short hairs; the thorax and abdomen bear long and short hairs intermixed; the pronotum is sparsely hairy, with long hairs only along the anterior margin, the long hairs of the abdominal tergites rather dense, and the tibiae also bear long hairs. Head broadly cylindrical and very stout, the sides almost parallel, the posterior lateral parts broadly rounded; mandibles stout, each with one marginal tooth.

/species/stylotermes-acrofrons/.soldier: Head of the soldier deep yellowish brown. Head capsule oval-rectangular, the fontanelle projecting like a small hillock. Antennae 13–14 segments, the first slightly larger than the third, and the third about three times the second. Compound eyes very slightly projecting. Labrum semicircular. Apex of the mandibles rather straight and pointed, the basal prominence moderate; the left mandible about 0.66 of the head capsule and about equal in length to the head width. Lacinia of the maxilla with ten marginal hairs. Anterior margin of the pronotum with a broad V-shaped concavity, the posterior margin running in a straight line, median emargination index 12–19%, more than 30 hairs in the middle region, the median line distinct. Hind femur 2.4–2.6 times as long as wide.

/species/stylotermes-alpinus/.distribution: Mount Gaoligong, Tengchong, Yunnan (altitude about 1920 m).
/species/stylotermes-alpinus/.soldier: Head of the soldier deep yellowish brown, the pronotum darker than the posterior part of the head, abdomen pale yellow. Pilosity of the head capsule rather abundant, the middle region of the pronotum with about 30 hairs. Head capsule nearly rectangular, slightly narrowed anteriorly, the fontanelle projecting. Labrum nearly square, the anterior margin nearly straight or faintly concave. Mandibles sabre-shaped, the apex slightly curved; the left mandible about 0.65 times the head capsule length and 0.99 times the head capsule width; the inner margin with extremely fine saw-like traces, with another small tooth below the middle, the mandibular basal ridge steep. Lacinia of the maxilla with about 13 marginal hairs. Antennae 14–15 segments, the third slightly larger than the first and about twice the second. Anterior margin of the pronotum with a broad V-shaped shallow concavity, its centre forming a U-shaped notch, the middle of the posterior margin shallowly concave, median emargination index 21–24%, the median longitudinal line distinct. Hind leg 2.5–2.8 times as long as the femur width.

/species/stylotermes-angustignathus/.soldier: Head of the soldier brownish yellow, the frons slightly darker, mandibles blackish brown and slightly paler at the base, labrum deep yellow, antennae yellow. Pronotum pale yellowish brown with the anterior margin slightly darker, the tibiae and tarsi slightly darker. Head capsule rectangular, the fontanelle a small circular dot, generally not rising above the surface of the vertex; the frontal slope appears rather steep. Labrum semicircular, wider than long, bearing two long hairs and seven or eight short hairs on its surface, the anterior margin with more than ten long hairs. Mandibles sabre-shaped, the apex rather slender and slightly curved, the outer margin smooth and slightly wavy near the base; the left mandible 0.65–0.71 of the head capsule; behind the middle of the inner margin of each upper mandible there is one minute tooth. Antennae 14 segments, the second short and small, the third stouter and longer, about twice the second. Postmentum slender and long, in profile its middle slightly arched beyond the lower margin of the head. Anterior margin of the pronotum rather deeply concave centrally, the angle of the notch about 130°, the lateral margins converging obliquely posteriorly, the surface slightly behind the anterior margin with two V-shaped depressions, the posterior margin narrow and almost without a central notch. Femora rather stout, tibiae rather slender.

/species/stylotermes-changtingensis/.alate: Head of the alate reddish brown, labrum yellow, mandibles concolorous with the head; ocelli pale yellow and transparent, compound eyes purplish brown; antennae yellow; pronotum brown with a brownish tinge, thorax and abdomen yellowish brown and paler ventrally; wings rather transparent and cream-coloured, the costa and radial sector rather strongly sclerotised and appearing brown. Head circular, compound eyes nearly circular and projecting from the sides of the head. Antennae 17–18 segments, the first rather long, the third distinctly short and slender, the fourth again larger. Ocelli melon-seed-shaped, the distance to the compound eye smaller than their diameter. Fontanelle dot-like, situated at the centre of the vertex. Pronotum an inverted trapezium, the notch of the anterior margin broad and shallow, the anterior corners narrowly rounded, the lateral margins slightly arched outwards and almost forming a semicircle with the posterior margin, which has no distinct incision. Wings narrow and long, the part extending beyond the end of the abdomen about half the wing length; in the forewing the radial sector runs very close and parallel to the costa, the media arises independently at the humeral suture, and many weak branches connect the two.
/species/stylotermes-changtingensis/.biology: Specimens collected from Chinese sweetgum (Liquidambar formosana).
/species/stylotermes-changtingensis/.soldier: Head of the soldier reddish brown, labrum pale brownish yellow, mandibles purplish black, eye spots greyish white, the posterior part of the third antennal segment brown and the remaining segments pale yellow; the pronotum faintly brown about its margins, thorax, abdomen and legs pale brownish yellow. Head capsule rectangular, the sides nearly parallel, the posterior margin a weak arc. Labrum almost circular, slightly wider than long, the apical margin bearing a row of about ten long hairs. Apex of the mandibles not strongly curved, the outer margin with a small notch near the base; the left mandible about 0.64 of the head capsule length. Antennae 14–15 segments, usually the second the shortest, the third distinctly longer and second only to the first. Eye spots circular, large and slightly projecting. Fontanelle a small circular dot at one-quarter of the head capsule from the front, its margin raised like a hillock. Postmentum slender and long, the widest part about twice the narrowest, the waist long and nearly parallel-sided. Pronotum broad and very flat, the anterior margin deeply incised in a V, the middle of the posterior margin with a shallow incision, the sides rather straight and converging posteriorly, the median longitudinal line absent.

/species/stylotermes-chengduensis/.soldier: Head of the soldier brown, the operculum of the antennal socket nearly blackish brown, eye spots pale brownish yellow; pronotum slightly paler than the head but distinctly darker than the abdomen. Setae of the frontal region stout and long, becoming slender and short posteriorly; the labrum with five or six pairs of long setae near the anterior margin, the middle pair longer; the anterior margin of the pronotum sparsely setose, the hairs of the middle region short and sparse; the mesonotal and metanotal tergites rather densely hairy; the abdomen rather densely hairy. Head capsule rectangular, the sides nearly parallel, the posterior lateral corners rounded, the inclination of the frontal region 43–45°. Fontanelle small and dot-like, the aperture diameter 0.03 mm, situated at one-quarter of the head from the front. Eye spots hardly projecting. Labrum nearly semicircular, the labral apex running straight; mandibles stout and sabre-shaped, the apex slightly curved, the outer margin almost smooth, each upper mandible with one small marginal tooth behind the mid-point of the inner margin; the left mandible about 0.42 of the head capsule length. Pronotum kidney-shaped, the anterior margin concave, the posterior margin semicircular.

/species/stylotermes-chongqingensis/.biology: Specimens collected from Chinese parasol tree (Firmiana simplex).
/species/stylotermes-chongqingensis/.soldier: Head of the soldier brown with a reddish tinge, strongly shining, labrum yellowish brown, antennae concolorous with the head, pronotum also yellowish brown. Pilosity of the head sparse, the middle region of the pronotum with about 30 setae. Head capsule nearly rectangular, slightly narrowed anteriorly, both broad and thick, the fontanelle rather projecting. Antennae 13–14 segments, the first and third nearly equal, the third about twice the second. Eye spots circular and not projecting. Labrum semicircular. Mandibles sabre-shaped and stout, the apex slightly curved, the outer margin smooth. Lacinia of the maxilla with about ten marginal hairs. Pronotum kidney-shaped, the anterior margin concave in a broad V, the lateral margins steeply inclined posteriorly, the middle of the posterior margin shallowly concave, the median longitudinal line distinct. Hind leg 2.5 times as long as the femur width.

/species/stylotermes-choui/.alate: Body of the alate deep brown, wing membrane greyish white. Head capsule nearly circular, the epicranial suture faintly visible, with a V-shaped raised line in front of the fontanelle. Long diameter of the compound eye about 3–4 times the distance from it to the lower margin of the head. Long diameter of the ocellus about 2–3 times the ocellus–compound eye distance, and the distance from the ocellus to the antennal socket about twice that from the compound eye to the antennal socket. Antennae 17 segments. Lacinia of the maxilla with eleven marginal hairs. The Cu vein of the forewing and hindwing with about 16 branches.
/species/stylotermes-choui/.biology: Specimens collected from a tree known locally as yuchimu.
/species/stylotermes-choui/.soldier: Head of the soldier brown with a reddish tinge, pronotum brown, abdomen pale brownish yellow, pilosity of the head capsule rather abundant. Head capsule rectangular, the fontanelle rather projecting, the compound eyes slightly projecting, labrum semicircular. Apex of the mandibles rather curved and slightly upturned. Lacinia of the maxilla with eleven marginal hairs. Antennae 13–14 segments, the first slightly larger than the third, the third about three times the second. Anterior margin of the pronotum with a broad V-shaped incision, the lateral margins gently inclined posteriorly, the middle of the posterior margin slightly concave, the median longitudinal line visible, median emargination index 12–19%, the middle region rather densely hairy.

/species/stylotermes-crinis/.soldier: Soldier head reddish yellow, the anterior end slightly darker, mandibles nearly black, pronotum pale yellowish brown with the anterior margin slightly darker. Head capsule rectangular, the lateral margins seemingly broadly undulate, the posterior margin almost straight, the posterior lateral angles broadly rounded, slightly constricted behind the middle of the head. Fontanelle minute, a depressed dot, the fontanelle area flat or slightly raised in lateral view. Eye spot indistinct. Postmentum slender and long, widest at about one-fifth from the anterior end, the sides in front of the mentum concavely undulate, in lateral view projecting slightly beyond the lower margin of the head. Antennae 13-segmented, segment 2 shortest and smallest, segment 3 stout and long. The cover over the antennal socket is crescent-shaped and slightly upturned. Labrum semicircular, the anterior margin arcuately convex. Mandibles sabre-shaped, the apices incurved, the outer margin slightly undulate at the base, with a blunt rounded small tooth behind the midpoint of the inner margin. The middle and anterior parts of the head bear numerous long setae; pronotum flat and kidney-shaped, the anterior margin broadly V-shaped, the anterior lateral angles rounded, the posterior margin slightly convex backwards with a slight median notch, the median longitudinal line very indistinct, the surface with long hairs and short down. Femora stout, tibiae slender.

/species/stylotermes-curvatus/.soldier: Soldier head deep brown, mandibles blackish brown, labrum pale brown, pronotum yellowish brown with darker margins, the femora pale yellowish brown, the tibiae and tarsi yellowish brown. The median area of the pronotum has more than 10 long hairs. Head capsule rectangular, the fontanelle pore distinct but almost not projecting. Antennae 14-segmented, segment 3 about twice as long as segment 2; the flange over the antennal socket strongly sclerotised, almost reaching the lateral margins of the head. Compound eyes yellowish brown, rather close to the antennal socket. Labrum subcircular. Mandibles long, the apices very strongly curved, the outer margin slightly concave; the inner margin of the left mandible with very fine traces of serration. Anterior margin of the pronotum broadly V-shaped, with a U-shaped median concavity, the lateral margins gently sloping backwards, the posterior margin inconspicuously concave.
