/species/stylotermes-fontanellus/.soldier: Soldier head brownish yellow, the anterior end slightly darker, labrum yellow at the centre, mandibles nearly black with reddish brown bases, antennae brownish yellow with the terminal segment nearly yellow, pronotum brownish yellow at the margins, abdomen yellow. Head capsule rectangular, the sides nearly parallel, the posterior margin narrow and straight, the posterior lateral angles broadly arcuate; in lateral view the head is flattened. Fontanelle minute, an elongate dot, the fontanelle area almost not raised. Eye spot oval and rather large, not bulging. The cover over the antennal socket is bow-shaped and upturned. Labrum nearly circular, the anterior margin bearing 12 long hairs. Mandibles sabre-shaped, the apices rather strongly curved. Postmentum enlarged anteriorly, the waist long and narrow, the waist constriction index about 0.44. Antennae 14-segmented, segment 2 shortest, segment 3 longest and largest, about 2.5 times segment 2 and hammer-shaped. Pronotum kidney-shaped, rather broad, the anterior margin slightly upturned, the V-shaped notch broad and rather deep, the anterior lateral angles narrowly rounded and projecting slightly forward, the posterior margin broadly arcuate, the posterior lateral angles broadly arcuate, the median longitudinal line almost invisible. Hind femur very stout.

/species/stylotermes-guiyangensis/.biology: Specimens collected from black locust, white poplar and Chinese willow.
/species/stylotermes-guiyangensis/.soldier: Soldier head deep yellowish brown, mandibles purplish brown with deep brown bases tinged with red, labrum and pronotum yellowish brown, legs pale yellow with the tibiae darker. The setae on the head capsule and pronotum are numerous, the median area of the pronotum with about 30 long hairs. Head capsule rectangular, the fontanelle pore distinct but not projecting. Labrum like a flattened square, the anterior lateral corners of the labral apex rounded and the centre straight. Mandible apices rather curved. Antennae 14-segmented, segment 3 strongly sclerotised, distinctly thicker than segment 2, about twice as long as segment 2. The flange over the antennal socket strongly sclerotised, not reaching the lateral margins of the head. Compound eyes pale yellow, their distance from the antennal socket roughly equal to the short diameter. Anterior margin of the pronotum with a V-shaped median incision, the lateral margins steeply narrowing backwards, the posterior margin nearly straight and hardly concave at the centre, the midline visible.

/species/stylotermes-inclinatus/.soldier: Soldier head chestnut brown, mandibles purplish brown, thorax and abdomen yellowish brown, the hairs of the head capsule rather sparse. Head capsule rectangular, the sides parallel, the posterior margin straight at the centre, the frontal slope about 23 degrees. Fontanelle small, pore-like and flat, 0.62 mm from the frontal margin. Labrum semicircular. Mandibles rather robust, the shaft rather slender and straight, the apices slightly curved, the mandibular basal ridge long and moderately inflated. The antennae are broken off, the flange over the antennal socket rather large. The waist region of the postmentum is narrow and long. Pronotum kidney-shaped, the anterior margin broadly V-shaped, the lateral margins joining the posterior margin in a semicircle, the median concavity ratio 9%, the median area with about 6 hairs.

/species/stylotermes-jinyunicus/.alate: Alate head capsule nearly circular, the coronal suture and the fontanelle both indistinct, with several longitudinal striae arranged in three parallel lines in front of the fontanelle. Antennae 13–15-segmented (specimen broken). The long diameter of the compound eye about 3 times its distance to the lower margin of the head. The long diameter of the ocellus about 3 times the ocellus–compound eye distance, the distance from the ocellus to the antennal socket about twice the distance from the compound eye to the antennal socket. Lacinia of the maxilla with 11 marginal bristles.
/species/stylotermes-jinyunicus/.soldier: Soldier head yellowish brown, pronotum slightly paler, abdomen pale yellow.

/species/stylotermes-labralis/.soldier: Soldier head brown tinged with red, pronotum paler, abdomen pale brownish yellow. Head capsule rectangular, fontanelle slightly projecting. Antennae 14–15-segmented, segment 1 slightly larger than segment 3, segment 3 about 3 times segment 2. Compound eyes bulging. Labrum nearly circular, slightly longer than wide; lacinia of the maxilla with 12 marginal bristles; mandibles distinctly curved. Anterior margin of the pronotum V-shaped, with a U-shaped median incision, the posterior margin shallowly concave at the centre, the midline visible.

/species/stylotermes-laticrus/.soldier: Soldier head chestnut brown tinged with red, pronotum chestnut brown, abdomen pale chestnut brown. Head capsule rectangular, fontanelle flat, almost not projecting. Antennae 13–14-segmented, segment 1 slightly larger than segment 3, segment 3 about 3 times segment 2. Compound eyes bulging. Labrum semicircular. Mandible apices rather curved and slightly upturned; the left mandible about 0.67 times the length of the head capsule and 0.105 times the greatest width of the head; lacinia of the maxilla with 11 marginal bristles. Anterior margin of the pronotum broadly V-shaped, with a U-shaped median incision, the posterior margin shallowly concave at the centre, the midline faintly visible.

/species/stylotermes-latilabrum/.soldier: Soldier head brownish yellow, mandibles reddish brown, pronotum yellowish brown, head capsule moderately haired. Head capsule rectangular, the sides nearly parallel or slightly narrowing posteriorly, the dorsal margin of the head rather flat, the frontal slope about 45 degrees. Fontanelle small, dot-like, 0.62 mm from the anterior frontal margin, raised like a small hill. Labrum ligulate, short and broad. Mandibles rather straight, the apices slender and slightly curved, the mandibular basal ridge visible. Antennae 12–13-segmented, segment 2 very short, segment 3 inflated and more than twice segment 2. The upper margin of the antennal socket is expanded into a cover almost reaching the sides of the head. Eye spot visible. The waist region of the postmentum is slender and long, the waist constriction index 0.33. Pronotum butterfly-shaped, the anterior margin broad with a broad V-shaped median concavity, the lateral margins joining the posterior margin in an arc, the posterior margin without a median notch, the median area sparsely haired.

/species/stylotermes-latipedunculus/.soldier: Soldier head chestnut brown, mandibles blackish brown, pronotum slightly paler than the head, head capsule sparsely haired. Head capsule rectangular, the sides parallel, the posterior margin straight at the centre. Fontanelle small, a flat pore, 0.73 mm from the frontal margin. Labrum semicircular. The antennae are broken off, the flange over the antennal socket rather large but not covering the sides of the head completely. The broad region of the postmentum appears to bear a small median elevation, the waist region broad and long. Mandibles stout, the apices rather straight, the mandibular basal ridge visible. Pronotum kidney-shaped, the anterior margin broadly V-shaped, the lateral margins joining the posterior margin in a semicircle, the posterior margin inconspicuously concave at the centre, the median area with 2 long hairs interspersed with a few short hairs.

/species/stylotermes-lianpingensis/.soldier: Soldier head deep brown tinged with red, pronotum paler, abdomen pale yellow, head capsule rather sparsely haired, the median area of the pronotum with about 20 hairs. Head capsule subrectangular, the sides slightly narrower anteriorly, fontanelle slightly projecting, compound eyes slightly bulging, labrum semicircular. Mandible apices slightly curved; the inner margin of the left mandible smooth with a small tooth below the middle, the right mandible with a small tooth at about the posterior third, the mandibular basal ridge indistinct. Lacinia of the maxilla with about 10 marginal bristles. Antennae 14–15-segmented, segment 1 larger than segment 3. Anterior margin of the pronotum with a broad V-shaped notch, the posterior margin shallowly concave at the centre, the median longitudinal line clear.

/species/stylotermes-longignathus/.soldier: Head reddish brown, the anterior margin of the head together with the flange over the antennal socket reddish brown, labrum brownish yellow, mandibles almost black. The antennae themselves pale yellow; from segment 3 onwards the posterior half of each segment turns pale brown to brown, so that the boundaries between segments are distinct. Pronotum pale reddish brown, femora pale yellow, tibiae and tarsi pale yellowish brown, abdomen pale yellowish white. The head is rather densely haired, several long setae around the fontanelle area, the clypeal hairs sparse, the anterior margin of the labrum with 12 hairs in all, the dorsum of the pronotum likewise rather densely haired.

/species/stylotermes-mecocephalus/.soldier: Head yellow, the frontal region brown, the anterior half of the mandibles blackish brown, labrum pale yellow; the flange over the antennal socket and the basal segments of the antennae brown, becoming paler towards the apex, the body pale yellowish white except for the darker margins of the pronotum. Head capsule rectangular and narrow, the lateral margins parallel, the posterior margin broadly rounded. Fontanelle pore very small, about 0.03 mm in diameter. Labrum semicircular, the labral apex bluntly rounded, the labral margin semi-transparent and bearing long setae. The outer margin of the mandibles curves in a broad arc, the apices slightly incurved; the middle to lower part of the inner margin of both mandibles bears a small triangular tooth, that of the right mandible slightly nearer the base; the base of the left mandible has a large process whose anterior notch is nearly a right angle, while the base of the right mandible has a rounded process. Antennae 12–14-segmented, segment 1 equal to or slightly longer than segment 3; the flange over the antennal socket very large, able to conceal the lateral margins of the head completely. The broad part of the postmentum bears punctate sculpture at the centre and is exposed beyond the lower margin of the head in lateral view. The anterior margin of the pronotum is shallowly concave, the posterior margin markedly concave, the lateral margins narrowing backwards, the femora inflated.

/species/stylotermes-mirabilis/.soldier: Head brownish yellow, pronotum dull yellow. The head bears short hairs, slightly denser anteriorly. Head capsule rectangular, the lateral margins parallel, the posterior margin broadly rounded. Fontanelle a small round dot, slightly raised. Labrum broadly ligulate, widest before the midpoint, wider than long. Mandibles stout and straight, the apices slightly curved, the ridge-like swelling at the mandibular base indistinct. Antennae 14-segmented. The waist region of the postmentum is narrow and long, the postmentum about 2.8–2.9 times as long as wide and about 7.47–7.58 times the narrowest part of the waist region. Pronotum kidney-shaped, about twice as wide as long, the anterior margin deeply concave in a broad V, the lateral margins joining the posterior margin in a broad arc, the posterior margin slightly concave at the centre, the median area with about 10 hairs.

/species/stylotermes-orthognathus/.soldier: Head reddish brown, mandibles blackish brown, labrum yellowish brown, pronotum yellowish brown with darker margins, legs pale yellowish brown, tibiae and tarsi darker. The median area of the pronotum bears about 20 long hairs. Head capsule rectangular, the fontanelle pore distinct but projecting scarcely above the surface. Antennae 14-segmented, segment 3 strongly sclerotised and longer than segment 2; the flange over the antennal socket is equally strongly sclerotised and remains far from the lateral margins of the head. Compound eyes pale yellow, their distance from the antennal socket about equal to the short diameter of the eye. Labrum subcircular, the labral apex slightly flattened. Mandibles short, the apices directed straight forward, the length of the left mandible about equal to the greatest width of the head and 0.55–0.61 times the length of the head capsule. Anterior margin of the pronotum shallowly concave in a broad V, the lateral margins sloping steeply backwards, the posterior margin hardly concave at the centre, the median longitudinal line visible.

/species/stylotermes-planifrons/.soldier: Head reddish yellowish brown, labrum yellowish brown, mandibles blackish brown; the flanges over the antennal sockets and antennal segments 1 to 3 reddish brown, becoming paler segment by segment towards the apex; pronotum yellowish brown, abdomen pale yellow. Head capsule sparsely haired, the setae of the median area of the pronotum about 10. Head capsule somewhat rectangular, the sides slightly contracted at the middle and slightly widened again behind, the posterior lateral angles broad and rounded. Fontanelle flat, almost not raised. Labrum semicircular. Mandibles sabre-shaped, the apices curved inwards, the outer margin a broad arc. Left mandible about 0.65 times the length of the head capsule and about 1.10 times the greatest width of the head. Lacinia of the maxilla with about 8 marginal bristles. Antennae 12-segmented, segments 1 and 3 almost equal in length, segment 3 about 2.5 times segment 2. Anterior margin of the pronotum with a broad U-shaped median concavity, the posterior margin almost straight at the centre, the median longitudinal line faintly discernible.

/species/stylotermes-robustus/.soldier: Head capsule chestnut brown with a reddish tinge, pronotum chestnut brown, abdomen pale brownish yellow. Head capsule rectangular, rather glossy. Fontanelle flat, almost not projecting. Antennae 15–16-segmented, segment 1 slightly larger than segment 3, segment 3 about twice segment 2. Labrum nearly square. Mandible apices slightly curved, the lacinia of the maxilla with 9 marginal bristles. Anterior margin of the pronotum concave in a broad V with an additional U-shaped incision at the centre, the posterior margin almost straight at the centre, the median concavity ratio 21–24%, the midline faintly visible.

/species/stylotermes-setosus/.soldier: Head brownish yellow, the anterior end darker in colour, mandibles blackish brown, labrum deep yellow, the small spot where the compound eye lies pale yellow, antennae brownish yellow with segment 3 darker. Pronotum brownish yellow, mesothorax, metathorax, legs and abdomen pale yellow, sternites pale white. The dorsum of the head, thorax and abdomen, as well as the antennae and legs, bear rather stout erect setae. Head capsule rectangular, the sides slightly parallel, the posterior margin broadly rounded. Fontanelle in the centre of the frons, shaped like a small round dot, distinctly raised in lateral view. Labrum oval, the margin slightly transparent, the sides slightly parallel, the anterior end bluntly rounded and projecting forward, length and width almost equal. Mandibles stout, the apices rather pointed and slightly curved, the middle to lower part of the inner margin of each mandible with a minute tooth-like process. Antennae 13–14-segmented, segment 3 the thickest and longest, obconical, segments 2 and 4 almost equal in length. Eyes circular, situated beside the antennal bases at the front of the head, not projecting. Pronotum kidney-shaped, the anterior margin broad and deeply concave, the anterior part broader, the anterior lateral angles rounded, the lateral margins sloping backwards and contracting, the posterior margin slightly concave at the middle.

/species/stylotermes-sinensis/.alate: Head capsule brown, antennae, thorax, abdomen and legs pale brown. Head capsule subcircular and slightly elongate. Fontanelle small, with longitudinal striae in front of it. The anterior part of the frons bears shallow impressed lines. In lateral view the vertex is rather flat, the postclypeus slightly raised and situated lower than the ocelli. Antennae 17-segmented. Compound eyes elongate-oval, prominence about 15%; the distance between the compound eye and the lower margin of the head about one-fifth of the long diameter of the eye, the distance between the ocellus and the compound eye about one-half of the long diameter of the ocellus. Pronotum about 1.75 times as wide as long, the anterior margin shallowly concave in a broad V, the lateral margins broadly rounded, the posterior margin nearly straight and slightly concave at the centre. Forewing longer than hindwing, the forewing 7.4–7.9 mm long and 2.10–2.15 mm wide, the hindwing 7.1–7.4 mm long and 1.9–2.0 mm wide; the forewing scale larger than the hindwing scale, the base of the hindwing scale slightly overlapped by the forewing scale; cubitus comb-like, with about 10 or more branches.
/species/stylotermes-sinensis/.biology: Host plants recorded: Chinese sweetgum, Ficus hispida, Quercus acutissima and Vernicia montana.
/species/stylotermes-sinensis/.soldier: Head reddish brown, mandibles purplish brown, pronotum orange-brown, head capsule moderately haired.
/species/stylotermes-sinensis/.taxonomy_note: The genus name is printed as Srylotermes in the original work, a spelling error for Stylotermes; the genus name currently in use is consistent with this.

/species/stylotermes-sui/.soldier: Head brownish, the frontal region darker, mandibles blackish brown, pronotum pale yellowish brown, abdomen and legs white tinged with yellow. Head capsule moderately haired. Head capsule rectangular, the sides nearly parallel, the posterior margin broadly rounded. Fontanelle pore projecting towards the vertex, resembling a crater. The anterior half of the labrum is semicircular, the labral apex straight, the hairs on the labral margin long and numerous. Mandibles sabre-shaped, stout, the apices slightly curved. Below the midpoint of the inner margin of the left mandible there remains the trace of a small tooth, at the corresponding position on the inner margin of the right mandible there are traces of two small teeth, and the bases of both mandibles bear a large tooth-like process and a notch. Antennae 11–12-segmented, the basal segment and segment 3 of similar length, segment 2 shortest; the flange over the antennal socket cannot reach the lateral margins of the head. Pronotum 1.9–2.0 times as wide as long, the anterior margin broadly concave with a U-shaped centre, the midline visible, the posterior margin semicircular, the median area with about 20 long hairs.

/species/stylotermes-triplanus/.soldier: Head reddish brown, pronotum brown, abdomen pale yellowish brown. Head capsule rectangular, the fontanelle pore large but not strongly raised. Anterior margin of the labrum straight. Mandibles rather slender and straight, the lacinia of the maxilla with 9 marginal bristles. Antennae 13–15-segmented, segment 1 slightly larger than segment 3, segment 3 twice segment 2. Anterior margin of the pronotum nearly straight with a shallow central incision, the posterior margin slightly concave at the middle, the lateral margins sloping steeply backwards, the midline faintly discernible.

/species/stylotermes-tsaii/.alate: Head deep yellowish brown; antennae yellowish brown; anteclypeus nearly white, postclypeus and labrum brownish yellow; pronotum yellowish brown, legs brownish yellow; wing membrane transparent with blackish brown veins; abdominal tergites deep brownish yellow. The head is sparsely covered with short hairs mixed with a few long hairs. Head subcircular in dorsal view, the crescent-shaped antennal bands distinct. Compound eyes subcircular, projecting beyond the lateral margins of the head; ocelli elongate-oval, slightly raised, closely adjacent to the compound eyes but not touching, the distance about half the short diameter of the ocellus. Labrum semicircular, slightly wider than long; postclypeus a narrow transverse band; postmentum hourglass-shaped, longer than wide, the lateral margins arcuately projecting. Antennae 17-segmented, segments 2 and 3 smaller, enlarging gradually from segment 4 onwards, fusiform from segment 8 onwards. Left mandible with three marginal teeth, the first smaller than the third and larger than the second; right mandible with two adjacent marginal teeth. Pronotum narrower than the width of the head including the eyes, the median notch of the anterior margin slightly distinct. Forewing slightly longer than the hindwing, the media arising from the humeral suture and unbranched, joining the radial sector but nearer the cubitus; cubitus with about 16 branches.

/species/stylotermes-undulatus/.soldier: Head yellow, the frontal region brown, the anterior ends of the mandibles blackish brown, labrum pale yellow, anteclypeus white; the flanges over the antennal sockets and antennal segments 1 to 3 brown, becoming paler segment by segment towards the apex. Except for the darker margins of the pronotum, the rest of the body is pale yellowish white in varying tones, the abdomen especially pale.

/species/stylotermes-valvules/.distribution: Jinxiu, Guangxi (altitude 800 m); Guangdong; Fujian; Jiangxi.
/species/stylotermes-valvules/.soldier: Fontanelle pore about 0.06 mm in diameter, like a small hill in lateral view, rising above the surface of the vertex. Labrum semicircular, wider than long, the labral margin semi-transparent and bearing more than 10 long setae. Both mandibles sabre-shaped, rather stout, the apices slightly curved. The middle to lower part of the inner margin of the left mandible bears a small triangular tooth, and at the corresponding position on the right mandible, slightly nearer the base, there is a similar small tooth. Antennae 12–14-segmented, segment 3 rather long and obconical; the flange over the antennal socket rather short, unable to cover the lateral margins of the head. Compound eyes vestigial, faintly discernible behind the antennal socket. Postmentum club-shaped, broad anteriorly and narrow posteriorly, the anterior margin slightly convex, its middle section concealed in lateral view within the outwardly bowed lower margin of the head. Pronotum rather kidney-shaped, the anterior margin slightly upturned, the angle of the median concavity about 150 degrees, the posterior margin rather shallowly concave, the lateral margins strongly contracted backwards. Femora stout and inflated, tibiae slender.

/species/stylotermes-wuyinicus/.alate: Body deep brown, wing membrane pale greyish white. Head capsule subcircular, the coronal suture faintly discernible. Fontanelle pale and depressed, with several longitudinal striae arranged in three parallel lines in front of it. The long diameter of the compound eye about 4–5 times its distance to the lower margin of the head, the long diameter of the ocellus about 4 times the distance between the ocellus and the compound eye. The distance from the ocellus to the antennal socket about 3 times the distance from the compound eye to the antennal socket. Lacinia of the maxilla with 9 marginal bristles. The cubitus of the forewing and hindwing with about 17 branches.
/species/stylotermes-wuyinicus/.soldier: Head deep yellowish brown, pronotum slightly paler, abdomen pale yellow. Head capsule subrectangular, the sides slightly widened posteriorly. Fontanelle slightly projecting. Labrum semicircular. Mandibles sabre-shaped, the apices slightly curved. Lacinia of the maxilla with 9 marginal bristles. The antennae are all broken off, segment 1 slightly larger than segment 3, segment 3 about twice segment 2. Anterior margin of the pronotum with a broad V-shaped notch, the lateral margins sloping steeply backwards, the posterior margin slightly concave at the centre, the median longitudinal line visible, the median area with about 20 hairs.

/species/termes-marjoriae/.alate: Head deep brownish yellow, the antennae, postclypeus, thorax, abdomen and wings paler than the head, the venter of the abdomen palest. The whole body densely haired, the wing surface hairless. Head broadly oval; compound eyes rather large, ocelli small and elongate-oval, very close to the compound eyes; fontanelle in the centre of the vertex, a longitudinal bar-shaped depressed spot; postclypeus very highly raised, the anterior margin straight, the posterior margin semicircular, the length about half the width. Antennae 15-segmented, segments 2 and 3 about equal in length, or segment 2 longer than segment 3, segments 2 and 4 nearly equal. Anterior lateral angles of the pronotum projecting forward, the posterior lateral angles broadly rounded, the anterior margin shallowly concave, the posterior margin concave at the centre. Forewing with the radial sector running close to the anterior margin to the wing apex, the media arising independently at the humeral suture, nearer the cubitus than the radial sector, reaching the wing apex with slight branching, the cubitus with about 12 branches; hindwing with the media arising from the base of the radial sector, the other veins as in the forewing.
/species/termes-marjoriae/.distribution: Jinghong, Yunnan, altitude 500 m; also recorded abroad in Myanmar.
/species/termes-marjoriae/.soldier: Head like a rectangular tube, the lateral margins slightly straight, the posterior lateral angles slightly rounded, the posterior margin slightly curved backwards, the anterior end truncate. The frontal prominence very conspicuous, thick and broad at the base, pointed and rounded at the apex and directed forward and upward; in lateral view this prominence first extends forward and then turns upward. Mandibles symmetrical, slender like pincers, the anterior ends slender and flattened, hooked towards the midline; in lateral view the mandibles first extend forward and upward and then curve downwards, like a bent stick. The inner margin of each mandible bears a small tooth at one-eighth of its posterior section, the tooth apex blunt; behind the small tooth of the left mandible there is a large tooth-like process with a rounded, blunt apex. Labrum subrectangular, the two anterior lateral angles drawn out into needle-like points. Antennae 14-segmented, segments 2 and 3 equal in length, segment 4 shortest or equal in length to segment 2.

/species/xiaitermes-yinxianensis/.alate: Alate entirely dark. Head broadly oval; postclypeus pale, several times as wide as long; fontanelle small, mostly elongate and forked; antennal segments not much elongate; posterior margins of the meso- and metanotum rather widely concave; forewing scale and hindwing scale similar in size; radial vein absent; media and cubitus very close together.
/species/xiaitermes-yinxianensis/.soldier: Small individuals: head yellowish brown, nasus reddish brown, frontal gland tube visible, antennae nearly concolorous with head, pronotum pale yellowish brown with anterior part pale reddish brown, meso- and metanotum and legs yellow, chaetotaxy as in large individuals. Head rather broadly pear-shaped, widest at the mid-posterior part; nasus rounded and tubular, in profile slightly obliquely upturned, vertex slightly convex, a small tubercle on each side of the nasus base; mandibular apical teeth distinct; antennae 13-segmented, segment III longer than II and IV, II and IV about equal in length. Pronotum saddle-shaped, anterior part upturned, the emarginations at the middle of the anterior and posterior margins both indistinct. Tibial spur formula 2:2:2; tarsi 4-segmented. Large individuals: head circular or elongate-oval, nasus projecting from before the frons, tubular or conical, narrow anteriorly and thick posteriorly; head not constricted at the middle, junction of vertex and nasus straight or slightly concave, no constriction behind the antennal sockets; mandibles very small, anterolateral corners blunt, or with a pointed spine projecting; antennal segments not much elongate; labrum extremely short.
/species/xiaitermes-yinxianensis/.worker: Workers also occur in two sizes. Large individuals: head reddish brown, pale T-shaped suture distinct, antennae yellowish brown, pronotum coloured like the antennae, legs yellowish brown, setae on the head sparse. Head somewhat broadly circular, widest behind the antennal sockets, fontanelle circular and depressed, situated just behind the intersection of the T-suture, postclypeus convex; antennae 15-segmented, segment II longer than III or IV; pronotum saddle-shaped, anterior margin concave, median emargination of the posterior margin indistinct. Small individuals: head paler than in large individuals, chaetotaxy the same; head square with rounded corners, postclypeus convex, antennae 14-segmented, segment IV shortest; pronotum saddle-shaped, median emargination of the anterior margin distinct, that of the posterior margin indistinct.

leads.t: Worker gut: mixed segment absent; midgut well developed (length and diameter both conspicuous), visible in situ in dorsal view; junction of midgut and hindgut with 4 lobes (indistinct in some species); without Malpighian tubule knots or false Malpighian tubule knots
Worker gut: mixed segment present or absent; junction of the paunch and the colon (P3–P4) without conspicuous posterior setae; with Malpighian tubule knots or false Malpighian tubule knots
Adult/worker: labrum with a dark sclerotised transverse band; anterior margin of the 3rd marginal tooth of the left mandible (LMt3) less than twice the length of its posterior margin

Adult/worker: labrum without a dark sclerotised transverse band; anterior margin of LMt3 twice the length of its posterior margin or more; junction of P3–P4 in the worker gut with conspicuous posterior setae
Worker gut: dorsal projection of P3b forming 2 loops and leaving the coil from the middle; with false Malpighian tubule knots; mixed segment absent; enteric valve (P2) without spines

Worker gut: dorsal projection of P3b erect and directed posteriorly or forming a single loop, leaving the coil along the margin of the midgut; with Malpighian tubule knots; mixed segment present or absent; enteric valve (P2) with or without spines

Worker gut: gizzard without columnar bands (degenerate type); mixed segment absent; ileum (P1) cylindrical, running as an elongated S along the left side of the abdomen; enteric valve (P2) composed of 6 smooth long pads, each with 1 spine at its apex
Worker gut: gizzard with columnar bands (ordinary type) or without (degenerate type); mixed segment present or absent; P1 variable in shape; enteric valve (P2) variable in morphology

Adult/worker: no distinct notch or depression between the 3rd marginal tooth of the left mandible (LMt3) and the fused first and second marginal teeth (LMt1+2); adult fontanelle slit-like, oval or circular; worker mixed segment (if present) situated outside the midgut loop
Adult/worker: distinct notch or depression between LMt3 and LMt1+2; adult fontanelle not slit-like, indistinct or oval, circular; worker mixed segment (if present) situated inside the midgut loop
Worker gut: paunch (P3) with a caecum or caecal pouch (also present in soldiers and adults)
Worker gut: paunch (P3) without a caecum or caecal pouch

Worker gut: gizzard without columnar bands (degenerate type); caecal pouch situated ventrally; P1 swollen; enteric valve apparatus composed of 6 long pads and 6 smaller intermediate pads, the apparatus weak; usually with small Malpighian tubule knots (Ethiopian region)

Worker gut: gizzard with columnar bands (ordinary type); caecal pouch seen in right lateral view on the P3 projection; P1 tubular; enteric valve apparatus composed of 6 pads, without intermediate pads (Neotropical region)
Worker gut: double mixed segment present or absent; soldier (always present): fontanelle opening at the tip of the frontal process or at the end of the nasus
Worker gut: double mixed segment absent; soldier (rarely absent): fontanelle on the front of the head or at the base of the frontal process (when the latter is present)
Worker gut: double mixed segment present or absent; ileum (P1) dilated. Soldier: fontanelle wide, mandibles functional (Neotropical region)
Worker gut: double mixed segment absent; ileum (P1) tubular. Soldier: fontanelle narrow, mandibles vestigial (cosmopolitan)
Worker gut: P1 tubular and long, forming a loop on the ventral side of P5; P1 inserting into P3 on the right side of the abdomen. Worker mandibles: molar region always ridged

Worker gut: P1 variable in shape (tubular or swollen), without a ventral loop; insertion of P1 on P3 variable; enteric valve on the right or left side of the abdomen. Worker mandibles: molar region ridged or not ridged

Adult/worker: base of the 1st marginal tooth of the right mandible (RMt1) without an accessory tooth, 2nd marginal tooth (RMt2) not as described below. Soldier: present. Worker gut: P1 inserting dorsally on P3 (Ethiopian and Neotropical regions)

Adult/worker: base of RMt1 with an accessory tooth, RMt2 well developed, anterior margin angular, posterior margin curved. Soldier: absent. Worker gut: P1 inserting posteroventrally on P3 (Oriental region)

Worker gut: usually with small Malpighian tubule knots, situated on the inner side of the midgut loop at the insertion of the Malpighian tubules. Soldier: frontal process well developed or extremely reduced
Worker gut: without small Malpighian tubule knots (sometimes with an ampulla). Soldier: morphology variable
Worker gut: P1 (position of the enteric valve) inserting into P3 on the left side of the abdomen
Worker gut: P1 (position of the enteric valve) inserting into P3 on the right side of the abdomen
Worker gut: mixed segment absent. Soldier mandibles: not snapping
Worker gut: mixed segment present

Worker gut: junction of the mixed segment and the ileum (P1) constricted and folded ventrally, forming an acute angle with the anterior apex. Adult/worker: RMt2 directed forward, posterior margin elongated; molar region ridged

Worker gut: junction of the mixed segment and the ileum (P1) arched. Soldier: asymmetric snapping. Adult/worker: RMt2 with both margins subequal, posterior margin slightly concave; molar region smooth or very weakly ridged (Australian, Afrotropical, Palaearctic (China–Japan) and Papuan regions)
Soldier mandibles: piercing (Onkotermes, Neotropical region) or cutting (Microcerotermes, Australian, Papuan, Oriental, Ethiopian and Neotropical regions)
Soldier mandibles: asymmetric or nearly symmetric snapping (Neotropical region)

Worker/soldier gut: P1 swollen or tubular. Soldier mandibles: crushing, piercing, cutting or symmetric snapping (only genera of the Neotropical region have symmetrically snapping mandibles); soldier head pear-shaped, without a frontal process (except Eremotermes and Dentispicotermes), labrum circular or slightly pointed at the apex
Worker/soldier gut: P1 always swollen. Soldier: mandibles snapping symmetrically, head with a distinct frontal tubercle or frontal process; labrum bifurcate

keys.note: This key is translated from Note 2 of the supplementary material of Hellemans et al. (2024); its endpoints cover the 13 families adopted by this site, which differs from the 6-family scheme of the original book (Huang Fusheng et al., 2000). The Stolotermitinae and Porotermitinae of Stolotermitidae and the Psammotermitinae and Prorhinotermitinae of Psammotermitidae are subfamily-level endpoints in the original key; this site has no separate pages for these subfamilies, so they are linked to the page of the family to which they belong and the subfamily name is retained; endpoints marked as 'partim' in the original key are noted in the entry text.
